namespace Infragistics.Win
{
	internal static class ScaledDrawingUtils
	{
		internal const double RADIANS_PER_DEGREE = Math.PI / 180.0;

		internal static double CalculateDistanceBetweenTwoPoints(Point p1, Point p2)
		{
			return Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(p1.X - p2.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(p1.Y - p2.Y, 2.0));
		}

		internal static float CalculateLineYFromX(PointF point1, PointF point2, int x)
		{
			float num = CalculateSlope(point1, point2);
			return ((float)x - point1.X) * num + point1.Y;
		}

		internal static float CalculateLineXFromY(PointF point1, PointF point2, int y)
		{
			float num = CalculateSlope(point1, point2);
			return ((float)y - point1.Y) / num + point1.X;
		}

		internal static PointF CalculatePointOnLine(PointF point1, PointF point2, float percentage)
		{
			return new PointF(point1.X + (point2.X - point1.X) * percentage, point1.Y + (point2.Y - point1.Y) * percentage);
		}

		internal static PointF CalculatePointOnLine(PointF startingPoint, double angle, float length)
		{
			return new PointF(startingPoint.X + (float)Math.Cos(angle) * length, startingPoint.Y + (float)Math.Sin(angle) * length);
		}

		internal static float CalculateSlope(PointF p1, PointF p2)
		{
			return (p2.Y - p1.Y) / (p2.X - p1.X);
		}

		internal static void CenterPoint(ref PointF point, float imageWidth, float imageHeight, SizeF availableSize)
		{
			float num = availableSize.Width / 2f;
			float num2 = availableSize.Height / 2f;
			float num3 = imageWidth / 2f;
			float num4 = imageHeight / 2f;
			float num5 = num - num3;
			float num6 = num2 - num4;
			point.X += num5;
			point.Y += num6;
		}

		internal static void CenterPoints(ref PointF[] points, float imageWidth, float imageHeight, SizeF availableSize)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				CenterPoint(ref points[i], imageWidth, imageHeight, availableSize);
			}
		}

		internal static void CenterRect(ref RectangleF rect, SizeF availableSize)
		{
			CenterRect(ref rect, rect.Width, rect.Height, availableSize);
		}

		internal static void CenterRect(ref RectangleF rect, float imageWidth, float imageHeight, SizeF availableSize)
		{
			float num = availableSize.Width / 2f;
			float num2 = availableSize.Height / 2f;
			float num3 = imageWidth / 2f;
			float num4 = imageHeight / 2f;
			float num5 = num - num3;
			float num6 = num2 - num4;
			rect.X += num5;
			rect.Y += num6;
		}

		internal static void DrawDot(Graphics g, Brush brush, Point p)
		{
			Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(p.X, p.Y, 1, 1);
			g.FillRectangle(brush, rect);
		}

		internal static float GetFontSizeInPointsToFitHeightInPixels(int fontHeightInPixels)
		{
			float num = DpiUtilities.GetSystemDpi();
			return (float)fontHeightInPixels * (72f / num);
		}

		internal static PointF GetPointOnEllipse(RectangleF rect, double angleInRadians)
		{
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return rect.Location;
			}
			float num = rect.Width / 2f;
			float num2 = rect.Height / 2f;
			double num3 = Math.Cos(angleInRadians);
			double num4 = Math.Sin(angleInRadians);
			double num5 = num4 / num3;
			double num6 = num5 * (double)num / (double)num2;
			double num7 = 1.0 / Math.Sqrt(1.0 + num6 * num6);
			PointF pt = new PointF(rect.Left + num, rect.Top + num2);
			double num8 = (double)num * num7 * (double)Math.Sign(num3);
			double num9 = (double)num2 * num7 * num6 * (double)Math.Sign(num3);
			return PointF.Add(pt, new SizeF((float)num8, (float)num9));
		}

		internal static void OffsetPoints(Point[] points, ref Point offSet)
		{
			if (!offSet.IsEmpty)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
				{
					points[i].Offset(offSet);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static double RadiansFromDegrees(float degrees)
		{
			return (double)degrees * (Math.PI / 180.0);
		}

		internal static void RotateRect90DegreesRight(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Rectangle rect)
		{
			int num = referenceRect.Bottom - rect.Bottom;
			int num2 = rect.Left - referenceRect.Left;
			rect = new Rectangle(referenceRect.Left + num, referenceRect.Top + num2, rect.Height, rect.Width);
		}

		internal static void RotatePoints180Degrees(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point[] points)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				RotatePoint180Degrees(referenceRect, ref points[i]);
			}
		}

		internal static void RotatePoint180Degrees(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point point)
		{
			RotatePoint90DegreesRight(referenceRect, ref point);
			RotatePoint90DegreesRight(referenceRect, ref point);
		}

		internal static void RotatePoints90DegreesRight(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point[] points)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				RotatePoint90DegreesRight(referenceRect, ref points[i]);
			}
		}

		internal static void RotatePoint90DegreesRight(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point point)
		{
			int num = referenceRect.Bottom - point.Y - 1;
			int num2 = point.X - referenceRect.Left;
			point = new Point(referenceRect.Left + num, referenceRect.Top + num2);
		}

		internal static void RotatePoints90DegreesLeft(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point[] points)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				RotatePoint90DegreesLeft(referenceRect, ref points[i]);
			}
		}

		internal static void RotatePoint90DegreesLeft(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point point)
		{
			int num = referenceRect.Right - point.X - 1;
			int y = point.Y;
			point = new Point(referenceRect.Left + y, referenceRect.Top + num);
		}

		internal static void FlipPointsHorizontally(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point[] points)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				FlipPointHorizontally(referenceRect, ref points[i]);
			}
		}

		internal static void FlipPointHorizontally(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point point)
		{
			point = new Point(referenceRect.Right - point.X - 1, point.Y);
		}

		internal static void FlipPointsVertically(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point[] points)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				FlipPointVertically(referenceRect, ref points[i]);
			}
		}

		internal static void FlipPointVertically(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point point)
		{
			point = new Point(point.X, referenceRect.Bottom - point.Y - 1);
		}

		internal static Bitmap TrimImage(Bitmap originalImage, Color backColor)
		{
			int width = originalImage.Width;
			int height = originalImage.Height;
			int num = width - 1;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = height - 1;
			int num4 = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < width; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < height; j++)
				{
					Color pixel = originalImage.GetPixel(i, j);
					if (!ColorSelector.IsSameColor(backColor, pixel))
					{
						num = Math.Min(num, i);
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, i);
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, j);
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, j);
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int width2 = num2 - num + 1;
			int height2 = num4 - num3 + 1;
			Rectangle srcRect = new Rectangle(num, num3, width2, height2);
			Rectangle destRect = new Rectangle(0, 0, width2, height2);
			if (originalImage.Size != destRect.Size)
			{
				Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(width2, height2);
				using Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
				graphics.DrawImage(originalImage, destRect, srcRect, GraphicsUnit.Pixel);
				return bitmap;
			}
			return originalImage;
		}
	}
	internal static class ScaledImageDrawingHelper
	{
		private static readonly Size DEFAULT_UNSCALED_EXPLORERBAR_EXPANSION_INDICATOR_ARROWSIZE = new Size(5, 4);

		private static readonly Size DEFAULT_UNSCALED_EXPLORERBAR_EXPANSION_INDICATOR_IMAGESIZE = new Size(7, 10);

		public static Image DrawExplorerBarExpandionIndicator(Control control)
		{
			Size arrowSize = DpiUtilities.ConvertToScaledDpi(control, DEFAULT_UNSCALED_EXPLORERBAR_EXPANSION_INDICATOR_ARROWSIZE);
			Size size = DpiUtilities.ConvertToScaledDpi(control, DEFAULT_UNSCALED_EXPLORERBAR_EXPANSION_INDICATOR_IMAGESIZE);
			Color color = Color.FromArgb(192, 192, 192);
			Color black = Color.Black;
			while (arrowSize.Width % 2 == 0)
			{
				arrowSize.Width--;
			}
			Point[] explorerBarExpansionIndicatorArrowPoints = GetExplorerBarExpansionIndicatorArrowPoints(arrowSize);
			Point[] explorerBarExpansionIndicatorArrowPoints2 = GetExplorerBarExpansionIndicatorArrowPoints(arrowSize);
			Point offSet = new Point(0, arrowSize.Height);
			ScaledDrawingUtils.OffsetPoints(explorerBarExpansionIndicatorArrowPoints2, ref offSet);
			int width = arrowSize.Width;
			int num = arrowSize.Height * 2;
			Point offSet2 = new Point((size.Width - width) / 2, (size.Height - num) / 2);
			ScaledDrawingUtils.OffsetPoints(explorerBarExpansionIndicatorArrowPoints, ref offSet2);
			ScaledDrawingUtils.OffsetPoints(explorerBarExpansionIndicatorArrowPoints2, ref offSet2);
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(size.Width, size.Height);
			using Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
			using Pen pen = new Pen(black);
			using Brush brush = new SolidBrush(black);
			graphics.Clear(color);
			graphics.DrawPolygon(pen, explorerBarExpansionIndicatorArrowPoints);
			graphics.FillPolygon(brush, explorerBarExpansionIndicatorArrowPoints);
			graphics.DrawPolygon(pen, explorerBarExpansionIndicatorArrowPoints2);
			graphics.FillPolygon(brush, explorerBarExpansionIndicatorArrowPoints2);
			return bitmap;
		}

		public static void DrawSortIndicator(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams, bool ascending, Rectangle imageRect, Color color)
		{
			int num = imageRect.Left;
			int x = imageRect.Right - 1;
			int top = imageRect.Top;
			int y = imageRect.Bottom - 1;
			int num2 = imageRect.Width;
			if (num2 % 2 == 0)
			{
				num2--;
				num++;
			}
			int x2 = num + num2 / 2;
			Point[] points = ((!ascending) ? new Point[3]
			{
				new Point(num, top),
				new Point(x, top),
				new Point(x2, y)
			} : new Point[3]
			{
				new Point(x2, top),
				new Point(x, y),
				new Point(num, y)
			});
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawPolygon(((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).GetPen((PenType)0, color), points);
		}

		private static Point[] GetExplorerBarExpansionIndicatorArrowPoints(Size arrowSize)
		{
			int y = 0;
			int x = 0;
			int width = arrowSize.Width;
			int height = arrowSize.Height;
			int x2 = width - 1;
			int num = height - 1;
			int x3 = arrowSize.Width / 2;
			int val = arrowSize.Height / 2;
			val = Math.Max(val, 2);
			float num2 = 1f / (float)DEFAULT_UNSCALED_EXPLORERBAR_EXPANSION_INDICATOR_ARROWSIZE.Height;
			int val2 = (int)Math.Round((float)arrowSize.Height * num2);
			val2 = Math.Max(val2, 1);
			Point point = new Point(x, y);
			Point point2 = new Point(x3, num - val2);
			Point point3 = new Point(x2, y);
			Point point4 = point;
			Point point5 = point2;
			Point point6 = point3;
			Point p = new Point(0, val2);
			point4.Offset(p);
			point5.Offset(p);
			point6.Offset(p);
			return new Point[6] { point, point4, point5, point6, point3, point2 };
		}
	}

				stateAppearances_TreeNode |= TreeNodeStates.Active;

				stateAppearances_TreeNode |= TreeNodeStates.Expanded;
			}
		}

			if ((long)roleState == 16)

	{
		public class CellAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private UltraTreeNodeCell cell;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)cell.UIElement;
					if (uIElement == null)
					{
						return Rectangle.Empty;
					}
					return uIElement.Control?.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.ClipRect) ?? Rectangle.Empty;
				}
			}

			public override string DefaultAction => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_EnterEditMode");

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					return cell.Column.TextResolved;
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent => cell.Node.AccessibilityObject;

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.Cell;

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					UltraTreeNodeColumn column = cell.Column;
					ColumnSettingsResolved settingsResolved = column.SettingsResolved;
					if (!settingsResolved.CanActivateCell(cell.Node))
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Unavailable;
					}
					else
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focusable;
						if (cell.IsActive)
						{
							accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Selected;
							if (((Control)(object)cell.Control).Focused)
							{
								accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focused;
							}
						}
					}
					if (((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Bounds.IsEmpty)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Offscreen;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public override string Value
			{
				get
				{
					return cell.Text;
				}
				set
				{
					cell.Value = value;
				}
			}

			public UltraTreeNodeCell Cell => cell;

			public CellAccessibleObject(UltraTreeNodeCell cell)
			{
				if (cell == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("cell");
				}
				this.cell = cell;
			}

			public override void DoDefaultAction()
			{
				UltraTreeNodeColumn column = cell.Column;
				if (column.SettingsResolved.CanCellEnterEditMode(cell.Node))
				{
					cell.BeginEdit();
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (index == 0 && cell.IsActive && cell.IsInEditMode)
				{
					return cell.EditorAccessibilityObject;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				return 0;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				if ((((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).State & AccessibleStates.Focused) != AccessibleStates.Focused)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (cell.IsInEditMode)
				{
					AccessibleObject focused = cell.EditorAccessibilityObject.GetFocused();
					if (focused != null)
					{
						return focused;
					}
				}
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).AccessibleObject;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return (Control)(object)cell.Control;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				if (cell.IsInEditMode)
				{
					AccessibleObject selected = cell.EditorAccessibilityObject.GetSelected();
					if (selected != null)
					{
						return selected;
					}
				}
				if ((((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).State & AccessibleStates.Selected) != AccessibleStates.Selected)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).AccessibleObject;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
					return null;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
					return ((UIElement)cell.UIElement).Navigate(navdir, new Type[1] { typeof(UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement) });
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
				{
					UltraTreeColumnSet displayColumnSetResolved = cell.node.DisplayColumnSetResolved;
					int num = displayColumnSetResolved.VisibleColumns.IndexOf(cell.Column);
					num = ((navdir != AccessibleNavigation.Next) ? (num - 1) : (num + 1));
					if (num < 0 || num >= displayColumnSetResolved.VisibleColumns.Count)
					{
						return null;
					}
					UltraTreeNodeColumn column = displayColumnSetResolved.VisibleColumns[num];
					return cell.Node.Cells[column].AccessibilityObject;
				}
				default:
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Navigate(navdir);
				}
			}

			private UltraTreeNodeCell GetVisibleSibling(UltraTreeNodeCell cell, NodePosition nodePosition)
			{
				UltraTreeNode sibling = cell.Node.GetSibling(nodePosition);
				while (sibling != null && !sibling.Visible)
				{
					sibling = cell.Node.GetSibling(nodePosition);
				}
				return sibling.Cells[cell.column];
			}
		}

		public Component EditorComponent
		{
			get
			{
				UltraTree control = Control;
				if (editorComponent == null && editorComponentName != null && control != null && !control.Initializing && !((Control)(object)control).Disposing && !((Control)(object)control).IsDisposed)
				{
					try
					{
						UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
						if (Utilities.CanAssert)
						{
							uIPermission.Assert();
						}
						Control editorControlContainer = control.EditorControlContainer;
						Component component = null;
						if (editorControlContainer != null)
						{
							component = Utilities.FindContainedComponentByName(editorControlContainer, editorComponentName);
						}
						if (component is IProvidesEmbeddableEditor)
						{
							editorComponent = component;
						}
						editorComponentName = null;
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
					}
				}
				return editorComponent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != editorComponent)
				{
					if (value != null && !(value is IProvidesEmbeddableEditor))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_ComponentMustImplementIProvidesEmbeddableEditor"));
					}
					editorComponent = value;
					editorComponentName = null;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.EditorComponent);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeEditor() && !ShouldSerializeEditorControl() && !ShouldSerializeEditorControl() && !ShouldSerializeValue())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeAllowEdit();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Activate()
		{
			return node.ActivateCell(column);
		}

		public bool BeginEdit()
		{
			return node.BeginCellEdit(column);
		}

		public bool EndEdit(bool cancel)
		{
			return node.EndCellEdit(cancel);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeAllowEdit())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AllowEdit", allowEdit);
			}
			if (appearanceHolder != null && appearanceHolder.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Appearance", appearanceHolder);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeEditor())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Editor", Editor);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeEditorControl())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "EditorControlName", EditorControl.Name);
			}
			else if (editorControlName != null && editorControlName.Length > 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "EditorControlName", editorControlName);
			}
			Component component = EditorComponent;
			INamedComponent val = (INamedComponent)(object)((component is INamedComponent) ? component : null);
			if (component is Control control)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "EditorComponentName", control.Name);
			}
			else if (val != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "EditorComponentName", val.Name);
			}
			else if (editorComponentName != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "EditorComponentName", editorComponentName);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				SerializeTag(info, "Tag");
			}
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Column", column);
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Node", node);
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		protected UltraTreeNodeCell(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			//IL_01b8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01c2: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0192: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Reset();
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "AllowEdit":
					allowEdit = (AllowCellEdit)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(AllowCellEdit), allowEdit);
					break;
				case "Appearance":
					appearanceHolder = (AppearanceHolder)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(AppearanceHolder), null);
					break;
				case "Editor":
					editor = (EmbeddableEditorBase)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(EmbeddableEditorBase), editor);
					break;
				case "EditorControlName":
					editorControlName = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), editorControlName);
					break;
				case "EditorComponentName":
					editorComponentName = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), editorComponentName);
					break;
				case "Column":
					column = (UltraTreeNodeColumn)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(UltraTreeNodeColumn), column);
					break;
				case "Node":
					node = (UltraTreeNode)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(UltraTreeNode), node);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(info, "Tag");
					break;
				}
			}
			if (editorComponentName == null || editorComponentName.Length == 0)
			{
				editorComponentName = editorControlName;
				editorControlName = null;
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, SerializationFormatter = true)]
		protected virtual void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
		}

	internal class CellNavigator
	{
		private UltraTreeNode node;

		private UltraTree treeControl;

		public LightweightCell NextCell
		{
			get
			{
				CellNavigationManager cellNavigationManager = new CellNavigationManager(node, NavigationDirection.Next);
				if (cellNavigationManager.IsEmpty)
				{
					return null;
				}
				cellNavigationManager.Process();
				int activeCellIndex = cellNavigationManager.ActiveCellIndex;
				if (activeCellIndex < cellNavigationManager.IndexOfFirst)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (activeCellIndex < cellNavigationManager.IndexOfLast)
				{
					return cellNavigationManager[activeCellIndex + 1] as LightweightCell;
				}
				UltraTreeNode nextVisibleNode = node.GetNextVisibleNode(disregardEnabledStatus: false);
				if (nextVisibleNode != null)
				{
					cellNavigationManager.Initialize(nextVisibleNode, NavigationDirection.First);
					cellNavigationManager.Process();
					if (!cellNavigationManager.IsEmpty)
					{
						return cellNavigationManager[0] as LightweightCell;
					}
					return null;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public LightweightCell PreviousCell
		{
			get
			{
				CellNavigationManager cellNavigationManager = new CellNavigationManager(node, NavigationDirection.Previous);
				if (cellNavigationManager.IsEmpty)
				{
					return null;
				}
				cellNavigationManager.Process();
				int activeCellIndex = cellNavigationManager.ActiveCellIndex;
				if (activeCellIndex < cellNavigationManager.IndexOfFirst)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (activeCellIndex < cellNavigationManager.IndexOfLast)
				{
					return cellNavigationManager[activeCellIndex + 1] as LightweightCell;
				}
				UltraTreeNode prevVisibleNode = node.GetPrevVisibleNode(disregardEnabledStatus: false);
				if (prevVisibleNode != null)
				{
					cellNavigationManager.Initialize(prevVisibleNode, NavigationDirection.Last);
					cellNavigationManager.Process();
					if (!cellNavigationManager.IsEmpty)
					{
						return cellNavigationManager[0] as LightweightCell;
					}
					return null;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public LightweightCell FirstCellInNode
		{
			get
			{
				CellNavigationManager cellNavigationManager = new CellNavigationManager(node, NavigationDirection.First);
				if (cellNavigationManager.IsEmpty)
				{
					return null;
				}
				cellNavigationManager.Process();
				if (!cellNavigationManager.IsEmpty)
				{
					return cellNavigationManager[0] as LightweightCell;

		public LightweightCell LastCellInNode
		{
			get
			{
				CellNavigationManager cellNavigationManager = new CellNavigationManager(node, NavigationDirection.Last);
				if (cellNavigationManager.IsEmpty)
				{
					return null;
				}
				cellNavigationManager.Process();
				if (!cellNavigationManager.IsEmpty)
				{
					return cellNavigationManager[0] as LightweightCell;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public bool IsFirstCellInNodeActive
		{
			get
			{
				if (treeControl.HasActiveCell)
				{
					UltraTreeNode activeNode = treeControl.ActiveNode;
					UltraTreeNodeColumn activeCellColumn = treeControl.ActiveCellColumn;
					LightweightCell firstCellInNode = FirstCellInNode;
					if (firstCellInNode.DataColumn == activeCellColumn)
					{
						return firstCellInNode.Node == activeNode;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsLastCellInNodeActive
		{
			get
			{
				if (treeControl.HasActiveCell)
				{
					UltraTreeNode activeNode = treeControl.ActiveNode;
					UltraTreeNodeColumn activeCellColumn = treeControl.ActiveCellColumn;
					LightweightCell lastCellInNode = LastCellInNode;
					if (lastCellInNode.DataColumn == activeCellColumn)
					{
						return lastCellInNode.Node == activeNode;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public CellPosition ActiveCellPosition
		{
			get
			{
				CellPosition cellPosition = CellPosition.Undefined;
				if (treeControl.HasActiveCell)
				{
					UltraTreeNode activeNode = treeControl.ActiveNode;
					UltraTreeNodeColumn activeCellColumn = treeControl.ActiveCellColumn;
					CellNavigationManager cellNavigationManager = new CellNavigationManager(activeNode, NavigationDirection.Next);
					cellNavigationManager.Process();
					int activeCellIndex = cellNavigationManager.ActiveCellIndex;
					if (activeCellIndex == cellNavigationManager.IndexOfFirst)
					{
						cellPosition |= CellPosition.InFirstLogicalColumn;
					}
					if (activeCellIndex == cellNavigationManager.IndexOfLast)
					{
						cellPosition |= CellPosition.InLastLogicalColumn;
					}
					cellNavigationManager.Initialize(activeNode, NavigationDirection.Below);
					cellNavigationManager.Process();
					activeCellIndex = cellNavigationManager.ActiveCellIndex;
					if (activeCellIndex == cellNavigationManager.IndexOfFirst)
					{
						cellPosition |= CellPosition.OnFirstLogicalRow;
					}
					if (activeCellIndex == cellNavigationManager.IndexOfLast)
					{
						cellPosition |= CellPosition.OnLastLogicalRow;
					}
				}
				return cellPosition;
			}
		}

		public LightweightCell AboveCell
		{
			get
			{
				CellNavigationManager cellNavigationManager = new CellNavigationManager(node, NavigationDirection.Above);
				if (cellNavigationManager.IsEmpty)
				{
					return null;
				}
				cellNavigationManager.Process();
				int activeCellIndex = cellNavigationManager.ActiveCellIndex;
				if (activeCellIndex < cellNavigationManager.IndexOfFirst)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (activeCellIndex < cellNavigationManager.IndexOfLast)
				{
					return cellNavigationManager[activeCellIndex + 1] as LightweightCell;
				}
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = null;
				for (ultraTreeNode = node.GetPreviousVisibleNodeAtSameLevel(); ultraTreeNode != null; ultraTreeNode = ultraTreeNode.GetPreviousVisibleNodeAtSameLevel())
				{
					cellNavigationManager.Initialize(ultraTreeNode, NavigationDirection.Above);
					cellNavigationManager.Process();
					if (!cellNavigationManager.IsEmpty)
					{
						return cellNavigationManager[0] as LightweightCell;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public LightweightCell BelowCell
		{
			get
			{
				CellNavigationManager cellNavigationManager = new CellNavigationManager(node, NavigationDirection.Below);
				if (cellNavigationManager.IsEmpty)
				{
					return null;
				}
				cellNavigationManager.Process();
				int activeCellIndex = cellNavigationManager.ActiveCellIndex;
				if (activeCellIndex < cellNavigationManager.IndexOfFirst)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (activeCellIndex < cellNavigationManager.IndexOfLast)
				{
					return cellNavigationManager[activeCellIndex + 1] as LightweightCell;
				}
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = null;
				for (ultraTreeNode = node.GetNextVisibleNodeAtSameLevel(); ultraTreeNode != null; ultraTreeNode = ultraTreeNode.GetNextVisibleNodeAtSameLevel())
				{
					cellNavigationManager.Initialize(ultraTreeNode, NavigationDirection.Below);
					cellNavigationManager.Process();
					if (!cellNavigationManager.IsEmpty)
					{
						return cellNavigationManager[0] as LightweightCell;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

	internal class LightweightCell : IComparable
	{
		private UltraTreeNode node;

		private UltraTreeNodeColumn displayColumn;

		private UltraTreeNodeColumn dataColumn;

		public UltraTreeNode Node => node;

		public UltraTreeNodeColumn DisplayColumn => displayColumn;

		public UltraTreeNodeColumn DataColumn => dataColumn;

		internal LightweightCell(UltraTreeNode node, UltraTreeNodeColumn displayColumn, UltraTreeNodeColumn dataColumn)
		{
			this.node = node;
			this.displayColumn = displayColumn;
			this.dataColumn = dataColumn;
		}

		int IComparable.CompareTo(object obj)
		{
			LightweightCell lightweightCell = obj as LightweightCell;
			if (lightweightCell == this)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (lightweightCell != null)
			{
				return DisplayColumn.Index.CompareTo(lightweightCell.DisplayColumn.Index);
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return base.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal class CellNavigationManager : ArrayList, IComparer
	{
		private UltraTreeNode node;

		private UltraTree treeControl;

		private NavigationDirection navigationDirection;

		public int ActiveCellIndex
		{
			get
			{
				UltraTreeNode activeNode = treeControl.ActiveNode;
				UltraTreeNodeColumn activeCellColumn = treeControl.ActiveCellColumn;
				UltraTreeNodeColumn displayColumnFromDataColumn = activeNode.GetDisplayColumnFromDataColumn(activeCellColumn);
				LightweightCell lightweightCell = ((displayColumnFromDataColumn != null && activeNode != null) ? this[activeNode, displayColumnFromDataColumn] : null);
				if (lightweightCell == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return IndexOf(lightweightCell);
			}
		}

		public bool IsEmpty => Count == 0;

		public int IndexOfLast => Count - 1;

		public int IndexOfFirst => 0;

		public LightweightCell this[UltraTreeNode node, UltraTreeNodeColumn displayColumn]
		{
			get
			{
				if (node == null || displayColumn == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					if (this[i] is LightweightCell lightweightCell && lightweightCell.Node == node && lightweightCell.DisplayColumn == displayColumn)
					{
						return lightweightCell;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal CellNavigationManager(UltraTreeNode node, NavigationDirection navigationDirection)
			: base(0)
		{
			Initialize(node, navigationDirection);
		}

		internal void Initialize(UltraTreeNode node, NavigationDirection navigationDirection)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("node");
			}
			if (node.Control == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("node.Control");
			}
			this.node = node;
			treeControl = this.node.Control;
			this.navigationDirection = navigationDirection;
			Clear();
			UltraTreeColumnSet displayColumnSetResolved = this.node.DisplayColumnSetResolved;
			if (displayColumnSetResolved == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			VisibleColumnsCollection visibleColumns = displayColumnSetResolved.VisibleColumns;
			for (int i = 0; i < visibleColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = visibleColumns[i];
				if (ultraTreeNodeColumn.SettingsResolved.CanActivateCell(this.node))
				{
					Add(new LightweightCell(this.node, ultraTreeNodeColumn, this.node.GetDataColumnFromDisplayColumn(ultraTreeNodeColumn)));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Process()
		{
			switch (navigationDirection)
			{
			case NavigationDirection.Next:
			case NavigationDirection.Previous:
				Sort(this);
				break;
			case NavigationDirection.First:
			case NavigationDirection.Last:
				Sort(this);
				if (Count > 1)
				{
					RemoveRange(1, Count - 1);
				}
				break;
			case NavigationDirection.Above:
			case NavigationDirection.Below:
				if (treeControl.HasActiveCell)
				{
					UltraTreeNode activeNode = treeControl.ActiveNode;
					UltraTreeNodeColumn activeCellColumn = treeControl.ActiveCellColumn;
					UltraTreeNodeColumn activeCellDisplayColumn = treeControl.ActiveCellDisplayColumn;
					Hashtable cellPositions = activeNode.CellPositions;
					Rectangle rectangle = (cellPositions.Contains(activeCellDisplayColumn) ? ((Rectangle)cellPositions[activeCellDisplayColumn]) : Rectangle.Empty);
					if (!rectangle.IsEmpty)
					{
						rectangle.Inflate(-1, -1);
					}
					int count = Count;
					ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(count);
					for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
					{
						if (this[i] is LightweightCell lightweightCell && cellPositions.Contains(lightweightCell.DisplayColumn) && (lightweightCell.DataColumn != activeCellColumn || lightweightCell.Node != activeNode))
						{
							Rectangle rectangle2 = (Rectangle)cellPositions[lightweightCell.DisplayColumn];
							if (!rectangle2.IsEmpty)
							{
								rectangle2.Inflate(-1, -1);
							}
							if ((lightweightCell.Node == activeNode && rectangle2.Top == rectangle.Top) || rectangle2.Left >= rectangle.Right || rectangle2.Right < rectangle.Left)
							{
								arrayList.Add(lightweightCell);
							}
						}
					}
					for (int j = 0; j < arrayList.Count; j++)
					{
						LightweightCell obj = arrayList[j] as LightweightCell;
						Remove(obj);
					}
					Sort(this);
				}
				else
				{
					Clear();
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
		{
			int result = 0;
			try
			{
				if (navigationDirection == NavigationDirection.None)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (x == y)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				Hashtable cellPositions = node.CellPositions;
				LightweightCell lightweightCell = x as LightweightCell;
				LightweightCell lightweightCell2 = y as LightweightCell;
				Rectangle rectangle = (cellPositions.Contains(lightweightCell.DisplayColumn) ? ((Rectangle)cellPositions[lightweightCell.DisplayColumn]) : Rectangle.Empty);
				Rectangle rectangle2 = (cellPositions.Contains(lightweightCell2.DisplayColumn) ? ((Rectangle)cellPositions[lightweightCell2.DisplayColumn]) : Rectangle.Empty);
				switch (navigationDirection)
				{
				case NavigationDirection.Previous:
				case NavigationDirection.Last:
					result = ((rectangle.Top != rectangle2.Top) ? ((rectangle.Top < rectangle2.Top) ? 1 : (-1)) : ((rectangle.Left < rectangle2.Left) ? 1 : ((rectangle.Left > rectangle2.Left) ? (-1) : ((IndexOf(lightweightCell) < IndexOf(lightweightCell2)) ? 1 : (-1)))));
					break;
				case NavigationDirection.Next:
				case NavigationDirection.First:
					result = ((rectangle.Top != rectangle2.Top) ? ((rectangle.Top > rectangle2.Top) ? 1 : (-1)) : ((rectangle.Left > rectangle2.Left) ? 1 : ((rectangle.Left < rectangle2.Left) ? (-1) : ((IndexOf(lightweightCell) > IndexOf(lightweightCell2)) ? 1 : (-1)))));
					break;
				case NavigationDirection.Above:
					result = ((rectangle.Top < rectangle2.Top) ? 1 : (-1));
					break;
				case NavigationDirection.Below:
					result = ((rectangle.Top > rectangle2.Top) ? 1 : (-1));
					break;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal enum NavigationDirection
	{
		None,
		Next,
		Previous,
		Above,
		Below,
		First,
		Last
	}
	internal enum CellPosition
	{
		Undefined = 0,
		InFirstLogicalColumn = 1,
		InLastLogicalColumn = 2,
		OnFirstLogicalRow = 4,
		OnLastLogicalRow = 8
	}

			private FragmentUIAProviderStub GetRelatedLayoutItemUiaProviderStub(FragmentUIAProviderStub layoutItemUiaProviderStub, bool forward)
			{
				UltraTreeNode node = Node;
				ColumnSetLayoutManager layoutManager = node.DisplayColumnSetResolved.LayoutManager;
				GridBagLayoutManager nodeLayoutManager = layoutManager.NodeLayoutManager;
				if (nodeLayoutManager == null || ((LayoutManagerBase)nodeLayoutManager).LayoutItems.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				int num = (forward ? ((LayoutManagerBase)nodeLayoutManager).LayoutItems.Count : (-1));

			}

				return;

						i--;
					}
					else if (index < i)
					{
						InternalRemove(i - 1);
						i -= 2;
					}
					else if (index > i)
					{

					}
				}
			}

				{

				}
			}
		}

			return ((UIElement)this).GetDescendant(type, contexts);
		}

		public override bool SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(Point point)
		{
			if (!AdjustableLayoutItem.SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(point, header: false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(point);
		}

		public override bool SupportsUpDownAdjustmentsFromPoint(Point point)
		{
			if (!AdjustableLayoutItem.SupportsUpDownAdjustmentsFromPoint(point, header: false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsUpDownAdjustmentsFromPoint(point);
		}

		public override void ApplyAdjustment(Point delta)
		{
			AdjustableLayoutItem.ApplyAdjustment(delta, (UIElement)(object)this);
		}

		public override void GetAdjustmentRange(Point point, out UIElementAdjustmentRangeParams range)
		{
			bool flag = ((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(point);
			bool flag2 = ((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsUpDownAdjustmentsFromPoint(point);
			LayoutItemResizeDirection resizeDirection = ((flag && flag2) ? LayoutItemResizeDirection.Diagnonal : ((!flag) ? LayoutItemResizeDirection.Vertical : LayoutItemResizeDirection.Horizontal));
			AdjustableLayoutItem.GetAdjustmentRange(point, out range, (UIElement)(object)this, resizeDirection);
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			if (adjustableArea && AllowSpanResize && UltraTree.GridBagLayoutDragManager.IsInSpanResizeMode)
			{
				captureMouseForElement = (UIElement)(object)this;
			}
			UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)this).GetDescendant(typeof(EmbeddableUIElementBase));
			EmbeddableUIElementBase val = (EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)((descendant is EmbeddableUIElementBase) ? descendant : null);
			Point point = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
			bool pointInEditArea = val != null && ((UIElement)val).Contains(point) && !((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(point) && !((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsUpDownAdjustmentsFromPoint(point);
			CellMouseDownInfo info = new CellMouseDownInfo(e, this, pointInEditArea);
			node.OnCellMouseDown(info);
			return ((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
		}

		protected override void OnDoubleClick(bool adjustableArea)
		{
			if (adjustableArea && column.SettingsResolved.CanResizeCellHorizontal)
			{
				column.PerformAutoResizeHelper((UIElement)(object)this, column.SettingsResolved.AutoSizeMode);
			}
			else
			{
				((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnDoubleClick(adjustableArea);
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanStartAdjustment(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			Orientation resizeDirection = ((!((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(new Point(e.X, e.Y))) ? Orientation.Vertical : Orientation.Horizontal);
			return AdjustableLayoutItem.CanStartAdjustment(e, AllowSpanResize, resizeDirection, (UIElement)(object)this);
		}

		protected override void OnNewDeltaX(int newDeltaX)
		{
			AdjustableLayoutItem.OnNewDeltaX(newDeltaX, (UIElement)(object)this);
			((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnNewDeltaX(newDeltaX);
		}

		protected override void OnNewDeltaY(int newDeltaY)
		{
			AdjustableLayoutItem.OnNewDeltaY(newDeltaY, (UIElement)(object)this);
			((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnNewDeltaY(newDeltaY);
		}

		public override Cursor GetAdjustableCursor(Point point)
		{
			bool flag = ((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(point);
			bool flag2 = ((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsUpDownAdjustmentsFromPoint(point);
			LayoutItemResizeDirection resizeDirection = ((flag && flag2) ? LayoutItemResizeDirection.Diagnonal : ((!flag) ? LayoutItemResizeDirection.Vertical : LayoutItemResizeDirection.Horizontal));
			Cursor adjustableCursor = AdjustableLayoutItem.GetAdjustableCursor(point, AllowSpanResize, resizeDirection);
			if (!(adjustableCursor != null))
			{
				return ((AdjustableUIElement)this).GetAdjustableCursor(point);
			}
			return adjustableCursor;
		}

		public override void OnElementAdjustmentAborted()
		{
			AdjustableLayoutItem.OnElementAdjustmentAborted();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseHover()
		{
			UltraTree ultraTree = UltraTree;
			ToolTip toolTip = ultraTree.ToolTip;
			Rectangle rectangle = ((Control)(object)ultraTree).RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)this).Rect);
			UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)this).GetDescendant(typeof(EmbeddableUIElementBase));
			EmbeddableUIElementBase val = (EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)((descendant is EmbeddableUIElementBase) ? descendant : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				toolTip.Show(rectangle, true, true, true, Rectangle.Empty, false, false, val.Editor, val.Owner, (object)this);
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseHover();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			UltraTree ultraTree = UltraTree;
			ToolTip toolTip = ultraTree.ToolTip;
			toolTip.Hide();
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseLeave();
			if (hotTrackingElement == this)
			{
				hotTrackingElement = null;
			}
			((UIElement)this).DirtyChildElements(true);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseEnter();
			hotTrackingElement = this;
			((UIElement)this).DirtyChildElements(true);
		}

		protected override IRawElementProviderFragment CreateUIAutomationProvider()
		{
			return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)Cell.GetUiaProviderStub()).Provider;
		}
	}

						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[0], isComplete: false);
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_P_UltraTreeNodeColumn_SortType")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public SortType SortType
		{
			get
			{
				return sortType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == sortType)
				{
					return;
				}
				VerifyCanBeModified();
				bool flag = true;
				if (columnSet != null)
				{
					UltraTree control = Control;
					if (control != null)
					{
						columnSet.Sort(this, value, control, clearExisting: false);
						flag = false;
					}
					else
					{
						columnSet.SortedColumns.AddHelper(this, notify: false);
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					SetSortType(value, notify: true);
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_P_UltraTreeNodeColumn_EditorComponent")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(EmbeddableEditorComponentConverter))]
		public Component EditorComponent
		{
			get
			{
				UltraTree control = Control;
				if (editorComponent == null && editorComponentName != null && control != null && !control.Initializing && !((Control)(object)control).Disposing && !((Control)(object)control).IsDisposed)
				{
					try
					{
						UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
						if (Utilities.CanAssert)
						{
							uIPermission.Assert();
						}
						Control editorControlContainer = control.EditorControlContainer;
						Component component = null;
						if (editorControlContainer != null)
						{
							component = Utilities.FindContainedComponentByName(editorControlContainer, editorComponentName);
						}
						if (component is IProvidesEmbeddableEditor)
						{
							editorComponent = component;
						}
						editorComponentName = null;
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
					}
				}
				return editorComponent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != editorComponent)
				{
					if (value != null && !(value is IProvidesEmbeddableEditor))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_ComponentMustImplementIProvidesEmbeddableEditor"));
					}
					editorComponent = value;
					editorComponentName = null;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.EditorComponent);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool ShowEditorButton(UltraTreeNode node, RoleState uiState)
		{
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I8
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I8
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I8
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0077: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I8
			if (settingsResolved != null && !settingsResolved.CanCellEnterEditMode(node))
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (buttonDisplayStyle)
			{
			case ButtonDisplayStyle.Always:
				return true;
			case ButtonDisplayStyle.OnCellActivate:
				return (uiState & 0x8000000000L) == 549755813888L;
			case ButtonDisplayStyle.OnNodeActivate:
				return (long)(uiState & 0x10) == 16;
			case ButtonDisplayStyle.OnMouseEnter:
				if ((long)(uiState & 4) != 4)
				{
					return (uiState & 0x8000000000L) == 549755813888L;
				}
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyCanBeModified()
		{
			if (!DesignMode || CanBeModified)
			{
				return;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_CannotModifyInheritedObject"));
		}

		internal void SetClonedFromColumn(UltraTreeNodeColumn column)
		{
			if (column != null)
			{
				_ = column.ColumnSet;
				_ = ColumnSet;
			}
			clonedFromColumn = column;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetActiveCellAppearance();
			ResetAllowCellEdit();
			ResetAllowMoving();
			ResetAllowSorting();
			ResetAutoSizeMode();
			ResetCanShowExpansionIndicator();
			ResetCellAppearance();
			ResetCellWrapText();
			ResetDataType();
			ResetEditor();
			ResetEditorControl();
			ResetEditorComponent();
			ResetFormat();
			ResetFormatProvider();
			ResetHeaderAppearance();
			ResetIsChaptered();
			ResetKey();
			ResetLayoutInfo();
			ResetMapToColumn();
			ResetMaxLength();
			ResetNullable();
			ResetNullText();
			ResetShowSortIndicators();
			ResetSortComparer();
			ResetSortType();
			ResetText();
			ResetTipStyleCell();
			ResetValueList();
			ResetVisible();
			ResetTag();
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeActiveCellAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeAllowCellEdit() && !ShouldSerializeAllowMoving() && !ShouldSerializeAllowSorting() && !ShouldSerializeAutoSizeMode() && !ShouldSerializeCanShowExpansionIndicator() && !ShouldSerializeCellAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeCellWrapText() && !ShouldSerializeDataType() && !ShouldSerializeEditor() && !ShouldSerializeEditorControl() && !ShouldSerializeEditorComponent() && !ShouldSerializeFormat() && !ShouldSerializeFormatProvider() && !ShouldSerializeHeaderAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeKey() && !ShouldSerializeLayoutInfo() && !ShouldSerializeMapToColumn() && !ShouldSerializeMaxLength() && !ShouldSerializeNullable() && !ShouldSerializeNullText() && !ShouldSerializeShowSortIndicators() && !ShouldSerializeSortComparer() && !ShouldSerializeSortType() && !ShouldSerializeText() && !ShouldSerializeTipStyleCell() && !ShouldSerializeValueList() && !ShouldSerializeVisible())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTag();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void PerformAutoResize(ColumnAutoSizeMode autoSizeMode)
		{
			PerformAutoResizeHelper(null, autoSizeMode);
		}

		public void PerformAutoResize()
		{
			PerformAutoResize(ColumnAutoSizeMode.VisibleNodes);
		}

		internal void PerformAutoResizeHelper(UIElement element, ColumnAutoSizeMode autoSizeMode)
		{
			columnSet.LayoutManager.PerformAutoResize(this, element, autoSizeMode);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (Key == null || Key.Length == 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("Column #{0}", Index);
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("Key: \"{0}\"", Key);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal void InitColumnSet(UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet)
		{
			this.columnSet = columnSet;
			if (SortType != SortType.None && this.columnSet != null && !this.columnSet.SortedColumns.Contains(this))
			{
				this.columnSet.SortedColumns.AddHelper(this, notify: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)0;
			if (propChange.Source is AppearanceBase && HasActiveCellAppearance && propChange.Source == activeCellAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.ActiveCellAppearance;
			}
			else if (propChange.Source is AppearanceBase && HasCellAppearance && propChange.Source == cellAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.CellAppearance;
			}
			else if (propChange.Source is AppearanceBase && HasHeaderAppearance && propChange.Source == headerAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.HeaderAppearance;
			}
			else if (layoutInfo != null && propChange.Source == layoutInfo)
			{
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.LayoutInfo;
			}
			else if (propChange.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId;
			}
			if (propertyIds != 0)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(propertyIds, propChange);
			}
			base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
		}

		internal UltraTreeNodeColumn Clone()
		{
			UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = MemberwiseClone() as UltraTreeNodeColumn;
			ultraTreeNodeColumn.SetClonedFromColumn(this);
			return ultraTreeNodeColumn;
		}

		internal DataColumn GetDataColumn(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (node != null)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor boundPropertyDescriptor = node.GetBoundPropertyDescriptor(this);
				if (boundPropertyDescriptor != null)
				{
					TreeNodesCollection parentNodesCollection = node.ParentNodesCollection;
					IBindingList bindingList = ((parentNodesCollection != null) ? (parentNodesCollection.DataList as IBindingList) : null);
					DataTable dataTable = ((bindingList != null) ? (bindingList as DataView) : null)?.Table;
					if (dataTable != null && dataTable.Columns.Contains(boundPropertyDescriptor.Name))
					{
						return dataTable.Columns[boundPropertyDescriptor.Name];
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool IsNullable(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			switch (Nullable)
			{
			case Nullable.Disallow:
				return false;
			case Nullable.Automatic:
			{
				PropertyDescriptor boundPropertyDescriptor = node.GetBoundPropertyDescriptor(this);
				if (boundPropertyDescriptor != null && boundPropertyDescriptor is IUltraDataColumn)
				{
					IUltraDataColumn val = (IUltraDataColumn)(object)((boundPropertyDescriptor is IUltraDataColumn) ? boundPropertyDescriptor : null);
					return val.AllowDBNull;
				}
				DataColumn dataColumn = GetDataColumn(node);
				if (dataColumn != null)
				{
					return dataColumn.AllowDBNull;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return true;
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			if (layoutInfo != null)
			{
				layoutInfo.InitColumn(this);
				layoutInfo.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (activeCellAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				activeCellAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (cellAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				cellAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (headerAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				headerAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			OnDeserialization();
		}

		bool IAdjustableLayoutItem.SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(Point point, bool header)
		{
			UltraTree control = Control;
			if (control != null && control.GridBagLayoutDragManager.IsInSpanResizeMode)
			{
				if (header && !SettingsResolved.CanSpanResizeHeaderHorizontal)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!header && !SettingsResolved.CanSpanResizeCellHorizontal)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (header && !SettingsResolved.CanResizeHeaderHorizontal)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!header && !SettingsResolved.CanResizeCellHorizontal)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		bool IAdjustableLayoutItem.SupportsUpDownAdjustmentsFromPoint(Point point, bool header)
		{
			UltraTree control = Control;
			if (control != null && control.GridBagLayoutDragManager.IsInSpanResizeMode)
			{
				if (header && !SettingsResolved.CanSpanResizeHeaderVertical)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!header && !SettingsResolved.CanSpanResizeCellVertical)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (header && !SettingsResolved.CanResizeHeaderVertical)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!header && !SettingsResolved.CanResizeCellVertical)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		void IAdjustableLayoutItem.ApplyAdjustment(Point delta, UIElement dragElement)
		{
			if (isSpanResizing)
			{
				isSpanResizing = false;
				UltraTree control = Control;
				Point clientPos = ((Control)(object)control).PointToClient(System.Windows.Forms.Control.MousePosition);
				control.GridBagLayoutDragManager.ColumnSpanResizeDragEnd(clientPos, dragElement, (ILayoutItem)(object)HeaderLayoutItem, (ILayoutItem)(object)CellLayoutItem);
			}
			else
			{
				ColumnSet.LayoutManager.ResizeColumn(dragElement, delta);
			}
		}

		void IAdjustableLayoutItem.GetAdjustmentRange(Point point, out UIElementAdjustmentRangeParams range, UIElement element, LayoutItemResizeDirection resizeDirection)
		{
			LayoutInfo.GetAdjustmentRange(element, point, resizeDirection, out range);
			if (isSpanResizing)
			{
				range.leftRightAdjustmentBar = Rectangle.Empty;
				range.upDownAdjustmentBar = Rectangle.Empty;
				ILayoutItem val = null;
				val = (ILayoutItem)(object)((!(element is UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement)) ? ((LayoutItemBase)HeaderLayoutItem) : ((LayoutItemBase)CellLayoutItem));
				if (val != null)
				{
					range.maxDeltaUp = Math.Min(0, element.Rect.Top + val.MinimumSize.Height - element.Rect.Bottom);
				}
			}
		}

		bool IAdjustableLayoutItem.CanStartAdjustment(MouseEventArgs e, bool allowSpanResize, Orientation resizeDirection, UIElement element)
		{
			UltraTree control = Control;
			if (control != null && control.IsCellInEditMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (control != null && control.GridBagLayoutDragManager.IsInSpanResizeMode)
			{
				if (!allowSpanResize)
				{
					return false;
				}
				isSpanResizing = true;
				bool isDragSpanHorizontal = resizeDirection == Orientation.Horizontal;
				Control.GridBagLayoutDragManager.ColumnSpanResizeDragStart(this, isDragSpanHorizontal, element);
			}
			return true;
		}

		void IAdjustableLayoutItem.OnNewDeltaX(int newDeltaX, UIElement element)
		{
			UltraTree control = Control;
			if (isSpanResizing)
			{
				Point clientPos = ((Control)(object)control).PointToClient(System.Windows.Forms.Control.MousePosition);
				control.GridBagLayoutDragManager.ColumnSpanResizeDragMove(clientPos, element, (ILayoutItem)(object)HeaderLayoutItem, (ILayoutItem)(object)CellLayoutItem);
			}
		}

		void IAdjustableLayoutItem.OnNewDeltaY(int newDeltaX, UIElement element)
		{
			UltraTree control = Control;
			if (isSpanResizing)
			{
				Point clientPos = ((Control)(object)control).PointToClient(System.Windows.Forms.Control.MousePosition);
				control.GridBagLayoutDragManager.ColumnSpanResizeDragMove(clientPos, element, (ILayoutItem)(object)HeaderLayoutItem, (ILayoutItem)(object)CellLayoutItem);
			}
		}

		Cursor IAdjustableLayoutItem.GetAdjustableCursor(Point point, bool allowSpanResize, LayoutItemResizeDirection resizeDirection)
		{
			UltraTree control = Control;
			if (allowSpanResize && control != null && control.GridBagLayoutDragManager.IsInSpanResizeMode)
			{
				return resizeDirection switch
				{
					LayoutItemResizeDirection.Diagnonal => null, 
					LayoutItemResizeDirection.Horizontal => control.SpanResizeCursorHorz, 
					_ => control.SpanResizeCursorVert, 
				};
			}
			return null;
		}

		void IAdjustableLayoutItem.OnElementAdjustmentAborted()
		{
			if (isSpanResizing)
			{
				isSpanResizing = false;
				Control.GridBagLayoutDragManager.ColumnSpanResizeDragAbort();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (layoutInfo != null)
			{
				layoutInfo.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				layoutInfo.Dispose();
				layoutInfo = null;
			}
			if (cellAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				cellAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				cellAppearanceHolder = null;
			}
			if (headerAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				headerAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				headerAppearanceHolder = null;
			}
		}

		internal void HookEditorEvents(EmbeddableEditorBase editor, bool hook)
		{
			//IL_00c7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d1: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (editor != null)
			{
				if (hook)
				{
					editor.BeforeEnterEditMode += OnEditor_BeforeEnterEditMode;
					editor.AfterEnterEditMode += OnEditor_AfterEnterEditMode;
					editor.BeforeExitEditMode += new BeforeExitEditModeEventHandler(OnEditor_BeforeExitEditMode);
					editor.AfterExitEditMode += OnEditor_AfterExitEditMode;
					editor.KeyDown += OnEditor_KeyDown;
					editor.KeyPress += OnEditor_KeyPress;
					editor.KeyUp += OnEditor_KeyUp;
					editor.ValueChanged += OnEditor_ValueChanged;
				}
				else
				{
					editor.BeforeEnterEditMode -= OnEditor_BeforeEnterEditMode;
					editor.AfterEnterEditMode -= OnEditor_AfterEnterEditMode;
					editor.BeforeExitEditMode -= new BeforeExitEditModeEventHandler(OnEditor_BeforeExitEditMode);
					editor.AfterExitEditMode -= OnEditor_AfterExitEditMode;
					editor.KeyDown -= OnEditor_KeyDown;
					editor.KeyPress -= OnEditor_KeyPress;
					editor.KeyUp -= OnEditor_KeyUp;
					editor.ValueChanged -= OnEditor_ValueChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnEditor_ValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{

			if (val != null && control != null)

				UltraTreeNode activeNode = control.ActiveNode;
				UltraTreeNodeColumn activeCellColumn = control.ActiveCellColumn;
				control.ActiveCellEditValueChanged = true;
				CellValueChangedEventArgs e2 = new CellValueChangedEventArgs(activeNode, activeCellColumn, val);
				control.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.CellValueChanged, e2);
			}
		}

		internal void OnEditor_BeforeEnterEditMode(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			EmbeddableEditorBase val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((sender is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? sender : null);
			UltraTree control = Control;
			if (val != null && control != null)
			{
				UltraTreeNode activeNode = control.ActiveNode;
				UltraTreeNodeColumn activeCellColumn = control.ActiveCellColumn;
				BeforeCellEnterEditModeEventArgs e2 = new BeforeCellEnterEditModeEventArgs(activeNode, activeCellColumn);
				control.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.BeforeCellEnterEditMode, e2);
				e.Cancel = e2.Cancel;
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					HookEditorEvents(val, hook: false);
				}
				else
				{
					control.ActiveCellEditValueChanged = false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnEditor_AfterEnterEditMode(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			EmbeddableEditorBase val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((sender is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? sender : null);
			UltraTree control = Control;
			if (val == null || control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraTreeNode activeNode = control.ActiveNode;
			UltraTreeNodeColumn activeCellColumn = control.ActiveCellColumn;
			if (activeNode.CellClickActionResolved == CellClickAction.EditCellSelectText && val.SupportsSelectableText)
			{
				int num = val.CurrentEditText?.Length ?? 0;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					val.SelectionStart = 0;
					val.SelectionLength = num;
				}
			}
			AfterCellEnterEditModeEventArgs e2 = new AfterCellEnterEditModeEventArgs(activeNode, activeCellColumn);
			control.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.AfterCellEnterEditMode, e2);
		}

		internal void OnEditor_BeforeExitEditMode(object sender, BeforeExitEditModeEventArgs e)
		{
			EmbeddableEditorBase val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((sender is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? sender : null);
			UltraTree control = Control;
			if (val == null || control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraTreeNode activeNode = control.ActiveNode;
			UltraTreeNodeColumn activeCellColumn = control.ActiveCellColumn;
			if (activeNode != null && activeCellColumn != null)
			{
				BeforeCellExitEditModeEventArgs e2 = new BeforeCellExitEditModeEventArgs(activeNode, activeCellColumn, e.ApplyChanges);
				control.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.BeforeCellExitEditMode, e2);
				((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = e2.Cancel;
				if (activeNode.Control != null && control.ActiveCellEditValueChanged && !((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel && e2.ApplyChanges)
				{
					((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = BeforeCellExitEditModeHelper(activeNode, activeCellColumn, val);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool BeforeCellExitEditModeHelper(UltraTreeNode node, UltraTreeNodeColumn column, EmbeddableEditorBase editor)
		{
			TreeNodesCollection parentNodesCollection = node.ParentNodesCollection;
			if (node.ListObject != null && parentNodesCollection != null && parentNodesCollection.IsDataSourceDisposing)
			{
				return true;
			}
			UltraTree control = node.Control;
			bool result = false;
			string message = string.Empty;
			Exception exception = null;
			object newValue = (editor.IsValid ? editor.Value : editor.CurrentEditText);
			bool flag = ValidateCellContents(editor, out exception, out message);
			bool flag2 = flag && !node.VerifyNullCellValue(this, newValue);
			if (flag2)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				node.VerifyNullCellValue(this, newValue, out newValue);
				try
				{
					node.SetPendingCellValue(column, newValue);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					flag = false;
					exception = ex;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				CellValidationErrorEventArgs e = new CellValidationErrorEventArgs(node, column);
				control.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.CellValidationError, e);
				if (e.RaiseDataErrorEvent)
				{
					object invalidValue = newValue;
					if (flag2)
					{
						string text = TextResolved;
						if (text.Length == 0)
						{
							text = Index.ToString();
						}
						message = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ViolatesNullable_Error_Message", text);
					}
					DataErrorEventArgs e2 = new DataErrorEventArgs(node, column, exception, invalidValue, message);
					control.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.DataError, e2);
					if (e2.DisplayMessageBox)
					{
						UltraMessageBoxManager.Show(e2.ErrorTextResolved, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataError_MessageBox_Title"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk);
					}
				}
				if (e.RestoreOriginalValue)
				{
					editor.Value = node.GetCellValueHelper(column, useEditorValueWhenInEditMode: false);
				}
				if (e.StayInEditMode && editor.SupportsSelectableText)
				{
					editor.SelectionStart = 0;
					editor.SelectionLength = editor.CurrentEditText.Length;
				}
				if (e.StayInEditMode)
				{
					result = true;
					if (editor.CanFocus)
					{
						editor.Focus();
					}
					if (node != null && control != null && control.UIElement != null)
					{
						((UIElement)control.UIElement).DirtyChildElements(false);
						((UIElement)control.UIElement).VerifyChildElements();
						((Control)(object)control).Refresh();
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void OnEditor_AfterExitEditMode(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			EmbeddableEditorBase val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((sender is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? sender : null);
			UltraTree control = Control;
			if (val != null && control != null)
			{
				UltraTreeNode activeNode = control.ActiveNode;
				UltraTreeNodeColumn activeCellColumn = control.ActiveCellColumn;
				HookEditorEvents(val, hook: false);
				AfterCellExitEditModeEventArgs e2 = new AfterCellExitEditModeEventArgs(activeNode, activeCellColumn);
				control.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.AfterCellExitEditMode, e2);
			}
		}

		private bool ValidateCellContents(EmbeddableEditorBase editor, out Exception exception, out string message)
		{
			if (editor != null)
			{
				_ = editor.IsInEditMode;
			}
			message = string.Empty;
			exception = null;
			object obj = null;
			bool result = true;
			try
			{
				string text = default(string);
				if (editor.IsValidValue(ref text))
				{
					obj = editor.Value;
					obj = ((obj == null) ? DBNull.Value : obj);
				}
				else
				{
					message = text;
					obj = editor.CurrentEditText;
					result = false;
				}
			}
			catch (DataFilterException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				exception = ex2;
			}
			UltraTreeNode node = Control?.ActiveNode;
			if (ConvertValueToDataType(node, obj, out message) == null)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal object ConvertValueToDataType(UltraTreeNode node, object valueToConvert, out string message)
		{
			message = string.Empty;
			if (DataType == typeof(object))
			{
				if (valueToConvert != null)
				{
					return valueToConvert;
				}
				return DBNull.Value;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			object obj = null;
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = node?.GetBoundPropertyDescriptor(this);
			if (valueToConvert is DBNull)
			{
				obj = valueToConvert;
			}
			else if (propertyDescriptor == null)
			{
				if (valueToConvert != null && valueToConvert.GetType() == DataType)
				{
					obj = valueToConvert;
				}
				if (obj == null)
				{
					try
					{
						obj = Convert.ChangeType(valueToConvert, DataType, FormatProvider);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (obj == null)
				{
					try
					{
						obj = Convert.ChangeType(valueToConvert, DataType);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (valueToConvert != null && valueToConvert.GetType() == propertyDescriptor.PropertyType)
				{
					obj = valueToConvert;
				}
				else if (valueToConvert != null && propertyDescriptor.PropertyType != null && propertyDescriptor.PropertyType.IsInstanceOfType(valueToConvert))
				{
					obj = valueToConvert;
				}
				else if (valueToConvert is string || DataType == typeof(string) || (valueToConvert != null && propertyDescriptor.Converter.CanConvertFrom(valueToConvert.GetType())))
				{
					try
					{
						obj = propertyDescriptor.Converter.ConvertFrom(null, FormatProvider as CultureInfo, valueToConvert);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (obj == null)
				{
					try
					{
						obj = Convert.ChangeType(valueToConvert, DataType, FormatProvider);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (obj == null)
				{
					try
					{
						obj = propertyDescriptor.Converter.ConvertFrom(valueToConvert);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (obj == null)
				{
					try
					{
						obj = Convert.ChangeType(valueToConvert, DataType);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				string text = ((valueToConvert != null) ? valueToConvert.GetType().ToString() : "(null)");
				Type type = ((propertyDescriptor != null) ? propertyDescriptor.PropertyType : DataType);
				message = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorUnableToConvert", text, type);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeEditorComponent()
		{
			return editorComponent != null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetEditorComponent()
		{
			EditorComponent = null;
		}

		{

			{

		internal EmbeddableEditorBase GetEditor(UltraTreeNodeCell cell)
		{
			if (cell != null)
			{

				{
					return cell.Editor;

		}

		internal bool CanCellEnterEditMode(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			EmbeddableEditorBase val = null;
			if (node.HasCells && node.Cells.HasCell(column))
			{
				val = GetEditor(node.Cells[column]);
				if (val != null && !val.CanEditType(column.DataType))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (node.Cells[column].AllowEdit != AllowCellEdit.Default)
				{
					if (node.Cells[column].AllowEdit == AllowCellEdit.Full || node.Cells[column].AllowEdit == AllowCellEdit.ReadOnly)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				val = Editor;
				if (val != null && !val.CanEditType(column.DataType))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (node.AllowCellEdit != AllowCellEdit.Default)
			{
				if (node.AllowCellEdit == AllowCellEdit.Full || node.AllowCellEdit == AllowCellEdit.ReadOnly)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			AllowCellEdit allowCellEdit = AllowCellEdit;
			if (allowCellEdit != AllowCellEdit.Full)
			{
				return allowCellEdit == AllowCellEdit.ReadOnly;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool IsCellReadOnly(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (node.HasCells && node.Cells.HasCell(column) && node.Cells[column].AllowEdit != AllowCellEdit.Default)
			{
				AllowCellEdit allowEdit = node.Cells[column].AllowEdit;
				if (allowEdit == AllowCellEdit.ReadOnly)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (node.AllowCellEdit != AllowCellEdit.Default)
			{
				if (node.AllowCellEdit == AllowCellEdit.ReadOnly)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (column.AllowCellEdit == AllowCellEdit.Default)
			{
				DataColumn dataColumn = column.GetDataColumn(node);
				if (dataColumn != null && dataColumn.ReadOnly)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			AllowCellEdit allowCellEdit = AllowCellEdit;
			return allowCellEdit == AllowCellEdit.ReadOnly;
		}

		internal bool IsCellEnabled(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			UltraTree control = column.Control;
			if (control != null && !((Control)(object)control).Enabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (node == null || !node.EnabledResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (control != null && control.IsViewStyleOutlookExpress)
			{
				UltraTreeNodeColumn dataColumnFromDisplayColumn = node.GetDataColumnFromDisplayColumn(column, allowNull: true);
				if (dataColumnFromDisplayColumn == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (node.HasCells && node.Cells.HasCell(column) && node.Cells[column].AllowEdit != AllowCellEdit.Default)
			{
				AllowCellEdit allowEdit = node.Cells[column].AllowEdit;
				if (allowEdit == AllowCellEdit.Disabled)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (node.AllowCellEdit != AllowCellEdit.Default)
			{
				if (node.AllowCellEdit == AllowCellEdit.Disabled)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			AllowCellEdit allowCellEdit = AllowCellEdit;
			return allowCellEdit != AllowCellEdit.Disabled;
		}

		internal bool CanActivateCell(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			return IsCellEnabled(node);
		}

		private ImageUIElement GetImageUIElement(UIElementsCollection oldElements, ref AppearanceData appData)
		{
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_010d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0113: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0116: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_011c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_015c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0162: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0165: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_016b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			UltraTree ultraTree = UltraTree;
			Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).GetImage(ultraTree.ImageList);
			if (image == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			Size imagePadding = column.Metrics.HeaderMetrics.ImagePadding;
			object obj = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(ImageUIElement), true);
			ImageUIElement val = (ImageUIElement)((obj is ImageUIElement) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				val = new ImageUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, image);
			}
			else
			{
				((ImageUIElementBase)val).Image = image;
			}
			Size columnHeaderImageSize = column.SettingsResolved.ColumnHeaderImageSize;
			if (columnHeaderImageSize.Width == 0 || columnHeaderImageSize.Height == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = columnHeaderImageSize.Width / columnHeaderImageSize.Height;
			columnHeaderImageSize.Height = Math.Min(columnHeaderImageSize.Height, rectInsideBorders.Height - imagePadding.Height * 2);
			if (columnHeaderImageSize.Height < image.Height)
			{
				columnHeaderImageSize.Height = (int)((double)columnHeaderImageSize.Width / num);

		internal class OriginXSortComparer : IComparer
		{
			int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = x as UltraTreeNodeColumn;
				UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn2 = y as UltraTreeNodeColumn;
				if (ultraTreeNodeColumn == ultraTreeNodeColumn2)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (ultraTreeNodeColumn == null && ultraTreeNodeColumn2 == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (ultraTreeNodeColumn == null && ultraTreeNodeColumn2 != null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (ultraTreeNodeColumn != null && ultraTreeNodeColumn2 == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				int originX = ultraTreeNodeColumn.LayoutInfo.OriginX;
				originX = ((originX >= 0) ? originX : ultraTreeNodeColumn.Index);
				int originX2 = ultraTreeNodeColumn2.LayoutInfo.OriginX;
				originX2 = ((originX2 >= 0) ? originX2 : ultraTreeNodeColumn2.Index);
				return originX.CompareTo(originX2);
			}
		}

				return;

			List.Clear();

			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(columns.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)

			UltraTreeNodeColumn[] c = arrayList.ToArray(typeof(UltraTreeNodeColumn)) as UltraTreeNodeColumn[];
			List.AddRange(c);
			List.Sort(new OriginXSortComparer());
			version = columnSet.VisibleColumnsVersion;
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Editor(typeof(UltraTreeNodeTextColumnTypeEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(TypeConverter))]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_P_UltraTreeColumnSet_NodeTextColumn")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public UltraTreeNodeColumn NodeTextColumn
		{
			get
			{
				if (nodeTextColumnIndex != -1)
				{
					TreeColumnsCollection treeColumnsCollection = (HasColumns ? Columns : null);
					if (treeColumnsCollection != null)
					{
						if (nodeTextColumnIndex >= 0 && nodeTextColumnIndex < treeColumnsCollection.Count)
						{
							nodeTextColumn = treeColumnsCollection[nodeTextColumnIndex];
						}
						nodeTextColumnIndex = -1;
					}
				}
				return nodeTextColumn;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != nodeTextColumn)
				{
					VerifyCanBeModified();
					TreeColumnsCollection treeColumnsCollection = (HasColumns ? Columns : null);
					if (value != null && (treeColumnsCollection == null || !treeColumnsCollection.Contains(value)))
					{
						throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LD_Exception_UltraTreeNodeColumnSet_NodeTextColumn"));
					}
					nodeTextColumn = value;
					nodeTextColumnIndex = -1;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.NodeTextColumn);
				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public int NodeTextColumnIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (NodeTextColumn != null)
				{
					return NodeTextColumn.Index;
				}
				return nodeTextColumnIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				nodeTextColumnIndex = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool Inherited
		{
			get
			{
				return inherited;
			}
			set
			{
				inherited = value;
				if (owningControl == null || columns == null || columns.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (UltraTreeNodeColumn column in columns)
				{
					column.Inherited = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal UltraTreeColumnSet(bool isAutoGenerated)
