		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)0;
			if (propChange.Source is AppearanceBase && HasActiveCellAppearance && propChange.Source == activeCellAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.ActiveCellAppearance;
			}
			else if (propChange.Source is AppearanceBase && HasCellAppearance && propChange.Source == cellAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.CellAppearance;
			}
			else if (propChange.Source is AppearanceBase && HasColumnHeaderAppearance && propChange.Source == columnHeaderAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.ColumnHeaderAppearance;
			}
			else if (propChange.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId;
			}
			PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo = propChange.FindTrigger(null);
			if (propChangeInfo.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				PropertyIds propertyIds2 = (PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId;
				if (propertyIds2 == PropertyIds.Visible || propertyIds2 == PropertyIds.IsChaptered || propertyIds2 == PropertyIds.Columns)
				{
					BumpListColumnsVersion();
				}
			}
			if (propertyIds != 0)
			{
				if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.Visible || propertyIds == PropertyIds.OriginX || propertyIds == PropertyIds.OriginY || propertyIds == PropertyIds.Columns)
				{
					BumpVisibleColumnsVersion();
				}
				NotifyPropChange(propertyIds, propChange);
			}
			base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
		}

		internal bool CanMergeAdjacentBorders(UIElementBorderStyle borderStyle1, UIElementBorderStyle borderStyle2)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!CanMergeAdjacentBorders(borderStyle1))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (borderStyle1 == borderStyle2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return CanMergeAdjacentBorders(borderStyle2);
		}

		internal bool CanMergeAdjacentBorders(UIElementBorderStyle borderStyle)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			UltraTree control = Control;
			bool result = control != null && ((UltraControlBase)control).UseFlatModeResolved;
			switch ((int)borderStyle)
			{
			case 4:
				return true;
			case 5:
			case 6:
			case 7:
			case 8:
				return result;
			case 0:
			case 2:
			case 3:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal void Sort(UltraTreeNodeColumn column, SortType sortType, UltraTree treeControl, bool clearExisting)
		{
			Sort(column, sortType, SortedColumns.Count, treeControl, clearExisting);
		}

		internal void Sort(UltraTreeNodeColumn column, SortType sortType, int index, UltraTree treeControl, bool clearExisting)
		{
			if (treeControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (clearExisting)
			{
				index = 0;
			}
			SortedColumnsCollection sortedColumnsCollection = SortedColumns.Clone();
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable(sortedColumnsCollection.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < sortedColumnsCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				hashtable.Add(sortedColumnsCollection[i], sortedColumnsCollection[i].SortType);
			}
			if (clearExisting)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < sortedColumnsCollection.Count; j++)
				{
					UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = sortedColumnsCollection[j];
					if (ultraTreeNodeColumn.ClonedFromColumn != column)
					{
						ultraTreeNodeColumn.SetSortType(SortType.None, notify: true);
					}
				}
				sortedColumnsCollection.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn2 = null;
				for (int k = 0; k < sortedColumnsCollection.Count; k++)
				{
					if (sortedColumnsCollection[k].ClonedFromColumn == column)
					{
						ultraTreeNodeColumn2 = sortedColumnsCollection[k];
						break;
					}
				}
				if (ultraTreeNodeColumn2 != null)
				{
					sortedColumnsCollection.Remove(ultraTreeNodeColumn2);
				}
			}
			UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn3 = column.Clone();
			ultraTreeNodeColumn3.SetSortType(sortType, notify: false);
			index = Math.Min(index, sortedColumnsCollection.Count);
			switch (ultraTreeNodeColumn3.SortType)
			{
			case SortType.Ascending:
			case SortType.Descending:
				sortedColumnsCollection.InsertHelper(index, ultraTreeNodeColumn3, notify: false);
				break;
			}
			BeforeSortChangeEventArgs e = new BeforeSortChangeEventArgs(sortedColumnsCollection);
			treeControl.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.BeforeSortChange, e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				if (clearExisting)
				{
					for (int l = 0; l < SortedColumns.Count; l++)
					{
						if (SortedColumns[l] != column)
						{
							SortedColumns[l].SetSortType(SortType.None, notify: true);
						}
					}
				}
				SortedColumns.InitializeFrom(sortedColumnsCollection);
				DirtySortForAssociatedNodesCollections(treeControl);
				treeControl.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.AfterSortChange, new AfterSortChangeEventArgs(sortedColumnsCollection));
				return;
			}
			sortedColumnsCollection = SortedColumns;
			for (int m = 0; m < sortedColumnsCollection.Count; m++)
			{
				UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn4 = sortedColumnsCollection[m];
				if (hashtable.ContainsKey(ultraTreeNodeColumn4))
				{
					ultraTreeNodeColumn4.SetSortType((SortType)hashtable[sortedColumnsCollection[m]], notify: false);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void DirtySortForAssociatedNodesCollections(UltraTree treeControl)
		{
			if (treeControl != null && treeControl.ViewStyleResolved == ViewStyle.OutlookExpress && sortedColumns != null)
			{
				sortedColumns.BumpVersion();
				return;
			}
			ArrayList list = new ArrayList(50);
			treeControl.GetAssociatedNodesCollections(ref list, null, this, includeDescendantsOfCollapsedNodes: true);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection = list[i] as TreeNodesCollection;
				treeNodesCollection.DirtyColumnSortVersion();
			}
			if (treeControl != null && list.Count > 0)
			{
				treeControl.VisibleNodesManager.VerifyScrollBoundsForTopNode();
			}
		}

		internal void BumpColumnsCollectionVersion()
		{
			if (columnsCollectionVersion == int.MaxValue)
			{
				columnsCollectionVersion = int.MinValue;
			}
			else
			{
				columnsCollectionVersion++;
			}
			if (columnsCollectionVersion == 0)
			{
				columnsCollectionVersion++;
			}
		}

		internal UltraTreeNodeColumn DataColumnFromDisplayColumn(UltraTreeColumnSet dataColumnSet, UltraTreeNodeColumn displayColumn)
		{
			UltraTreeColumnSet ultraTreeColumnSet = columnSet;
			if (ultraTreeColumnSet == dataColumnSet)
			{
				return displayColumn;
			}

			}

			{
				version = num;
				dataColumnSets.Clear();
			}
			Dictionary<UltraTreeNodeColumn, UltraTreeNodeColumn> dictionary = null;
			if (!dataColumnSets.ContainsKey(dataColumnSet))
			{
				dictionary = new Dictionary<UltraTreeNodeColumn, UltraTreeNodeColumn>();
				dataColumnSets.Add(dataColumnSet, dictionary);
			}
			else
			{
				dictionary = dataColumnSets[dataColumnSet];
			}
			UltraTreeNodeColumn value = null;

			{
				return value;
			}
			VisibleColumnsCollection visibleColumns = ultraTreeColumnSet.VisibleColumns;
			TreeColumnsCollection columns = dataColumnSet.Columns;
			string key = displayColumn.Key;
			if (key != null && key.Length > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = columns[i];
					if (!ultraTreeNodeColumn.IsChaptered)
					{

						{

							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}

				{

				}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public override bool IsReadOnly => false;

		internal ColumnSetsCollection(int initialCapacity)
		{
			this.initialCapacity = initialCapacity;
		}

		internal ColumnSetsCollection(UltraTree owningControl)
		{
			this.owningControl = owningControl;
		}

		protected ColumnSetsCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Value is UltraTreeColumnSet)
				{
					UltraTreeColumnSet ultraTreeColumnSet = (UltraTreeColumnSet)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(UltraTreeColumnSet), null);
					if (ultraTreeColumnSet != null)
					{
						List.Add(ultraTreeColumnSet);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(info, "Tag");
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			return AddHelper(columnSet, notify: true);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			if (!(value is UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			InsertHelper(index, columnSet, notify: true);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			RemoveHelper(columnSet, notify: true);
		}

		public int Add(UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet)
		{
			return AddHelper(columnSet, notify: true);
		}

		public UltraTreeColumnSet Add(string key)
		{
			UltraTreeColumnSet ultraTreeColumnSet = new UltraTreeColumnSet(owningControl, key);
			AddHelper(ultraTreeColumnSet, notify: true);
			return ultraTreeColumnSet;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet)
		{
			InsertHelper(index, columnSet, notify: true);
		}

		public void Remove(UltraTreeColumnSet value)
		{
			value.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalRemove(value);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ColumnSets, null);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			Remove(this[index]);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (Control != null)
			{
				for (int num = Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					RemoveHelper(this[num], notify: false);
				}
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ColumnSets);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public ColumnSetEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new ColumnSetEnumerator(this);
		}

		internal void InitControl(UltraTree control)
		{
			owningControl = control;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeColumnSet ultraTreeColumnSet = this[i];
				ultraTreeColumnSet.InitControl(control);
			}
		}

		internal int AddHelper(UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet, bool notify)
		{
			InsertHelper(Count, columnSet, notify);
			return Count - 1;
		}

		private void InsertHelper(int index, UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet, bool notify)
		{
			if (owningControl != null && owningControl.Initializing)
			{
				int num = IndexOf(columnSet.Key);
				if (num >= 0 && this[num].Inherited)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			InternalInsert(index, columnSet);
			columnSet.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			columnSet.InitControl(owningControl);
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ColumnSets);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveHelper(UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet, bool notify)
		{
			columnSet.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalRemove(columnSet);
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ColumnSets);
			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (Count <= 0)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTag();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ColumnSets, propChangeInfo);
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeColumnSet ultraTreeColumnSet = this[i];
				ultraTreeColumnSet.InitControl(owningControl);
				ultraTreeColumnSet.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			OnDeserialization();
		}

		protected virtual void OnDeserialization()
		{
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains(value);
		}
	}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[Editor(typeof(UltraTreeColumnSetTypeEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_P_UltraTreeColumnSettings_RootColumnSet")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public UltraTreeColumnSet RootColumnSet
		{
			get
			{
				if (rootColumnSetIndex != -1)
				{
					ColumnSetsCollection columnSetsCollection = (HasColumnSets ? ColumnSets : null);
					if (columnSetsCollection != null)
					{
						if (rootColumnSetIndex >= 0 && rootColumnSetIndex < columnSetsCollection.Count)
						{
							rootColumnSet = columnSetsCollection[rootColumnSetIndex];
						}
						rootColumnSetIndex = -1;
					}
				}
				if (rootColumnSet == null)
				{
					rootColumnSet = new UltraTreeColumnSet(Control);
					rootColumnSet.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				if (rootColumnSet.Control == null)
				{
					rootColumnSet.InitControl(Control);
				}
				return rootColumnSet;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != rootColumnSet)
				{
					if (rootColumnSet != null)
					{
						rootColumnSet.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					rootColumnSet = value;
					if (rootColumnSet != null)
					{
						rootColumnSet.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					rootColumnSetIndex = -1;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RootColumnSet);
				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		public int RootColumnSetIndex
		{
			get
			{

		internal UltraTreeColumnSet OutlookExpressDisplayColumnSet
		{
			get
			{
				if (owningControl == null || !owningControl.IsViewStyleOutlookExpress)
				{
					return rootColumnSet;
				}
				UltraTreeColumnSet ultraTreeColumnSet = RootColumnSet;
				if (ultraTreeColumnSet != null && ultraTreeColumnSet.HasColumns)
				{
					return ultraTreeColumnSet;
				}
				UltraTreeColumnSet columnSetResolved = owningControl.Nodes.ColumnSetResolved;
				if (columnSetResolved == null || !columnSetResolved.HasColumns)
				{
					return ultraTreeColumnSet;
				}
				return columnSetResolved;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)0;
			if (propChange.Source is AppearanceBase && HasActiveCellAppearance && propChange.Source == activeCellAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.ActiveCellAppearance;
			}
			else if (propChange.Source is AppearanceBase && HasCellAppearance && propChange.Source == cellAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.CellAppearance;
			}
			else if (propChange.Source is AppearanceBase && HasColumnHeaderAppearance && propChange.Source == columnHeaderAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				propertyIds = PropertyIds.ColumnHeaderAppearance;
			}
			else if (propChange.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId;
			}
			if (propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.BorderStyleCell) != null || propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.BorderStyleColumnHeader) != null)
			{
				DirtyBorderStyleVersionNumber();
			}
			if (propertyIds != 0)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(propertyIds, propChange);
			}
			base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0082: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00be: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00dc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0136: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0154: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01fe: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0235: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02fd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (ShouldSerializeActiveCellAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ActiveCellAppearance", activeCellAppearanceHolder);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeAllowCellEdit())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AllowCellEdit", AllowCellEdit);
			}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			if (activeCellAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				activeCellAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (cellAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				cellAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (columnHeaderAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				columnHeaderAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (rootColumnSet != null)
			{
				rootColumnSet.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (columnSets != null)
			{
				columnSets.InitControl(owningControl);
				columnSets.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			OnDeserialization();
		}

		protected virtual void OnDeserialization()
		{
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (cellAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				cellAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				cellAppearanceHolder = null;
			}
			if (columnHeaderAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				columnHeaderAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				columnHeaderAppearanceHolder = null;
			}
			if (columnSets != null)
			{
				columnSets.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				columnSets = null;
			}
			if (rootColumnSet != null)
			{
				rootColumnSet.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				rootColumnSet = null;
			}
		}

		internal void DirtyBorderStyleVersionNumber()
		{
			if (borderStyleVersionNumber == int.MaxValue)
			{
				borderStyleVersionNumber = int.MinValue;
			}
			else
			{
				borderStyleVersionNumber++;
			}
		}

	internal class ColumnSettingsSettingsResolved
	{
		private UltraTreeColumnSettings columnSettings;

		internal UltraTreeColumnSettings ColumnSettings => columnSettings;

		internal bool AutoFitColumns
		{
			get
			{
				if (!columnSettings.Control.IsViewStyleOutlookExpress)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return columnSettings.AutoFitColumns != Infragistics.Win.UltraWinTree.AutoFitColumns.None;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasSeparateHeaderAreaInOutlookExpressViewStyle
		{
			get
			{
				UltraTree control = columnSettings.Control;
				if (control == null || !control.IsViewStyleOutlookExpress)
				{
					return false;
				}
				UltraTreeColumnSet outlookExpressDisplayColumnSet = columnSettings.OutlookExpressDisplayColumnSet;
				if (outlookExpressDisplayColumnSet != null && outlookExpressDisplayColumnSet.SettingsResolved.LabelStyle == NodeLayoutLabelStyle.Separate)
				{
					return outlookExpressDisplayColumnSet.SettingsResolved.LabelPosition != NodeLayoutLabelPosition.None;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal TabNavigation TabNavigation
		{
			get
			{
				if (columnSettings.TabNavigation != TabNavigation.Default)
				{
					return columnSettings.TabNavigation;
				}
				return TabNavigation.NextControl;
			}
		}

		internal ColumnSettingsSettingsResolved(UltraTreeColumnSettings columnSettings)
		{
			this.columnSettings = columnSettings;
		}
	}

		internal void OnDispose()
		{
			if (editorWithText != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)editorWithText).Dispose();
				editorWithText = null;
			}
			if (editorWithCombo != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)editorWithCombo).Dispose();
				editorWithCombo = null;
			}
			if (dateTimeEditor != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)dateTimeEditor).Dispose();
				dateTimeEditor = null;
			}
			if (checkEditor != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)checkEditor).Dispose();
				checkEditor = null;
			}
			if (colorPickerEditor != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)colorPickerEditor).Dispose();
				colorPickerEditor = null;
			}
			if (imageRenderer != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)imageRenderer).Dispose();
				imageRenderer = null;
			}
		}

		public EmbeddableEditorBase GetEditor(UltraTreeNodeColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("column");
			}
			if (!column.HasAllowCellEditPropertyBeenSet)
			{
				return (EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)EditorWithText;
			}
			EmbeddableEditorBase val = null;
			Type dataType = column.DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)DateTimeEditor;
			}
			else if (dataType == typeof(Color))
			{
				val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)ColorPickerEditor;
			}
			else if (dataType == typeof(bool) || dataType == typeof(CheckState))
			{
				val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)CheckEditor;
			}
			else if (dataType == typeof(Image) || dataType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(Image)))
			{
				val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)ImageRenderer;
			}
			if (val == null)
			{
				val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((column.ValueList == null) ? ((object)EditorWithText) : ((object)EditorWithCombo));
			}
			return val;
		}

		internal LabelEditNode(UltraTree control)
			: base(control)
		{
		}

		protected override bool ProcessDialogKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			if (base.Active && (keyData == Keys.Tab || keyData == (Keys.Tab | Keys.Shift)))
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = base.Node;
				if (ultraTreeNode != null)
				{
					ultraTreeNode.EndEdit(cancel: false);
					if (ultraTreeNode.IsEditing)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return base.ProcessDialogKey(keyData);
		}

		protected override bool ProcessKeyMessage(ref Message msg)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			switch (msg.Msg)
			{
			case 256:
			case 257:
			case 258:
				if (msg.Msg == 256)
				{
					lastProcessedDialogKeyChar = '\0';
					Keys keyData = Keys.None;
					if (!GetKeyDataFromIntPtr(msg.WParam, out keyData))
					{
						return base.ProcessKeyMessage(ref msg);
					}
					if (ShouldProcessDialogKey(keyData) && ProcessDialogKey(keyData))
					{
						lastProcessedDialogKeyChar = (char)(int)msg.WParam;
						return true;
					}
					if (!ProcessKeyPreview(ref msg))
					{
						OnKeyDown(CreateKeyEventArgs(keyData));
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (msg.Msg == 258)
				{
					char keyChar = '\0';
					if (!GetCharFromIntPtr(msg.WParam, out keyChar))
					{
						return base.ProcessKeyMessage(ref msg);
					}
					if (lastProcessedDialogKeyChar == keyChar)
					{
						lastProcessedDialogKeyChar = '\0';
						return true;
					}
					lastProcessedDialogKeyChar = '\0';
					if (!ProcessKeyPreview(ref msg))
					{
						OnKeyPress(new KeyPressEventArgs(keyChar));
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (msg.Msg == 257)
				{
					lastProcessedDialogKeyChar = '\0';
					Keys keyData2 = Keys.None;
					if (!GetKeyDataFromIntPtr(msg.WParam, out keyData2))
					{
						return base.ProcessKeyMessage(ref msg);
					}
					if (!ProcessKeyPreview(ref msg))
					{
						OnKeyUp(CreateKeyEventArgs(keyData2));
					}
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			return base.ProcessKeyMessage(ref msg);
		}

		private bool GetKeyDataFromIntPtr(IntPtr val, out Keys keyData)
		{
			if (val == new IntPtr(27))
			{
				keyData = Keys.Escape;
				return UsesInputKey(keyData);
			}
			if (val == new IntPtr(13))
			{
				keyData = Keys.Return;
				return UsesInputKey(keyData);
			}
			keyData = Keys.None;
			return false;
		}

		private bool GetCharFromIntPtr(IntPtr val, out char keyChar)
		{
			if (val == new IntPtr(27) || val == new IntPtr(13))
			{
				Keys keyData = Keys.None;
				if (!GetKeyDataFromIntPtr(val, out keyData))
				{
					keyChar = '\0';
					return false;
				}
				keyChar = (char)(int)val;
				return true;
			}
			keyChar = '\0';
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsNavigationalKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			if (keyData == Keys.Tab || keyData == Keys.None || keyData == Keys.Right || keyData == Keys.Left)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldProcessDialogKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			if (owner == null)
			{
				return !IsNavigationalKey(keyData);
			}
			return owner.ShouldProcessDialogKey(keyData);
		}

		private KeyEventArgs CreateKeyEventArgs(Keys keyData)
		{
			keyData |= Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control;
			keyData |= Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Shift;
			keyData |= Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Alt;
			return new KeyEventArgs(keyData);
		}

		protected override void WndProc(ref Message m)
		{
			int msg = m.Msg;
			if (msg == 61 && m.LParam.ToInt64() == -25 && UIAutomationProvider != null)
			{
				Utilities.VerifyAutomationCache();
				m.Result = AutomationInteropProvider.ReturnRawElementProvider(m.HWnd, m.WParam, m.LParam, UIAutomationProvider);
			}
			else
			{
				base.WndProc(ref m);
			}
		}
	}

		private void DisposePrintManager()
		{
			if (printManager != null)
			{
				printManager.EndPrint();
				printManager.Dispose();
				printManager = null;
			}
		}

		private static void CopyEditorComponent(UltraTree source, UltraTree destination)
		{
			if (source.HasOverride && source.Override.EditorComponent != null)
			{
				destination.Override.EditorComponent = source.Override.EditorComponent;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < source.NodeLevelOverrides.Count; i++)
			{
				if (source.NodeLevelOverrides[i].EditorComponent != null)
				{
					destination.NodeLevelOverrides[i].EditorComponent = source.NodeLevelOverrides[i].EditorComponent;
				}
			}
			if (source.Nodes.HasOverride)
			{
				destination.Nodes.Override.EditorComponent = source.Nodes.Override.EditorComponent;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < source.Nodes.Count; j++)
			{
				CopyEditorComponent(source.Nodes[j], destination.Nodes[j]);
			}
		}

		private static void CopyEditorComponent(UltraTreeNode source, UltraTreeNode destination)
		{
			if (source.HasOverride)
			{
				destination.Override.EditorComponent = source.Override.EditorComponent;
			}
			if (source.HasNodes)
			{
				if (source.Nodes.HasOverride)
				{
					destination.Nodes.Override.EditorComponent = source.Nodes.Override.EditorComponent;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < source.Nodes.Count; i++)
				{
					CopyEditorComponent(source.Nodes[i], destination.Nodes[i]);
				}
			}
		}

			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnTreeControlCreated(UltraTree newTree)
		{
			newTree.PrintDocument = this;
			((UltraControlBase)newTree).DrawFilter = DrawFilter;
			((UltraControlBase)newTree).CreationFilter = CreationFilter;
			newTree.ColumnSettings.AutoGenerateColumnSets = false;
			if (tree != null)
			{
				newTree.BeforeDataNodesCollectionPopulated += newTree_BeforeDataNodesCollectionPopulated;
				newTree.InitializeDataNode += newTree_InitializeDataNode;
				newTree.AfterDataNodesCollectionPopulated += newTree_AfterDataNodesCollectionPopulated;
				try
				{
					CopyProperties(tree, newTree);
				}
				finally
				{
					newTree.BeforeDataNodesCollectionPopulated -= newTree_BeforeDataNodesCollectionPopulated;
					newTree.InitializeDataNode -= newTree_InitializeDataNode;
					newTree.AfterDataNodesCollectionPopulated -= newTree_AfterDataNodesCollectionPopulated;
				}
			}
			InitializePrintSettings(newTree, beforeInitializeEvent: true);
			InitializeTreeEventArgs e = new InitializeTreeEventArgs(newTree);
			OnInitializeTree(e);
			InitializePrintSettings(newTree, beforeInitializeEvent: false);
		}

		protected override string GetFormattedHeaderFooterString(HeaderFooterPageSection headerFooterPageSection, string text)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(text);
			if (PrintManager.CurrentHorizontalPageNumber.HasValue)
			{
				stringBuilder.Replace(HorizontalPageNumberToken, PrintManager.CurrentHorizontalPageNumber.Value.ToString());
			}
			if (PrintManager.CurrentVerticalPageNumber.HasValue)
			{
				stringBuilder.Replace(VerticalPageNumberToken, PrintManager.CurrentVerticalPageNumber.Value.ToString());
			}
			return ((UltraPrintDocument)this).GetFormattedHeaderFooterString(headerFooterPageSection, stringBuilder.ToString());
		}

		protected override void OnBeginPrint(PrintEventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraPrintDocument)this).OnBeginPrint(e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Tree == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationExcepyion_TreeCannotBeNull"));
			}
			isPrintInProgress = true;
			if (PrintManager.BeginPrint(out var errorText))
			{
				return;
			}
			e.Cancel = true;
			if (errorText != null)
			{
				Infragistics.Win.UltraWinTree.Printing.ErrorEventArgs e2 = new Infragistics.Win.UltraWinTree.Printing.ErrorEventArgs(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraTreePrintDocument_Error_Title"), errorText);
				OnError(e2);
				if (!e2.Cancel)
				{
					UltraMessageBoxManager.Show(e2.ErrorDescription, e2.ErrorTitle, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
				}
			}
			((UltraPrintDocument)this).OnPrintEnded();
		}

		protected override void OnEndPrint(PrintEventArgs e)
		{
			isPrintInProgress = false;
			DisposePrintManager();
			((UltraPrintDocument)this).OnEndPrint(e);
		}

		}

		protected override void OnPagePrinting(PagePrintingEventArgs e)

		}

		public override void Reset(bool deserializing)
		{
			if (isPrintInProgress)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("The component cannot be reset nor can a layout be loaded while a print operation is in progress.");
			}
			((UltraPrintDocument)this).Reset(deserializing);
			if (!deserializing)
			{
				CreationFilter = null;
				DrawFilter = null;
				Tree = null;
			}
		}

	[Serializable]
	[ListBindable(false)]
	public class TreeNodesCollection : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ISerializable, IComparer, IDeserializationCallback
	{
		internal class NodesCollectionUiaProviderStub : FragmentUIAProviderStub
		{
			public TreeNodesCollection Nodes => ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).Context as TreeNodesCollection;

			public override bool IsDelegatingProvider => true;

			internal NodesCollectionUiaProviderStub(TreeNodesCollection nodes)
				: base((object)nodes)
			{
			}

			private UltraTreeNode GetRelatedVisibleNode(UltraTreeNode startingNode, bool forward)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = null;
				int num = startingNode?.Index ?? (forward ? (-1) : Nodes.Count);
				int num2 = (forward ? 1 : (-1));
				for (int i = num + num2; i >= 0 && i < Nodes.Count; i += num2)
				{
					ultraTreeNode = Nodes[i];
					if (ultraTreeNode.VisibleResolved)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if (ultraTreeNode != null)
				{
					return ultraTreeNode;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override Rectangle GetBoundingRectangle()
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}

			public override ControlType GetControlType()
			{
				return ControlType.List;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment GetFirstChild()
			{
				if (Nodes.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				UltraTreeNode relatedVisibleNode = GetRelatedVisibleNode(null, forward: true);
				if (relatedVisibleNode != null)
				{
					return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)relatedVisibleNode.GetUiaProviderStub()).Provider;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment GetLastChild()
			{
				if (Nodes.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				UltraTreeNode relatedVisibleNode = GetRelatedVisibleNode(null, forward: false);
				if (relatedVisibleNode != null)
				{
					return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)relatedVisibleNode.GetUiaProviderStub()).Provider;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragmentRoot GetFragmentRoot()
			{
				UltraTree control = Nodes.Control;
				if (control == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (IRawElementProviderFragmentRoot)((UltraControlBase)control).UIAutomationProvider;
			}

			protected override bool GetIsEnabled()
			{
				return true;
			}

			protected override bool GetIsKeyboardFocusable()
			{
				return true;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return (Control)(object)Nodes.Control;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment GetParent()
			{
				UltraTreeNode parentNode = Nodes.ParentNode;
				if (parentNode == null)
				{
					UltraTree control = Nodes.Control;
					if (control == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return ((UltraControlBase)control).UIAutomationProvider;
				}
				return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)parentNode.GetUiaProviderStub()).Provider;
			}

			public override IRawElementProviderFragment NavigateChildren(FragmentUIAProviderStub childStub, bool forward)
			{
				if (childStub is UltraTreeNode.NodeUiaProviderStub { Node: var node })
				{
					UltraTreeNode relatedVisibleNode = GetRelatedVisibleNode(node, forward);
					if (relatedVisibleNode != null)
					{
						return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)relatedVisibleNode.GetUiaProviderStub()).Provider;
					}
					return null;
				}
				return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)this).NavigateChildren(childStub, forward);
			}
		}

		internal class TreeNodesCollectionComparer : IComparer
		{
			private TreeNodesCollection owningCollection;

			private UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet;

			private IComparer sortComparer;

			private SortType sort = SortType.None;

			internal TreeNodesCollectionComparer(TreeNodesCollection owningCollection)
			{
				if (owningCollection == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("owningCollection");
				}
				this.owningCollection = owningCollection;
				columnSet = this.owningCollection.ColumnSetResolved;
				sortComparer = this.owningCollection.SortComparerResolved;
				sort = this.owningCollection.SortResolved;
			}

			int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				return CompareHelper(x, y, columnSet, sortComparer, sort);
			}

			internal static int CompareHelper(object x, object y, UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet, IComparer sortComparer, SortType sort)
			{
				if (columnSet != null && columnSet.HasColumns)
				{
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = x as UltraTreeNode;
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode2 = y as UltraTreeNode;
					if (ultraTreeNode == ultraTreeNode2)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					SortedColumnsCollection sortedColumns = columnSet.SortedColumns;
					int num = 0;
					for (int i = 0; i < sortedColumns.Count; i++)
					{
						UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = sortedColumns[i];
						UltraTreeNodeColumn dataColumnFromDisplayColumn = ultraTreeNode.GetDataColumnFromDisplayColumn(ultraTreeNodeColumn);
						UltraTreeNodeColumn dataColumnFromDisplayColumn2 = ultraTreeNode2.GetDataColumnFromDisplayColumn(ultraTreeNodeColumn);
						if (ultraTreeNodeColumn.SortComparer != null)
						{
							UltraTreeNodeCell x2 = ultraTreeNode.Cells[dataColumnFromDisplayColumn];
							UltraTreeNodeCell y2 = ultraTreeNode2.Cells[dataColumnFromDisplayColumn2];
							num = ultraTreeNodeColumn.SortComparer.Compare(x2, y2);
						}
						else
						{
							object obj = ultraTreeNode.GetCellValue(dataColumnFromDisplayColumn);
							object obj2 = ultraTreeNode2.GetCellValue(dataColumnFromDisplayColumn2);
							if (obj != null && obj2 != null && obj.GetType() != obj2.GetType())
							{
								UltraTreeNodeCell cell = ((ultraTreeNode.HasCells && ultraTreeNode.Cells.HasCell(dataColumnFromDisplayColumn)) ? ultraTreeNode.Cells[dataColumnFromDisplayColumn] : null);
								UltraTreeNodeCell cell2 = ((ultraTreeNode2.HasCells && ultraTreeNode2.Cells.HasCell(dataColumnFromDisplayColumn2)) ? ultraTreeNode2.Cells[dataColumnFromDisplayColumn2] : null);
								EmbeddableEditorBase editor = dataColumnFromDisplayColumn.SettingsResolved.GetEditor(cell);
								EmbeddableEditorBase editor2 = dataColumnFromDisplayColumn2.SettingsResolved.GetEditor(cell2);
								obj = editor.DataValueToText(obj, (EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)dataColumnFromDisplayColumn.EditorOwner, (object)dataColumnFromDisplayColumn);
								obj2 = editor2.DataValueToText(obj2, (EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)dataColumnFromDisplayColumn2.EditorOwner, (object)dataColumnFromDisplayColumn2);
							}
							num = ((!(obj is IComparable)) ? DefaultCompare(obj, obj2) : ((IComparable)obj).CompareTo(obj2));
						}
						if (num != 0)
						{
							if (ultraTreeNodeColumn.SettingsResolved.SortType == SortType.Descending)
							{
								num *= -1;
							}
							return num;
						}
					}
					if (num == 0)
					{
						num = ((ultraTreeNode.Index >= ultraTreeNode2.Index) ? 1 : (-1));
					}
					return num;
				}
				int num2 = 0;
				if (sortComparer != null)
				{
					num2 = sortComparer.Compare(x, y);
				}
				else
				{
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode3 = x as UltraTreeNode;
					UltraTreeNode obj3 = y as UltraTreeNode;
					num2 = ((IComparable)ultraTreeNode3).CompareTo((object)obj3);
				}
				if (sort == SortType.Descending)
				{
					return -num2;
				}
				return num2;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Data")]
		public SortType SortResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (HasOverride && overrideObj.ShouldSerializeSort())
				{
					return overrideObj.Sort;
				}
				if (Control != null && Count > 0 && Control.HasNodeLevelOverride(this[0].Level) && Control.NodeLevelOverrides[this[0].Level].ShouldSerializeSort())
				{
					return Control.NodeLevelOverrides[this[0].Level].Sort;
				}
				if (Control != null)
				{
					return Control.SortResolved;
				}
				return SortType.None;
			}
		}

		private int CompareNodeAtIndex(UltraTreeNode node, IComparer compare, int index)
		{
			if (compare != null)
			{
				return compare.Compare(node, this[index]);
			}
			int num = ((IComparable)node).CompareTo((object)this[index]);
			if (SortResolved == SortType.Descending)
			{
				num *= -1;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void InsertSortedHelper(UltraTreeNode node, IComparer compare)
		{
			if (Count == 0)
			{
				AddNodeToCollection(node, notify: true);
				return;
			}
			if (Count == 1)
			{
				int num = CompareNodeAtIndex(node, compare, 0);
				if (num == 0 || num > 0)
				{
					AddNodeToCollection(node, notify: true);
				}
				else
				{
					InsertNodeHelper(0, node, notify: true);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (CompareNodeAtIndex(node, compare, 0) < 0)
			{
				InsertNodeHelper(0, node, notify: true);
				return;
			}
			if (CompareNodeAtIndex(node, compare, Count - 1) >= 0)
			{
				AddNodeToCollection(node, notify: true);
				return;
			}
			if (Count == 2)
			{
				InsertNodeHelper(1, node, notify: true);
				return;
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = Count - 1;
			int num4 = (num3 - num2) / 2;
			int num5 = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			while (!flag)
			{
				if ((CompareNodeAtIndex(node, compare, num4) > 0 && CompareNodeAtIndex(node, compare, num4 + 1) < 0) || (CompareNodeAtIndex(node, compare, num4) < 0 && CompareNodeAtIndex(node, compare, num4 + 1) > 0))
				{
					InsertNodeHelper(num4 + 1, node, notify: true);
					break;
				}
				if ((CompareNodeAtIndex(node, compare, num4) > 0 && CompareNodeAtIndex(node, compare, num4 - 1) < 0) || (CompareNodeAtIndex(node, compare, num4) < 0 && CompareNodeAtIndex(node, compare, num4 - 1) > 0))
				{
					InsertNodeHelper(num4, node, notify: true);
					break;
				}
				if (CompareNodeAtIndex(node, compare, num4) == 0)
				{
					InsertNodeHelper(num4, node, notify: true);
					break;
				}
				if (CompareNodeAtIndex(node, compare, num4) > 0)
				{
					num2 = num4;
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = num4;
				}
				num5 = (num3 - num2) / 2;
				num4 = num2 + num5;
				if (num2 == num3)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool InsertSorted(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal TreeNodesCollection(UltraTree owningControl, UltraTreeNode parentNode, string[] keys)
		{
			this.owningControl = owningControl;
			this.parentNode = parentNode;
			for (int i = 0; i < keys.Length; i++)
			{
				Add(keys[i]);
			}
		}

		internal void ApplySort()
		{
			if (Control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SortType sortResolved = SortResolved;
			if (sortResolved == SortType.Ascending || sortResolved == SortType.Descending)
			{
				Sort();
				if (Control != null)
				{
					Control.VisibleNodesManager.MarkDirty(value: true, collectionChanged: true);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Sort()
		{
			Sort(checkVersion: true);
		}

		internal void Sort(bool checkVersion)
		{
			Sort(checkVersion, checkSortResolved: true);
		}

		internal void SortByColumns(bool checkVersion)
		{
			Sort(checkVersion, checkSortResolved: false);
		}

		internal void Sort(bool checkVersion, bool checkSortResolved)
		{
			if (checkSortResolved && SortResolved == SortType.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = ((owningControl != null) ? owningControl.SortVersion : sortVersion);
			if (!checkVersion || sortVersion != num)
			{
				sortVersion = num;
				if ((owningControl == null || !owningControl.preventSorting) && Count > 1)
				{
					Utilities.SortMerge(List, (IComparer)new TreeNodesCollectionComparer(this));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void DirtySortVersion()
		{
			sortVersion++;
			int num = Control?.SortVersion ?? 0;
			if (sortVersion == num)
			{
				sortVersion = num + 1;
			}
		}

		protected TreeNodesCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.ObjectType == typeof(UltraTreeNode) || current.ObjectType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(UltraTreeNode)))
				{
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = (UltraTreeNode)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(UltraTreeNode), null);
					if (ultraTreeNode != null)
					{
						InternalAdd(ultraTreeNode);
					}
					continue;
				}
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Count":
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				case "Override":
					overrideObj = (Override)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Override), Override);
					break;
				case "CheckedOptionButtonIndex":
					checkedOptionButtonIndex = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), CheckedOptionButtonIndex);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
			if (ShouldSerializeOverride())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Override", Override);
			}
			if (checkedOptionButtonIndex != -1)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CheckedOptionButtonIndex", checkedOptionButtonIndex);
			}
		}

		public int Add(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is UltraTreeNode))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_2", typeof(UltraTreeNode).ToString()));
			}
			VerifyCanAdd();
			if (ParentNode != null && owningControl != ParentNode.Control)
			{
				owningControl = ParentNode.Control;
			}
			UltraTreeNode nodeFromObject = GetNodeFromObject(value);
			int result = AddNodeHelper(nodeFromObject, notify: true, internallyCreatedNode: false);
			nodeFromObject?.SetParent(parentNode);
			return result;
		}

		public int Add(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			return Add((object)node);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			Remove(GetNodeFromObject(value));
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			Remove(this[index]);
		}

		private UltraTreeNode GetNodeFromObject(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V3_Exception_43"));
			}
			if (ultraTreeNode.Control == null)
			{
				ultraTreeNode.InitControl(owningControl);
			}
			return ultraTreeNode;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			VerifyCanAdd();
			InsertNodeHelper(index, GetNodeFromObject(value), notify: true);
		}

		internal void InitControl(UltraTree control)
		{
			if (overrideObj != null)
			{
				Override.InitControl(control);
			}
			owningControl = control;
			NodeEnumerator nodeEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (nodeEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraTreeNode current = nodeEnumerator.Current;
					current.InitControl(control);
					if (parentNode == null)
					{
						initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, 50);
						SetLevelAndVerifyDescendantLevels(current);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = nodeEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "";
		}

		public UltraTreeNode Add()
		{
			VerifyCanAdd();
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = InternalAdd();
			UltraTree control = Control;
			if (control != null && !control.IsCellInEditMode)
			{
				control.SetActiveNode(ultraTreeNode, bringIntoView: false);
			}
			return ultraTreeNode;
		}

		internal UltraTreeNode InternalAdd()
		{
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = new UltraTreeNode(owningControl, parentNode);
			AddNodeHelper(ultraTreeNode, notify: true, internallyCreatedNode: true);
			return ultraTreeNode;
		}

		public UltraTreeNode Add(string key)
		{
			return Add(key, key);
		}

		public UltraTreeNode Add(string key, string text)
		{
			VerifyCanAdd();
			ValidateKeyDoesNotExist(key);
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = new UltraTreeNode(owningControl, parentNode, key, text);
			AddNodeHelper(ultraTreeNode, notify: true, internallyCreatedNode: true);
			return ultraTreeNode;
		}

		internal int AddNodeHelper(UltraTreeNode node, bool notify, bool internallyCreatedNode)
		{
			node.SetParent(parentNode);
			if (!internallyCreatedNode)
			{
				if (node.Key.Length > 0)
				{
					ValidateKeyDoesNotExist(node.Key);
				}
				else if (Contains(node))
				{
					return IndexOf(node);
				}
				if (node.HasNodes)
				{
					ValidateChildKeysDontExist(node.Nodes);
				}
			}
			if (InsertSorted(node))
			{
				return node.Index;
			}
			return AddNodeToCollection(node, notify);
		}

		private int AddNodeToCollection(UltraTreeNode node, bool notify)
		{
			node.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			int result = InternalAdd(node);
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Nodes);
			}
			DirtyColumnSortVersion();
			return result;
		}

		internal static void ValidateChildKeysDontExist(TreeNodesCollection nodes, UltraTree tree)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraTreeNode node in nodes)
			{
				tree.ValidateKeyDoesNotExist(node.Key);
				ValidateChildKeysDontExist(node.Nodes, tree);
			}
		}

		internal void ValidateChildKeysDontExist(TreeNodesCollection nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraTreeNode node in nodes)
			{
				ValidateKeyDoesNotExist(node.Key);
				if (node.HasNodes)
				{
					ValidateChildKeysDontExist(node.Nodes);
				}
			}
		}

		public UltraTreeNode Insert(int index)
		{
			return Insert(index, "", "");
		}

		public UltraTreeNode Insert(int index, string key)
		{
			return Insert(index, key, key);
		}

		public UltraTreeNode Insert(int index, string key, string text)
		{
			VerifyCanAdd();
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode;
			if (key != null && key.Length > 0)
			{
				ValidateKeyDoesNotExist(key);
				ultraTreeNode = new UltraTreeNode(owningControl, parentNode, key, null);
			}
			else
			{
				ultraTreeNode = new UltraTreeNode(owningControl, parentNode);
			}
			if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				ultraTreeNode.Text = text;
			}
			InsertNodeHelper(index, ultraTreeNode, notify: true);
			return ultraTreeNode;
		}

		private void InsertNodeHelper(int index, UltraTreeNode node, bool notify)
		{
			node.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalInsert(index, node);
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Nodes);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			ClearHelper(validateBound: true);
		}

		private void ClearHelper(bool validateBound)
		{
			UltraTree control = Control;
			if (control != null)
			{
				UltraTreeNode activeNode = control.ActiveNode;
				if (control.IsCellInEditMode)
				{
					activeNode.EndCellEdit(cancel: false);
				}
				else if (activeNode != null && activeNode.IsEditing)
				{
					activeNode.EndEdit(cancel: false);
				}
			}
			if (List.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (validateBound)
			{
				VerifyCanClear();
			}
			if (Control != null)
			{
				Control.ResetNextNodeIndex();
			}
			if (Control != null)
			{
				Control.ClearActiveCellColumn();
			}
			if (Control != null && Control.Nodes == this)
			{
				Control.TreeNodeKeys.Clear();
			}
			if (Control != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					this[i].SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					if (Control.Nodes != this)
					{
						Control.RemoveNodeKey(this[i], removeChildKeys: true);
					}
				}
			}
			if (Control != null && Control.SelectedNodes.Count > 0)
			{
				if (Control.Nodes == this)
				{
					Control.SelectedNodes.Clear();
				}
				else
				{
					int count = Control.SelectedNodes.Count;
					UltraTreeNode[] array = new UltraTreeNode[count];
					Control.SelectedNodes.CopyTo(array, 0);
					SelectedNodesCollection selectedNodesCollection = new SelectedNodesCollection(cloned: true);
					bool flag = false;
					for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
					{
						UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = array[j];
						if (Contains(ultraTreeNode))
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							selectedNodesCollection.InternalAdd(ultraTreeNode);
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						Control.SelectNewSelection(selectedNodesCollection);
					}
				}
			}
			synchronizedCheckedNodes = null;
			synchronizedUncheckedNodes = null;
			synchronizedIndeterminateNodes = null;
			NodeEnumerator nodeEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (nodeEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraTreeNode current = nodeEnumerator.Current;
					current.ResetParent();
					current.ResetControl();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = nodeEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
			NodeEnumerator nodeEnumerator2 = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (nodeEnumerator2.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraTreeNode current2 = nodeEnumerator2.Current;
					Control control2 = (Control)(object)current2.Control;
					string name = control2.Name;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable2 = nodeEnumerator2 as IDisposable;
				if (disposable2 != null)
				{
					disposable2.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (Control != null && Control.Nodes == this)
			{
				Control.TopNode = null;
			}
			if (Control != null)
			{
				Control.VisibleNodesManager.MarkDirty(value: true, collectionChanged: true);
			}
			if (Control != null && ParentNode == null)
			{
				((UIElement)Control.UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
			}
			checkedOptionButtonIndex = -1;
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Nodes);
		}

		public void Remove(UltraTreeNode value)
		{
			Remove(value, verifyBound: true);
		}

		internal void Remove(UltraTreeNode value, bool verifyBound)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraTree control = Control;
			if (control != null && value.IsActive)
			{
				UltraTreeNodeColumn activeCellColumn = control.ActiveCellColumn;
				if (activeCellColumn != null && control.IsActiveCell(value, activeCellColumn) && control.IsCellInEditMode)
				{
					value.EndCellEdit(cancel: false);
				}
				else if (value.IsEditing)
				{
					value.EndEdit(cancel: false);
				}
			}
			if (verifyBound)
			{
				VerifyCanRemove();
			}
			value.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = null;
			if (parentNode != null)
			{
				parentNode.DecrementBoundRootDescendantCount(value.BoundRootDescendantCount);
			}
			UltraTree control2 = value.Control;
			if (control2 != null && value == control2.ActiveNode)
			{
				ultraTreeNode = control2.GetNewActiveNodeAfterDeletion(value, checkSelected: false);
				if (ultraTreeNode != null)
				{
					control2.ActiveNode = ultraTreeNode;
				}
				control2.ClearActiveCellColumn();
			}
			InternalRemove(value);
			if (control2 != null)
			{
				ScrollbarControl scrollbarControl = control2.ScrollbarControl;
				scrollbarControl.SetVScrollbarDirty(dirty: true);
				if (!((UltraControlBase)control2).IsUpdating)
				{
					scrollbarControl.RecalcVScroll();
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.Key) && control2.TreeNodeKeys.Contains(value.Key))
				{
					control2.RemoveNodeKey(value, removeChildKeys: true);
				}
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Nodes, null);
		}

		public NodeEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			VerifySortVersion();
			return new NodeEnumerator(this);
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (propChangeInfo.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case PropertyIds.ActiveNodeAppearance:
				case PropertyIds.ExpandedNodeAppearance:
				case PropertyIds.HotTrackingNodeAppearance:
				case PropertyIds.NodeAppearance:
				case PropertyIds.SelectedNodeAppearance:
				case PropertyIds.BorderStyleNode:
				case PropertyIds.ShowExpansionIndicator:
				case PropertyIds.Editor:
				case PropertyIds.MaxLabelWidth:
				case PropertyIds.MaxLabelHeight:
				case PropertyIds.Multiline:
				case PropertyIds.UseEditor:
				case PropertyIds.ShowEditorButtons:
				{
					int i = 0;
					for (int count = List.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						UltraTreeNode nodeWithoutVerification = GetNodeWithoutVerification(i);
						if (nodeWithoutVerification != null)
						{
							nodeWithoutVerification.RecalcSize = true;
						}
					}
					if (Control != null)
					{
						((UIElement)Control.UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
					}
					break;
				}
				case PropertyIds.SortComparer:
				case PropertyIds.Sort:
					ApplySort();
					if (Control != null)
					{
						int vScrollOriginOffSet = Control.VScrollOriginOffSet;
						UltraTree control2 = Control;
						if (control2.VisibleNodesArray.Count > 0)
						{
							control2.TopNode = control2.VisibleNodesArray[0] as UltraTreeNode;
						}
						if (!Control.AllVisibleNodesAreInView && Control.ActiveNode != null)
						{
							Control.ScrollbarControl.VerticalScroll.Value = 0;
							Control.ScrollNodeIntoView(Control.ActiveNode, includeHorizontal: false);
						}
					}
					break;
				case PropertyIds.Visible:
					if (inVerifyBoundNodes)
					{
						UltraTree control = Control;
						if (control != null)
						{
							control.VisibleNodesManager.IsDirty = true;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Nodes, propChangeInfo);
		}

		internal void CloneFrom(TreeNodesCollection treeNodesClone)
		{
			if (Count > 0)
			{
				Clear();
			}
			Tag = treeNodesClone.Tag;
			if (treeNodesClone.Count != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < treeNodesClone.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraTreeNode node = (UltraTreeNode)treeNodesClone[i].Clone();
					AddNodeToCollection(node, notify: false);
				}
				if (treeNodesClone.HasOverride)
				{
					Override.CloneFrom(treeNodesClone.Override);
				}
				checkedOptionButtonIndex = treeNodesClone.checkedOptionButtonIndex;
			}
		}

		internal void InternalSetOwningControl(UltraTree owningControl, UltraTreeNode treeNode)
		{
			UltraTree ultraTree = this.owningControl;
			if (overrideObj != null)
			{
				Override.InitControl(owningControl);
			}
			this.owningControl = owningControl;
			parentNode = treeNode;
			for (int i = 0; i < ListCount; i++)
			{
				GetNodeWithoutVerification(i).InternalSetOwningControl(owningControl, treeNode);
			}
			if (this.owningControl != ultraTree)
			{
				if (dataSource is IComponent)
				{
					((IComponent)dataSource).Disposed -= DataSource_Dispose;
				}
				ResetBindingManager(recursive: false);
				ResetDataList(recursive: false);
				boundNodesDirty = true;
			}
		}

		internal int InternalAdd(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (node.Control != null && node.Control != Control)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_CantAddNodeThatBelongsToDifferentControl"));
			}
			if (Control != null)
			{
				Control.AddNodeKey(node, addChildKeys: true);
			}
			SetLevelAndVerifyDescendantLevels(node);
			int num = List.Add(node);
			node.OnReAddedToCollection(this);
			node.InitializeIndex(num);
			if (Control != null)
			{
				Control.VisibleNodesManager.MarkDirty(value: true, collectionChanged: true);
				if (Control.UIElement != null)
				{
					((UIElement)Control.UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				}
			}
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ParentNode;
			node.GetNodeStyleResolved(verifyAncestors: true);
			if (ultraTreeNode != null && ultraTreeNode.IsSynchronizedCheckBox && node.IsSynchronizedCheckBox)
			{
				HashSet<UltraTreeNode> affectedNodes = new HashSet<UltraTreeNode>();
				node.VerifyParentNodeCheckBoxSynchronization(affectedNodes);
				FireAfterCheckSynchronization(affectedNodes);
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal void InternalInsert(int index, UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (node.Control != null && node.Control != Control)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_CantAddNodeThatBelongsToDifferentControl"));
			}
			if (Control != null)
			{
				Control.AddNodeKey(node, !IsBound);
			}
			node.SetParent(parentNode);
			node.InternalSetOwningControl(Control, parentNode);
			SetLevelAndVerifyDescendantLevels(node);
			List.Insert(index, node);
			node.OnReAddedToCollection(this);
			node.InitializeIndex(index);
			if (Control != null)
			{
				Control.VisibleNodesManager.MarkDirty(value: true, collectionChanged: true);
				if (Control.UIElement != null)
				{
					((UIElement)Control.UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InternalRemove(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			int index = node.Index;
			if (node.ParentNodesCollection != this)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_Exception_TreeNodesCollection_CannotRemoveNodeFromOtherCollection"));
			}
			if (Control != null)
			{
				Control.RemoveNodeKey(node, removeChildKeys: true);
			}
			InternalRemove((IKeyedSubObject)node);
			if (Control != null && node == Control.TopNode)
			{
				UltraTreeNode nextVisibleNode = node.GetNextVisibleNode(disregardEnabledStatus: true);
				if (nextVisibleNode != null)
				{
					Control.TopNode = nextVisibleNode;
					if (node.Parent == null && Control.VisibleNodesArray.Count > 0 && nextVisibleNode == Control.VisibleNodesArray[0] && Control.IsVerticalScrollShown)
					{
						Control.ScrollbarControl.VerticalScroll.Value = 0;
					}
				}
			}
			UltraTree control = Control;
			if (control != null)
			{
				if (control.SelectedNodes.Contains(node))
				{
					SelectedNodesCollection selectedNodes = control.SelectedNodes;
					SelectedNodesCollection selectedNodesCollection = new SelectedNodesCollection(cloned: true);
					for (int i = 0; i < selectedNodes.Count; i++)
					{
						UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = selectedNodes[i];
						if (ultraTreeNode != node)
						{
							selectedNodesCollection.InternalAdd(ultraTreeNode);
						}
					}
					control.SelectNewSelection(selectedNodesCollection);
				}
				if (control.Nodes.Count == 0)
				{
					control.ActiveNode = null;
				}
			}
			if (checkedOptionButtonIndex == index)
			{
				checkedOptionButtonIndex = -1;
			}
			else if (checkedOptionButtonIndex != -1 && checkedOptionButtonIndex > index)
			{
				checkedOptionButtonIndex--;
			}
			UpdateSynchronizedNodeCheckStateOnRemove(node);
			HashSet<UltraTreeNode> affectedNodes = new HashSet<UltraTreeNode>();
			node.VerifyParentNodeCheckBoxSynchronization(affectedNodes);
			FireAfterCheckSynchronization(affectedNodes);
			if (owningControl != null)
			{
				owningControl.VisibleNodesManager.Remove(node);
				((UIElement)owningControl.UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
			if (node.HasNodesCollectionBeenCreated)
			{
				node.Nodes.SetBoundNodesDirty(dirty: false, recursive: true);
				node.Nodes.ResetBindingManager(recursive: true);
				node.Nodes.ResetDataList(recursive: true);
			}
			node.ResetControl();
			node.ResetParent();
		}

		internal UltraTreeNode GetNextVisibleNode(int nodeNumber)
		{
			for (int i = nodeNumber; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i].VisibleResolved)
				{
					return this[i];
				}
			}
			if (parentNode != null)
			{
				if (parentNode.Parent == null)
				{
					return Control.Nodes.GetNextVisibleNode(parentNode.Index + 1);
				}
				return parentNode.Parent.Nodes.GetNextVisibleNode(parentNode.Index + 1);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal new void ValidateKeyDoesNotExist(string key)
		{
			if (key != null && key.Length > 0 && Control != null)
			{
				Control.ValidateKeyDoesNotExist(key);
			}
		}

		public void AddRange(UltraTreeNode[] nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_18"));
			}
			VerifyCanAdd();
			if (ParentNode != null && owningControl != ParentNode.Control)
			{
				owningControl = ParentNode.Control;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Length; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i] == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_1", i.ToString()));
				}
				if (nodes[i].Control == null)
				{
					nodes[i].InitControl(owningControl);
				}
				AddNodeHelper(nodes[i], notify: false, internallyCreatedNode: false);
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Nodes);
		}

		internal void PasteNodes(int index, object[] nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_18"));
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!(nodes[i] is UltraTreeNode))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_1", i.ToString()));
				}
			}
			VerifyPastedNodes(ref nodes);
			for (int j = 0; j < nodes.Length; j++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = nodes[j] as UltraTreeNode;
				InsertNodeHelper(index + j, ultraTreeNode, notify: false);
				ultraTreeNode.InternalSetOwningControl(owningControl, parentNode);
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Nodes);
		}

		private void VerifyPastedNodes(ref object[] nodeArray)
		{
			if (nodeArray == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = nodeArray.Length;
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable(num);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = nodeArray[i] as UltraTreeNode;
				if (!ultraTreeNode.HasNodes)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode2 = nodeArray[j] as UltraTreeNode;
					if (ultraTreeNode2 != ultraTreeNode && HasDescendant(ultraTreeNode, ultraTreeNode2) && !hashtable.Contains(ultraTreeNode2))
					{
						hashtable.Add(ultraTreeNode2, ultraTreeNode2);
					}
				}
			}
			List<UltraTreeNode> list = new List<UltraTreeNode>(num);
			for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode3 = nodeArray[k] as UltraTreeNode;
				if (!hashtable.Contains(ultraTreeNode3))
				{
					list.Add(ultraTreeNode3);
				}
			}
			nodeArray = list.ToArray();
		}

		private bool HasDescendant(UltraTreeNode parentNode, UltraTreeNode searchNode)
		{
			if (searchNode == parentNode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (parentNode.HasNodes)
			{
				TreeNodesCollection nodes = parentNode.Nodes;
				int count = nodes.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = nodes[i];
					if (HasDescendant(ultraTreeNode, searchNode))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

				this[i].ResetForceSuppresionOfExpansionIndicator();
			}
		}

			{
				this[i].ResetForceSuppresionOfExpansionIndicator(level);
			}
		}

		{
			if (HasOverride)
			{
				return overrideObj.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetOverride()
		{
			if (HasOverride)
			{
				overrideObj.Reset();
			}
		}

		internal static int DefaultCompare(object x, object y)
		{
			if (x == null || x == DBNull.Value)
			{
				if (y == null || y == DBNull.Value)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return -1;
			}
			if (y == null || DBNull.Value == y)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (x is IComparable comparable)
			{
				return comparable.CompareTo(y);
			}
			int result = 0;
			Type type = x.GetType();
			if (type == typeof(string))
			{
				result = string.Compare((string)x, (string)y, ignoreCase: false, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			}
			else if (type == typeof(char))
			{
				if ((char)x < (char)y)
				{
					result = -1;
				}
				else if ((char)x > (char)y)
				{
					result = 1;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(int))
			{
				if ((int)x < (int)y)
				{
					result = -1;
				}
				else if ((int)x > (int)y)
				{
					result = 1;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(uint))
			{
				if ((uint)x < (uint)y)
				{
					result = -1;
				}
				else if ((uint)x > (uint)y)
				{
					result = 1;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(long))
			{
				if ((long)x < (long)y)
				{
					result = -1;
				}
				else if ((long)x > (long)y)
				{
					result = 1;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(ulong))
			{
				if ((ulong)x < (ulong)y)
				{
					result = -1;
				}
				else if ((ulong)x > (ulong)y)
				{
					result = 1;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(short))
			{
				if ((short)x < (short)y)
				{
					result = -1;
				}
				else if ((short)x > (short)y)
				{
					result = 1;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(ushort))
			{
				if ((ushort)x < (ushort)y)
				{
					result = -1;
				}
				else if ((ushort)x > (ushort)y)
				{
					result = 1;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(double))
			{
				if ((double)x < (double)y)
				{
					result = -1;
				}
				else if ((double)x > (double)y)
				{
					result = 1;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(float))
			{
				if ((float)x < (float)y)
				{
					result = -1;
				}
				else if ((float)x > (float)y)
				{
					result = 1;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(decimal))
			{
				if ((decimal)x < (decimal)y)
				{
					result = -1;
				}
				else if ((decimal)x > (decimal)y)
				{
					result = 1;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				if ((DateTime)x < (DateTime)y)
				{
					result = -1;
				}
				else if ((DateTime)x > (DateTime)y)
				{
					result = 1;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(DayOfWeek))
			{
				if ((DayOfWeek)x < (DayOfWeek)y)
				{
					result = -1;
				}
				else if ((DayOfWeek)x > (DayOfWeek)y)
				{
					result = 1;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(byte))
			{
				if ((byte)x < (byte)y)
				{
					result = -1;
				}
				else if ((byte)x > (byte)y)
				{
					result = 1;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(sbyte))
			{
				if ((sbyte)x < (sbyte)y)
				{
					result = -1;
				}
				else if ((sbyte)x > (sbyte)y)
				{
					result = 1;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(Color))
			{
				int num = ((Color)x).ToArgb();
				int num2 = ((Color)y).ToArgb();
				if (num < num2)
				{
					result = -1;
				}
				else if (num > num2)
				{
					result = 1;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				string strA = x.ToString();
				string strB = y.ToString();
				result = string.Compare(strA, strB, ignoreCase: false, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			}
			return result;
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			NodeEnumerator nodeEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (nodeEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraTreeNode current = nodeEnumerator.Current;
					current.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = nodeEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (overrideObj != null)
			{
				overrideObj.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		internal void SetLevelAndVerifyDescendantLevels(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			UltraTreeNode parent = node.Parent;
			if (parent != null)
			{
				node.SetLevel(parent.Level + 1);
			}
			else if (ParentNode != null)
			{
				node.SetLevel(ParentNode.Level + 1);
			}
			else
			{
				node.SetLevel(0);
			}
			if (node.HasNodesWithoutVerification)
			{
				TreeNodesCollection nodesWithoutVerification = node.GetNodesWithoutVerification();
				for (int i = 0; i < nodesWithoutVerification.ListCount; i++)
				{
					SetLevelAndVerifyDescendantLevels(nodesWithoutVerification.GetNodeWithoutVerification(i));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AddRangeInternal(ICollection nodes)
		{
			List.AddRange(nodes);
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (IsBound)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Count <= 0 && !ShouldSerializeOverride())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTag();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal UltraTreeColumnSet GetColumnSetResolved(bool includeRootColumnSet)
		{
			UltraTree control = Control;
			int index = ((ParentNode != null) ? (ParentNode.Level + 1) : 0);
			Override obj = (HasOverride ? Override : null);
			Override obj2 = ((control != null && control.HasNodeLevelOverride(index)) ? control.NodeLevelOverrides[index] : null);
			Override obj3 = ((control != null && control.HasOverride) ? control.Override : null);
			if (obj != null && obj.HasColumnSet && obj.ColumnSet.HasColumns && obj.ColumnSet.Columns.Count > 0)
			{
				return obj.ColumnSet;
			}
			if (obj2 != null && obj2.HasColumnSet && obj2.ColumnSet.HasColumns && obj2.ColumnSet.Columns.Count > 0)
			{
				return obj2.ColumnSet;
			}
			if (obj3 != null && obj3.HasColumnSet && obj3.ColumnSet.HasColumns && obj3.ColumnSet.Columns.Count > 0)
			{
				return obj3.ColumnSet;
			}
			if (control != null && IsBound)
			{
				ColumnSetsCollection columnSets = control.ColumnSettings.ColumnSets;
				bool flag = DataMember == null || (DataMember.Length == 0 && !IsBandNodesCollection);
				if (lastColumnSetIndex >= 0 && lastColumnSetIndex < columnSets.Count)
				{
					UltraTreeColumnSet ultraTreeColumnSet = columnSets[lastColumnSetIndex];
					bool flag2 = ultraTreeColumnSet.Key == null || ultraTreeColumnSet.Key.Length == 0;
					if (flag && flag2)
					{
						return ultraTreeColumnSet;
					}
					if (!flag && !flag2 && ultraTreeColumnSet.Key.Length == DataMember.Length)
					{
						if (InternStrings)
						{
							if ((object)((IKeyedSubObjectEx)ultraTreeColumnSet).KeyLowercaseInterned == string.Intern(DataMember.ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)))
							{
								return ultraTreeColumnSet;
							}
						}
						else if (string.Compare(((IKeyedSubObject)ultraTreeColumnSet).Key, DataMember, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
						{
							return ultraTreeColumnSet;
						}
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					int i = 0;
					for (int count = columnSets.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						UltraTreeColumnSet ultraTreeColumnSet2 = columnSets[i];
						if (ultraTreeColumnSet2.Key == null || ultraTreeColumnSet2.Key.Length == 0)
						{
							lastColumnSetIndex = i;
							return ultraTreeColumnSet2;
						}
					}
					lastColumnSetIndex = -1;
				}
				else
				{
					lastColumnSetIndex = columnSets.IndexOf(DataMember);
					if (lastColumnSetIndex >= 0)
					{
						return columnSets[lastColumnSetIndex];
					}
				}
			}
			if (includeRootColumnSet && control != null)
			{
				return control.ColumnSettings.RootColumnSet;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void DirtyColumnSortVersion()
		{
			if (columnSortVersion < int.MaxValue)
			{
				columnSortVersion++;
			}
			else
			{
				columnSortVersion = 0;
			}
		}

		internal void UnDirtyColumnSortVersion()
		{
			UltraTreeColumnSet columnSetResolved = ColumnSetResolved;
			if (columnSetResolved != null)
			{
				columnSortVersion = columnSetResolved.SortedColumns.SortVersion;
			}
		}

		private void VerifySortVersion()
		{
			UltraTreeColumnSet columnSetResolved = ColumnSetResolved;
			if (columnSetResolved != null && columnSetResolved.HasSortedColumns && columnSortVersion != columnSetResolved.SortedColumns.SortVersion)
			{
				columnSortVersion = columnSetResolved.SortedColumns.SortVersion;
				if (columnSetResolved.HasSortedColumns)
				{
					SortByColumns(checkVersion: false);
					if (owningControl != null)
					{
						owningControl.VisibleNodesManager.MarkDirty(value: true, collectionChanged: true);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (owningControl == null || owningControl.ViewStyleResolved != ViewStyle.Standard)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = ((owningControl != null) ? owningControl.SortVersion : sortVersion);
				if (sortVersion != num)
				{
					sortVersion = num;
					Sort(checkVersion: false);
					if (owningControl != null)
					{
						owningControl.VisibleNodesManager.MarkDirty(value: true, collectionChanged: false);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CacheBoundNodes(bool recursive)
		{
			NodeEnumerator nodeEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (nodeEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraTreeNode current = nodeEnumerator.Current;
					if (IsBandNodesCollection)
					{
						CachedNodes[current.BandName] = current;
					}
					else
					{
						if (!IsBound)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (current.listObject != null)
						{
							object objectForRowComparision = TreeUtils.GetObjectForRowComparision(current.listObject);
							CachedNodes[objectForRowComparision] = current;
						}
					}
					if (recursive && current.HasNodesCollectionBeenCreated)
					{
						current.Nodes.CacheBoundNodes(recursive: true);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = nodeEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResetCachedNodes()
		{
			cachedNodes = null;
		}
