		internal UltraTreeNode GetChildBandNode(string bandName)
		{
			if (!isBandNodesCollection)
			{
				return null;
			}
			NodeEnumerator nodeEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (nodeEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraTreeNode current = nodeEnumerator.Current;
					if (current.BandName == bandName)
					{
						return current;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = nodeEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private BindingManagerBase GetBindingManager(object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			return GetBindingManager(dataSource, dataMember, createNewBindingContext: false);
		}

		private BindingManagerBase GetBindingManager(object dataSource, string dataMember, bool createNewBindingContext)
		{
			BindingContext bindingContext = null;
			if (!createNewBindingContext)
			{
				if (Control == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				bindingContext = ((Control)(object)Control).BindingContext;
			}
			else
			{
				bindingContext = new BindingContext();
			}
			if (bindingContext == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BindingManagerBase result = null;
			if (dataSource != null)
			{
				try
				{
					result = DataBindingUtils.GetCurrencyManager(bindingContext, dataSource, dataMember);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private IList GetBoundList()
		{
			if (IsBoundRoot)
			{
				BindingManagerBase bindingManagerBase = null;
				bindingManagerBase = GetBindingManager(dataSource, dataMember, createNewBindingContext: false);
				CurrencyManager currencyManager = bindingManagerBase as CurrencyManager;
				return currencyManager.List;
			}
			if (IsChildOfBoundRootBandNode)
			{
				BindingManagerBase bindingManagerBase2 = null;
				bindingManagerBase2 = GetBindingManager(parentNode.ParentNodesCollection.DataSource, parentNode.PropertyDescriptorInfo.GetFirstChapteredPropertyDescriptorName(GetParentDataColumnSet()), createNewBindingContext: false);
				CurrencyManager currencyManager2 = bindingManagerBase2 as CurrencyManager;
				return currencyManager2.List;
			}
			if (IsBandNodesCollection)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PropertyDescriptorCollection propertyDescriptorCollection = GetParentPropertyDescriptorInfo().PropertyDescriptorCollection;
			string firstChapteredPropertyDescriptorName = GetParentPropertyDescriptorInfo().GetFirstChapteredPropertyDescriptorName(GetParentDataColumnSet());
			if (firstChapteredPropertyDescriptorName == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = propertyDescriptorCollection[firstChapteredPropertyDescriptorName];
			object parentListObject = GetParentListObject();
			if (parentListObject == UltraTree.dummyListObject)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				return propertyDescriptor.GetValue(parentListObject) as IList;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private UltraTreeNode GetBoundActiveNode()
		{
			if (IsBoundRoot || IsChildOfBoundRootBandNode)
			{
				return GetNodeFromListIndex(bindingInfo.BindingManager.Position);
			}
			UltraTreeNode parent = parentNode;
			if (parent.isBandNode)
			{
				parent = parent.Parent;
			}
			UltraTreeNode boundActiveNode = parent.ParentNodesCollection.GetBoundActiveNode();
			if (boundActiveNode == parent)
			{
				return GetNodeFromListIndex(bindingInfo.BindingManager.Position);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private string GetFullDataMember()
		{
			if (IsBoundRoot || IsChildOfBoundRootBandNode)
			{
				return dataMember;
			}
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = parentNode;
			if (ultraTreeNode.Control == null)
			{
				return dataMember;
			}
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (!ultraTreeNode.isBandNode)
			{
				empty = ultraTreeNode.ParentNodesCollection.GetFullDataMember();
				if (empty != null && empty.Trim().Length > 0)
				{
					return ultraTreeNode.ParentNodesCollection.GetFullDataMember() + "." + dataMember;
				}
				return dataMember;
			}
			ultraTreeNode = ultraTreeNode.Parent;
			empty = ((ultraTreeNode != null) ? ultraTreeNode.ParentNodesCollection.GetFullDataMember() : Control.DataMember);
			if (empty != null && empty.Trim().Length > 0)
			{
				return ultraTreeNode.ParentNodesCollection.GetFullDataMember() + "." + dataMember;
			}
			return dataMember;
		}

		private BindingInfo GetParentBindingInfo()
		{
			if (IsBoundRoot)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = parentNode;
			if (ultraTreeNode == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!ultraTreeNode.isBandNode || IsChildOfBoundRootBandNode)
			{
				return ultraTreeNode.ParentNodesCollection.BindingInfo;
			}
			return ultraTreeNode.Parent?.ParentNodesCollection.BindingInfo;
		}

		internal UltraTreeNode GetNodeFromListIndex(int listIndex)
		{
			if (boundNodeList == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			VerifyBoundNodes();
			if (boundNodeList == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (listIndex < 0 || listIndex >= boundNodeList.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (UltraTreeNode)boundNodeList[listIndex];
		}

		internal TreeNodesCollection GetRootDataNodesCollection()
		{
			if (IsBoundRoot)
			{
				return this;
			}
			if (ParentNode != null && ParentNode.ParentNodesCollection != null)
			{
				return ParentNode.ParentNodesCollection.GetRootDataNodesCollection();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void InitializeBindingManager()
		{
			if (dataSource != null)
			{
				InitializeBindingManager(dataSource, dataMember);
				return;
			}
			PropertyDescriptorInfo parentPropertyDescriptorInfo = GetParentPropertyDescriptorInfo();
			dataMember = parentPropertyDescriptorInfo.GetFirstChapteredPropertyDescriptorName(GetParentDataColumnSet());
			string fullDataMember = GetFullDataMember();
			TreeNodesCollection rootDataNodesCollection = GetRootDataNodesCollection();
			object obj = ((rootDataNodesCollection != null) ? rootDataNodesCollection.DataSource : dataSource);
			InitializeBindingManager(obj, fullDataMember);
		}

		private void InitializeBindingManager(object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			ResetBindingManager(recursive: false);
			TreeNodesCollection rootDataNodesCollection = GetRootDataNodesCollection();
			if (rootDataNodesCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			BindingManagerBase bindingManager = GetBindingManager(dataSource, dataMember);
			if (bindingManager != null)
			{
				BindingInfo bindingInfo = rootDataNodesCollection.BindingInfoManager.GetBindingInfo(bindingManager);
				if (bindingInfo == null)
				{
					bindingInfo = ((!IsBoundRoot) ? new BindingInfo(Control, bindingManager, GetParentBindingInfo(), parentNode.BandName, this.dataMember) : new BindingInfo(Control, bindingManager, this, this.dataMember));
					rootDataNodesCollection.BindingInfoManager.Add(bindingManager, bindingInfo);
				}

		internal void RefreshShowBandNode()
		{
			NodeEnumerator nodeEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (nodeEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraTreeNode current = nodeEnumerator.Current;
					if (current.HasNodesCollectionBeenCreated && current.BoundRootDescendantCount > 0)
					{
						current.Nodes.RefreshShowBandNode();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = nodeEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (IsBoundRoot)
			{
				ResetDataBinding();
			}
		}

				Control.DirtyTreeElement();
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldChildrenBeBandNodes(PropertyDescriptorInfo propsWrapper)
		{
			ShowBandNodes showBandNodes = Control.ShowBandNodes;
			if (!IsBoundRoot)
			{
				if (parentNode.isBandNode)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (showBandNodes == ShowBandNodes.Always)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return propsWrapper.GetChapteredPropertyDescriptorNames(GetParentDataColumnSet()).Length > 1;
			}
			return !TreeUtils.HasNonChapteredColumns(propsWrapper.PropertyDescriptorCollection);
		}

		internal void VerifyBoundNodes()
		{
			if (inVerifyBoundNodes || Control == null || Control.Initializing)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraTreeColumnSet ultraTreeColumnSet = null;
			if (!boundNodesDirty)
			{
				if (lastColumnStructureVersion == Control.ColumnStructureVersion)
				{
					return;
				}
				lastColumnStructureVersion = Control.ColumnStructureVersion;
				ultraTreeColumnSet = GetParentDataColumnSet();
				if (lastParentColumnSet != ultraTreeColumnSet)
				{
					boundNodesDirty = true;
					lastParentColumnSet = ultraTreeColumnSet;
					if (ultraTreeColumnSet != null)
					{
						lastListColumnVersion = ultraTreeColumnSet.ListColumnsVersion;
					}
					else
					{
						lastListColumnVersion = 0;
					}
				}
				else if (ultraTreeColumnSet == null)
				{
					lastListColumnVersion = 0;
				}
				else if (ultraTreeColumnSet.ListColumnsVersion != lastListColumnVersion)
				{
					boundNodesDirty = true;
					lastListColumnVersion = ultraTreeColumnSet.ListColumnsVersion;
				}
				if (!boundNodesDirty)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			UltraTree control = Control;
			bool preventPropChangeNotification = Control.preventPropChangeNotification;
			try
			{
				inVerifyBoundNodes = true;
				Control.InternalDesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled = true;
				if (Control.IsDesignMode)
				{
					Control.preventPropChangeNotification = true;
				}
				if (DataSource != null)
				{
					InitializeBindingManager();
				}
				PropertyDescriptorInfo parentPropertyDescriptorInfo = GetParentPropertyDescriptorInfo();
				if (parentPropertyDescriptorInfo == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				string[] chapteredPropertyDescriptorNames = parentPropertyDescriptorInfo.GetChapteredPropertyDescriptorNames();
				if (ShouldChildrenBeBandNodes(parentPropertyDescriptorInfo))
				{
					PopulateBandNodes(chapteredPropertyDescriptorNames);
					return;
				}
				ultraTreeColumnSet = (lastParentColumnSet = GetParentDataColumnSet());
				if (ultraTreeColumnSet != null)
				{
					lastListColumnVersion = ultraTreeColumnSet.ListColumnsVersion;
					chapteredPropertyDescriptorNames = parentPropertyDescriptorInfo.GetChapteredPropertyDescriptorNames(ultraTreeColumnSet);
					string key = ((chapteredPropertyDescriptorNames.Length != 0) ? chapteredPropertyDescriptorNames[0] : null);
					int num = ultraTreeColumnSet.Columns.IndexOf(key);
					if (num < 0)
					{
						ClearHelper(validateBound: false);
						return;
					}
					if (!ultraTreeColumnSet.Columns[num].IsChaptered || !ultraTreeColumnSet.Columns[num].Visible)
					{
						ClearHelper(validateBound: false);
						return;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					lastListColumnVersion = 0;
				}
				InitializeDataList();
				if (dataSource == null)
				{
					InitializeBindingManager();
				}
				PopulateBoundNodes();
			}
			finally
			{
				ResetCachedNodes();
				boundNodesDirty = false;
				inVerifyBoundNodes = false;
				control.InternalDesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled = false;
				if (control.IsDesignMode)
				{
					control.preventPropChangeNotification = preventPropChangeNotification;
				}
			}
		}

		private void dataList_ListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.ListChangedType)
			{
			case ListChangedType.ItemAdded:
				dataList_ItemAdded(e);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemChanged:
				dataList_ItemChanged(e);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemDeleted:
				dataList_ItemDeleted(e);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemMoved:
				dataList_ItemMoved(e);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorAdded:
				dataList_PropertyDescriptorAdded(e);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged:
				dataList_PropertyDescriptorChanged(e);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorDeleted:
				dataList_PropertyDescriptorDeleted(e);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.Reset:
				dataList_Reset(e);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void dataList_ItemMoved(ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{

			{
				return;
			}
			int oldIndex = e.OldIndex;
			int newIndex = e.NewIndex;

			if (oldIndex >= 0 && oldIndex < num && newIndex >= 0 && newIndex < num)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = (UltraTreeNode)boundNodeList[oldIndex];
				if (ultraTreeNode == null || ultraTreeNode.ListIndex == oldIndex)
				{

				}
			}

			{

			}
		}

							if (item.Name != text)
							{
								int num = columnSetResolved.Columns.IndexOf(text);
								if (num >= 0)
								{
									TreeUtils.GenerateColumn(item, columnSetResolved.Columns[num]);
								}
							}
						}
					}
					InitializePropertyDescriptorInfo();
					PropertyDescriptorInfo propertyDescriptorInfo2 = this.propertyDescriptorInfo;
					PropertyDescriptor[] array = PropertyDescriptorInfo.FindSamePropertyDescriptors(propertyDescriptorInfo2, propertyDescriptorInfo);
					if (array != null)
					{
						PropertyDescriptor[] array2 = array;
						foreach (PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor2 in array2)
						{
							int num2 = columnSetResolved.Columns.IndexOf(propertyDescriptor2.Name);
							if (num2 >= 0)
							{
								TreeUtils.GenerateColumn(propertyDescriptor2, columnSetResolved.Columns[num2]);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			ResetDataBinding();
		}

		private void dataList_PropertyDescriptorDeleted(ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Control != null && Control.ColumnSettings != null && Control.ColumnSettings.AutoGenerateColumnSets && !IsBandNodesCollection)
			{
				UltraTreeColumnSet columnSetResolved = GetColumnSetResolved(includeRootColumnSet: false);
				if (columnSetResolved != null)

					PropertyDescriptorInfo propertyDescriptorInfo2 = this.propertyDescriptorInfo;
					PropertyDescriptor[] array = PropertyDescriptorInfo.FindDifferentPropertyDescriptors(propertyDescriptorInfo, propertyDescriptorInfo2);
					if (array != null)

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			base.Dispose();
			if (synchronizedCheckedNodes != null)
			{
				synchronizedCheckedNodes = null;
			}
			if (synchronizedUncheckedNodes != null)
			{
				synchronizedUncheckedNodes = null;
			}
			if (synchronizedIndeterminateNodes != null)
			{
				synchronizedIndeterminateNodes = null;
			}
		}

		internal CheckState? GetResolvedSynchronizedCheckState()
		{
			if (Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (SynchronizedCheckedNodes.Count == SynchronizedChildNodeCount)
			{
				return CheckState.Checked;
			}
			if (SynchronizedUncheckedNodes.Count == SynchronizedChildNodeCount)
			{
				return CheckState.Unchecked;
			}
			return CheckState.Indeterminate;
		}

		internal void ParentNodesStyleResolvedChanged(bool verifyCheckBoxSynchronization = false)
		{
			if (isInParentNodesStyleResolvedChanged)
			{
				return;
			}
			isInParentNodesStyleResolvedChanged = true;
			try
			{
				synchronizedCheckedNodes = null;
				synchronizedUncheckedNodes = null;
				synchronizedIndeterminateNodes = null;
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ParentNode;
				if (ultraTreeNode == null || !ultraTreeNode.IsSynchronizedCheckBox)
				{
					return;
				}
				NodeEnumerator nodeEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (nodeEnumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						UltraTreeNode current = nodeEnumerator.Current;
						if (current.IsSynchronizedCheckBox)
						{
							switch (current.CheckedState)
							{
							case CheckState.Checked:
								SynchronizedCheckedNodes.Add(current);
								break;
							case CheckState.Unchecked:
								SynchronizedUncheckedNodes.Add(current);
								break;
							case CheckState.Indeterminate:
								SynchronizedIndeterminateNodes.Add(current);
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					IDisposable disposable = nodeEnumerator as IDisposable;
					if (disposable != null)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
				if (verifyCheckBoxSynchronization)
				{
					HashSet<UltraTreeNode> affectedNodes = new HashSet<UltraTreeNode>();
					ultraTreeNode.VerifyCheckBoxSynchronization(affectedNodes);
					FireAfterCheckSynchronization(affectedNodes);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isInParentNodesStyleResolvedChanged = false;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateSynchronizedNodeCheckStateOnRemove(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			switch (node.CheckedState)
			{
			case CheckState.Checked:
				SynchronizedCheckedNodes.Remove(node);
				break;
			case CheckState.Unchecked:
				SynchronizedUncheckedNodes.Remove(node);
				break;
			case CheckState.Indeterminate:
				SynchronizedIndeterminateNodes.Remove(node);
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateSynchronizedNodeCheckState(UltraTreeNode node, CheckState originalCheckedState)
		{
			switch (originalCheckedState)
			{
			case CheckState.Checked:
				SynchronizedCheckedNodes.Remove(node);
				break;
			case CheckState.Unchecked:
				SynchronizedUncheckedNodes.Remove(node);
				break;
			case CheckState.Indeterminate:
				SynchronizedIndeterminateNodes.Remove(node);
				break;
			}
			switch (node.CheckedState)
			{
			case CheckState.Checked:
				SynchronizedCheckedNodes.Add(node);
				break;
			case CheckState.Unchecked:
				SynchronizedUncheckedNodes.Add(node);
				break;
			case CheckState.Indeterminate:
				SynchronizedIndeterminateNodes.Add(node);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void FireAfterCheckSynchronization(HashSet<UltraTreeNode> affectedNodes)
		{
			UltraTree control = Control;
			if (control != null)
			{
				Control.FireAfterCheckSynchronization(affectedNodes);
			}
		}

		internal void ChildNodesStyleResolvedChanged(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (node.IsSynchronizedCheckBox)
			{
				UpdateSynchronizedNodeCheckState(node, CheckState.Unchecked);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateSynchronizedNodeCheckStateOnRemove(node);
			}
			HashSet<UltraTreeNode> hashSet = new HashSet<UltraTreeNode>();
			hashSet.Add(node);
			UltraTreeNode parent = node.Parent;
			if (parent != null && parent.IsSynchronizedCheckBox)
			{
				parent.VerifyCheckBoxSynchronization(hashSet);
			}
			FireAfterCheckSynchronization(hashSet);
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains(value);
		}
	}

		public sealed class UltraTreeNodeTypeConverter : TypeConverter

			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_17"));
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is UltraTreeNode)
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = value.GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
					if (constructor != null)
					{
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[0], isComplete: false);
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		public class NodeAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private UltraTreeNode node;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)node.UIElement;
					if (uIElement == null)
					{
						return Rectangle.Empty;
					}
					return uIElement.Control?.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.ClipRect) ?? Rectangle.Empty;
				}
			}

			public override string DefaultAction
			{
				get
				{
					if (node.HasNodes && node.Nodes.Count > 1)
					{
						if (node.Expanded)
						{
							return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_Collapse");
						}
						return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_Expand");
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			public override string Description => null;

			public override string Help => null;

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					return node.TextToRender;
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent => ((Control)(object)node.Control).AccessibilityObject;

			public override AccessibleRole Role
			{
				get
				{
					switch (node.NodeStyleResolved)
					{
					case NodeStyle.CheckBox:
					case NodeStyle.CheckBoxTriState:
					case NodeStyle.SynchronizedCheckBox:
						return AccessibleRole.CheckButton;
					case NodeStyle.OptionButton:
						return AccessibleRole.RadioButton;
					default:
						return AccessibleRole.OutlineItem;
					}
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					accessibleStates = ((!node.Expanded) ? (accessibleStates | AccessibleStates.Collapsed) : (accessibleStates | AccessibleStates.Expanded));
					if (!node.EnabledResolved)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Unavailable;
					}
					else if (node.VisibleResolved)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Selectable;
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focusable;
						if (node.IsHotTracking)
						{
							accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.HotTracked;
						}
						if (node.IsActive)
						{
							accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Selected;
							if (((Control)(object)node.Control).Focused)
							{
								accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focused;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					if (((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Bounds.IsEmpty)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Offscreen;
					}
					if ((((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Role == AccessibleRole.CheckButton || ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Role == AccessibleRole.RadioButton) && node.CheckedState == CheckState.Checked)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Checked;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public override string Value
			{
				get
				{
					return node.Level.ToString();
				}
				set
				{
				}
			}

			public UltraTreeNode Node => node;

			public NodeAccessibleObject(UltraTreeNode node)
			{
				if (node == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("node");
				}
				this.node = node;
			}

			public override void DoDefaultAction()
			{
				if (node.HasNodes && node.Nodes.Count > 1)
				{
					node.Expanded = !node.Expanded;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (!node.ShowColumnsResolved)
				{
					if (index == 0 && node.IsActive && node.IsEditing)
					{
						return node.EditorAccessibilityObject;
					}
					return null;
				}
				UltraTreeColumnSet displayColumnSetResolved = node.DisplayColumnSetResolved;
				if (displayColumnSetResolved == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (index >= displayColumnSetResolved.VisibleColumns.Count)
				{
					return null;
				}
				UltraTreeNodeColumn column = displayColumnSetResolved.VisibleColumns[index];
				return node.Cells[column].AccessibilityObject;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				if (!node.ShowColumnsResolved)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				UltraTreeColumnSet displayColumnSetResolved = node.DisplayColumnSetResolved;
				return displayColumnSetResolved.VisibleColumns.Count;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				if ((((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).State & AccessibleStates.Focused) != AccessibleStates.Focused)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (node.IsEditing)
				{
					AccessibleObject focused = node.EditorAccessibilityObject.GetFocused();
					if (focused != null)
					{
						return focused;
					}
				}
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).AccessibleObject;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return (Control)(object)node.Control;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				if (node.IsEditing)
				{
					AccessibleObject selected = node.EditorAccessibilityObject.GetSelected();
					if (selected != null)
					{
						return selected;
					}
				}
				if ((((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).State & AccessibleStates.Selected) != AccessibleStates.Selected)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).AccessibleObject;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = null;
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
				{
					if (!node.ShowColumnsResolved)
					{
						if (node.Nodes.Count > 0 && node.Expanded)
						{
							ultraTreeNode = node.Nodes[0];
							if (!ultraTreeNode.Visible)
							{
								ultraTreeNode = GetVisibleSibling(ultraTreeNode, NodePosition.Next);
							}
						}
						break;
					}
					UltraTreeColumnSet displayColumnSetResolved2 = node.DisplayColumnSetResolved;
					if (displayColumnSetResolved2 == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (displayColumnSetResolved2.VisibleColumns.Count == 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					UltraTreeNodeColumn column2 = displayColumnSetResolved2.VisibleColumns[0];
					return node.Cells[column2].AccessibilityObject;
				}
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
				{
					if (!node.ShowColumnsResolved)
					{
						if (node.Nodes.Count > 0 && node.Expanded)
						{
							ultraTreeNode = node.Nodes[node.Nodes.Count - 1];
							if (!ultraTreeNode.Visible)
							{
								ultraTreeNode = GetVisibleSibling(ultraTreeNode, NodePosition.Previous);
							}
						}
						break;
					}
					UltraTreeColumnSet displayColumnSetResolved = node.DisplayColumnSetResolved;
					if (displayColumnSetResolved == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (displayColumnSetResolved.VisibleColumns.Count == 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					UltraTreeNodeColumn column = displayColumnSetResolved.VisibleColumns[displayColumnSetResolved.VisibleColumns.Count - 1];
					return node.Cells[column].AccessibilityObject;
				}
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
					ultraTreeNode = GetVisibleSibling(node, NodePosition.Next);
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
					ultraTreeNode = GetVisibleSibling(node, NodePosition.Previous);
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
					ultraTreeNode = node.GetNextVisibleNode(disregardEnabledStatus: false);
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
					ultraTreeNode = node.GetPrevVisibleNode(disregardEnabledStatus: false);
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
					if (node.Expanded && node.Nodes.Count > 0)
					{
						ultraTreeNode = node.Nodes[0];
						if (!ultraTreeNode.Visible)
						{
							ultraTreeNode = GetVisibleSibling(node, NodePosition.Next);
						}
					}
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
					ultraTreeNode = node.Parent;
					break;
				}
				return ultraTreeNode?.AccessibilityObject;
			}

			public override void Select(AccessibleSelection flags)
			{
				if (node.Enabled)
				{
					if (AccessibleSelection.RemoveSelection == (AccessibleSelection.RemoveSelection & flags))
					{
						node.Selected = false;
					}
					if (AccessibleSelection.TakeSelection == (AccessibleSelection.TakeSelection & flags))
					{
						node.Control.SelectNode(node, shift: false, control: false);
					}
					bool flag = AccessibleSelection.AddSelection == (AccessibleSelection.AddSelection & flags);
					bool flag2 = AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection == (AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection & flags);
					if (flag || flag2)
					{
						node.Control.SelectNode(node, flag2, flag);
					}
					if (AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus == (AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus & flags) && !node.IsActive)
					{
						node.Control.ActiveNode = node;
					}
				}
			}

			private UltraTreeNode GetVisibleSibling(UltraTreeNode node, NodePosition nodePosition)
			{
				UltraTreeNode sibling = node.GetSibling(nodePosition);
				while (sibling != null && !sibling.Visible)
				{
					sibling = node.GetSibling(nodePosition);
				}
				return sibling;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Data")]
		public int Index
		{
			get
			{
				TreeNodesCollection parentNodesCollection = ParentNodesCollection;
				if (parentNodesCollection == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (index < 0 || index >= parentNodesCollection.Count || this != parentNodesCollection.GetNodeWithoutVerification(index))
				{
					index = parentNodesCollection.IndexOf(this);
				}
				return index;
			}
		}

		[Localizable(true)]
		public virtual string Text
		{
			get
			{
				if (owningControl != null)
				{
					UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = DataColumnSetResolved?.SettingsResolved.NodeTextColumn;
					if (!ShouldUseTextProperty && ultraTreeNodeColumn != null)
					{
						object cellValue = GetCellValue(ultraTreeNodeColumn);
						string empty = string.Empty;
						if (cellValue == null || cellValue == DBNull.Value)
						{
							return ultraTreeNodeColumn.SettingsResolved.NullText;
						}
						EmbeddableEditorBase editor = ultraTreeNodeColumn.SettingsResolved.Editor;
						return editor.DataValueToText(cellValue, (EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)ultraTreeNodeColumn.EditorOwner, (object)ultraTreeNodeColumn);
					}
				}
				return text;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != Text)
				{
					text = ((value == null) ? string.Empty : value);
					singleLineText = null;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Text);
					if (parent != null)
					{
						parent.Nodes.ApplySort();
					}
					else if (owningControl != null)
					{
						owningControl.Nodes.ApplySort();
					}
					RecalcSize = true;
					VerifyHScrollbar();
				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraTreeNode_P_Handle")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Data")]
		public IntPtr Handle
		{
			get
			{
				if (handle == (IntPtr)0 && owningControl != null)

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraTreeNode_P_Visible")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		public virtual bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return visible;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == visible)
				{
					return;
				}
				visible = value;
				int oldVisibleIndex = -1;
				if (owningControl != null && !((UltraControlBase)owningControl).IsUpdating)
				{
					VisibleNodesManager visibleNodesManager = owningControl.VisibleNodesManager;
					bool isDirty = visibleNodesManager.IsDirty;
					if (!owningControl.IsOnNodePropertyEditor)
					{
						if (owningControl.TopNode != null)
						{
							oldVisibleIndex = owningControl.TopNode.VisibleIndex;
						}
						if ((!isDirty || visibleNodesManager.IsDirty) && !visibleNodesManager.ProcessVisibleStateChanged(this, visible))
						{
							visibleNodesManager.IsDirty = true;
						}
						if (owningControl.ActiveNode == this)
						{
							UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = NextVisibleNode;
							if (ultraTreeNode == null)
							{
								ultraTreeNode = PrevVisibleNode;
							}
							owningControl.SetActiveNode(ultraTreeNode);
						}
						visibleNodesManager.VerifyTopNode(oldVisibleIndex);
					}
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Visible, null);
			}
		}

		internal UltraTreeNode LastVisibleNode
		{
			get
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = this;
				if (nodes != null && nodes.Count > 0 && ultraTreeNode.Expanded)
				{
					for (int num = nodes.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
					{
						if (nodes.GetNodeWithoutVerification(num).VisibleResolved)
						{
							ultraTreeNode = nodes.GetNodeWithoutVerification(num);
							ultraTreeNode = ultraTreeNode.LastVisibleNode;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				return ultraTreeNode;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraTreeNode_P_ImageSizeResolved")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Data")]
		public Size ImageSizeResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ReserveImageSpaceResolved && !GetImage())
				{
					return Size.Empty;
				}
				if (HasOverride && overrideObj.ShouldSerializeImageSize())
				{
					return overrideObj.ImageSize;
				}
				Override nodesOverride = GetNodesOverride();
				if (nodesOverride != null && nodesOverride.ShouldSerializeImageSize())
				{
					return nodesOverride.ImageSize;
				}
				if (owningControl != null && owningControl.HasNodeLevelOverride(level) && owningControl.NodeLevelOverrides[level].ShouldSerializeImageSize())
				{
					return owningControl.NodeLevelOverrides[level].ImageSize;
				}
				if (owningControl != null && owningControl.HasOverride && owningControl.Override.ShouldSerializeImageSize())
				{
					return owningControl.Override.ImageSize;
				}
				if (ReserveImageSpaceResolved)
				{
					return new Size(16, 16);
				}
				if (GetImage())
				{
					return new Size(Image.Width, Image.Height);
				}
				return Size.Empty;
			}
		}

					{
						return CheckState.Indeterminate;
					}
					_ = CheckedState;
					_ = 2;
					return CheckState.Unchecked;
				}
				if (IsStyleCheckBox)
				{
					if (CheckedState == CheckState.Unchecked)
					{
						return CheckState.Checked;
					}
					return CheckState.Unchecked;

					if (CheckedState == CheckState.Checked)

				}
				return CheckState.Unchecked;
			}
		}

		internal SelectType SelectionTypeResolved
		{
			get
			{
				TreeNodesCollection parentNodesCollection = ParentNodesCollection;
				SelectType selectType = ((parentNodesCollection != null && parentNodesCollection.HasOverride) ? parentNodesCollection.Override : null)?.SelectionType ?? SelectType.Default;
				SelectType selectType2 = ((owningControl != null && owningControl.HasNodeLevelOverride(level)) ? owningControl.NodeLevelOverrides[level] : null)?.SelectionType ?? SelectType.Default;
				SelectionBehavior selectionBehavior = ((owningControl != null) ? owningControl.SelectionBehavior : SelectionBehavior.UseOverride);
				if (selectionBehavior != SelectionBehavior.UseOverride && (selectType == SelectType.None || (selectType == SelectType.Default && selectType2 == SelectType.None)))
				{
					return SelectType.None;
				}
				switch (selectionBehavior)
				{
				case SelectionBehavior.ExtendedAcrossCollections:
					return SelectType.Extended;
				case SelectionBehavior.ExtendedAutoDragAcrossCollections:
					return SelectType.ExtendedAutoDrag;
				default:
				{
					if (selectType != SelectType.Default)
					{
						return selectType;
					}
					if (selectType2 != SelectType.Default)
					{
						return selectType2;
					}
					SelectType selectType3 = ((owningControl != null && owningControl.HasOverride) ? owningControl.Override : null)?.SelectionType ?? SelectType.Default;
					if (selectType3 != SelectType.Default)
					{
						return selectType3;
					}
					return SelectType.Single;
				}
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsLastVisibleSibling
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsLastViewableNode)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (VisibleIndex == -1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (owningControl != null)
				{
					if (VerticalPosition < owningControl.ViewableArea.Top || VerticalPosition > owningControl.ViewableArea.Bottom)
					{
						return false;
					}
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = null;
					int bottom = owningControl.ViewableArea.Bottom;
					if (level == 0)
					{
						for (int i = VisibleIndex + 1; i < owningControl.VisibleNodesArray.Count; i++)
						{
							ultraTreeNode = owningControl.VisibleNodesArray[i] as UltraTreeNode;
							if (ultraTreeNode.Level == level)
							{
								return false;
							}
						}
						return true;
					}
					if (ParentNodesCollection.Count == 1)
					{
						return true;
					}
					for (int j = Index + 1; j < ParentNodesCollection.Count; j++)
					{
						ultraTreeNode = ParentNodesCollection[j];
						if (ultraTreeNode.VisibleIndex != -1)
						{
							if (ultraTreeNode.VerticalPosition < bottom)
							{
								return false;
							}
							if (ultraTreeNode.VerticalPosition > bottom)
							{
								return true;
							}
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsFirstVisibleNodeInIsland
		{

				return IsFirstVisibleNodeInIslandHelper(topNodeVisibleIndex);
			}

		internal bool IsLastVisibleNodeBeforeNewIsland
		{
			get
			{
				if (owningControl == null || owningControl.VisibleNodesArray.Count == 0 || IsLastViewableNode)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!Visible)
				{
					return false;
				}
				int num = VisibleIndex;
				if (!(owningControl.VisibleNodesArray[num + 1] is UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode) || ultraTreeNode.Level != Level || DisplayColumnSetResolved != ultraTreeNode.DisplayColumnSetResolved)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (owningControl.IsViewStyleFreeForm && HasOverride && Override.HasColumnSet && ultraTreeNode.HasOverride && ultraTreeNode.Override.HasColumnSet)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsLastViewableSibling
		{
			get
			{
				TreeNodesCollection parentNodesCollection = ParentNodesCollection;
				if (parentNodesCollection == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				int num = VisibleIndex;
				if (owningControl != null && owningControl.VisibleNodesManager.IsInitializing)
				{
					int count = parentNodesCollection.Count;
					int num2 = Index;
					if (num2 < count - 1)
					{
						for (int i = num2 + 1; i < count; i++)
						{
							UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = parentNodesCollection[i];
							if (ultraTreeNode.visible)
							{
								return false;
							}
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				int j = Index + 1;
				for (int count2 = parentNodesCollection.Count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					if (parentNodesCollection.GetNodeWithoutVerification(j).visibleIndex >= num)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public EmbeddableEditorBase EditorResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (!UseEditorResolved)

		internal bool ShowEditorButtonsNow
		{
			get
			{
				switch (ShowEditorButtonsResolved)
				{
				case ShowEditorButtons.Active:
					if (IsActive)
					{
						return true;
					}
					break;
				case ShowEditorButtons.ActiveAndHotTracked:
					if (IsActive || IsHotTracking)
					{
						return true;
					}
					break;
				case ShowEditorButtons.HotTracked:
					if (IsHotTracking)
					{
						return true;
					}
					break;
				case ShowEditorButtons.Always:
					return true;
				}
				return IsEditing;
			}
		}

		internal string TextToRender
		{
			get
			{
				string text = Text;
				if (multilineCached)
				{
					return text;
				}
				if (!ShouldUseTextProperty)
				{
					singleLineText = null;
				}
				if (singleLineText == null)
				{
					int num = text.IndexOf('\n');
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						if (num > 0 && text[num - 1] == '\r')
						{
							num--;
						}
						singleLineText = text.Substring(0, num);
					}
					else
					{
						singleLineText = text;
					}
				}
				return singleLineText;
			}
		}

		internal bool DisplaysCells
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ShowColumnsResolved)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Hashtable cellPositions = CellPositions;
				if (cellPositions == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				UltraTreeColumnSet displayColumnSetResolved = DisplayColumnSetResolved;
				if (displayColumnSetResolved == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				VisibleColumnsCollection visibleColumns = displayColumnSetResolved.VisibleColumns;
				for (int i = 0; i < visibleColumns.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = visibleColumns[i];
					if (cellPositions.Contains(ultraTreeNodeColumn) && !((Rectangle)cellPositions[ultraTreeNodeColumn]).IsEmpty)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, SerializationFormatter = true)]
		protected virtual void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (ShouldSerializeCheckedState())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CheckedState", CheckedState);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeEnabled())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Enabled", Enabled);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeLeftImages())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "LeftImages", LeftImages);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeLeftImagesAlignment())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "LeftImagesAlignment", LeftImagesAlignment);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRightImages())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "RightImages", RightImages);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRightImagesAlignment())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "RightImagesAlignment", RightImagesAlignment);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeNodes())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Nodes", nodes);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeKey())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Key", Key);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeOverride())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Override", Override);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
			if (ShouldSerializeDataKey())
			{
				Utils.SerializeObjectProperty(info, "DataKey", DataKey);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeText())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Text", Text);
			}
			if (Expanded)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Expanded", Expanded);
			}
			if (!forceSuppresionOfExpansionIndicator)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ForceSuppressionOfExpansionIndicator", forceSuppresionOfExpansionIndicator);
			}
			if (!Visible)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Visible", Visible);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeAllowCellEdit())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AllowCellEdit", AllowCellEdit);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeCellValues())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CellValues", cellValues);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeCells())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Cells", cellsCollection);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeNotificationBadgeText())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "NotificationBadgeText", notificationBadgeText);
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		internal void InitControl(UltraTree control)
		{
			InternalSetOwningControl(control, null);
			if (cellValues != null)
			{
				VerifyCachedCellValues();
			}
			InitCellsCollection();
		}

		private void InitCellsCollection()
		{
			if (cellsCollection != null)
			{
				cellsCollection.InitNode(this);
				cellsCollection.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (!HasNodes)
			{
				return;
			}
			TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection = Nodes;
			foreach (UltraTreeNode item in treeNodesCollection)
			{
				item.InitCellsCollection();
			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeKey() && !ShouldSerializeText() && !ShouldSerializeNodes() && !ShouldSerializeCheckedState() && !ShouldSerializeEnabled() && !ShouldSerializeSelected() && !ShouldSerializeTag() && !ShouldSerializeDataKey() && !ShouldSerializeLeftImages() && !ShouldSerializeRightImages() && !ShouldSerializeOverride() && !ShouldSerializeLeftImagesAlignment() && !ShouldSerializeRightImagesAlignment() && !ShouldSerializeVisible() && !ShouldSerializeAllowCellEdit())

			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (nodes != null)
			{
				nodes.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				nodes.Dispose();
				nodes = null;
			}
			if (overrideObj != null)
			{
				overrideObj.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (leftImages != null)
			{
				leftImages.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (rightImages != null)
			{
				rightImages.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (cellsCollection != null)
			{
				cellsCollection.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			overrideObj = null;
			leftImages = null;
			rightImages = null;
			cellsCollection = null;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (propChangeInfo.Source == nodes && nodes != null)
			{
				PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo2 = propChangeInfo.FindTrigger(null);
				if (propChangeInfo2 != null && propChangeInfo2.PropId is PropertyIds && DoesPropIdDirtySize((PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo2.PropId))
				{
					foreach (UltraTreeNode node in nodes)
					{
						node.RecalcSize = true;
					}
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Nodes, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(propChangeInfo.PropId is PropertyIds))
				{
					return;
				}
				PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId;
				if (HasOverride && propChangeInfo.Source == Override)
				{
					if ((propertyIds == PropertyIds.SortComparer || propertyIds == PropertyIds.Sort) && nodes != null)
					{
						nodes.ApplySort();
					}
					if (DoesPropIdDirtySize(propertyIds))
					{
						RecalcSize = true;
					}
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Override, propChangeInfo);
				}
				else if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.LeftImages || propertyIds == PropertyIds.RightImages || propertyIds == PropertyIds.Text)
				{
					RecalcSize = true;
					NotifyPropChange(propertyIds, propChangeInfo);
				}
				else if (propChangeInfo.FindSource(typeof(UltraTreeNodeCell)) != null)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Cells, propChangeInfo);
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool DoesPropIdDirtySize(PropertyIds id)
		{
			switch (id)
			{
			case PropertyIds.ItemHeight:
			case PropertyIds.ActiveNodeAppearance:
			case PropertyIds.ExpandedNodeAppearance:
			case PropertyIds.HotTrackingNodeAppearance:
			case PropertyIds.NodeAppearance:
			case PropertyIds.SelectedNodeAppearance:
			case PropertyIds.BorderStyleNode:
			case PropertyIds.NodeStyle:
			case PropertyIds.ReserveCheckBoxSpace:
			case PropertyIds.ReserveImageSpace:
			case PropertyIds.ImageSize:
			case PropertyIds.ShowExpansionIndicator:
			case PropertyIds.Editor:
			case PropertyIds.MaxLabelWidth:
			case PropertyIds.MaxLabelHeight:
			case PropertyIds.Multiline:
			case PropertyIds.UseEditor:
			case PropertyIds.ShowEditorButtons:
			case PropertyIds.GlyphPadding:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveExpandedNodeAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			Override nodesOverride = GetNodesOverride();
			if (HasOverride && Override.HasExpandedNodeAppearance)
			{
				Override.ExpandedNodeAppearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (nodesOverride != null && nodesOverride.HasExpandedNodeAppearance)
			{
				nodesOverride.ExpandedNodeAppearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (owningControl != null && owningControl.HasNodeLevelOverride(level) && owningControl.NodeLevelOverrides[level].HasExpandedNodeAppearance)
			{
				owningControl.NodeLevelOverrides[level].ExpandedNodeAppearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (owningControl != null && owningControl.HasOverride && owningControl.Override.HasExpandedNodeAppearance)
			{
				owningControl.Override.ExpandedNodeAppearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
			}
		}

		public virtual object Clone()
		{
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = new UltraTreeNode();
			ultraTreeNode.InitializeFrom(this);
			return ultraTreeNode;
		}

		public int GetNodeCount(bool includeSubTrees)
		{
			if (!HasNodes)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = nodes.Count;
			if (!includeSubTrees)
			{
				return num;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				num += nodes[i].GetNodeCount(includeSubTrees: true);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public void Remove()
		{
			if (owningControl != null && NextVisibleNode == null && IsInView)
			{
				owningControl.ScrollNodeIntoView(PrevVisibleNode, includeHorizontal: false);
			}
			if (selected)
			{
				Selected = false;
			}
			InternalRemove();
		}

		internal void InternalRemove()
		{
			if (owningControl != null)
			{
				owningControl.VisibleNodesManager.Remove(this);
			}
			if (parent != null)
			{
				parent.Nodes.Remove(this);
			}
			else if (owningControl != null)
			{
				owningControl.Nodes.Remove(this);
			}
		}

		public UltraTreeNode GetSibling(NodePosition nodePosition)
		{
			if (!HasSibling(nodePosition))
			{
				return null;
			}
			TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection;
			if (parent != null)
			{
				treeNodesCollection = parent.Nodes;
			}
			else
			{
				if (owningControl == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				treeNodesCollection = owningControl.Nodes;
			}
			return nodePosition switch
			{
				NodePosition.Next => treeNodesCollection[Index + 1], 
				NodePosition.Previous => treeNodesCollection[Index - 1], 
				NodePosition.First => treeNodesCollection[0], 
				NodePosition.Last => treeNodesCollection[treeNodesCollection.Count - 1], 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public bool HasSibling(NodePosition nodePosition)
		{
			if (Index < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection;
			if (parent != null)
			{
				treeNodesCollection = parent.Nodes;
			}
			else
			{
				if (owningControl == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				treeNodesCollection = owningControl.Nodes;
			}
			if (nodePosition == NodePosition.Next && Index + 1 < treeNodesCollection.Count)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (nodePosition == NodePosition.Previous && Index - 1 >= 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (nodePosition == NodePosition.First && this != treeNodesCollection[0])
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (nodePosition == NodePosition.Last && this != treeNodesCollection[treeNodesCollection.Count - 1])
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			if (selected != value)
			{
				selected = value;
				if (HasSelectedNodeAppearance)
				{
					RecalcSize = true;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void InternalSetCheckedState(CheckState newVal)
		{
			HashSet<UltraTreeNode> affectedNodes = (IsSynchronizedCheckBox ? new HashSet<UltraTreeNode>() : null);
			InternalSetCheckedState(newVal, affectedNodes);
			FireAfterCheckSynchronization(affectedNodes);
		}

		internal void InternalSetCheckedState(CheckState newVal, HashSet<UltraTreeNode> affectedNodes)
		{
			if (checkState != newVal)
			{
				CheckState originalCheckedState = checkState;
				checkState = newVal;
				if (owningControl != null)
				{
					owningControl.AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.StateChange, VisibleIndex);
				}
				affectedNodes?.Add(this);
				VerifyCheckBoxSynchronization(originalCheckedState, synchChildren: true, synchParent: true, affectedNodes);
			}
		}

		internal void SetCheckState(CheckState value, HashSet<UltraTreeNode> affectedNodes, bool synchChildren = true, bool synchParent = true)
		{
			if (checkState == value)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeforeCheckEventArgs e = new BeforeCheckEventArgs(this);
			e.NewValue = value;
			CheckState checkedState = CheckedState;
			if (owningControl != null)
			{
				owningControl.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.BeforeCheck, e);
			}
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (NodeStyleResolved == NodeStyle.OptionButton)
			{
				if (ParentNodesCollection != null && checkState != e.NewValue)
				{
					if (ParentNodesCollection.CheckedOptionButtonIndex == Index && value == CheckState.Unchecked)
					{
						ParentNodesCollection.CheckedOptionButtonIndex = -1;
					}
					else
					{
						ParentNodesCollection.CheckedOptionButtonIndex = Index;
					}
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.CheckedState, null);
				}
			}
			else if (checkState != e.NewValue)
			{
				checkState = e.NewValue;
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.CheckedState, null);
			}
			if (owningControl != null)
			{
				NodeEventArgs e2 = new NodeEventArgs(this);
				owningControl.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.AfterCheck, e2);
				UltraTree control = Control;
				ToggleState toggleState = TreeUtils.GetToggleState(checkedState);
				ToggleState toggleState2 = TreeUtils.GetToggleState(checkState);
				control.RaiseUIAutomationPropertyChangedEventInternal((AutomationPropertyIds)30086, toggleState, toggleState2, ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)GetUiaProviderStub()).Provider);
			}
			affectedNodes?.Add(this);
			VerifyCheckBoxSynchronization(checkedState, synchChildren, synchParent, affectedNodes);
		}

		internal void internalExpand(bool value)
		{
			internalExpand(value, notify: true, updateVisibleNodes: true);
		}

		internal void internalExpand(bool value, bool notify, bool updateVisibleNodes)
		{
			if (expanded == value)
			{
				return;
			}
			VisibleNodesManager visibleNodesManager = ((owningControl != null) ? owningControl.VisibleNodesManager : null);
			int num = (HasNodes ? nodes.Count : 0);
			if (owningControl != null)
			{
				CancelableNodeEventArgs e = new CancelableNodeEventArgs(this);
				if (value)
				{
					owningControl.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.BeforeExpand, e);
				}
				else
				{
					owningControl.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.BeforeCollapse, e);
				}
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!value)
				{
					bool flag = true;
					UltraTreeNodeCell activeCell = owningControl.ActiveCell;
					if (activeCell != null && owningControl.IsCellInEditMode)
					{
						if (IsAncestorOf(activeCell.Node))
						{
							flag = activeCell.EndEdit(cancel: false);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						UltraTreeNode activeNode = owningControl.ActiveNode;
						if (activeNode != null && activeNode.IsEditing)
						{
							activeNode.EndEdit(cancel: false);
							flag = !activeNode.IsEditing;
						}
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			expanded = value;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (expanded)
			{
				TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection = Nodes;
				int listCount = treeNodesCollection.ListCount;
				treeNodesCollection.VerifyBoundNodes();
				if (treeNodesCollection.ListCount != listCount && owningControl != null && visibleNodesManager.IsDirty)
				{
					visibleNodesManager.Reinitialize();
					flag2 = true;
				}
			}
			if (owningControl != null)
			{
				if (UIElement != null && !owningControl.dragInProgress && visibleNodesManager.VisibleNodes.Count > 0 && ParentNodesCollection != null && !ParentNodesCollection.IsVerifyBoundNodesInProgress)
				{
					if (!visibleNodesManager.IsDirty)
					{
						int oldVisibleIndex = owningControl.TopNode.VisibleIndex;
						if (updateVisibleNodes && !flag2)
						{
							visibleNodesManager.ProcessExpandedStateChanged(this, value);
						}
						visibleNodesManager.VerifyTopNode(oldVisibleIndex);
						if (owningControl.ActiveNode != null && owningControl.ActiveNode.VisibleIndex == -1)
						{
							owningControl.SetActiveNode(this, bringIntoView: false);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					visibleNodesManager.IsDirty = true;
				}
			}
			if (owningControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (HasExpandedNodeAppearance)
			{
				RecalcSize = true;
				if (owningControl != null)
				{
					((UIElement)owningControl.UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
				}
			}
			if (ShowExpansionIndicatorResolved == ShowExpansionIndicator.CheckOnExpand && num == 0 && !HasNodes)
			{
				expanded = false;
				forceSuppresionOfExpansionIndicator = true;
				((UIElement)owningControl.UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
			}
			else
			{
				forceSuppresionOfExpansionIndicator = false;
			}
			if (owningControl.HasOverride && owningControl.Override.HasExpandedNodeAppearance)
			{
				RecalcSize = true;
			}
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.IsExpanded, null);
			}
			if (value && nodes != null)
			{
				nodes.ApplySort();
			}
			NodeEventArgs e2 = new NodeEventArgs(this);
			if (value)
			{
				owningControl.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.AfterExpand, e2);
			}
			else
			{
				owningControl.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.AfterCollapse, e2);
			}
			if (notify)
			{
				owningControl.AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.StateChange, VisibleIndex);
			}
		}

		private bool GetImage()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AppearanceData appData = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)384;
			ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref requestedProps);
			if (((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).Image != null && owningControl != null)
			{
				if (((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).Image is Image)
				{
					isImageFromImageList = false;
				}
				else
				{
					isImageFromImageList = true;
				}
				image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).GetImage(owningControl.ImageList);
				return image != null;
			}
			image = null;
			return false;
		}

		internal NodeStyle GetNodeStyleResolved(bool verifyAncestors)
		{
			NodeStyle nodeStyle = CalculateNodeStyleResolved();
			if (nodeStyle != lastNodeStyleResolved && (nodeStyle == NodeStyle.SynchronizedCheckBox || lastNodeStyleResolved == NodeStyle.SynchronizedCheckBox))
			{
				lastNodeStyleResolved = nodeStyle;
				Nodes.ParentNodesStyleResolvedChanged();
				if (verifyAncestors)
				{
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = Parent;
					if (ultraTreeNode != null)
					{
						ParentNodesCollection.ChildNodesStyleResolvedChanged(this);
					}
				}
			}
			return nodeStyle;
		}

		}

		public void ExpandAll(ExpandAllType expand)
		{
			try
			{
				ExpandCollapseAllHelper(expand: true, expand);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (owningControl != null)
				{
					owningControl.VisibleNodesManager.ProcessExpandedStateChanged(this, expand: true);
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.IsExpanded);
					owningControl.AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.StateChange, visibleIndex);
				}
			}
		}

		public void CollapseAll()
		{
			try
			{
				ExpandCollapseAllHelper(expand: false, ExpandAllType.Always);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (owningControl != null)
				{
					owningControl.VisibleNodesManager.ProcessExpandedStateChanged(this, expand: true);
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.IsExpanded);
					owningControl.AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.StateChange, visibleIndex);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ExpandCollapseAllHelper(bool expand, ExpandAllType expandAllType)
		{
			if (expandAllType != ExpandAllType.Always && !HasVisibleNodes)
			{
				return;
			}
			internalExpand(expand, notify: false, updateVisibleNodes: false);
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraTreeNode node in nodes)
			{
				node.ExpandCollapseAllHelper(expand, expandAllType);
			}
		}

		public void Reposition(UltraTreeNode relativeNode, NodePosition relativePosition)
		{
			VerifyCanReposition(ParentNodesCollection, relativeNode.ParentNodesCollection);
			if (relativeNode == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_14"));
			}
			if (IsAncestorOf(relativeNode))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_15"));
			}
			bool flag = parent == relativeNode.Parent;
			TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection = null;
			treeNodesCollection = ((relativeNode.Parent != null) ? relativeNode.Parent.Nodes : relativeNode.Control.Nodes);
			int num = treeNodesCollection.IndexOf(relativeNode);
			if (Control != null)
			{
				((UIElement)Control.UIElement).VerifyChildElements();
			}
			int top = relativeNode.Control.Nodes[0].Bounds.Top;
			switch (relativePosition)
			{
			case NodePosition.First:
				num = 0;
				break;
			case NodePosition.Last:
				num = treeNodesCollection.Count - 1;
				break;
			case NodePosition.Next:
				if (flag && relativeNode.Index == Index - 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!flag || this == relativeNode)
				{
					num++;
				}
				else if (relativeNode.Index < Index)
				{
					num++;
				}
				break;
			case NodePosition.Previous:
				if (flag)
				{
					if (relativeNode.Index == Index + 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (relativeNode.Index > Index || this == relativeNode)
					{
						num--;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				if (relativePosition != NodePosition.Previous && relativePosition != NodePosition.First)
				{
					return;
				}
				num = 0;
			}
			if (num >= treeNodesCollection.Count)
			{
				if (relativePosition != NodePosition.Last && relativePosition != NodePosition.Next)
				{
					return;
				}
				num = treeNodesCollection.Count;
			}
			Reposition(treeNodesCollection, num);
		}

		public void Reposition(TreeNodesCollection newNodesCollection)
		{
			Reposition(newNodesCollection, newNodesCollection.Count);
		}

		public void Reposition(TreeNodesCollection newNodesCollection, int index)
		{
			if (ParentNodesCollection == newNodesCollection && Index == index)
			{
				return;
			}
			VerifyCanReposition(ParentNodesCollection, newNodesCollection);
			if (newNodesCollection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_16"));
			}
			UltraTreeNode parentNode = newNodesCollection.ParentNode;
			if (IsAncestorOf(parentNode) || parentNode == this)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_15"));
			}
			UltraTree ultraTree = owningControl;
			UltraTreeNode firstVisibleNode = owningControl.FirstVisibleNode;
			int vScrollPosition = ultraTree.ScrollbarControl.VScrollPosition;
			if (this == firstVisibleNode && NextVisibleNode != null)
			{
				firstVisibleNode = NextVisibleNode;
				while (firstVisibleNode != null && firstVisibleNode.Level != level)
				{
					firstVisibleNode = firstVisibleNode.NextVisibleNode;
				}
			}
			if (Selected)
			{
				Selected = false;
			}
			bool flag = ParentNodesCollection == newNodesCollection;
			InternalRemove();
			if (flag && index > newNodesCollection.Count - 1)
			{
				index = newNodesCollection.Count;
			}
			if (parentNode == null)
			{
				if (newNodesCollection.Control != null)
				{
					InternalSetOwningControl(newNodesCollection.Control, parentNode);
					if (newNodesCollection.ParentNode == null)
					{
						newNodesCollection.Control.Nodes.Insert(index, this);
					}
					else
					{
						newNodesCollection.ParentNode.Nodes.Insert(index, this);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				InternalSetOwningControl(parentNode.Control, parentNode);
				parentNode.Nodes.Insert(index, this);
			}
			if (index == 0 && newNodesCollection == newNodesCollection.Control.Nodes)
			{
				newNodesCollection.Control.TopNode = this;
			}
			if (owningControl != null)
			{
				RecalcSize = true;
				((UIElement)owningControl.UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		internal void AdjustRepositionSelection(UltraTree newTreeControl)
		{
			if (selected)
			{
				ISelectionStrategy selectionStrategy = newTreeControl.GetSelectionManagerInternal().GetSelectionStrategy((ISelectableItem)this);
				if (selectionStrategy.IsSingleSelect && newTreeControl.SelectedNodes.Count > 0)
				{
					selected = false;
				}
				else
				{
					newTreeControl.SelectedNodes.InternalAdd(this);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsAncestorOf(UltraTreeNode descendantNode)
		{
			if (descendantNode == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = descendantNode.Parent; ultraTreeNode != null; ultraTreeNode = ultraTreeNode.Parent)
			{
				if (ultraTreeNode == this)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void BeginEdit()
		{
			BeginEdit(ignoreLabelEdit: true);
		}

		internal void BeginEdit(bool ignoreLabelEdit)
		{
			if (!editing && owningControl != null)

					editing = owningControl.BeginEdit(this, ignoreLabelEdit);

			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldExpandOnHover()
		{
			switch (AllowAutoDragExpandResolved)
			{
			case AllowAutoDragExpand.Never:
				return false;
			case AllowAutoDragExpand.ExpandOnDragHover:
				if (!Expanded && HasNodes)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			case AllowAutoDragExpand.ExpandOnDragHoverWhenExpansionIndicatorVisible:
				if (HasExpansionIndicator)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool CanBeSelected(bool clearExistingSelection, bool programmatic)
		{
			if (owningControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SelectedNodesCollection selectedNodes = owningControl.SelectedNodes;
			if (!clearExistingSelection && !owningControl.CanSelectAcrossCollections && selectedNodes.Count != 0 && selectedNodes[0].ParentNodesCollection != ParentNodesCollection)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = owningControl.CanBeSelectedVersion;
			if (canBeSelectedVersion != num)
			{
				if (!EnabledResolved || (!Visible && !programmatic))
				{
					cachedCanBeSelected = CanBeSelectedType.None;
				}
				else
				{
					switch (SelectionTypeResolved)
					{
					case SelectType.None:
						cachedCanBeSelected = CanBeSelectedType.None;
						break;
					case SelectType.Extended:
					case SelectType.ExtendedAutoDrag:
						cachedCanBeSelected = CanBeSelectedType.Extended;
						break;
					default:
						cachedCanBeSelected = CanBeSelectedType.Single;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			switch (cachedCanBeSelected)
			{
			case CanBeSelectedType.None:
				return false;
			case CanBeSelectedType.Single:
				if (clearExistingSelection || selectedNodes.Count == 0 || selectedNodes[0].ParentNodesCollection == ParentNodesCollection)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsFirstVisibleNodeInIslandHelper(int topNodeVisibleIndex)
		{
			if (owningControl == null || owningControl.VisibleNodesArray.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = VisibleIndex;
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ((num > 0) ? (owningControl.VisibleNodesArray[num - 1] as UltraTreeNode) : null);
			bool flag = false;
			if (ultraTreeNode != null)
			{
				if (ultraTreeNode.Level != Level)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					for (int i = topNodeVisibleIndex; i < num; i++)
					{
						UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode2 = owningControl.VisibleNodesArray[i] as UltraTreeNode;
						if (ultraTreeNode2.Level == Level)
						{
							flag = false;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (num == topNodeVisibleIndex || flag)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (owningControl.IsViewStyleFreeForm && ultraTreeNode != null && ultraTreeNode.HasOverride && ultraTreeNode.Override.HasColumnSet && ultraTreeNode.Override.ColumnSet.HasColumns)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ShowTooltipIfNeeded()
		{
			if (owningControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (owningControl.ActiveNode != null && owningControl.ActiveNode.IsEditing)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DisplaysCells)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TreeNodeUIElement uIElement = UIElement;
			if (uIElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)uIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(NodeTextUIElement));
			if (descendant == null)
			{
				descendant = ((UIElement)uIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(EmbeddableUIElementBase));
			}
			if (descendant == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Rectangle rect = descendant.Rect;
			int num = 0;
			Size size = UnconstrainedTextSize;
			if (multilineCached)
			{
				num = MaxLabelWidthResolved;
				rect.Height = Math.Max(constrainedTextSize.Height, rect.Height);
				rect.Width = Math.Max(constrainedTextSize.Width, rect.Width);
				if (num == 0 || num >= size.Width)
				{
					rect.Size = size;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				rect.Size = size;
			}
			if ((singleLineText == null || singleLineText.Equals(Text)) && owningControl.ViewableArea.Contains(rect) && descendant.Rect.Contains(rect))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Point location = rect.Location;
			location = ((Control)(object)owningControl).PointToScreen(location);
			if (descendant is NodeTextUIElement || owningControl.DisplayStyleResolved == UltraTreeDisplayStyle.WindowsVista)
			{
				location.Offset(-2, -1);
				owningControl.ToolTip.ToolTipText = Text;
				owningControl.ShowingTipForNode = this;
				switch (owningControl.DisplayStyleResolved)
				{
				case UltraTreeDisplayStyle.Standard:
					ShowToolTipStandard(rect, num, location);
					break;
				case UltraTreeDisplayStyle.WindowsVista:
					ShowToolTipWindowsVista(rect, num, location);
					break;
				default:
					ShowToolTipStandard(rect, num, location);
					break;
				}
				return true;
			}
			EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = EditorResolved;
			if (editorResolved == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			rect = descendant.DrawingRect;
			owningControl.ShowingTipForNode = this;
			owningControl.ToolTip.Show(new Rectangle(location, Size.Empty), true, true, true, Rectangle.Empty, false, false, editorResolved, (EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)owningControl.EditorOwner, (object)owningControl.ToolTip, false, num);
			return true;
		}

		internal void BringIntoViewHelper(bool includeChildNodes, bool includeHorizontal, bool includeVertical, bool leftOnly)

		}

		internal void BringIntoViewHelper(bool includeChildNodes, bool includeHorizontal, bool includeVertical, bool leftOnly, bool isVerifying)
		{
			if (owningControl == null || !VisibleResolved)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!isVerifying && (((UltraControlBase)owningControl).IsUpdating || !owningControl.HasPainted))
			{
				owningControl.SetPendingBringIntoViewInfo(this, includeChildNodes, includeHorizontal, includeVertical, leftOnly);
			}
			else
			{
				if (owningControl.TopNode == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!includeHorizontal)
				{
					UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)UIElement;
					if (uIElement != null && uIElement.GetAncestor(typeof(NodeClientAreaUIElement)) is NodeClientAreaUIElement nodeClientAreaUIElement)
					{
						Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)nodeClientAreaUIElement).Rect;
						Rectangle rect2 = uIElement.Rect;
						if (rect2.Y >= rect.Y && rect2.Bottom < rect.Bottom)
						{
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				for (UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = parent; ultraTreeNode != null; ultraTreeNode = ultraTreeNode.Parent)
				{
					if (!ultraTreeNode.VisibleResolved)
					{
						return;
					}
					ultraTreeNode.Expanded = true;
				}
				if (includeChildNodes)
				{
					Expanded = true;
				}
				ViewStyle viewStyleResolved = owningControl.ViewStyleResolved;
				Rectangle viewableArea = owningControl.ViewableArea;
				if (viewStyleResolved == ViewStyle.Standard)
				{
					((UIElement)owningControl.UIElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode2 = null;
					if (includeChildNodes && HasNodes)
					{
						ultraTreeNode2 = nodes.LastVisibleNode;
					}
					int itemHeightResolvedWithSpacing = ItemHeightResolvedWithSpacing;
					int rightExtent = 0;
					itemHeightResolvedWithSpacing += ((ultraTreeNode2 != null) ? CalcAllDescendantsHeight(ref rightExtent) : 0);
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode3 = null;
					Rectangle myBounds = Bounds;
					Rectangle rectangle = myBounds;
					int num = 0;
					if (includeVertical)
					{
						VisibleNodesManager visibleNodesManager = owningControl.VisibleNodesManager;
						int height = visibleNodesManager.ScrollSize.Height;
						if (height <= viewableArea.Height)
						{
							UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode4 = ((visibleNodesManager.VisibleNodes.Count == 0) ? null : (visibleNodesManager.VisibleNodes[0] as UltraTreeNode));
							ultraTreeNode3 = ultraTreeNode4;
						}
						else if (itemHeightResolvedWithSpacing >= viewableArea.Height)
						{
							ultraTreeNode3 = this;
						}
						else
						{
							if (rectangle.Top + itemHeightResolvedWithSpacing > viewableArea.Bottom)
							{
								num = rectangle.Top + itemHeightResolvedWithSpacing - viewableArea.Bottom;
							}
							else if (rectangle.Top < viewableArea.Top)
							{
								ultraTreeNode3 = this;
							}
							if (num > 0)
							{
								for (int i = owningControl.TopNode.VisibleIndex; i < owningControl.VisibleNodesArray.Count; i++)
								{
									UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode5 = owningControl.VisibleNodesArray[i] as UltraTreeNode;
									rectangle = ultraTreeNode5.Bounds;
									if (rectangle.Top + ultraTreeNode5.NodeSpacingBeforeResolved - viewableArea.Top >= num)
									{
										ultraTreeNode3 = ultraTreeNode5;
										break;
									}
									if (ultraTreeNode5 == this || rectangle.Bottom > viewableArea.Bottom)
									{
										break;
									}
								}
								if (ultraTreeNode3 == null)
								{
									ultraTreeNode3 = this;
								}
							}
						}
						if (ultraTreeNode3 != null)
						{
							owningControl.TopNode = ultraTreeNode3;
						}
					}
					if (includeHorizontal)
					{
						int num2 = CalcTargetHorizontalScrollPosition(leftOnly, ref viewableArea, ultraTreeNode2, rightExtent, ref myBounds);
						if (Control.AutoScrollHorizontalResolved)
						{
							Control.StartHorizontalScrollAnimationTimer(num2);
						}
						else
						{
							owningControl.ScrollbarControl.HScrollPosition = num2;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					int num3 = VisibleIndex;
					UltraTreeNode topNode = owningControl.TopNode;
					ArrayList visibleNodesArray = owningControl.VisibleNodesArray;
					if (num3 < topNode.VisibleIndex)
					{
						owningControl.TopNode = this;
					}
					else if (num3 > topNode.VisibleIndex)
					{
						int num4 = 0;
						int[] array = new int[num3 - topNode.VisibleIndex + 1];
						int num5 = topNode.VisibleIndex;
						for (int j = num5; j <= num3; j++)
						{
							UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode6 = visibleNodesArray[j] as UltraTreeNode;
							int itemHeightResolvedWithSpacing2 = ultraTreeNode6.ItemHeightResolvedWithSpacing;
							int num6 = (ultraTreeNode6.DisplaysHeaderAreaHelper(topNode.VisibleIndex) ? ultraTreeNode6.DisplayColumnSetResolved.LayoutManager.HeaderAreaSize.Height : 0);
							array[j - num5] = itemHeightResolvedWithSpacing2 + num6;
							num4 += itemHeightResolvedWithSpacing2 + num6;
						}
						if (num4 > viewableArea.Height)
						{
							for (int k = num5 + 1; k <= num3; k++)
							{
								num4 -= array[k - num5];
								if (num4 <= viewableArea.Height)
								{
									owningControl.TopNode = visibleNodesArray[k] as UltraTreeNode;
									break;
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				((UIElement)owningControl.UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				if (owningControl.UIElement != null)
				{
					((UIElement)owningControl.UIElement).VerifyChildElements();
				}
			}
		}

		private int CalcAllDescendantsHeight(ref int rightExtent)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (HasNodes)
			{
				foreach (UltraTreeNode node in nodes)
				{
					if (node.VisibleResolved)
					{
						num += node.ItemHeightResolvedWithSpacing;
						if (node.expanded)
						{
							num += node.CalcAllDescendantsHeight(ref rightExtent);
						}
						else
						{
							rightExtent = node.Bounds.Right;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				rightExtent = Bounds.Right;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal void ResetControl()
		{
			if (HasNodesWithoutVerification)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < nodes.ListCount; i++)
				{
					UltraTreeNode nodeWithoutVerification = nodes.GetNodeWithoutVerification(i);
					nodeWithoutVerification.ResetControl();
				}
			}
			else if (HasNodesCollectionBeenCreated)
			{
				nodes.ResetControl();
			}
			if (Control != null)
			{
				if (Control.pivotItem == this)
				{
					Control.pivotItem = null;
				}
				if (Control.lastHoverNode == this)
				{
					Control.lastHoverNode = null;
				}
			}
			owningControl = null;
		}
