		private UltraTreeColumnSet GetColumnSet(NodeColumnRelationship relationship)
		{
			UltraTree control = Control;
			UltraTreeColumnSet result = null;
			int num = ((owningControl != null) ? owningControl.ColumnSetVersion : 0);
			switch (relationship)
			{
			case NodeColumnRelationship.Display:
				if (cachedDisplayColumnSet != null && displayColumnSetVersion == num)
				{
					return cachedDisplayColumnSet;
				}
				break;
			case NodeColumnRelationship.Data:
				if (cachedDataColumnSet != null && dataColumnSetVersion == num)
				{
					return cachedDataColumnSet;
				}
				break;
			}
			switch (relationship)
			{
			case NodeColumnRelationship.Display:
				if (control != null && control.IsViewStyleOutlookExpress)
				{
					result = control.ColumnSettings.OutlookExpressDisplayColumnSet;
				}
				else
				{
					Override obj2 = ((HasOverride && (relationship == NodeColumnRelationship.Data || control.ViewStyle == ViewStyle.FreeForm)) ? Override : null);
					if (obj2 != null && obj2.HasColumnSet && obj2.ColumnSet.HasColumns && obj2.ColumnSet.Columns.Count > 0)
					{
						result = obj2.ColumnSet;
					}
					else if (ParentNodesCollection != null)
					{
						result = ParentNodesCollection.ColumnSetResolved;
					}
				}
				cachedDisplayColumnSet = result;
				displayColumnSetVersion = num;
				break;
			case NodeColumnRelationship.Data:
			{
				Override obj = (HasOverride ? Override : null);
				if (obj != null && obj.HasColumnSet && obj.ColumnSet.HasColumns && obj.ColumnSet.Columns.Count > 0)
				{
					result = obj.ColumnSet;
				}
				else if (ParentNodesCollection != null)
				{
					result = ParentNodesCollection.ColumnSetResolved;
				}
				cachedDataColumnSet = result;
				dataColumnSetVersion = num;
				break;
			}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool DisplaysHeaderAreaHelper(int topNodeVisibleIndex)
		{
			if (topNodeVisibleIndex < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ShowColumnsResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraTree control = Control;
			if (control == null || control.VisibleNodesManager.VisibleNodes.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = false;
			UltraTreeColumnSet displayColumnSetResolved = DisplayColumnSetResolved;
			switch (control.ViewStyleResolved)
			{
			case ViewStyle.Standard:
			case ViewStyle.OutlookExpress:
				result = false;
				break;
			case ViewStyle.Grid:
			case ViewStyle.FreeForm:
				result = displayColumnSetResolved.SettingsResolved.LabelStyle != NodeLayoutLabelStyle.WithCellData && displayColumnSetResolved.SettingsResolved.LabelPosition != NodeLayoutLabelPosition.None && ((!control.IsViewStyleFreeForm) ? IsFirstVisibleNodeInIslandHelper(topNodeVisibleIndex) : ((HasOverride && Override.HasColumnSet && Override.ColumnSet.HasColumns && Override.ColumnSet.Columns.Count > 0) || IsFirstVisibleNodeInIslandHelper(topNodeVisibleIndex)));
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void ProcessDoubleClick(bool adjustableArea)
		{
			if ((System.Windows.Forms.Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) != Keys.Control && (System.Windows.Forms.Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Shift) != Keys.Shift)
			{
				if (NodeDoubleClickActionResolved == NodeDoubleClickAction.ToggleExpansion)
				{
					Toggle();
				}
				else if (NodeDoubleClickActionResolved == NodeDoubleClickAction.ToggleExpansionWhenExpansionIndicatorVisible && HasExpansionIndicator)
				{
					Toggle();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResetPendingCellValues()
		{
			TreeColumnsCollection dataColumns = DataColumns;
			if (dataColumns == null || pendingCellValues == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < dataColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = dataColumns[i];
				if (pendingCellValues.ContainsKey(ultraTreeNodeColumn))
				{
					pendingCellValues[ultraTreeNodeColumn] = null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResetChangedBoundCellsHash()
		{
			TreeColumnsCollection dataColumns = DataColumns;
			if (dataColumns == null || changedBoundCellsHash == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < dataColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = dataColumns[i];
				if (changedBoundCellsHash.ContainsKey(ultraTreeNodeColumn))
				{
					changedBoundCellsHash[ultraTreeNodeColumn] = false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetPendingCellValue(UltraTreeNodeColumn column, object value)
		{
			if (IsBound(column))
			{
				SetBoundCellValue(column, value);
				Hashtable hashtable = ChangedBoundCellsHash;
				if (hashtable.ContainsKey(column))
				{
					hashtable[column] = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Hashtable hashtable2 = PendingCellValues;
				if (hashtable2.ContainsKey(column))
				{
					hashtable2[column] = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool VerifyNullCellValue(UltraTreeNodeColumn column, object value, out object newValue)
		{
			bool flag = value is string && ((string)value).Length == 0;
			bool flag2 = value == null || value is DBNull;
			bool flag3 = column.IsNullable(this);
			Nullable nullable = column.Nullable;
			newValue = value;
			if (flag || flag2)
			{
				switch (nullable)
				{
				case Nullable.Disallow:
					return false;
				case Nullable.Automatic:
					if (flag3)
					{
						newValue = DBNull.Value;
					}
					else
					{
						newValue = string.Empty;
					}
					break;
				case Nullable.DbNull:
					newValue = DBNull.Value;
					break;
				case Nullable.Nothing:
					newValue = null;
					break;
				case Nullable.EmptyString:
					newValue = string.Empty;
					break;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool CommitCellValue(UltraTreeNodeColumn column)
		{
			if (!IsCellValueDirty(column))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!ShowColumnsResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (owningControl != null)
			{
				CancelableNodeEventArgs e = new CancelableNodeEventArgs(this);
				owningControl.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.BeforeNodeUpdate, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (IsBound(column))
			{
				flag = ListObjectEndEdit(column);
				if (flag)
				{
					ChangedBoundCellsHash[column] = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Hashtable hashtable = PendingCellValues;
				if (!hashtable.ContainsKey(column))
				{
					return false;
				}
				object obj = hashtable[column];
				if (obj != null)
				{
					SetCellValue(column, obj);
					hashtable[column] = null;
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				NodeEventArgs e2 = new NodeEventArgs(this);
				owningControl.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.AfterNodeUpdate, e2);
			}
			return flag;
		}

			}

			TreeColumnsCollection dataColumns = DataColumns;

			}

				{
					object obj = hashtable[column];
					if (obj != null)
					{
						CellValues[column] = obj;
						hashtable[column] = null;
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (owningControl != null)
			{
				NodeEventArgs e2 = new NodeEventArgs(this);
				owningControl.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.AfterNodeUpdate, e2);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal void UndoEdit(bool dirtyElements, bool fireEvents)

				owningControl.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.AfterNodeCancelUpdate, e2);

		public void SetCellValue(UltraTreeNodeColumn column, object value)
		{
			object cellValueHelper = GetCellValueHelper(column, useEditorValueWhenInEditMode: false);
			if (object.Equals(cellValueHelper, value))
			{
				return;
			}
			string message = string.Empty;
			if (owningControl != null && column.ConvertValueToDataType(this, value, out message) == null)
			{
				DataErrorEventArgs e = new DataErrorEventArgs(this, column, null, value, message, includePrefixInMessage: false);
				owningControl.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.DataError, e);
				if (e.DisplayMessageBox)
				{
					UltraMessageBoxManager.Show(e.ErrorTextResolved, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataError_MessageBox_Title"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (IsBound(column))
			{
				SetBoundCellValue(column, value);
			}
			else
			{
				if (pendingCellValues != null)
				{
					SetPendingCellValue(column, null);
				}
				Hashtable hashtable = CellValues;
				if (hashtable.ContainsKey(column))
				{
					hashtable[column] = value;
				}
			}
			SortType sortType = ((owningControl != null && column != null) ? column.SettingsResolved.SortType : SortType.None);
			if (sortType != SortType.None)
			{
				column.ColumnSet.DirtySortForAssociatedNodesCollections(owningControl);
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Value);
		}

				}
			}
		}

		{

				throw new ArgumentNullException();

			{
				EmbeddableUIElementBase cellEmbeddableElement = GetCellEmbeddableElement(column);
				if (cellEmbeddableElement == null)

					return null;
				}
				return cellEmbeddableElement.Editor.Value;
			}
			Hashtable hashtable = PendingCellValues;
			object obj = (hashtable.ContainsKey(column) ? hashtable[column] : null);
			if (obj != null)
			{
				return obj;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor boundPropertyDescriptor = GetBoundPropertyDescriptor(column);
			if (boundPropertyDescriptor == null)
			{
				Hashtable hashtable2 = CellValues;
				if (hashtable2.ContainsKey(column))
				{
					return hashtable2[column];
				}
				ViewStyle viewStyle = ((owningControl == null) ? ViewStyle.Standard : owningControl.ViewStyleResolved);
				if (viewStyle == ViewStyle.OutlookExpress && IsBandNode && column.IsExpansionIndicatorColumn)
				{
					return Text;
				}
				return null;
			}
			object listObjectResolved = ListObjectResolved;
			if (listObjectResolved != UltraTree.dummyListObject)
			{
				try
				{
					return boundPropertyDescriptor.GetValue(listObjectResolved);
				}
				catch
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return DataBindingUtils.GetSampleDataForType(boundPropertyDescriptor.PropertyType);
		}

		internal UltraTreeNodeColumn GetDisplayColumnFromDataColumn(UltraTreeNodeColumn dataColumn)

			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraTreeColumnSet displayColumnSetResolved = DisplayColumnSetResolved;
			UltraTreeColumnSet dataColumnSetResolved = DataColumnSetResolved;

			}
			VisibleColumnsCollection visibleColumns = displayColumnSetResolved.VisibleColumns;
			VisibleColumnsCollection visibleColumns2 = dataColumnSetResolved.VisibleColumns;
			string mapToColumn = dataColumn.MapToColumn;
			if (mapToColumn != null && mapToColumn.Length > 0 && visibleColumns.Exists(mapToColumn))

		internal void BringColumnIntoViewHelper(UltraTreeNodeColumn column, LayoutItemType layoutItemType)
		{
			if (owningControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraTreeColumnSet displayColumnSetResolved = DisplayColumnSetResolved;
			if (displayColumnSetResolved == null || !displayColumnSetResolved.Columns.Contains(column))
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraTreeNode_Exception_BringCellIntoView"));
			}
			NodeLayoutLabelPosition labelPosition = displayColumnSetResolved.SettingsResolved.LabelPosition;
			NodeLayoutLabelStyle labelStyle = displayColumnSetResolved.SettingsResolved.LabelStyle;
			if ((layoutItemType == LayoutItemType.Header && (labelPosition == NodeLayoutLabelPosition.None || labelStyle == NodeLayoutLabelStyle.Separate)) || (layoutItemType == LayoutItemType.Cell && labelPosition == NodeLayoutLabelPosition.LabelOnly))
			{
				return;
			}
			BringIntoViewHelper(includeChildNodes: false, includeHorizontal: false);
			ColumnSetLayoutManager.LayoutPositionCalculator layoutPositionCalculator = new ColumnSetLayoutManager.LayoutPositionCalculator(this);
			Rectangle rectangle = layoutPositionCalculator[column, layoutItemType];
			int num = Indentation;
			if (Level > 0)
			{
				int num2 = (owningControl.ShouldIndentRootLevel ? owningControl.IndentResolved : 0);
				num += num2;
			}
			int hScrollPosition = owningControl.ScrollbarControl.HScrollPosition;
			int num3 = rectangle.Left + num;
			int num4 = rectangle.Right + num;
			Size size = owningControl.ViewableArea.Size;
			if (num3 >= hScrollPosition && num4 < hScrollPosition + size.Width)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (num3 < hScrollPosition)
			{
				owningControl.ScrollbarControl.HScrollPosition = num3;
			}
			else if (num4 > hScrollPosition + rectangle.Width)
			{
				if (rectangle.Width > size.Width)
				{
					owningControl.ScrollbarControl.HScrollPosition = num3;
					return;
				}
				num3 -= size.Width - rectangle.Width;
				owningControl.ScrollbarControl.HScrollPosition = num3;
			}
		}

		internal PropertyDescriptor GetBoundPropertyDescriptor(UltraTreeNodeColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				throw new NullReferenceException("column");
			}
			string name = column.Key;
			if (PropertyDescriptorInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (PropertyDescriptorInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor nonChapteredPropertyDescriptor = PropertyDescriptorInfo.GetNonChapteredPropertyDescriptor(name);
			if (nonChapteredPropertyDescriptor != null)
			{
				return nonChapteredPropertyDescriptor;
			}
			nonChapteredPropertyDescriptor = PropertyDescriptorInfo.GetChapteredPropertyDescriptor(name);
			if (nonChapteredPropertyDescriptor != null)
			{
				return nonChapteredPropertyDescriptor;
			}
			return null;
		}

		}

		internal UltraTreeNode GetFirstActivateableNodeInCollection(bool mustDisplayCells)
		{
			UltraTreeNode result = null;
			TreeNodesCollection parentNodesCollection = ParentNodesCollection;
			if (parentNodesCollection != null && (parentNodesCollection.ParentNode == null || parentNodesCollection.ParentNode.Expanded))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < parentNodesCollection.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = parentNodesCollection[i];
					if (ultraTreeNode.EnabledResolved && ultraTreeNode.VisibleResolved && (!mustDisplayCells || (ultraTreeNode.DisplaysCells && ultraTreeNode.AllowCellEdit != AllowCellEdit.Disabled)))
					{
						result = ultraTreeNode;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal UltraTreeNode GetLastActivateableNodeInCollection(bool mustDisplayCells)
		{
			UltraTreeNode result = null;
			TreeNodesCollection parentNodesCollection = ParentNodesCollection;
			if (parentNodesCollection != null && (parentNodesCollection.ParentNode == null || parentNodesCollection.ParentNode.Expanded))
			{
				for (int num = parentNodesCollection.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = parentNodesCollection[num];
					if (ultraTreeNode.EnabledResolved && ultraTreeNode.VisibleResolved && (!mustDisplayCells || (ultraTreeNode.DisplaysCells && ultraTreeNode.AllowCellEdit != AllowCellEdit.Disabled)))
					{
						result = ultraTreeNode;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public bool ActivateCell(UltraTreeNodeColumn column)
		{
			if (owningControl != null)
			{
				return owningControl.SetActiveCellHelper(this, column);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool BeginCellEdit(UltraTreeNodeColumn column)
		{
			if (owningControl != null && ActivateCell(column))
			{
				if (owningControl.EventManager.InProgress(TreeEventIds.BeforeCellEnterEditMode) || owningControl.EventManager.InProgress(TreeEventIds.AfterCellEnterEditMode))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!owningControl.SetFocus())
				{
					return false;
				}
				EmbeddableUIElementBase cellEmbeddableElement = GetCellEmbeddableElement(owningControl.ActiveCellColumn);
				if (cellEmbeddableElement != null)
				{
					EmbeddableEditorBase editor = cellEmbeddableElement.Editor;
					if (editor.CanEditType(column.DataType))
					{
						return editor.EnterEditMode(cellEmbeddableElement);
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool EndCellEdit(bool cancel)
		{
			if (owningControl != null && owningControl.IsCellInEditMode && IsActive)
			{
				if (owningControl.EventManager.InProgress(TreeEventIds.BeforeCellExitEditMode) || owningControl.EventManager.InProgress(TreeEventIds.AfterCellExitEditMode))
				{
					return false;
				}
				bool flag = true;
				EmbeddableUIElementBase cellEmbeddableElement = GetCellEmbeddableElement(owningControl.ActiveCellColumn);
				if (cellEmbeddableElement != null)
				{
					EmbeddableEditorBase editor = cellEmbeddableElement.Editor;
					flag = editor.ExitEditMode(false, !cancel);
					if (!flag && editor.CanFocus)
					{
						editor.Focus();
					}
				}
				return flag;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void OnCellMouseDown(CellMouseDownInfo info)
		{
			if (owningControl != null && owningControl.IsActiveCell(this, info.CellElement.DataColumn) && owningControl.IsCellInEditMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (owningControl != null && owningControl.IsCellInEditMode && !owningControl.ActiveNode.EndCellEdit(cancel: false))
			{
				info.EatMessage = true;
				info.NotifyParentElement = false;
				return;
			}
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ((info.CellElement != null) ? info.CellElement.Node : null);
			if (ultraTreeNode != null && ultraTreeNode.Control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!info.CellElement.Column.SettingsResolved.CanActivateCell(info.CellElement.Node))
			{
				info.EatMessage = true;
				info.NotifyParentElement = false;
				return;
			}
			CellClickAction cellClickActionResolved = CellClickActionResolved;
			switch (cellClickActionResolved)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case CellClickAction.SelectNodeOnly:
				info.EatMessage = false;
				info.NotifyParentElement = true;
				return;
			case CellClickAction.ActivateCell:
				if ((System.Windows.Forms.Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Shift) == Keys.Shift || (System.Windows.Forms.Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) == Keys.Control)
				{
					info.EatMessage = false;
					info.NotifyParentElement = true;
					return;
				}
				break;
			case CellClickAction.EditCell:
			case CellClickAction.EditCellSelectText:
				break;
			}
			if (info.MouseEventArgs.Button != MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraTreeNodeColumn dataColumn = info.CellElement.DataColumn;
			if (ActivateCell(dataColumn))
			{

				{
					BeginCellEdit(dataColumn);

					info.NotifyParentElement = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				info.EatMessage = true;
				info.NotifyParentElement = false;
			}
		}

		public bool Update()
		{
			if (owningControl == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (owningControl.IsCellInEditMode && !EndCellEdit(cancel: false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return CommitCellValues();
		}

		public void CancelUpdate()
		{
			if (owningControl != null && (!owningControl.IsCellInEditMode || EndCellEdit(cancel: false)))
			{
				UndoEdit(dirtyElements: true, fireEvents: true);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyCachedCellValues()
		{
			UltraTreeColumnSet dataColumnSetResolved = DataColumnSetResolved;
			bool flag = false;
			if (dataColumnSetResolved != null && cellValues != null)
			{
				UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = null;
				foreach (object key in cellValues.Keys)
				{
					ultraTreeNodeColumn = key as UltraTreeNodeColumn;
					if (ultraTreeNodeColumn != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				UltraTreeColumnSet ultraTreeColumnSet = ultraTreeNodeColumn?.ColumnSet;
				if (ultraTreeColumnSet != dataColumnSetResolved)
				{
					flag = true;
					cellValues = null;
					pendingCellValues = null;
				}
			}
			if (dataColumnSetResolved == null || (!flag && columnsCollectionVersion == dataColumnSetResolved.ColumnsCollectionVersion))
			{
				return;
			}
			columnsCollectionVersion = dataColumnSetResolved.ColumnsCollectionVersion;
			TreeColumnsCollection columns = dataColumnSetResolved.Columns;
			Hashtable hashtable = (flag ? CellValues : cellValues);
			Hashtable hashtable2 = (flag ? PendingCellValues : pendingCellValues);
			if (hashtable == null && hashtable2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			if (hashtable != null)
			{
				foreach (DictionaryEntry item in hashtable)
				{
					if (item.Key is UltraTreeNodeColumn value && !columns.Contains(value))
					{
						arrayList.Add(value);
					}
				}
				foreach (object item2 in arrayList)
				{
					UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn2 = item2 as UltraTreeNodeColumn;
					hashtable.Remove(ultraTreeNodeColumn2);
				}
			}
			if (hashtable2 != null)
			{
				arrayList.Clear();
				foreach (DictionaryEntry item3 in hashtable2)
				{
					if (item3.Key is UltraTreeNodeColumn value2 && !columns.Contains(value2))
					{
						arrayList.Add(value2);
					}
				}
				foreach (object item4 in arrayList)
				{
					UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn3 = item4 as UltraTreeNodeColumn;
					hashtable2.Remove(ultraTreeNodeColumn3);
				}
			}
			Hashtable hashtable3 = changedBoundCellsHash;
			if (hashtable3 != null)
			{
				arrayList.Clear();
				foreach (DictionaryEntry item5 in hashtable3)
				{
					if (item5.Key is UltraTreeNodeColumn value3 && !columns.Contains(value3))
					{
						arrayList.Add(value3);
					}
				}
				foreach (object item6 in arrayList)
				{
					UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn4 = item6 as UltraTreeNodeColumn;
					hashtable3.Remove(ultraTreeNodeColumn4);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn5 = columns[i];
				if (hashtable != null && !hashtable.Contains(ultraTreeNodeColumn5))
				{
					hashtable.Add(ultraTreeNodeColumn5, null);
				}
				if (hashtable2 != null && !hashtable2.Contains(ultraTreeNodeColumn5))
				{
					hashtable2.Add(ultraTreeNodeColumn5, null);
				}
				if (hashtable3 != null && !hashtable3.Contains(ultraTreeNodeColumn5))
				{
					hashtable3.Add(ultraTreeNodeColumn5, false);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeCellValues()
		{
			if (cellValues == null || IsBound())
			{
				return false;
			}
			Hashtable hashtable = cellValues;
			foreach (DictionaryEntry item in hashtable)
			{
				if (!(item.Key is UltraTreeNodeColumn))
				{
					return false;
				}
				object value = item.Value;
				if (value != null && !Utils.IsSafelySerializable(value))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private int CalcTargetHorizontalScrollPosition(bool leftOnly, bool includeChildNodes)
		{
			Rectangle viewableArea = owningControl.ViewableArea;
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = null;
			if (includeChildNodes && HasNodes)
			{
				ultraTreeNode = nodes.LastVisibleNode;
			}
			int rightExtent = 0;
			if (ultraTreeNode != null)
			{
				CalcAllDescendantsHeight(ref rightExtent);
			}
			Rectangle myBounds = Bounds;
			return CalcTargetHorizontalScrollPosition(leftOnly, ref viewableArea, ultraTreeNode, rightExtent, ref myBounds);
		}

		private int CalcTargetHorizontalScrollPosition(bool leftOnly, ref Rectangle viewableArea, UltraTreeNode lastVisibleChildNode, int rightExtent, ref Rectangle myBounds)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = ((lastVisibleChildNode != null) ? rightExtent : myBounds.Right);
			int hScrollPosition = owningControl.ScrollbarControl.HScrollPosition;
			if (myBounds.Left < viewableArea.Left)
			{
				num = viewableArea.Left + myBounds.Left;
			}
			else if (num2 > viewableArea.Right && !leftOnly)
			{
				num = num2 - viewableArea.Right;
				int val = myBounds.Left - viewableArea.Left;
				num = Math.Min(val, num);
			}
			if (Level == 0)
			{
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return hScrollPosition;
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				return Math.Min(owningControl.ScrollbarControl.HorizontalScroll.Maximum, hScrollPosition + num);
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return Math.Max(owningControl.ScrollbarControl.HorizontalScroll.Minimum, hScrollPosition + num);
			}
			return hScrollPosition;
		}

		}

		private void VerifyChildNodeCheckBoxSynchronization(HashSet<UltraTreeNode> affectedNodes)
		{
			if (!IsSynchronizedCheckBox)
			{
				return;
			}
			CheckState checkedState = CheckedState;
			if (CheckState.Indeterminate == checkedState)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraTreeNode node in Nodes)
			{
				if (node.GetNodeStyleResolved(verifyAncestors: false) == NodeStyle.SynchronizedCheckBox)
				{
					if (node.CheckedState != checkedState)
					{
						affectedNodes.Add(node);
					}
					node.SetCheckState(checkedState, affectedNodes, synchChildren: true, synchParent: false);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyParentNodeCheckBoxSynchronization(HashSet<UltraTreeNode> affectedNodes)
		{
			if (IsSynchronizedCheckBox)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = Parent;
				if (ultraTreeNode != null && ultraTreeNode.IsSynchronizedCheckBox)
				{
					ultraTreeNode.VerifyCheckBoxSynchronization(affectedNodes);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyCheckBoxSynchronization(HashSet<UltraTreeNode> affectedNodes)
		{
			if (IsSynchronizedCheckBox && Nodes.GetResolvedSynchronizedCheckState().HasValue)
			{
				SetCheckState(Nodes.GetResolvedSynchronizedCheckState().Value, affectedNodes, synchChildren: false);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyCheckBoxSynchronization(CheckState originalCheckedState, bool synchChildren, bool synchParent, HashSet<UltraTreeNode> affectedNodes)
		{
			if (IsSynchronizedCheckBox)
			{
				if (synchChildren)
				{
					VerifyChildNodeCheckBoxSynchronization(affectedNodes);
				}
				ParentNodesCollection?.UpdateSynchronizedNodeCheckState(this, originalCheckedState);
				if (synchParent)
				{
					VerifyParentNodeCheckBoxSynchronization(affectedNodes);
				}
			}
		}

		private NodeStyle CalculateNodeStyleResolved()
		{
			if (ShowColumnsResolved)
			{
				return NodeStyle.Standard;
			}
			if (HasOverride && overrideObj.ShouldSerializeNodeStyle())
			{
				return overrideObj.NodeStyle;
			}
			Override nodesOverride = GetNodesOverride();
			if (nodesOverride != null && nodesOverride.ShouldSerializeNodeStyle())
			{
				return nodesOverride.NodeStyle;
			}
			if (owningControl != null && owningControl.HasNodeLevelOverride(level) && owningControl.NodeLevelOverrides[level].ShouldSerializeNodeStyle())
			{
				return owningControl.NodeLevelOverrides[level].NodeStyle;
			}
			if (owningControl != null)
			{
				return owningControl.NodeStyleResolved;
			}
			return NodeStyle.Standard;
		}

		internal void InitializeLastNodeStyleResolved(bool recursive = false)
		{
			lastNodeStyleResolved = CalculateNodeStyleResolved();
			if (!recursive)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraTreeNode node in Nodes)
			{
				node.InitializeLastNodeStyleResolved(recursive: true);
			}
		}

		{

		}

		private void CacheNodeElements(Hashtable table, UIElementsCollection oldElements, int startIndex)
		{
			if (table == null || lastStartIndex < 0 || lastEndIndex < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = lastEndIndex - lastStartIndex;
			int num2 = startIndex + num;
			int count = ((ArrayList)(object)oldElements).Count;
			int num3 = ((startIndex > lastStartIndex) ? (startIndex - lastStartIndex) : 0);
			for (int num4 = count - 1; num4 >= num3; num4--)
			{
				if (oldElements[num4] is TreeNodeUIElement { Node: var node } treeNodeUIElement)
				{
					int visibleIndex = node.VisibleIndex;
					if (visibleIndex >= startIndex && visibleIndex <= num2)
					{
						table[node] = treeNodeUIElement;
						oldElements.Remove((UIElement)(object)treeNodeUIElement);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private TreeNodeUIElement GetNodeElement(Hashtable table, UIElementsCollection oldElements, UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			TreeNodeUIElement treeNodeUIElement = null;
			if (table != null)
			{
				treeNodeUIElement = table[node] as TreeNodeUIElement;
			}
			if (treeNodeUIElement == null)
			{
				treeNodeUIElement = ExtractExistingNodeElement(oldElements, node) as TreeNodeUIElement;
				if (treeNodeUIElement == null)
				{
					treeNodeUIElement = new TreeNodeUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
				}
				else
				{
					((UIElement)treeNodeUIElement).DirtyChildElements(false);
				}
				treeNodeUIElement.InitializeNode(node);
			}
			return treeNodeUIElement;
		}

		internal TreeNodeUIElement GetNodeElement(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (nodeElements != null)
			{
				TreeNodeUIElement value = null;
				if (nodeElements.TryGetValue(node, out value))
				{
					return value;
				}
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).GetDescendant(typeof(TreeNodeUIElement), (object)node) as TreeNodeUIElement;
		}
	}
	internal class PropertyDescriptorInfo : DisposableObject
	{
		private PropertyDescriptorCollection props;

		private Hashtable chapteredPropHash;

		private Hashtable nonChapteredPropHash;

		private Hashtable originalPropNames;

		public PropertyDescriptorCollection PropertyDescriptorCollection => props;

		public bool HasChapteredColumns => chapteredPropHash != null;

		public bool HasNonChapteredColumns => nonChapteredPropHash != null;

		public Hashtable ChapteredPropHash
		{
			get
			{
				if (chapteredPropHash == null)
				{
					chapteredPropHash = new Hashtable();
				}
				return chapteredPropHash;
			}
		}

		public Hashtable NonChapteredPropHash
		{
			get
			{
				if (nonChapteredPropHash == null)
				{
					nonChapteredPropHash = new Hashtable();
				}
				return nonChapteredPropHash;
			}
		}

		public Hashtable OriginalPropNames
		{
			get
			{
				if (originalPropNames == null)
				{
					originalPropNames = new Hashtable();
				}
				return originalPropNames;
			}
		}

		public PropertyDescriptorInfo(PropertyDescriptorCollection props)
		{
			this.props = props;
			PopulatePropHashtables();
		}

		public PropertyDescriptor GetNonChapteredPropertyDescriptor(string Name)
		{
			if (nonChapteredPropHash == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return nonChapteredPropHash[Name] as PropertyDescriptor;
		}

		public PropertyDescriptor GetChapteredPropertyDescriptor(string Name)
		{
			if (chapteredPropHash == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return chapteredPropHash[Name] as PropertyDescriptor;
		}

		public string[] GetNonChapteredPropertyDescriptorNames()
		{
			string[] array = new string[NonChapteredPropHash.Keys.Count];
			NonChapteredPropHash.Keys.CopyTo(array, 0);
			return array;
		}

		public string[] GetChapteredPropertyDescriptorNames()
		{
			return GetChapteredPropertyDescriptorNames(null);
		}

		public string[] GetChapteredPropertyDescriptorNames(UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet)
		{
			if (columnSet == null)
			{
				string[] array = new string[ChapteredPropHash.Keys.Count];
				ChapteredPropHash.Keys.CopyTo(array, 0);
				return array;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			foreach (string key in ChapteredPropHash.Keys)
			{
				int num = columnSet.Columns.IndexOf(key);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = columnSet.Columns[num];
					if (ultraTreeNodeColumn.IsChaptered && ultraTreeNodeColumn.Visible)
					{
						arrayList.Add(key);
					}
				}
			}
			return (string[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(string));
		}

		public string GetFirstChapteredPropertyDescriptorName(UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet)
		{
			string[] array = ((columnSet != null) ? GetChapteredPropertyDescriptorNames(columnSet) : GetChapteredPropertyDescriptorNames());
			if (array.Length != 0)
			{
				return array[0];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public string GetFirstChapteredPropertyDescriptorName()
		{
			return GetFirstChapteredPropertyDescriptorName(null);
		}

		internal static PropertyDescriptor[] FindDifferentPropertyDescriptors(PropertyDescriptorInfo propertyDescriptorInfo1, PropertyDescriptorInfo propertyDescriptorInfo2)
		{
			if (propertyDescriptorInfo1 == null || propertyDescriptorInfo1.PropertyDescriptorCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList;
			if (propertyDescriptorInfo2 == null)
			{
				arrayList = new ArrayList(propertyDescriptorInfo1.PropertyDescriptorCollection);
				return (PropertyDescriptor[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(PropertyDescriptor));
			}
			arrayList = new ArrayList();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in propertyDescriptorInfo1.PropertyDescriptorCollection)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor2 = propertyDescriptorInfo2.PropertyDescriptorCollection.Find(item.Name, ignoreCase: true);
				if (propertyDescriptor2 == null)
				{
					arrayList.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (arrayList.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (PropertyDescriptor[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(PropertyDescriptor));
		}

		internal static PropertyDescriptor[] FindSamePropertyDescriptors(PropertyDescriptorInfo propertyDescriptorInfo1, PropertyDescriptorInfo propertyDescriptorInfo2)
		{
			if (propertyDescriptorInfo1 == null || propertyDescriptorInfo1.PropertyDescriptorCollection.Count == 0 || propertyDescriptorInfo2 == null || propertyDescriptorInfo2.PropertyDescriptorCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in propertyDescriptorInfo1.PropertyDescriptorCollection)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor2 = propertyDescriptorInfo2.PropertyDescriptorCollection.Find(item.Name, ignoreCase: true);
				if (propertyDescriptor2 != null)
				{
					arrayList.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (arrayList.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (PropertyDescriptor[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(PropertyDescriptor));
		}

		private void PopulatePropHashtables()
		{
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor prop in props)
			{
				OriginalPropNames.Add(prop, prop.Name);
				if (TreeUtils.IsChaptered(prop))
				{
					ChapteredPropHash.Add(prop.Name, prop);
				}
				else
				{
					NonChapteredPropHash.Add(prop.Name, prop);
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (props.Count == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = props[0].GetHashCode();
			for (int i = 1; i < props.Count; i++)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = props[i];
				num ^= propertyDescriptor.GetHashCode();
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorInfo propertyDescriptorInfo = obj as PropertyDescriptorInfo;
			PropertyDescriptorCollection propertyDescriptorCollection = propertyDescriptorInfo.PropertyDescriptorCollection;
			if (propertyDescriptorCollection == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (props.Count != propertyDescriptorCollection.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor prop in props)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor2 = propertyDescriptorCollection.Find(prop.Name, ignoreCase: true);
				if (propertyDescriptor2 == null || propertyDescriptor2.Name != prop.Name || propertyDescriptor2.PropertyType != prop.PropertyType)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (HasChapteredColumns)
			{
				chapteredPropHash = null;
			}
			if (HasNonChapteredColumns)
			{
				nonChapteredPropHash = null;
			}
			originalPropNames = null;
		}
	}
	internal class PropertyDescriptorManager : DisposableObject
	{
		private Hashtable propCollectionHash;

		public PropertyDescriptorManager()
		{
			propCollectionHash = new Hashtable();
		}

		public PropertyDescriptorInfo GetPropDescWrapper(PropertyDescriptorCollection props)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorInfo propertyDescriptorInfo = new PropertyDescriptorInfo(props);
			if (propCollectionHash[propertyDescriptorInfo] is PropertyDescriptorInfo result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			propCollectionHash.Add(propertyDescriptorInfo, propertyDescriptorInfo);
			return propertyDescriptorInfo;
		}

		public PropertyDescriptorInfo GetPropDescWrapper(PropertyDescriptor prop)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection props = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(new PropertyDescriptor[1] { prop });
			PropertyDescriptorInfo propertyDescriptorInfo = new PropertyDescriptorInfo(props);
			if (propCollectionHash[propertyDescriptorInfo] is PropertyDescriptorInfo result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			propCollectionHash.Add(propertyDescriptorInfo, propertyDescriptorInfo);
			return propertyDescriptorInfo;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			propCollectionHash = null;
		}
	}
	internal class BindingInfo : DisposableObject
	{
		private BindingManagerBase bindingManager;

		private BindingInfo parentBindingInfo;

		private UltraTree treeControl;

		private TreeNodesCollection boundRootNodesCollection;

		private string parentBandName;

		private string bandName;

		private PropertyDescriptorInfo propertyDescriptorInfo;

		private bool inPositionChanged;

		public string BandName => bandName;

		public BindingManagerBase BindingManager => bindingManager;

		public BindingInfo ParentBindingInfo => parentBindingInfo;

		public UltraTree TreeControl => treeControl;

		public BindingInfo(UltraTree treeControl, BindingManagerBase bindingManager, BindingInfo parentBindingInfo, string parentBandName, string bandName)
		{
			if (parentBindingInfo == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parentBindingInfo");
			}
			Initialize(treeControl, bindingManager, parentBindingInfo, parentBandName, null, bandName);
		}

		public BindingInfo(UltraTree treeControl, BindingManagerBase bindingManager, TreeNodesCollection boundRootNodesCollection, string bandName)
		{
			if (boundRootNodesCollection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("boundRootNodesCollection");
			}
			Initialize(treeControl, bindingManager, null, null, boundRootNodesCollection, bandName);
		}

		public UltraTreeNode GetActiveNode(string childBandName)
		{
			if (boundRootNodesCollection != null)
			{
				return boundRootNodesCollection.GetNodeFromListIndex(bindingManager.Position);
			}
			UltraTreeNode activeNode = ParentBindingInfo.GetActiveNode(parentBandName);
			if (activeNode == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TreeNodesCollection nodes = activeNode.Nodes;
			if (nodes.IsBandNodesCollection)
			{
				UltraTreeNode childBandNode = nodes.GetChildBandNode(childBandName);
				if (childBandNode == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				nodes = childBandNode.Nodes;
			}
			return nodes.GetNodeFromListIndex(bindingManager.Position);
		}

		private UltraTreeColumnSet FindColumnSet()
		{
			ColumnSetsCollection columnSets = TreeControl.ColumnSettings.ColumnSets;
			if (bandName == null || bandName.Length == 0)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = columnSets.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					UltraTreeColumnSet ultraTreeColumnSet = columnSets[i];
					if (ultraTreeColumnSet.Key == null || ultraTreeColumnSet.Key.Length == 0)
					{
						return ultraTreeColumnSet;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int num = columnSets.IndexOf(bandName);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					return columnSets[num];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal TreeNodesCollection GetBoundRootNodesCollection()
		{
			if (boundRootNodesCollection != null)
			{
				return boundRootNodesCollection;
			}
			return parentBindingInfo.GetBoundRootNodesCollection();
		}

		private void Initialize(UltraTree treeControl, BindingManagerBase bindingManager, BindingInfo parentBindingInfo, string parentBandName, TreeNodesCollection boundRootNodesCollection, string bandName)
		{
			if (treeControl == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("treeControl");
			}
			if (bindingManager == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("bindingManager");
			}
			this.bandName = bandName;
			this.treeControl = treeControl;
			this.bindingManager = bindingManager;
			this.bindingManager.PositionChanged += bindingManager_PositionChanged;
			((CurrencyManager)this.bindingManager).ItemChanged += bindingManager_ItemChanged;
			if (((CurrencyManager)this.bindingManager).List is IBindingList bindingList && this.treeControl.IsDesignMode)
			{
				InitializePropertyDescriptorInfo();
				bindingList.ListChanged += dataList_ListChanged;
			}
			this.parentBandName = parentBandName;
			this.parentBindingInfo = parentBindingInfo;
			this.boundRootNodesCollection = boundRootNodesCollection;
		}

		private void InitializePropertyDescriptorInfo()
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = bindingManager.GetItemProperties();
			propertyDescriptorInfo = treeControl.PropertyDescriptorManager.GetPropDescWrapper(itemProperties);
		}

		private void bindingManager_PositionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (treeControl.SynchronizeCurrencyManager && !inPositionChanged && !treeControl.inSetBindingManagerPosition && !treeControl.IsDesignMode)
			{
				try
				{
					inPositionChanged = true;
					treeControl.ActiveNode = GetActiveNode(parentBandName);
				}
				finally
				{
					inPositionChanged = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private void bindingManager_ItemChanged(object sender, ItemChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (boundRootNodesCollection != null)
			{
				if (e.Index == -1)
				{
					boundRootNodesCollection.SetBoundNodesDirty(dirty: true, recursive: true);
				}
				((UIElement)treeControl.UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
			}
			if (e.Index != -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection = GetBoundRootNodesCollection();
			if (treeNodesCollection == null || parentBindingInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraTreeNode activeNode = parentBindingInfo.GetActiveNode(parentBindingInfo.bandName);
			if (activeNode != null && activeNode.HasNodesCollectionBeenCreated)
			{
				int count = activeNode.Nodes.Count;
				BindingManagerBase bindingManagerBase = BindingManager;
				if (bindingManagerBase != null && (bindingManagerBase.Count != count || bindingManagerBase.Position < 0))
				{
					activeNode.Nodes.SetBoundNodesDirty(dirty: true, recursive: true);
					((UIElement)treeControl.UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
				}
			}
		}

		private void dataList_ListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.ListChangedType)
			{
			case ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorAdded:
				dataList_PropertyDescriptorAdded(e);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged:
				dataList_PropertyDescriptorChanged(e);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorDeleted:
				dataList_PropertyDescriptorDeleted(e);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.Reset:
			case ListChangedType.ItemAdded:
			case ListChangedType.ItemDeleted:
			case ListChangedType.ItemMoved:
			case ListChangedType.ItemChanged:
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void dataList_PropertyDescriptorAdded(ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (TreeControl.ColumnSettings == null || !TreeControl.ColumnSettings.AutoGenerateColumnSets)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraTreeColumnSet ultraTreeColumnSet = FindColumnSet();
			if (ultraTreeColumnSet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PropertyDescriptorInfo propertyDescriptorInfo = this.propertyDescriptorInfo;
			InitializePropertyDescriptorInfo();
			PropertyDescriptorInfo propertyDescriptorInfo2 = this.propertyDescriptorInfo;
			PropertyDescriptor[] array = PropertyDescriptorInfo.FindDifferentPropertyDescriptors(propertyDescriptorInfo2, propertyDescriptorInfo);
			if (array == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor[] array2 = array;
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor in array2)
			{
				if (!ultraTreeColumnSet.Columns.Exists(propertyDescriptor.Name))
				{
					UltraTreeNodeColumn column = TreeUtils.GenerateColumn(propertyDescriptor);
					ultraTreeColumnSet.Columns.Add(column);
				}
			}
		}

		private void dataList_PropertyDescriptorChanged(ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (TreeControl.ColumnSettings == null || !TreeControl.ColumnSettings.AutoGenerateColumnSets)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraTreeColumnSet ultraTreeColumnSet = FindColumnSet();
			if (ultraTreeColumnSet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PropertyDescriptorInfo propertyDescriptorInfo = this.propertyDescriptorInfo;
			if (propertyDescriptorInfo != null)
			{
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in propertyDescriptorInfo.PropertyDescriptorCollection)
				{
					string text = (string)propertyDescriptorInfo.OriginalPropNames[item];
					if (item.Name != text)
					{
						int num = ultraTreeColumnSet.Columns.IndexOf(text);
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							TreeUtils.GenerateColumn(item, ultraTreeColumnSet.Columns[num]);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			InitializePropertyDescriptorInfo();
			PropertyDescriptorInfo propertyDescriptorInfo2 = this.propertyDescriptorInfo;
			PropertyDescriptor[] array = PropertyDescriptorInfo.FindSamePropertyDescriptors(propertyDescriptorInfo2, propertyDescriptorInfo);
			if (array == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor[] array2 = array;
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor2 in array2)
			{
				int num2 = ultraTreeColumnSet.Columns.IndexOf(propertyDescriptor2.Name);
				if (num2 >= 0)
				{
					TreeUtils.GenerateColumn(propertyDescriptor2, ultraTreeColumnSet.Columns[num2]);
				}
			}
		}

		private void dataList_PropertyDescriptorDeleted(ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (TreeControl.ColumnSettings == null || !TreeControl.ColumnSettings.AutoGenerateColumnSets)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraTreeColumnSet ultraTreeColumnSet = FindColumnSet();
			if (ultraTreeColumnSet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PropertyDescriptorInfo propertyDescriptorInfo = this.propertyDescriptorInfo;
			InitializePropertyDescriptorInfo();
			PropertyDescriptorInfo propertyDescriptorInfo2 = this.propertyDescriptorInfo;
			PropertyDescriptor[] array = PropertyDescriptorInfo.FindDifferentPropertyDescriptors(propertyDescriptorInfo, propertyDescriptorInfo2);
			if (array == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor[] array2 = array;
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor in array2)
			{
				int num = ultraTreeColumnSet.Columns.IndexOf(propertyDescriptor.Name);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					UltraTreeNodeColumn value = ultraTreeColumnSet.Columns[num];
					ultraTreeColumnSet.Columns.Remove(value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			bindingManager.PositionChanged -= bindingManager_PositionChanged;
			((CurrencyManager)bindingManager).ItemChanged -= bindingManager_ItemChanged;
			if (((CurrencyManager)bindingManager).List is IBindingList bindingList && treeControl.IsDesignMode)
			{
				bindingList.ListChanged -= dataList_ListChanged;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class BindingInfoManager : DisposableObject
	{
		private Hashtable bindingInfoHash;

		public BindingInfoManager()
		{
			bindingInfoHash = new Hashtable();
		}

		public BindingInfo GetBindingInfo(BindingManagerBase bindingManager)
		{
			return bindingInfoHash[bindingManager] as BindingInfo;
		}

		public void Add(BindingManagerBase bindingManager, BindingInfo bindingInfo)
		{
			if (bindingInfoHash.ContainsKey(bindingManager))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("bindingManager already exists in this BindingInfoManager");
			}
			bindingInfoHash.Add(bindingManager, bindingInfo);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			foreach (BindingInfo value in bindingInfoHash.Values)
			{
				value.Dispose();
			}
			bindingInfoHash = null;
		}
	}

			: base(type, name)

		}

		}

	public class TreeEventManager : EventManagerBase
	{
		private UltraTree tree;

		private static int[] beforeEventIndexes;

		private static int[] afterEventIndexes;

		internal UltraTree Tree => tree;

		private int[] AfterEventIndexes
		{
			get
			{
				if (afterEventIndexes == null)
				{
					afterEventIndexes = new int[13]
					{
						3, 2, 4, 20, 19, 21, 6, 7, 8, 26,
						27, 35, 37
					};
				}
				return afterEventIndexes;
			}
		}

		private int[] BeforeEventIndexes
		{
			get
			{
				if (beforeEventIndexes == null)
				{
					beforeEventIndexes = new int[13]
					{
						9, 10, 11, 23, 22, 24, 13, 14, 15, 28,
						29, 34, 36
					};
				}
				return beforeEventIndexes;
			}
		}

		public TreeEventManager(UltraTree tree)
			: base(61)
		{
			this.tree = tree;
		}

		public bool InProgress(TreeEventIds eventid)
		{
			return InProgress((int)eventid);
		}

		public bool IsEnabled(TreeEventIds eventid)
		{
			return IsEnabled((int)eventid);
		}

		public void SetEnabled(TreeEventIds eventid, bool enabled)
		{
			SetEnabled((int)eventid, enabled);
		}

		public bool IsEnabled(EventGroups group)
		{
			return group switch
			{
				EventGroups.AllEvents => base.AllEventsEnabled, 
				EventGroups.BeforeEvents => IsEnabled(BeforeEventIndexes), 
				EventGroups.AfterEvents => IsEnabled(AfterEventIndexes), 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		public void SetEnabled(EventGroups group, bool enabled)
		{
			switch (group)
			{
			case EventGroups.AllEvents:
				base.AllEventsEnabled = enabled;
				break;
			case EventGroups.BeforeEvents:
				SetEnabled(BeforeEventIndexes, enabled);
				break;
			case EventGroups.AfterEvents:
				SetEnabled(AfterEventIndexes, enabled);
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void IncrementInProgress(TreeEventIds eventid)
		{
			IncrementInProgress((int)eventid);
		}

		internal void DecrementInProgress(TreeEventIds eventid)
		{
			DecrementInProgress((int)eventid);
		}

		internal bool CanFireEvent(TreeEventIds eventid)
		{
			return IsEnabled(eventid);
		}
	}

	public class BeforeNodeLayoutItemResizeEventArgs : CancelEventArgs
	{
		private UltraTreeNode node;

		private UltraTreeNodeColumn column;

		private Size originalSize = Size.Empty;

		private Size newSize = Size.Empty;

		private bool isAutoResize;

		public UltraTreeNodeColumn Column => column;

		public UltraTreeNode Node => node;

		public UltraTreeNodeCell Cell
		{
			get
			{
				if (node == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return node.Cells[column];
			}
		}

		public bool IsLabel => !IsCell;

		public bool IsCell => node != null;

		public Size OriginalSize => originalSize;

		public Size NewSize
		{
			get
			{
				return newSize;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value.Width < 0 || value.Height < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("NewSize");
				}
				newSize = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsAutoResize => isAutoResize;

		public BeforeNodeLayoutItemResizeEventArgs(UltraTreeNode node, UltraTreeNodeColumn column, Size originalSize, Size newSize)
			: this(node, column, originalSize, newSize, isAutoResize: false)
		{
		}

		public BeforeNodeLayoutItemResizeEventArgs(UltraTreeNode node, UltraTreeNodeColumn column, Size originalSize, Size newSize, bool isAutoResize)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			this.node = node;
			this.column = column;
			this.newSize = newSize;
			this.originalSize = originalSize;
			this.isAutoResize = isAutoResize;
		}
	}

	public class DataErrorEventArgs : CellEventArgs
	{
		private Exception exception;

		private string errorText;

		private string editorErrorMessage;

		private object invalidValue;

		private bool displayMessageBox = true;

		private bool includePrefixInMessage = true;

		public object InvalidValue => invalidValue;

		public Exception Exception => exception;

		public string ErrorText
		{
			get
			{
				if (errorText == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return errorText;
			}
			set
			{
				errorText = value;
			}
		}

		internal string ErrorTextResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (errorText != null)
				{
					return errorText;
				}
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(256);
				if (includePrefixInMessage)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("InvalidEditorValue_Error_Message_Prefix"));
				}
				string text = ((exception != null && exception.Message != null) ? exception.Message : string.Empty);
				string text2 = ((editorErrorMessage != null) ? editorErrorMessage : string.Empty);
				stringBuilder.Append((text.Length > 0) ? text : ((text2.Length > 0) ? text2 : Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("InvalidEditorValue_Error_Message")));
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		public bool DisplayMessageBox
		{
			get
			{
				return displayMessageBox;
			}
			set
			{
				displayMessageBox = value;
			}
		}

		{

			if (ultraTree != null)

				if (activeNode != null)
				{
					flag = activeNode.IsEditing || ultraTree.IsCellInEditMode;
					if (activeNode.IsEditing)
					{
						activeNode.EndEdit(cancel: false);
					}
					else if (ultraTree.IsCellInEditMode)
					{
						activeNode.EndCellEdit(cancel: false);
					}
					if (activeNode.IsEditing || ultraTree.IsCellInEditMode)
					{
						return;
					}
				}

			{
				Node.Toggle();
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				((UIElement)ultraTree.UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				((UIElement)ultraTree.UIElement).VerifyChildElements();

	[Serializable]
	[ListBindable(false)]
	[Editor("Infragistics.Win.UltraWinTree.ImagesCollectionEditor, Infragistics4.Win.v21.1.Design, Version=21.1.20211.24, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
	public class ImagesCollection : DisposableObjectCollectionBase, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ISerializable
	{
		private int initialCapacity = 5;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return base.GetItem(index);
			}
			set
			{
				RemoveAt(index);
				InsertImageHelper(index, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsFixedSize => false;

		public object this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return base.GetItem(index);
			}
			set
			{
				RemoveAt(index);
				InsertImageHelper(index, value);
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		protected override int InitialCapacity => initialCapacity;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => false;

		internal ImagesCollection(int initialCapacity)
		{
			this.initialCapacity = initialCapacity;
		}

		protected ImagesCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.ObjectType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(Image)))
				{
					Image image = (Image)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Image), null);
					if (image != null)
					{
						AddImageHelper(image);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
					else if (current.Name != null && current.Name.Length > 0 && char.IsNumber(current.Name, 0))
					{
						object image2 = Utils.DeserializeObjectProperty(current);
						AddImageHelper(image2);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				object obj = this[i];
				if (obj is Image)
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
				}
				else
				{
					Utils.SerializeObjectProperty(info, i.ToString(), obj);
				}
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		public int Add(object value)
		{
			return AddImageHelper(value);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			Remove(value);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			Remove(this[index]);
		}

		private Image GetImageFromObject(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is Image result))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_0"));
			}
			return result;
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			InsertImageHelper(index, value);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "";
		}

		internal int AddImageHelper(object image)
		{
			int result = InternalAdd(image);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.LeftImages);
			return result;
		}

		protected int InternalAdd(object image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_1"));
			}
			return List.Add(image);
		}

		protected void InternalInsert(int index, object image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_2"));
			}
			List.Insert(index, image);
		}

		protected void InternalClear()
		{
			List.Clear();
		}

		protected void InternalRemove(object image)
		{
			List.Remove(image);
		}

		private void InsertImageHelper(int index, object image)
		{
			InternalInsert(index, image);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.LeftImages);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			InternalClear();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.LeftImages);
		}

		public void Remove(object value)
		{
			InternalRemove(value);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.LeftImages, null);
		}

		public ImageEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new ImageEnumerator(this);
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.LeftImages, propChangeInfo);
		}

		internal void CloneFrom(ImagesCollection imagesClone)
		{
			if (Count > 0)
			{
				Clear();
			}
			if (imagesClone.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < imagesClone.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!(imagesClone[i] is Image))
				{
					InternalAdd(imagesClone[i]);
				}
				else
				{
					InternalAdd(((Image)imagesClone[i]).Clone());
				}
			}
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains(value);
		}
	}

	internal class LabelEditNodeBase : TextBox
	{
		private bool hasBeenSetup;

		private int originalWidth;

		private int originalHeight;

		private UltraTreeNode node;

		protected ISilentTextBoxOwner owner;

		private bool active;

		internal UltraTreeNode Node => node;

		internal bool Active
		{
			get
			{
				return active;
			}
			set
			{
				active = value;
			}
		}

		internal LabelEditNodeBase(UltraTree control)
		{
			owner = (ISilentTextBoxOwner)(object)control;
			base.Bounds = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
			base.AcceptsTab = true;
		}

		internal void SetupEdit(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (node != null)
			{
				this.node = node;
				Multiline = node.MultilineCached;
				base.WordWrap = node.MultilineCached;
				base.Parent = (Control)(object)node.Control;
				Font = ((Control)(object)node.Control).Font;
				Text = node.Text;
				if (this.node.MultilineResolved)
				{
					base.Location = node.TextRectangle.Location;
					base.Size = GetAdjustedSize(node.TextRectangle.Size);
				}
				else
				{
					Rectangle textRectangle = node.TextRectangle;
					Point location = textRectangle.Location;
					int num = base.Height;
					location.Y = Math.Max(0, location.Y + textRectangle.Height / 2 - num / 2);
					base.Location = location;
					base.Size = GetAdjustedSize(base.Size);
				}
				originalWidth = base.Width;
				originalHeight = base.Height;
				base.HideSelection = false;
				base.BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle;
				hasBeenSetup = true;
				active = true;
				UpdateNodeElementDimensions();
			}
		}

		internal void Show(bool show)
		{
			if (hasBeenSetup && show)
			{
				Show();
				TreeUtils.FocusControl(this);
				HookupEvent(hookup: true);
			}
			else
			{
				HookupEvent(hookup: false);
				TreeUtils.FocusControl((Control)(object)GetParent());
				Hide();
				hasBeenSetup = false;
			}
		}

		private void ResizeOnTextChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (node != null)
			{
				node.TextRectangle = new Rectangle(base.Location, base.Size);
				node.RecalcSize = true;
				UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)node.UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement.Parent.DirtyChildElements(true);
					uIElement.Parent.VerifyChildElements(true);
					UpdateNodeElementDimensions();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateNodeElementDimensions()
		{
			if (node != null)
			{
				Rectangle rectangle = ((!(((UIElement)GetParent().UIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(NodeClientAreaUIElement)) is NodeClientAreaUIElement nodeClientAreaUIElement)) ? ((Control)(object)GetParent()).ClientRectangle : ((UIElement)nodeClientAreaUIElement).Rect);
				Graphics cachedGraphics = DrawUtility.GetCachedGraphics((Control)this);
				Size size = node.CalculateLabelSize(cachedGraphics, Font, Text, Multiline, addExtraSpaceWhileEditing: true, rectangle.Width - base.Left, rectangle.Height - base.Top, constrained: true);
				base.Size = new Size(Math.Max(originalWidth, size.Width), Math.Max(originalHeight, size.Height));
				DrawUtility.ReleaseCachedGraphics(cachedGraphics);
				node.TextRectangle = new Rectangle(node.TextRectangle.Location, base.Size);
				node.RecalcSize = true;
				((UIElement)node.UIElement).Parent.DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		internal Size GetAdjustedSize(Size targetSize)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = ((!(((UIElement)GetParent().UIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(NodeClientAreaUIElement)) is NodeClientAreaUIElement nodeClientAreaUIElement)) ? ((Control)(object)GetParent()).ClientRectangle : ((UIElement)nodeClientAreaUIElement).Rect);
			return new Size(Math.Min(targetSize.Width, rectangle.Width - base.Left), Math.Min(targetSize.Height, rectangle.Height - base.Top));
		}

		private void HookupEvent(bool hookup)
		{
			UltraTree ultraTree = GetParent();
			if (ultraTree != null)
			{
				if (hookup)
				{
					base.KeyDown += ultraTree.LabelEdit_KeyDown;
					base.KeyUp += ultraTree.LabelEdit_KeyUp;
					base.KeyPress += ultraTree.LabelEdit_KeyPress;
					base.TextChanged += ResizeOnTextChanged;
					base.LostFocus += ultraTree.LabelEdit_LostFocus;
				}
				else
				{
					base.KeyDown -= ultraTree.LabelEdit_KeyDown;
					base.KeyUp -= ultraTree.LabelEdit_KeyUp;
					base.KeyPress += ultraTree.LabelEdit_KeyPress;
					base.TextChanged -= ResizeOnTextChanged;
					base.LostFocus -= ultraTree.LabelEdit_LostFocus;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsInputKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			if (UsesInputKey(keyData))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.IsInputKey(keyData);
		}

		protected bool UsesInputKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			if (keyData == Keys.Return || keyData == Keys.Escape)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (owner != null)
			{
				owner.OnKeyDown(e);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnKeyDown(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyPress(KeyPressEventArgs e)
		{
			if (owner != null)
			{
				owner.OnKeyPress(e);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnKeyPress(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyUp(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (owner != null)
			{
				owner.OnKeyUp(e);
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)this).OnKeyUp(e);
			}
		}

		internal UltraTree GetParent()
		{
			return TreeUtils.GetParent(this) as UltraTree;
		}
	}

		internal int LabelSpanResolved
		{
			get
			{
				NodeLayoutLabelPosition nodeLayoutLabelPosition = owningColumn.ColumnSet.SettingsResolved.LabelPosition;
				int num = 0;
				switch (nodeLayoutLabelPosition)
				{
				case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.Left:
				case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.Right:
					num = SpanX;
					break;
				case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.Top:
				case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.Bottom:
					num = SpanY;
					break;
				}
				if (num <= 0)
				{
					return LabelSpan;
				}
				return Math.Min(num, LabelSpan);
			}
		}

		internal void SetPreferredCellSizeHelper(Size value)
		{
			SetPreferredCellSizeHelper(value, autoSize: false);
		}

		internal void SetPreferredCellSizeHelper(Size value, bool autoSize)
		{
			if (value != preferredCellSize || autoSize)
			{
				if (value.Width < 0 || value.Height < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraTreeNodeLayoutInfo_Exception_InvalidSize"));
				}
				preferredCellSize = value;
				UltraTreeNodeColumn column = Column;
				if (column != null && !column.SettingsResolved.LabelDeterminesWidth && column.ColumnSet != null)
				{
					column.ColumnSet.LayoutManager.LastResizedColumn = column;
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.PreferredCellSize);
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetAllowCellSizing();
			ResetAllowLabelSizing();
			ResetCellInsets();
			ResetLabelInsets();
			ResetLabelPosition();
			ResetLabelSpan();
			ResetMinimumCellSize();
			ResetMinimumLabelSize();
			ResetOriginX();
			ResetOriginY();
			ResetPreferredCellSize();
			ResetPreferredLabelSize();
			ResetSpanX();
			ResetSpanY();
			ResetWeightX();
			ResetWeightY();
			ResetTag();
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAllowCellSizing() && !ShouldSerializeAllowLabelSizing() && !ShouldSerializeCellInsets() && !ShouldSerializeLabelInsets() && !ShouldSerializeLabelPosition() && !ShouldSerializeLabelSpan() && !ShouldSerializeMinimumCellSize() && !ShouldSerializeMinimumLabelSize() && !ShouldSerializeOriginX() && !ShouldSerializeOriginY() && !ShouldSerializePreferredCellSize() && !ShouldSerializePreferredLabelSize() && !ShouldSerializeSpanX() && !ShouldSerializeSpanY() && !ShouldSerializeWeightX() && !ShouldSerializeWeightY())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTag();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void SetLabelSize(Size newSize, LayoutItemResizeDirection resizeDirection)
		{
			Size size = owningColumn.SettingsResolved.PreferredLabelSize;
			Size size2 = (PreferredLabelSize = resizeDirection switch
			{
				LayoutItemResizeDirection.Horizontal => new Size(newSize.Width, size.Height), 
				LayoutItemResizeDirection.Diagnonal => new Size(newSize.Width, newSize.Height), 
				_ => new Size(size.Width, newSize.Height), 
			});
			if ((resizeDirection == LayoutItemResizeDirection.Diagnonal || resizeDirection == LayoutItemResizeDirection.Horizontal) && owningColumn.ColumnSet != null && owningColumn.ColumnSet.SettingsResolved.HeadersInSeparateArea)
			{
				Size size4 = new Size(size2.Width, owningColumn.SettingsResolved.PreferredCellSize.Height);
				PreferredCellSize = size4;
			}
		}

		internal void SetCellSize(Size newSize, LayoutItemResizeDirection resizeDirection)
		{
			Size size = owningColumn.SettingsResolved.PreferredCellSize;
			Size size2 = (PreferredCellSize = resizeDirection switch
			{
				LayoutItemResizeDirection.Horizontal => new Size(newSize.Width, size.Height), 
				LayoutItemResizeDirection.Diagnonal => new Size(newSize.Width, newSize.Height), 
				_ => new Size(size.Width, newSize.Height), 
			});
			if ((resizeDirection == LayoutItemResizeDirection.Diagnonal || resizeDirection == LayoutItemResizeDirection.Horizontal) && owningColumn.ColumnSet != null && owningColumn.ColumnSet.SettingsResolved.HeadersInSeparateArea)
			{
				Size size4 = new Size(size2.Width, owningColumn.SettingsResolved.PreferredLabelSize.Height);
				PreferredLabelSize = size4;
			}
		}

		internal void GetAdjustmentRange(UIElement element, Point point, LayoutItemResizeDirection resizeDirection, out UIElementAdjustmentRangeParams range)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			range = default(UIElementAdjustmentRangeParams);
			UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = owningColumn;
			UltraTreeColumnSet ultraTreeColumnSet = ultraTreeNodeColumn?.ColumnSet;
			if (ultraTreeColumnSet != null)
			{
				UltraTree control = owningColumn.Control;
				Rectangle rectangleForZoomFactor = Utilities.GetRectangleForZoomFactor(((Control)(object)control).ClientRectangle, ((UltraControlBase)control).ZoomFactor, true);
				Rectangle deskTopWorkArea = UIElement.GetDeskTopWorkArea(((Control)(object)control).RectangleToScreen(rectangleForZoomFactor));
				Rectangle rect = element.Rect;
				Rectangle rectangle = ((Control)(object)control).RectangleToScreen(rect);
				bool flag = ultraTreeColumnSet.SettingsResolved.LabelStyle == NodeLayoutLabelStyle.Separate;
				LayoutItemType layoutItemType = ((element is UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement) ? LayoutItemType.Cell : LayoutItemType.Header);
				ILayoutItem val = null;
				val = (ILayoutItem)(object)((layoutItemType != LayoutItemType.Cell) ? ((LayoutItemBase)ultraTreeNodeColumn.HeaderLayoutItem) : ((LayoutItemBase)ultraTreeNodeColumn.CellLayoutItem));
				Size containerSize = ((layoutItemType == LayoutItemType.Header && flag) ? ultraTreeColumnSet.LayoutManager.HeaderAreaSize : ultraTreeColumnSet.LayoutManager.PreferredNodeSize);
				int minWidth = 0;
				int minHeight = 0;
				Column.ColumnSet.LayoutManager.GetLayoutItemResizeRange(val, containerSize, ref minWidth, ref minHeight);
				Size size = new Size(minWidth, minHeight);
				bool flag2 = resizeDirection == LayoutItemResizeDirection.Horizontal || resizeDirection == LayoutItemResizeDirection.Diagnonal;
				bool flag3 = resizeDirection == LayoutItemResizeDirection.Vertical || resizeDirection == LayoutItemResizeDirection.Diagnonal;
				if (flag2)
				{
					range.leftRightAdjustmentBar = new Rectangle(Utilities.GetZoomedValue(point.X, ((UltraControlBase)control).ZoomFactor, true), rectangleForZoomFactor.Top, 1, rectangleForZoomFactor.Height);
					range.maxDeltaLeft = (rect.Width - size.Width) * -1;
					range.maxDeltaRight = deskTopWorkArea.Right - rectangle.Right;
				}
				if (flag3)
				{
					range.upDownAdjustmentBar = new Rectangle(rectangleForZoomFactor.Left, Utilities.GetZoomedValue(point.Y, ((UltraControlBase)control).ZoomFactor, true), rectangleForZoomFactor.Width, 1);
					range.maxDeltaUp = (rect.Height - size.Height) * -1;
					range.maxDeltaDown = deskTopWorkArea.Bottom - rectangle.Bottom;
				}
			}
		}

		internal static Size GetResolvedMinimumSize(ILayoutItem layoutItem)
		{
			HeaderLayoutItem headerLayoutItem = layoutItem as HeaderLayoutItem;
			CellLayoutItem cellLayoutItem = layoutItem as CellLayoutItem;
			return headerLayoutItem?.OwningColumn.SettingsResolved.MinimumLabelSize ?? cellLayoutItem?.OwningColumn.SettingsResolved.MinimumCellSize ?? Size.Empty;
		}

		internal static Insets GetResolvedInsets(ILayoutItem layoutItem)
		{
			IGridBagConstraint val = (IGridBagConstraint)(object)((layoutItem is IGridBagConstraint) ? layoutItem : null);
			Insets insets = emptyInsets;
			if (val.Insets != null)
			{
				insets = val.Insets;
			}
			return insets;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeAllowCellSizing())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AllowCellSizing", AllowCellSizing);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeAllowLabelSizing())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AllowLabelSizing", AllowLabelSizing);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeCellInsets())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CellInsets", CellInsets);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeLabelInsets())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "LabelInsets", LabelInsets);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeLabelPosition())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "LabelPosition", LabelPosition);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeLabelSpan())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "LabelSpan", LabelSpan);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMinimumCellSize())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MinimumCellSize", MinimumCellSize);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMinimumLabelSize())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MinimumLabelSize", MinimumLabelSize);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeOriginX())

	internal class NodeLayoutContainer : ILayoutContainer
	{
		private NodeSelectableAreaUIElement nodeUIElement;

		private Rectangle clipRect = Rectangle.Empty;

		internal NodeLayoutContainer()

		private void Initialize(NodeSelectableAreaUIElement nodeUIElement, Rectangle containerRect, UIElementsCollection oldElements)
		{
			this.nodeUIElement = nodeUIElement;
			this.containerRect = containerRect;
			this.oldElements = oldElements;
			clipRect = ((nodeUIElement != null) ? ((UIElement)nodeUIElement).ClipRect : Rectangle.Empty);
			if (cellElements == null)
			{
				int capacity = ((this.oldElements != null) ? ((ArrayList)(object)this.oldElements).Count : 0);
				cellElements = new Dictionary<UltraTreeNodeColumn, UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement>(capacity);
			}
			if (this.oldElements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			cellElements.Clear();
			List<UIElement> list = new List<UIElement>();
			UIElementEnumerator enumerator = this.oldElements.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current is UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement)
					{
						UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement ultraTreeNodeCellUIElement = current as UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement;
						cellElements.Add(ultraTreeNodeCellUIElement.Column, ultraTreeNodeCellUIElement);
						list.Add(current);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			foreach (UIElement item in list)
			{
				this.oldElements.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		void ILayoutContainer.PositionItem(ILayoutItem item, Rectangle rect, object containerContext)
		{
			//IL_0095: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_016b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!clipRect.IsEmpty && !clipRect.IntersectsWith(rect))
			{
				return;
			}
			HeaderLayoutItem headerLayoutItem = item as HeaderLayoutItem;
			CellLayoutItem cellLayoutItem = item as CellLayoutItem;
			UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = ((headerLayoutItem != null) ? headerLayoutItem.OwningColumn : cellLayoutItem?.OwningColumn);
			if (ultraTreeNodeColumn == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (headerLayoutItem != null)
			{
				UltraTreeNodeColumnHeaderUIElement ultraTreeNodeColumnHeaderUIElement = NodeSelectableAreaUIElement.InternalExtractExistingElement(oldElements, typeof(UltraTreeNodeColumnHeaderUIElement), remove: true) as UltraTreeNodeColumnHeaderUIElement;
				if (ultraTreeNodeColumnHeaderUIElement == null)
				{
					ultraTreeNodeColumnHeaderUIElement = new UltraTreeNodeColumnHeaderUIElement(nodeUIElement, ultraTreeNodeColumn);
				}
				else
				{
					ultraTreeNodeColumnHeaderUIElement.Initialize(ultraTreeNodeColumn);
				}
				UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet = ultraTreeNodeColumn.ColumnSet;
				if (columnSet != null && columnSet.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(ultraTreeNodeColumn.SettingsResolved.BorderStyleColumnHeader))
				{
					AdjustRectForBorderSides(ref rect, item, containerRect);
				}
				columnSet.LayoutManager.AdjustRectForEvenHeight(ref rect, item);
				((UIElement)ultraTreeNodeColumnHeaderUIElement).Rect = rect;
				((UIElement)nodeUIElement).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)ultraTreeNodeColumnHeaderUIElement);
			}
			else if (cellLayoutItem != null && ultraTreeNodeColumn.LayoutInfo.ShouldPositionCellElement)
			{
				UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement ultraTreeNodeCellUIElement = null;
				ultraTreeNodeCellUIElement = ((cellElements != null && cellElements.ContainsKey(ultraTreeNodeColumn)) ? cellElements[ultraTreeNodeColumn] : (NodeSelectableAreaUIElement.InternalExtractExistingElement(oldElements, typeof(UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement), remove: true) as UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement));
				if (ultraTreeNodeCellUIElement == null)
				{
					ultraTreeNodeCellUIElement = new UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement(nodeUIElement, ultraTreeNodeColumn);
				}
				else
				{

				}
				UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet2 = ultraTreeNodeColumn.ColumnSet;
				if (columnSet2 != null && columnSet2.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(ultraTreeNodeColumn.SettingsResolved.BorderStyleCell))
				{
					AdjustRectForBorderSides(ref rect, item, containerRect);
				}
				columnSet2.LayoutManager.AdjustRectForEvenHeight(ref rect, item);
				AdjustRectForOutlookExpress(nodeUIElement, ultraTreeNodeCellUIElement, ref rect);
				((UIElement)ultraTreeNodeCellUIElement).Rect = rect;
				((UIElement)nodeUIElement).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)ultraTreeNodeCellUIElement);
			}
		}

		internal static void AdjustRectForBorderSides(ref Rectangle rect, ILayoutItem item, Rectangle containerRect)
		{
			IGridBagConstraint val = (IGridBagConstraint)(object)((item is IGridBagConstraint) ? item : null);
			Insets insets = val.Insets;
			if (insets.Left == 0 && rect.X > containerRect.X)
			{
				rect.X--;
				rect.Width++;
			}
			if (insets.Top == 0 && rect.Y > containerRect.Y)
			{
				rect.Y--;
				rect.Height++;
			}
		}

		private void AdjustRectForOutlookExpress(NodeSelectableAreaUIElement nodeElement, UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement cellElement, ref Rectangle rect)
		{
			if (nodeUIElement == null || !(((UIElement)nodeUIElement).Control is UltraTree { ViewStyleResolved: ViewStyle.OutlookExpress } ultraTree))
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)ultraTree.UIElement;
			ColumnHeaderAreaUIElement columnHeaderAreaUIElement = ((uIElement != null) ? (uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(ColumnHeaderAreaUIElement)) as ColumnHeaderAreaUIElement) : null);
			if (columnHeaderAreaUIElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle headerRect = columnHeaderAreaUIElement.GetHeaderRect(cellElement.Column);
			if (headerRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			rect.X = headerRect.X;
			rect.Width = headerRect.Width;
			int num = headerRect.Right - ((UIElement)nodeElement).Rect.Right;
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle rect2 = ((UIElement)nodeElement).Rect;
			rect2.Width += num;
			((UIElement)nodeElement).Rect = rect2;
			if (((UIElement)nodeElement).GetAncestor(typeof(TreeNodeUIElement)) is TreeNodeUIElement treeNodeUIElement)
			{
				Rectangle rect3 = ((UIElement)treeNodeUIElement).Rect;
				num = headerRect.Right - rect3.Right;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					rect3.Width += num;
					((UIElement)treeNodeUIElement).Rect = rect3;
				}
			}
		}

		{

			private Rectangle containerRect = Rectangle.Empty;
