			internal Hashtable CellPositions
			{
				get
				{
					UltraTreeColumnSet displayColumnSetResolved = node.DisplayColumnSetResolved;
					if (displayColumnSetResolved != null)
					{
						VisibleColumnsCollection visibleColumns = displayColumnSetResolved.VisibleColumns;
						if (cellPositions == null)
						{
							cellPositions = new Hashtable(visibleColumns.Count);
						}
						UltraTree control = displayColumnSetResolved.Control;
						int num = control?.MetricsVersion ?? versionNumber;
						if (versionNumber != num)
						{
							versionNumber = control.MetricsVersion;
							cellPositions.Clear();
							((LayoutManagerBase)displayColumnSetResolved.LayoutManager.NodeLayoutManager).LayoutContainer((ILayoutContainer)(object)this, (object)null);
						}
					}
					return cellPositions;
				}
			}

			internal Hashtable LabelPositions
			{
				get
				{
					UltraTreeColumnSet displayColumnSetResolved = node.DisplayColumnSetResolved;
					if (displayColumnSetResolved != null)

						if (labelPositions == null)

						}
					}
					return labelPositions;
				}
			}

			internal Rectangle this[UltraTreeNodeColumn column, LayoutItemType layoutItemType]
			{
				get
				{
					switch (layoutItemType)
					{
					case LayoutItemType.Cell:
					{
						Hashtable hashtable2 = CellPositions;
						if (hashtable2.ContainsKey(column))
						{
							return (Rectangle)hashtable2[column];
						}
						break;
					}
					case LayoutItemType.Header:
					{
						Hashtable hashtable = LabelPositions;
						if (hashtable.ContainsKey(column))
						{
							return (Rectangle)hashtable[column];
						}
						break;
					}
					}
					return Rectangle.Empty;
				}
			}

				}

		internal void VerifyNodeLayoutItemPositions()
		{
			if (dontVerifyLayoutCache || isVerifyingNodeLayoutItemPositions)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				isVerifyingNodeLayoutItemPositions = true;
				LayoutItemsCollection layoutItems = ((LayoutManagerBase)NodePositionManager).LayoutItems;
				layoutItems.Clear();
				VisibleColumnsCollection visibleColumns = columnSet.VisibleColumns;
				for (int i = 0; i < visibleColumns.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = visibleColumns[i];
					UltraTreeNodeLayoutInfo layoutInfo = ultraTreeNodeColumn.LayoutInfo;
					layoutItems.Add((ILayoutItem)(object)layoutInfo, (object)layoutInfo);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isVerifyingNodeLayoutItemPositions = false;
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyNodeLayoutItems()
		{
			if (dontVerifyLayoutCache || isVerifyingNodeLayoutItems)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				isVerifyingNodeLayoutItems = true;
				LayoutItemsCollection layoutItems = ((LayoutManagerBase)NodeLayoutManager).LayoutItems;
				layoutItems.Clear();
				VisibleColumnsCollection visibleColumns = columnSet.VisibleColumns;
				for (int i = 0; i < visibleColumns.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = visibleColumns[i];
					HeaderLayoutItem headerLayoutItem = ultraTreeNodeColumn.HeaderLayoutItem;
					CellLayoutItem cellLayoutItem = ultraTreeNodeColumn.CellLayoutItem;

		internal void PerformAutoResize(UltraTreeNodeColumn column, UIElement element, ColumnAutoSizeMode autoSizeMode)
		{
			if (column == null || autoSizeMode == ColumnAutoSizeMode.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraTree control = columnSet.Control;
			if (control == null || control.IsDesignMode)
			{
				return;
			}

			int num = 0;
			int num2 = control.ViewableArea.Height;
			bool headersInSeparateArea = columnSet.SettingsResolved.HeadersInSeparateArea;
			int height = columnSet.LayoutManager.HeaderAreaSize.Height;

			bool hasExpansionIndicator = isViewStyleOutlookExpress && column.IsExpansionIndicatorColumn;

			{
				num2 -= height;
			}
			if (flag)
			{

				int num3 = ((control.TopNode != null) ? control.TopNode.VisibleIndex : 0);
				int num4 = 0;

					num = Math.Max(num, cellWidth);
					num4 += ultraTreeNode.ItemHeightResolvedWithSpacing;
					if (ultraTreeNode.DisplaysHeaderArea)
					{
						num4 += height;
					}
					if (num4 > num2)
					{

					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int capacity = (flag2 ? 100 : 10);
				ArrayList list = new ArrayList(capacity);
				if (isViewStyleOutlookExpress && columnSet == control.Nodes.ColumnSetResolved)
				{
					list = control.GetAllNodesCollections(flag2);
				}
				else
				{
					control.GetAssociatedNodesCollections(ref list, null, columnSet, flag2);
				}
				if (list != null)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
					{
						TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection = list[j] as TreeNodesCollection;
						for (int k = 0; k < treeNodesCollection.Count; k++)
						{
							UltraTreeNode node = treeNodesCollection[k];
							int cellWidth2 = GetCellWidth(control, node, column, hasExpansionIndicator);

						}

			if (headersInSeparateArea && labelPosition != NodeLayoutLabelPosition.None)
			{

			}
			bool labelDeterminesWidth = column.SettingsResolved.LabelDeterminesWidth;
			if (headersInSeparateArea && labelPosition != NodeLayoutLabelPosition.None)
			{

			}
			LayoutItemType? layoutItemType = ((element is UltraTreeNodeColumnHeaderUIElement) ? new LayoutItemType?(LayoutItemType.Header) : ((element is UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement) ? new LayoutItemType?(LayoutItemType.Cell) : ((LayoutItemType?)null)));

			{
				originalSize = ((layoutItemType.Value == LayoutItemType.Header) ? preferredLabelSize : preferredCellSize);
				empty = ((layoutItemType.Value == LayoutItemType.Header) ? new Size(num5, preferredLabelSize.Height) : new Size(num, preferredCellSize.Height));
				BeforeNodeLayoutItemResizeEventArgs e = new BeforeNodeLayoutItemResizeEventArgs(null, column, originalSize, empty, isAutoResize: true);
				control.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.BeforeNodeLayoutItemResize, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			switch (labelPosition)
			{
			case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.Top:
			case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.Bottom:
			case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.LabelOnly:
				column.LayoutInfo.SetPreferredLabelSizeHelper(new Size(num5, column.LayoutInfo.PreferredLabelSize.Height), autoSize: true);
				if (labelDeterminesWidth)
				{
					column.LayoutInfo.SetPreferredCellSizeHelper(new Size(num5, column.LayoutInfo.PreferredCellSize.Height), autoSize: true);
				}
				else if (labelPosition != NodeLayoutLabelPosition.LabelOnly)
				{
					column.LayoutInfo.SetPreferredCellSizeHelper(new Size(num, column.LayoutInfo.PreferredCellSize.Height), autoSize: true);
				}
				break;
			case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.Left:
			case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.Right:
				column.LayoutInfo.SetPreferredLabelSizeHelper(new Size(num5, column.LayoutInfo.PreferredLabelSize.Height), autoSize: true);
				goto case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.None;
			case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.None:
				column.LayoutInfo.SetPreferredCellSizeHelper(new Size(num, column.LayoutInfo.PreferredCellSize.Height), autoSize: true);
				break;
			}
			if (layoutItemType.HasValue && ((layoutItemType.Value == LayoutItemType.Header) ? column.LayoutInfo.PreferredLabelSize : column.LayoutInfo.PreferredCellSize).Width != originalSize.Width)
			{
				AfterNodeLayoutItemResizeEventArgs e2 = new AfterNodeLayoutItemResizeEventArgs(null, column, isAutoResize: true);
				control.FireEvent(TreeEventIds.AfterNodeLayoutItemResize, e2);
			}
		}

		private int GetCellWidth(UltraTree treeControl, UltraTreeNode node, UltraTreeNodeColumn column, bool hasExpansionIndicator)
		{
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0081: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0086: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!node.DisplayColumnSetResolved.Columns.Contains(column))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			UltraTreeNodeCell ultraTreeNodeCell = ((node.HasCells && node.Cells.HasCell(column)) ? node.Cells[column] : null);
			EmbeddableEditorBase editor = column.SettingsResolved.GetEditor(ultraTreeNodeCell);
			object obj = node;
			if (ultraTreeNodeCell != null)
			{
				obj = ultraTreeNodeCell;
			}
			UltraTreeNodeColumn dataColumnFromDisplayColumn = node.GetDataColumnFromDisplayColumn(column);
			int width = editor.GetSize((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)dataColumnFromDisplayColumn.EditorOwner, obj, false, true, false).Width;
			UIElementBorderStyle borderStyleCell = column.SettingsResolved.BorderStyleCell;
			UIElementBorderWidths val = DrawUtility.CalculateBorderWidths(borderStyleCell);
			width += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
			if (hasExpansionIndicator)
			{
				width += (node.Level + 1) * treeControl.IndentResolved;
			}
			return width;
		}

		internal void AdjustRectForEvenHeight(ref Rectangle rect, ILayoutItem item)
		{
			if (preferredNodeSizeAdjusted)
			{
				ColumnSetSettingsResolved settingsResolved = columnSet.SettingsResolved;
				NodeLayoutLabelPosition labelPosition = settingsResolved.LabelPosition;
				bool flag = item is HeaderLayoutItem;
				bool flag2 = false;
				switch (labelPosition)
				{
				case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.None:
				case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.Left:
				case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.Right:
				case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.LabelOnly:
					flag2 = true;
					break;
				case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.Top:
				case NodeLayoutLabelPosition.Bottom:
					flag2 = !flag;
					break;
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					rect.Height++;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		protected override void DrawForeground(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0083: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_010c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).InvalidRect.IntersectsWith(((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).ElementDrawingRect))
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle rectValue = base.rectValue;
			rectValue.X = (rectValue.Left + rectValue.Right) / 2;
			rectValue.Width = 1;
			rectValue.Height++;
			Border3DSide border3DSide = Border3DSide.Left;
			UIElementBorderStyle nodeConnectorBorderStyle = TreeControl.NodeConnectorBorderStyle;
			switch (nodeConnectorBorderStyle - 2)

			case 1:
				if (rectValue.Y % 2 > 0)

					rectValue.Y--;
				}
				if (rectValue.Height % 2 > 0)
				{

				}
				break;
			case 5:
				rectValue.Width++;
				border3DSide |= Border3DSide.Right;
				break;
			case 6:

				rectValue.Width++;
				border3DSide |= Border3DSide.Right;
				break;

		{
			get
			{
				if (index >= base.Count)
				{
					this[index] = new Override(treeControl);
					return this[index];
				}
				Override obj = (Override)base.GetItem(index);
				if (obj == null)
				{
					this[index] = new Override(treeControl);
					return this[index];
				}
				return obj;
			}
			set
			{
				while (base.Count < index)
				{
					List.Add(null);
				}
				if (index < base.Count)
				{
					if (base.GetItem(index) == null)
					{
						InternalRemove(index);
					}
					else
					{
						RemoveAt(index);
					}
				}
				value.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				InternalInsert(index, value);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.NodeLevelOverrides, null);
			}
		}

			Override obj = new Override(treeControl);
			obj.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalAdd(obj);
			return obj;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		protected NodeLevelOverridesCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.ObjectType == typeof(Override) || current.ObjectType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(Override)))
				{
					Override obj = (Override)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Override), null);
					if (obj != null)
					{
						AddOverrideHelper(obj);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

		private int AddOverrideHelper(Override overrideObj)
		{
			overrideObj.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			return InternalAdd(overrideObj);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index > Count || index < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_3"));
			}
			Override obj = this[index];
			InternalRemove(index);
			obj.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			InternalClear();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(propChange.PropId, propChange);
		}

		public int Add(object value)
		{
			return ((IList)this).Add(value);
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_4"));
			}
			if (!(value is Override obj))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_4", value.GetType().Name));
			}
			obj.InitControl(treeControl);
			obj.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			return InternalAdd(obj);
		}

			InternalRemove(obj);
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i].ShouldSerialize())

				}

		private void treeView1_DragOver(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
		{
			Point point = ((Control)(object)treeView1).PointToClient(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
			UltraTreeNode nodeFromPoint = treeView1.GetNodeFromPoint(point);
			if (nodeFromPoint == null)
			{
				e.Effect = DragDropEffects.None;
				UltraTree_DropHightLight_DrawFilter.ClearDropHighlight();
			}
			else if (IsAnyParentSelected(nodeFromPoint))
			{
				e.Effect = DragDropEffects.None;
				UltraTree_DropHightLight_DrawFilter.ClearDropHighlight();
			}
			else
			{
				UltraTree_DropHightLight_DrawFilter.SetDropHighlightNode(nodeFromPoint, point);
				e.Effect = DragDropEffects.Move;
			}
		}

		private void treeView1_DragDrop(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
		{
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = null;
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode2 = UltraTree_DropHightLight_DrawFilter.DropHightLightNode;
			SelectedNodesCollection selectedNodesCollection = (SelectedNodesCollection)e.Data.GetData(typeof(SelectedNodesCollection));
			selectedNodesCollection = selectedNodesCollection.Clone() as SelectedNodesCollection;
			selectedNodesCollection.SortByPosition();
			switch (UltraTree_DropHightLight_DrawFilter.DropLinePosition)
			{
			case DropLinePositionEnum.OnNode:
			{
				for (int i = 0; i <= selectedNodesCollection.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					ultraTreeNode = selectedNodesCollection[i];
					ultraTreeNode.Reposition(ultraTreeNode2.Nodes);
				}
				break;
			}
			case DropLinePositionEnum.BelowNode:
			{
				for (int i = 0; i <= selectedNodesCollection.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					ultraTreeNode = selectedNodesCollection[i];
					ultraTreeNode.Reposition(ultraTreeNode2, NodePosition.Next);
					ultraTreeNode2 = ultraTreeNode;
				}
				break;
			}
			case DropLinePositionEnum.AboveNode:
			{
				for (int i = 0; i <= selectedNodesCollection.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					ultraTreeNode = selectedNodesCollection[i];
					ultraTreeNode.Reposition(ultraTreeNode2, NodePosition.Previous);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			UltraTree_DropHightLight_DrawFilter.ClearDropHighlight();
			treeView1.ActiveNode = ultraTreeNode;
			if (ultraTreeNode != null)
			{
				ultraTreeNode.Selected = true;
			}
		}

		private void treeView1_SelectionDragStart(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)treeView1).DoDragDrop((object)treeView1.SelectedNodes, DragDropEffects.Move);
		}

			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		private void NodePropertyEditor_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			propertyGrid1.SelectedObject = treeView1.ActiveNode;
			CenterToParent();
			MinimumSize = base.Size;
			treeView1.HideSelection = false;
			if (treeView1.Nodes.Count > 0)
			{
				treeView1.InternalSelectItem(treeView1.Nodes[0], clearExistingSelection: true, select: true);
			}
		}

		private void NodePropertyEditor_Activated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!firstActivated)
			{
				treeView1.Override.SelectionType = SelectType.Single;
				treeView1.SelectionBehavior = SelectionBehavior.UseOverride;
				treeView1.DisplayStyle = UltraTreeDisplayStyle.Standard;
				if (treeView1.Nodes.Count > 0)
				{
					treeView1.ActiveNode = treeView1.Nodes[0];
					treeView1.InternalSelectItem(treeView1.Nodes[0], clearExistingSelection: true, select: true);
					propertyGrid1.SelectedObject = treeView1.ActiveNode;
					firstActivated = true;
				}
				VerifyToolbarButtonStates();
			}
		}

		private void NodePropertyEditor_Resize(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private void EnableControls(bool enable)
		{
			btnAddChild.Enabled = enable;
			btnAddSibling.Enabled = enable;
			btnRemove.Enabled = enable;
			btnEdit.Enabled = enable;
			btnClear.Enabled = enable;
			btnMoveUp.Enabled = enable;
			btnMoveDown.Enabled = enable;
		}

		private void OK_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			object tag = ((Control)(object)treeViewBeingEdited).Tag;
			if (treeView1.HideSelection != valueForHideSelectionOnLoad)
			{
				treeView1.HideSelection = valueForHideSelectionOnLoad;
			}
			if (treeView1.Override.SelectionType != valueForSelectionTypeOnLoad)
			{
				treeView1.Override.SelectionType = valueForSelectionTypeOnLoad;
			}
			if (treeView1.Scrollable != valueForScrollable)
			{
				treeView1.Scrollable = valueForScrollable;
			}
			if (treeView1.Override.NodeSpacingAfter != valueForNodeSpacingAfter)
			{
				treeView1.Override.NodeSpacingAfter = valueForNodeSpacingAfter;
			}
			if (treeView1.SelectionBehavior != valueForSelectionBehavior)
			{
				treeView1.SelectionBehavior = valueForSelectionBehavior;
			}
			if (treeView1.DisplayStyle != valueForDisplayStyle)
			{
				treeView1.DisplayStyle = valueForDisplayStyle;
			}
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			treeView1.SaveAsBinary(memoryStream);
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			treeViewBeingEdited.InternalDesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled = true;
			treeViewBeingEdited.LoadFromBinary(memoryStream);
			memoryStream.Close();
			treeViewBeingEdited.TreeNodeKeys.Clear();
			ReplaceNewNodesWithOriginals(treeViewBeingEdited.Nodes, treeView1.Nodes);
			treeViewBeingEdited.InternalDesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled = false;
			((Control)(object)treeViewBeingEdited).Tag = tag;
			if (treeView1.Nodes.Count > 0)
			{
				treeViewBeingEdited.ActiveNode = treeViewBeingEdited.Nodes[0];
			}
		}

		private void treeView1_OnAfterActivate(object sender, NodeEventArgs e)
		{
			propertyGrid1.SelectedObject = e.TreeNode;
			VerifyToolbarButtonStates();
		}

		private void PopulateTempNodeMappings(TreeNodesCollection originalNodes, TreeNodesCollection tempNodes)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < originalNodes.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = originalNodes[i];
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode2 = tempNodes[i];
				tempNodeMappings[ultraTreeNode2] = ultraTreeNode;
				PopulateTempNodeMappings(ultraTreeNode.Nodes, ultraTreeNode2.Nodes);
			}
		}

		private void ReplaceNewNodesWithOriginals(TreeNodesCollection newNodes, TreeNodesCollection tempNodes)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < newNodes.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = newNodes[i];
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode2 = tempNodes[i];
				if (tempNodeMappings.TryGetValue(ultraTreeNode2, out var value))
				{
					List<UltraTreeNode> list = new List<UltraTreeNode>();
					for (int j = 0; j < ultraTreeNode.Nodes.Count; j++)
					{
						list.Add(ultraTreeNode.Nodes[j]);
					}
					ultraTreeNode.Nodes.Clear();
					value.InitializeFrom(ultraTreeNode);
					value.Nodes.Clear();
					for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
					{
						value.Nodes.Add(list[k]);
					}
					newNodes.RemoveAt(i);
					newNodes.Insert(i, value);
					ReplaceNewNodesWithOriginals(value.Nodes, ultraTreeNode2.Nodes);
				}
				else
				{
					ReplaceNewNodesWithOriginals(ultraTreeNode.Nodes, ultraTreeNode2.Nodes);
				}
			}
		}

		private void btnAddRoot_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			AddRootHelper();
		}

		private void btnAddChild_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)

		private void AddRootHelper()
		{
			((UltraControlBase)treeView1).BeginUpdate();
			TreeNodesCollection nodes = treeView1.Nodes;
			nodes.Add();
			nodes[nodes.Count - 1].BringIntoView();
			((UltraControlBase)treeView1).EndUpdate(true);
			treeView1.InternalSelectItem(nodes[nodes.Count - 1], clearExistingSelection: true, select: true);
			treeView1.ActiveNode.BeginEdit(ignoreLabelEdit: true);
			VerifyToolbarButtonStates();
		}

		private void AddChildHelper()
		{
			UltraTreeNode activeNode = treeView1.ActiveNode;
			if (activeNode != null)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)treeView1).BeginUpdate();
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = activeNode.Nodes.Add();
				ultraTreeNode.BringIntoView();
				((UltraControlBase)treeView1).EndUpdate(true);
				treeView1.InternalSelectItem(ultraTreeNode, clearExistingSelection: true, select: true);
				treeView1.ActiveNode.BeginEdit(ignoreLabelEdit: true);
				VerifyToolbarButtonStates();
			}
		}

		private void AddSiblingHelper()
		{
			UltraTreeNode activeNode = treeView1.ActiveNode;
			if (activeNode != null)
			{
				TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection = null;
				treeNodesCollection = ((activeNode.Parent != null) ? activeNode.Parent.Nodes : activeNode.Control.Nodes);
				((UltraControlBase)treeView1).BeginUpdate();
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = treeNodesCollection.Add();
				ultraTreeNode.BringIntoView();
				((UltraControlBase)treeView1).EndUpdate(true);
				treeView1.InternalSelectItem(ultraTreeNode, clearExistingSelection: true, select: true);
				treeView1.ActiveNode.BeginEdit(ignoreLabelEdit: true);
				VerifyToolbarButtonStates();
			}
		}

		private void RemoveHelper()
		{
			UltraTreeNode activeNode = treeView1.ActiveNode;
			UltraTreeNode sibling = activeNode.GetSibling(NodePosition.Next);
			if (sibling == null)
			{
				sibling = activeNode.GetSibling(NodePosition.Previous);
			}
			if (sibling == null)
			{
				sibling = activeNode.Parent;
			}
			activeNode?.Remove();
			if (treeView1.Nodes.Count == 0)
			{
				EnableControls(enable: false);
			}
			else
			{
				if (sibling != null)
				{
					sibling.Selected = true;
				}
				treeView1.ActiveNode = sibling;
			}
			VerifyToolbarButtonStates();
		}

		private void EditHelper()
		{
			treeView1.ActiveNode.BeginEdit(ignoreLabelEdit: true);
			VerifyToolbarButtonStates();
		}

		private void ClearHelper()
		{
			string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AllNodesDelete");
			DialogResult dialogResult = UltraMessageBoxManager.Show(text, "Infragistics UltraWinTree", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo);
			if (dialogResult == DialogResult.Yes)
			{
				treeView1.Nodes.Clear();
				propertyGrid1.SelectedObject = null;
				EnableControls(enable: false);
				btnAddRoot.Enabled = true;
			}
			VerifyToolbarButtonStates();
		}

		private void MoveUpHelper()
		{
			MoveHelper(up: true);
		}

		private void MoveDownHelper()
		{
			MoveHelper(up: false);
		}

		private void MoveHelper(bool up)
		{
			UltraTreeNode activeNode = treeView1.ActiveNode;
			if (activeNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			NodePosition nodePosition = (up ? NodePosition.Previous : NodePosition.Next);
			int index = activeNode.Index;
			TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection = null;
			if (activeNode.IsRootLevelNode)
			{
				treeNodesCollection = treeView1.Nodes;
			}
			else
			{
				if (activeNode.ParentNodesCollection == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				treeNodesCollection = activeNode.ParentNodesCollection;
			}
			int count = treeNodesCollection.Count;
			if (count > 1 && index >= 0 && index < count)
			{
				UltraTreeNode sibling = activeNode.GetSibling(nodePosition);
				if (sibling != null)
				{
					activeNode.Reposition(sibling, nodePosition);
					index = ((nodePosition != NodePosition.Previous) ? (index + 1) : (index - 1));
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = treeNodesCollection[index];
					treeView1.ActiveNode = ultraTreeNode;
					ultraTreeNode.Selected = true;
				}
			}
			VerifyToolbarButtonStates();
		}

		private void OutdentHelper()
		{
			UltraTreeNode activeNode = treeView1.ActiveNode;
			if (activeNode != null && !activeNode.IsRootLevelNode)
			{
				TreeNodesCollection parentNodesCollection = activeNode.Parent.ParentNodesCollection;
				int index = activeNode.Parent.Index + 1;
				activeNode.Reposition(parentNodesCollection, index);
				treeView1.ActiveNode = parentNodesCollection[index];
				treeView1.ActiveNode.Selected = true;
				VerifyToolbarButtonStates();
			}
		}

		private void IndentHelper()
		{
			UltraTreeNode activeNode = treeView1.ActiveNode;
			if (activeNode != null)
			{
				UltraTreeNode sibling = activeNode.GetSibling(NodePosition.Previous);
				if (sibling != null)
				{
					activeNode.Reposition(sibling.Nodes);
					treeView1.ActiveNode = sibling.Nodes[sibling.Nodes.Count - 1];
					treeView1.ActiveNode.Selected = true;
				}
				VerifyToolbarButtonStates();
			}
		}

		private void VerifyToolbarButtonStates()
		{
			btnAddRoot.Enabled = true;
			UltraTreeNode activeNode = treeView1.ActiveNode;
			bool flag = activeNode == null;
			btnAddChild.Enabled = !flag;
			btnAddSibling.Enabled = !flag;
			btnEdit.Enabled = !flag;
			btnRemove.Enabled = !flag;
			btnClear.Enabled = treeView1.Nodes.Count > 0;
			if (activeNode != null)
			{
				if (activeNode.IsRootLevelNode)
				{
					btnMoveUp.Enabled = treeView1.Nodes.IndexOf(activeNode) > 0;
					btnMoveDown.Enabled = treeView1.Nodes.IndexOf(activeNode) < treeView1.Nodes.Count - 1;
					btnOutdent.Enabled = false;
				}
				else
				{
					btnMoveUp.Enabled = activeNode.ParentNodesCollection.IndexOf(activeNode) > 0;
					btnMoveDown.Enabled = activeNode.ParentNodesCollection.IndexOf(activeNode) < activeNode.ParentNodesCollection.Count - 1;
					btnOutdent.Enabled = true;
				}
				UltraTreeNode sibling = activeNode.GetSibling(NodePosition.Previous);
				btnIndent.Enabled = sibling != null;
			}
			else
			{
				btnMoveUp.Enabled = false;
				btnMoveDown.Enabled = false;
				btnOutdent.Enabled = false;
				btnIndent.Enabled = false;
			}
			propertyGrid1.Enabled = propertyGrid1.SelectedObject != null;
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	internal enum DropLinePositionEnum
	{
		None = 0,

		internal static object InternalExtractExistingElement(UIElementsCollection oldElements, Type type, bool remove)
		{
			return UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, type, remove);
		}

		protected override void DrawFocus(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			//IL_0067: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0081: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_009d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a0: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (!((UIElement)this).DrawsFocusRect)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraTree ultraTree = ((UIElement)this).Control as UltraTree;
			switch (ultraTree.ViewStyleResolved)
			{
			case ViewStyle.OutlookExpress:
			case ViewStyle.Grid:
			case ViewStyle.FreeForm:
			{
				UltraTreeNode node = Node;
				if (node != null && node.ShowColumnsResolved && ((UIElement)this).GetDescendant(typeof(UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement)) is UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement ultraTreeNodeCellUIElement)
				{
					UIElementBorderStyle borderStyle = ((UIElement)ultraTreeNodeCellUIElement).BorderStyle;
					Border3DSide borderSides = ((UIElement)ultraTreeNodeCellUIElement).BorderSides;
					Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
					if ((int)borderStyle == 1)
					{
						rect.Height--;
					}
					else
					{
						rect.Inflate(-1, -1);
					}
					if ((int)borderStyle != 1 && (borderSides & Border3DSide.Top) == 0)
					{
						rect.Y--;
						rect.Height++;
					}
					((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).DrawFocusRectangle(rect);
					return;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			((UIElement)this).DrawFocus(ref drawParams);
		}

		public override object GetContext(Type type, bool checkParentElementContexts)
		{
			if (type != null && (type == typeof(UltraTreeNode) || type.IsSubclassOf(typeof(UltraTreeNode))))
			{
				return Node;
			}
			if (type != null && (type == typeof(UltraTreeColumnSet) || type.IsSubclassOf(typeof(UltraTreeColumnSet))))
			{
				UltraTreeNode node = Node;
				UltraTree ultraTree = ((UIElement)this).Control as UltraTree;
				if (!ultraTree.IsViewStyleStandard)
				{
					return node.DisplayColumnSetResolved;
				}
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).GetContext(type, checkParentElementContexts);
		}
	}
	public class NodeTextUIElement : TextUIElement
	{
		protected override bool DrawsBackColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (((UIElement)this).Control is UltraTree ultraTree)
				{
					return ultraTree.DisplayStyleResolved == UltraTreeDisplayStyle.Standard;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public UltraTreeNode Node => (UltraTreeNode)((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(UltraTreeNode));

		protected override bool DrawsFocusRect
		{
			get
			{
				UltraTree ultraTree = ((UIElement)this).Control as UltraTree;
				if (!ultraTree.DrawsFocusRectResolved)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Node.IsActive)
				{
					return !ultraTree.IsInFullRowSelectMode;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public NodeTextUIElement(UIElement parent, string text)
			: base(parent, text)
		{
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			Node.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			((TextUIElement)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected override void DrawBackColor(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (!Node.IsEditing)
			{
				UltraTree ultraTree = ((UIElement)this).Control as UltraTree;
				if (!ultraTree.IsInFullRowSelectMode)
				{
					((TextUIElementBase)this).DrawBackColor(ref drawParams);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void DrawImageBackground(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			UltraTree ultraTree = ((UIElement)this).Control as UltraTree;
			if (!ultraTree.IsInFullRowSelectMode)
			{
				((TextUIElementBase)this).DrawImageBackground(ref drawParams);
			}
		}
	}
	public class NodeOptionButtonUIElement : OptionButtonUIElement
	{
		public UltraTreeNode Node => (UltraTreeNode)((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(UltraTreeNode));

		public NodeOptionButtonUIElement(UIElement parent)
			: base(parent)
		{
			((OptionButtonUIElement)this).CheckAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter;
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			if (Node.CheckedState == CheckState.Checked)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeforeCheckEventArgs e = new BeforeCheckEventArgs(Node);
			e.NewValue = CheckState.Checked;
			CheckState checkedState = Node.CheckedState;
			if (((UIElement)this).Control != null)
			{
				((UltraTree)(object)((UIElement)this).Control).FireEvent(TreeEventIds.BeforeCheck, e);
			}
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				if (e.NewValue == CheckState.Checked)
				{
					((ButtonWithTextUIElementBase)this).OnClick();
					OnCheckStateChanged();
				}
				if (((UIElement)this).Control != null)
				{
					NodeEventArgs e2 = new NodeEventArgs(Node);
					((UltraTree)(object)((UIElement)this).Control).FireEvent(TreeEventIds.AfterCheck, e2);
					UltraTree ultraTree = (UltraTree)(object)((UIElement)this).Control;
					ToggleState toggleState = TreeUtils.GetToggleState(checkedState);
					ToggleState toggleState2 = TreeUtils.GetToggleState(Node.CheckedState);
					ultraTree.RaiseUIAutomationPropertyChangedEventInternal((AutomationPropertyIds)30086, toggleState, toggleState2, ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)Node.GetUiaProviderStub()).Provider);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void DrawFocus(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParames)
		{
		}

		private void OnCheckStateChanged()
		{
			Node.ParentNodesCollection.CheckedOptionButtonIndex = Node.Index;
			Node.NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.CheckedState, null);
		}

		protected override void DrawBackColor(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawImageBackground(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
		}
	}

		public sealed class OverrideTypeConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_12"));
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is Override)
				{
					Override obj = (Override)value;
					ConstructorInfo constructor = value.GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
					if (constructor != null)
					{
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[0], isComplete: false);
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Editor(typeof(UltraTreeColumnSetTypeEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_Override_P_ColumnSet")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public UltraTreeColumnSet ColumnSet
		{
			get
			{
				if (columnSetIndex != -1 && treeControl != null)
				{
					ColumnSetsCollection columnSetsCollection = ((treeControl != null && treeControl.ColumnSettings.HasColumnSets) ? treeControl.ColumnSettings.ColumnSets : null);
					if (columnSetsCollection != null)
					{
						if (columnSetIndex >= 0 && columnSetIndex < columnSetsCollection.Count)
						{
							columnSet = columnSetsCollection[columnSetIndex];
						}
						columnSetIndex = -1;
					}
				}
				if (columnSet != null && columnSet.Control == null)
				{
					columnSet.InitControl(treeControl);
				}
				return columnSet;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == columnSet)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (columnSet != null)
				{
					columnSet.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				columnSet = value;
				if (columnSet != null)
				{
					if (treeControl != null)
					{
						columnSet.InitControl(treeControl);
					}
					columnSet.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				columnSetIndex = -1;
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ColumnSet);
			}
		}

		internal bool HasColumnSet
		{
			get
			{
				if (columnSetIndex >= 0)
				{
					if (ColumnSet != null)
					{
						return ShouldSerializeColumnSet();
					}
					return false;
				}
				if (columnSet != null)
				{
					return ShouldSerializeColumnSet();
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public int ColumnSetIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (columnSet != null && treeControl != null)
				{
					return treeControl.ColumnSettings.ColumnSets.IndexOf(columnSet);
				}
				return columnSetIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				columnSetIndex = value;
			}
		}

		[TypeConverter(typeof(EmbeddableEditorComponentConverter))]

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public Component EditorComponent
		{
			get
			{
				if (editorComponent == null && editorComponentName != null && treeControl != null && !treeControl.Initializing && !((Control)(object)treeControl).Disposing && !((Control)(object)treeControl).IsDisposed)
				{
					try
					{
						UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
						if (Utilities.CanAssert)
						{
							uIPermission.Assert();
						}
						Control editorControlContainer = treeControl.EditorControlContainer;
						Component component = null;
						if (editorControlContainer != null)
						{
							component = Utilities.FindContainedComponentByName(editorControlContainer, editorComponentName);
						}
						if (component is IProvidesEmbeddableEditor)
						{
							editorComponent = component;
						}
						editorComponentName = null;
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
					}
				}
				return editorComponent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != editorComponent)
				{
					if (value != null && !(value is IProvidesEmbeddableEditor))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_ComponentMustImplementIProvidesEmbeddableEditor"));
					}
					editorComponent = value;
					editorComponentName = null;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.EditorComponent);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (appearanceHolders != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
				{
					if (appearanceHolders[i] != null)
					{
						appearanceHolders[i].SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
						appearanceHolders[i].Reset();
						appearanceHolders[i] = null;
					}
				}
			}
			if (columnSet != null)
			{
				columnSet.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				columnSet = null;
			}
			if (notificationBadgeSettings != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).Dispose();
				((SubObjectBase)(object)notificationBadgeSettings).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				notificationBadgeSettings = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeAppearanceHolders()
		{
			if (appearanceHolders != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
				{
					if (appearanceHolders[i] != null && appearanceHolders[i].ShouldSerialize())
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetAppearanceHolders()
		{
			if (appearanceHolders == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
			{
				if (appearanceHolders[i] != null)
				{
					appearanceHolders[i].Reset();
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetAppearances()
		{
			if (appearanceHolders == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
			{
				if (appearanceHolders[i] != null)
				{
					ResetAppearance((OverrideAppearanceIndex)i);
				}
			}
		}

		internal Override Clone()
		{
			Override obj = (Override)MemberwiseClone();
			obj.itemHeight = itemHeight;
			obj.selectType = selectType;
			for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
			{
				if (appearanceHolders[i] != null)
				{
					obj.appearanceHolders[i] = appearanceHolders[i].Clone();
				}
				else
				{
					obj.appearanceHolders[i] = null;
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		internal bool HasAppearance(OverrideAppearanceIndex index)
		{
			if (appearanceHolders != null && appearanceHolders[(int)index] != null)
			{
				return appearanceHolders[(int)index].HasAppearance;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeAppearance(OverrideAppearanceIndex index)
		{
			if (HasAppearance(index))
			{
				return GetAppearance(index).ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ResetAppearance(OverrideAppearanceIndex index)
		{
			if (appearanceHolders != null && appearanceHolders[(int)index] != null)
			{
				appearanceHolders[(int)index].Reset();
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Appearance);
			}
		}

		internal AppearanceBase GetAppearance(OverrideAppearanceIndex index)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (AppearanceHolders[(int)index] == null)
			{
				AppearanceHolders[(int)index] = new AppearanceHolder();
				appearanceHolders[(int)index].SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (treeControl != null)
			{
				appearanceHolders[(int)index].Collection = treeControl.Appearances;
			}
			return AppearanceHolders[(int)index].Appearance;
		}

		private void SetAppearance(OverrideAppearanceIndex index, AppearanceBase appearance)
		{
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (AppearanceHolders[(int)index] == null || !AppearanceHolders[(int)index].HasAppearance || appearance != AppearanceHolders[(int)index].Appearance)
			{
				if (AppearanceHolders[(int)index] == null)
				{
					AppearanceHolders[(int)index] = new AppearanceHolder();
					appearanceHolders[(int)index].SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				if (treeControl != null)
				{
					appearanceHolders[(int)index].Collection = treeControl.Appearances;
				}
				AppearanceHolders[(int)index].Appearance = appearance;
				NotifyPropChange(AppearancePropIds[(int)index], null);
			}
		}

		internal void InternalSetOwningControl(UltraTree owningControl)
		{
			treeControl = owningControl;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (appearanceHolders != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
				{
					if (appearanceHolders[i] != null && appearanceHolders[i].HasAppearance && propChange.Source == appearanceHolders[i].RootAppearance)
					{
						NotifyPropChange(AppearancePropIds[i], propChange);
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			if (propChange.Source == columnSet)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ColumnSet, propChange);
			}
			else if (notificationBadgeSettings != null && propChange.Source == notificationBadgeSettings)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.NotificationBadgeSettings, propChange);
			}
		}

		internal void InitControl(UltraTree treeControl)
		{
			this.treeControl = treeControl;
			InitAppearanceHolders();
			if (HasColumnSet && ColumnSet.Control == null)
			{
				ColumnSet.InitControl(this.treeControl);
			}
		}

		internal void InitAppearanceHolders()
		{
			if (appearanceHolders == null || treeControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
			{
				if (appearanceHolders[i] != null)
				{
					appearanceHolders[i].Collection = treeControl.Appearances;
				}
			}
		}

		void IDeserializationCallback.OnDeserialization(object sender)
		{
			if (appearanceHolders != null)
			{
				AppearanceHolder[] array = appearanceHolders;
				foreach (AppearanceHolder val in array)
				{
					if (val != null)
					{
						val.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
				}
			}
			if (columnSet != null)
			{
				columnSet.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				columnSet.InitControl(treeControl);
			}
			OnDeserialization(sender);
		}

	public class PreNodeAreaUIElement : UIElement
	{
		public UltraTreeNode Node => (UltraTreeNode)((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(UltraTreeNode));

		public override ISelectableItem SelectableItem
		{
			get
			{
				UltraTree ultraTree = ((UIElement)this).Control as UltraTree;
				if (ultraTree.IsInFullRowSelectMode)
				{
					return Node;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => (UIElementBorderStyle)1;

		public override Border3DSide BorderSides => (Border3DSide)0;

		public PreNodeAreaUIElement(UIElement parent)
			: base(parent)
		{
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (((UIElement)this).Control is UltraTree ultraTree)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = ultraTree.NodeConnectorColorResolved;
			}
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			if (!Node.HasExpansionIndicator)
			{
				if (base.childElementsCollection != null && ((ArrayList)(object)base.childElementsCollection).Count > 0)
				{
					((ArrayList)(object)base.childElementsCollection).Clear();
				}
				return;
			}
			ExpansionIndicatorUIElement expansionIndicatorUIElement = null;
			if (base.childElementsCollection != null && ((ArrayList)(object)base.childElementsCollection).Count > 0)
			{
				expansionIndicatorUIElement = (ExpansionIndicatorUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)base.childElementsCollection, typeof(ExpansionIndicatorUIElement), false);
			}
			if (expansionIndicatorUIElement == null)
			{
				expansionIndicatorUIElement = new ExpansionIndicatorUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)expansionIndicatorUIElement);
			}
			Rectangle rectValue = base.rectValue;
			int num = ((Node.Control != null) ? Node.Control.ExpansionIndicatorSizeResolved.Height : 9);
			int num2 = rectValue.Top + 1 + (rectValue.Height - num) / 2;
			if (rectValue.Top % 2 > 0)
			{
				num2--;
			}
			Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(0, 0, (Node.Control != null) ? Node.Control.ExpansionIndicatorSizeResolved.Width : 9, (Node.Control != null) ? Node.Control.ExpansionIndicatorSizeResolved.Height : 9);
			DrawUtility.AdjustHAlign((HAlign)2, ref rect, rectValue);
			DrawUtility.AdjustVAlign((VAlign)2, ref rect, rectValue);
			((UIElement)expansionIndicatorUIElement).Rect = rect;
		}

		protected override void DrawBackColor(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawImageBackground(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawForeground(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			//IL_00ed: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0119: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0163: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((UIElement)this).Control is UltraTree { ShowLines: not false } ultraTree && ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).InvalidRect.IntersectsWith(((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).ElementDrawingRect))
			{
				Rectangle rectValue = base.rectValue;
				int num = (rectValue.Top + rectValue.Bottom + 1) / 2;
				if (rectValue.Top % 2 > 0)
				{
					num--;
				}
				UltraTreeNode node = Node;
				int num2 = rectValue.Left + rectValue.Width / 2;
				if (Node.HasExpansionIndicator)
				{
					num2 += ((Node.Control != null) ? (Node.Control.ExpansionIndicatorSizeResolved.Width / 2) : 4);
				}
				rectValue.X = num2;
				rectValue.Width = 1 + ((UIElement)this).Rect.Right - rectValue.Left;
				rectValue.Y = num;
				rectValue.Height = 1;
				Border3DSide border3DSide = Border3DSide.Top;
				UIElementBorderStyle nodeConnectorBorderStyle = ultraTree.NodeConnectorBorderStyle;
				switch (nodeConnectorBorderStyle - 2)
				{
				case 5:
					rectValue.Height++;
					border3DSide |= Border3DSide.Bottom;
					break;
				case 6:
					rectValue.Y--;
					rectValue.Height++;
					border3DSide |= Border3DSide.Bottom;
					break;
				}
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).DrawBorders(nodeConnectorBorderStyle, border3DSide, ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor, rectValue, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).InvalidRect);
			}
		}
	}

	public class ScrollbarControl : IDisposable
	{
		private ScrollBarInfo hscrollBar;

		private ScrollBarInfo vscrollBar;

		private IScrollableControl control;

		private bool dirtyVScrollBar = true;

		private bool dirtyHScrollBar = true;

		private int vscrollPos;

		private int hscrollPos;

		private bool isVScrollBarVisible;

		private bool isHScrollBarVisible;

		internal ScrollBarInfo VerticalScroll
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (vscrollBar == null && control != null)
				{
					vscrollBar = new ScrollBarInfo((Control)control, Orientation.Vertical, ((UltraTree)control).Appearances);
					vscrollBar.ScrollBarLook = ((UltraTree)control).ScrollBarLook;
					vscrollBar.Scroll += OnVerticalScroll;
					vscrollBar.AutoDisable = true;
				}
				return vscrollBar;
			}
		}

		internal ScrollBarInfo HorizontalScroll
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (hscrollBar == null && control != null)
				{
					hscrollBar = new ScrollBarInfo((Control)control, Orientation.Horizontal, ((UltraTree)control).Appearances);
					hscrollBar.ScrollBarLook = ((UltraTree)control).ScrollBarLook;
					hscrollBar.Scroll += OnHorizontalScroll;
					hscrollBar.AutoDisable = true;
				}
				return hscrollBar;
			}
		}

		internal bool VScrollVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (vscrollBar != null)
				{
					return isVScrollBarVisible;
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
				if (vscrollBar != null && value != isVScrollBarVisible)
				{
					isVScrollBarVisible = value;
					if (isHScrollBarVisible)
					{
						RecalcHScroll();
					}
					UltraTree ultraTree = control as UltraTree;
					if (ultraTree.ColumnSettings.SettingsResolved.AutoFitColumns)
					{
						ultraTree.BumpMetricsVersion();
					}
				}
			}
		}

					int value2 = (hscrollPos = ((value < minimum) ? minimum : ((value > maximumDragValue) ? maximumDragValue : value)));
					hscrollBar.Value = value2;
					control.DirtyControl();
				}
			}

						value = 0;
					}
					vscrollPos = value;
					vscrollBar.Value = value;

					vertical = ScaledSystemInformation.GetVerticalScrollBarWidth((Control)(object)ultraTree);

				Rectangle result = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.Right - vertical, rectInsideBorders.Top, vertical, isHScrollBarVisible ? (rectInsideBorders.Height - horizontal) : rectInsideBorders.Height);

		internal void ShowVerticalScroll(bool show)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SetVScrollbarDirty(dirty: false);
			if (show == isVScrollBarVisible)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (show)
			{
				if (!VScrollVisible)
				{
					VScrollVisible = true;
				}
				RecalcVScroll();
			}
			else if (vscrollBar != null)
			{
				VScrollPosition = 0;
				VScrollVisible = false;
			}
			if (HScrollVisible)
			{
				RecalcHScroll();
			}
			control.DirtyControl();
		}

		internal void ShowHorizontalScroll(bool show)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SetHScrollbarDirty(dirty: false);
			if (show != isHScrollBarVisible)
			{
				if (show)
				{
					RecalcHScroll();
					HScrollVisible = true;
				}
				else if (hscrollBar != null)
				{
					HScrollPosition = 0;
					HScrollVisible = false;
				}
				if (VScrollVisible)
				{
					RecalcVScroll();
				}
				control.DirtyControl();
			}
		}

		internal void OnVerticalScroll(object sender, ScrollEventArgs arg)
		{
			if (vscrollBar == null || control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraTree ultraTree = control as UltraTree;
			if (!ultraTree.VerifyEditModeExited())
			{
				arg.NewValue = vscrollBar.Value;
				vscrollBar.CancelScroll();
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (ultraTree != null)
				{
					ultraTree.IsScrollingVertically = true;
				}
				int newPostion = VScrollPosition;
				control.OnScroll(ScrollBarType.vertical, arg, ref newPostion);
				VScrollPosition = newPostion;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (ultraTree != null)
				{
					ultraTree.IsScrollingVertically = false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnHorizontalScroll(object obj, ScrollEventArgs arg)
		{
			if (hscrollBar != null && control != null)
			{
				UltraTree ultraTree = control as UltraTree;
				if (!ultraTree.VerifyEditModeExited())
				{
					arg.NewValue = hscrollBar.Value;
					hscrollBar.CancelScroll();
				}
				else
				{
					int newPostion = HScrollPosition;
					control.OnScroll(ScrollBarType.horizontal, arg, ref newPostion);
					HScrollPosition = newPostion;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RecalcVScroll()
		{
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = control.RectInsideBorders;
			VerticalScroll.Maximum = control.MaxSize(ScrollBarType.vertical);
			if (vscrollPos > VerticalScroll.MaximumDragValue)
			{
				vscrollPos = VerticalScroll.MaximumDragValue;
			}
			int val = control.MinSize(ScrollBarType.vertical);
			int val2 = control.LargeChange(ScrollBarType.vertical);
			VerticalScroll.SmallChange = Math.Max(1, val);
			VerticalScroll.LargeChange = Math.Max(1, val2);
		}

		internal void RecalcHScroll()
		{
			UltraTree ultraTree = control as UltraTree;
			int num = (ultraTree.IsViewStyleStandard ? 5 : 0);
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = control.RectInsideBorders;
			HorizontalScroll.Maximum = control.MaxSize(ScrollBarType.horizontal) + num;
			UltraTree ultraTree2 = control as UltraTree;
			int num2;
			if (ultraTree2 != null)
			{
				ScrollBarLook scrollBarLookIfAllocated = ultraTree2.GetScrollBarLookIfAllocated();
				num2 = ScrollBarLook.GetVerticalScrollBarWidthResolved((Control)(object)ultraTree2, scrollBarLookIfAllocated, ((UltraControlBase)ultraTree2).ComponentRole);
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = ScaledSystemInformation.GetVerticalScrollBarWidth((Control)(object)ultraTree2);
			}
			int num3 = ((vscrollBar != null && isVScrollBarVisible) ? (rectInsideBorders.Width - num2) : rectInsideBorders.Width);
			float num4 = (ultraTree.IsViewStyleStandard ? 0.9f : 1f);
			HorizontalScroll.LargeChange = Math.Max(Convert.ToInt32((float)num3 * num4), 0);
			HorizontalScroll.SmallChange = control.MinSize(ScrollBarType.horizontal);
		}

		internal void SetVScrollbarDirty(bool dirty)
		{
			dirtyVScrollBar = dirty;
		}

		internal void SetHScrollbarDirty(bool dirty)
		{
			dirtyHScrollBar = dirty;
		}

		internal void ScrollVertical(ScrollEventType type)
		{
			int num = CalculateNewScrollBarValue(vscrollBar, type);
			if (num != vscrollBar.Value)
			{
				ScrollEventArgs arg = new ScrollEventArgs(type, num);
				OnVerticalScroll(null, arg);
			}
		}

		private int CalculateNewScrollBarValue(ScrollBarInfo scrollbar, ScrollEventType type)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement => Math.Max(scrollbar.Minimum, scrollbar.Value - scrollbar.SmallChange), 
				ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement => Math.Min(scrollbar.MaximumDragValue, scrollbar.Value + scrollbar.SmallChange), 
				ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement => Math.Max(scrollbar.Minimum, scrollbar.Value - scrollbar.LargeChange), 
				ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement => Math.Min(scrollbar.MaximumDragValue, scrollbar.Value + scrollbar.LargeChange), 
				_ => scrollbar.Value, 
			};
		}

		internal void ScrollHorizontal(ScrollEventType type)
		{
			int num = CalculateNewScrollBarValue(hscrollBar, type);
			if (num != hscrollBar.Value)
			{
				HScrollPosition = num;
				ScrollEventArgs arg = new ScrollEventArgs(type, num);
				OnHorizontalScroll(null, arg);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (hscrollBar != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)hscrollBar).Dispose();
				hscrollBar = null;
			}
			if (vscrollBar != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)vscrollBar).Dispose();
				vscrollBar = null;
			}
		}

		internal void SetHScrollPosition(int hScrollPosiiton)
		{
			if (hscrollBar != null && control != null)
			{
				hscrollPos = hScrollPosiiton;
				hscrollBar.Value = hScrollPosiiton;
				control.DirtyControl();
			}
		}
	}

	public class SelectedNodesCollection : SubObjectsCollectionBase, ICloneable
	{
		private class NodesByIndexComparer : IComparer
		{
			int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = x as UltraTreeNode;
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode2 = y as UltraTreeNode;
				if (ultraTreeNode == ultraTreeNode2)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (ultraTreeNode == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (ultraTreeNode2 == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				int? num = CompareByAncestor(ultraTreeNode, ultraTreeNode2);
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					return num.Value;
				}
				return CompareByIndex(ultraTreeNode, ultraTreeNode2);
			}

			private static int CompareByIndex(UltraTreeNode node1, UltraTreeNode node2)
			{
				int index = node1.Index;
				int index2 = node2.Index;
				if (index < index2)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 1;
			}

			private int? CompareByAncestor(UltraTreeNode x, UltraTreeNode y)
			{
				int num = x?.Level ?? 0;
				int num2 = y?.Level ?? 0;
				if (x.ParentNodesCollection == y.ParentNodesCollection)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (x.Level > y.Level)
				{
					while (x.Level > y.Level)
					{
						x = x.Parent;
						if (x == y)
						{
							return 1;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (y.Level > x.Level)
				{
					while (y.Level > x.Level)
					{
						y = y.Parent;
						if (y == x)
						{
							return -1;
						}
					}
				}
				while (x != null && y != null && x.ParentNodesCollection != y.ParentNodesCollection)
				{
					x = x.Parent;
					y = y.Parent;
				}
				return CompareByIndex(x, y);
			}
		}

		private HashSet<UltraTreeNode> nodeCollectionKeyMap;

		private bool cloned;

		private UltraTree control;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		protected override int InitialCapacity => 50;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => true;

		internal HashSet<UltraTreeNode> NodeCollectionKeyMap
		{
			get
			{
				if (nodeCollectionKeyMap == null)
				{
					nodeCollectionKeyMap = new HashSet<UltraTreeNode>();
				}
				return nodeCollectionKeyMap;
			}
		}

		internal int InternalAdd(UltraTreeNode selectedNode)
		{
			if (Contains(selectedNode))
			{
				AddToNodeCollectionKeyMap(selectedNode);
				return IndexOf(selectedNode);
			}
			AddToNodeCollectionKeyMap(selectedNode);
			return List.Add(selectedNode);
		}

		internal void InternalAddRange(object[] nodes)
		{
			List.AddRange(nodes);
			foreach (object obj in nodes)
			{
				NodeCollectionKeyMap.Add((UltraTreeNode)obj);
			}
		}

		internal void Remove(UltraTreeNode selectedNode)
		{
			InternalRemove(selectedNode);
			RemoveFromNodeCollectionKeyMap(selectedNode);
		}

		internal void InternalInsert(int index, UltraTreeNode selectedNode)
		{
			if (!Contains(selectedNode))
			{
				InternalInsert(index, (SubObjectBase)selectedNode);
				NodeCollectionKeyMap.Add(selectedNode);
			}
		}

		public NodeEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new NodeEnumerator(this);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (Count < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (cloned)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V3_Exception_42"));
			}
			NodeEnumerator nodeEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (nodeEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraTreeNode current = nodeEnumerator.Current;
					RemoveFromNodeCollectionKeyMap(current);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = nodeEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (this[0].Control != null)
			{
				SelectedNodesCollection selected = new SelectedNodesCollection(cloned: true);
				this[0].Control.SelectNewSelection(selected);
			}
		}

		internal void InternalSortByPosition()
		{
			if (Count >= 2)
			{
				UltraTree ultraTree = this[0].Control;
				if (ultraTree != null)
				{
					List.Sort(new NodesByIndexComparer());
				}
			}
		}

		public void SortByPosition()
		{
			InternalSortByPosition();
		}

		internal void CloneContents(SelectedNodesCollection source)
		{
			List.Clear();
			NodeCollectionKeyMap.Clear();
			if (source.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraTreeNode item in source.List)
			{
				NodeCollectionKeyMap.Add(item);
			}
			List.AddRange(source.List);
		}

			}
		}

		internal bool CutToClipboard()
		{
			if (!CopyToClipboard())
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraTree ultraTree = this[0].Control;
			if (ultraTree == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ultraTree.CanSelectAcrossCollections)
			{
				return CutToClipboardAcrossCollections(ultraTree);
			}
			TreeNodesCollection parentNodesCollection = this[0].ParentNodesCollection;
			if (parentNodesCollection == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraTreeNode newActiveNodeAfterDeletion = ultraTree.GetNewActiveNodeAfterDeletion(ultraTree.ActiveNode);
			if (ultraTree.HideSelection)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)ultraTree).Invalidate();
			}
			NodeEnumerator nodeEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (nodeEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraTreeNode current = nodeEnumerator.Current;
					parentNodesCollection.Remove(current);
					ultraTree.SelectedNodes.InternalRemove(current);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = nodeEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (newActiveNodeAfterDeletion != null)
			{
				ultraTree.ActiveNode = newActiveNodeAfterDeletion;
				if (ultraTree.ActiveNode == newActiveNodeAfterDeletion)
				{
					newActiveNodeAfterDeletion.BringIntoView();
				}
			}
			((UIElement)ultraTree.UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
			return true;
		}

		private bool CutToClipboardAcrossCollections(UltraTree tree)
		{
			UltraTreeNode newActiveNodeAfterDeletion = tree.GetNewActiveNodeAfterDeletion(tree.ActiveNode);
			if (tree.HideSelection)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)tree).Invalidate();
			}
			int count = Count;
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable(count);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = this[i];
				hashtable.Add(ultraTreeNode, ultraTreeNode);
			}
			SelectedNodesCollection selectedNodes = tree.SelectedNodes;
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode2 = this[j];
				TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection = ultraTreeNode2?.ParentNodesCollection;
				if (treeNodesCollection == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				bool flag = true;
				for (UltraTreeNode parent = ultraTreeNode2.Parent; parent != null; parent = parent.Parent)
				{
					if (hashtable.ContainsKey(parent))
					{
						flag = false;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					treeNodesCollection.Remove(ultraTreeNode2);
				}
				selectedNodes.InternalRemove(ultraTreeNode2);
			}
			if (newActiveNodeAfterDeletion != null)
			{
				tree.ActiveNode = newActiveNodeAfterDeletion;
				if (tree.ActiveNode == newActiveNodeAfterDeletion)
				{
					newActiveNodeAfterDeletion.BringIntoView();
				}
			}
			((UIElement)tree.UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
			return true;
		}

		internal bool CopyToClipboard()
		{
			if (Count < 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection = new TreeNodesCollection(Count);
			treeNodesCollection.AddRangeInternal(this);
			if (ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				treeNodesCollection.Tag = Tag;
			}
			Clipboard.SetDataObject(treeNodesCollection, copy: true);
			return true;
		}

		public virtual object Clone()
		{
			SelectedNodesCollection selectedNodesCollection = new SelectedNodesCollection(cloned: true);
			selectedNodesCollection.CloneContents(this);
			if (ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				selectedNodesCollection.Tag = Tag;
			}
			return selectedNodesCollection;
		}

		public void AddRange(UltraTreeNode[] nodes, bool clearExistingSelection)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_SelectedNodes_AddRange_NotSupported"));
			}
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("nodes");
			}
			int num = nodes.Length;
			int count = Count;
			Dictionary<UltraTreeNode, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<UltraTreeNode, object>(count + num);
			if (!clearExistingSelection)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					dictionary.Add(this[i], null);
				}
			}
			TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection = (control.CanSelectAcrossCollections ? null : ((Count > 0 && !clearExistingSelection) ? this[0].ParentNodesCollection : ((nodes.Length != 0) ? nodes[0].ParentNodesCollection : null)));
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = nodes[j];
				if (ultraTreeNode == null)
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_SelectedNodes_AddRange_ArrayHasNullMember"));
				}
				if (ultraTreeNode.Control != control)
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_SelectedNodes_AddRange_DifferentControl"));
				}
				if (dictionary.ContainsKey(ultraTreeNode) || (treeNodesCollection != null && ultraTreeNode.ParentNodesCollection != treeNodesCollection) || !ultraTreeNode.CanBeSelectedInAddRange)
				{
					nodes[j] = null;
					continue;
				}
				dictionary.Add(nodes[j], null);
				AddToNodeCollectionKeyMap(nodes[j]);
			}
			SelectedNodesCollection selectedNodesCollection = new SelectedNodesCollection(cloned: true);
			if (!clearExistingSelection)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < count; k++)
				{
					UltraTreeNode selectedNode = this[k];
					selectedNodesCollection.InternalAdd(selectedNode);
				}
			}
			for (int l = 0; l < num; l++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode2 = nodes[l];
				if (ultraTreeNode2 != null)
				{
					selectedNodesCollection.InternalAdd(ultraTreeNode2);
				}
			}
			control.SelectNewSelection(selectedNodesCollection, isRangeSelect: true);
		}

		public bool Contains(UltraTreeNode item)
		{
			return NodeCollectionKeyMap.Contains(item);
		}

		private void AddToNodeCollectionKeyMap(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			NodeCollectionKeyMap.Add(node);
		}

		private void RemoveFromNodeCollectionKeyMap(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (NodeCollectionKeyMap.Contains(node))
			{
				NodeCollectionKeyMap.Remove(node);
			}
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	public class SortedColumnsCollection : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase, ISerializable
	{
		public class SortedColumnEnumerator : DisposableObjectEnumeratorBase
		{
			public UltraTreeNodeColumn Current => (UltraTreeNodeColumn)((IEnumerator)this).Current;

			public SortedColumnEnumerator(SortedColumnsCollection sortedColumns)
				: base(sortedColumns)
			{
			}
		}

		private UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet;

		private int sortVersion;

		internal bool inProcessingNewSortedColumns;

		private int initialCapacity = 5;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public UltraTreeColumnSet ColumnSet => columnSet;

		public bool IsFixedSize => false;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => false;

		internal UltraTree Control
		{
			get
			{
				if (columnSet == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return columnSet.Control;
			}
		}

		internal int SortVersion => sortVersion;

		protected override int InitialCapacity => initialCapacity;

		private bool IsClone
		{
			get
			{
				if (columnSet != null && columnSet.SortedColumns == this)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public UltraTreeNodeColumn this[int index] => base.GetItem(index) as UltraTreeNodeColumn;

		public UltraTreeNodeColumn this[string key] => base.GetItem(key) as UltraTreeNodeColumn;

		internal SortedColumnsCollection(UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet)
		{
			this.columnSet = columnSet;
		}

		internal void VerifyColumns()
		{
			for (int num = Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (columnSet.Columns.IndexOf(this[num]) < 0)
				{
					RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		internal int AddHelper(UltraTreeNodeColumn column, bool notify)
		{
			InsertHelper(Count, column, notify: true);
			return Count;
		}

		internal void InsertHelper(int index, UltraTreeNodeColumn column, bool notify)
		{
			if (Contains(column))
			{
				return;
			}
			string key = column.Key;
			if (key == null || key.Length <= 0 || !Exists(key))
			{
				InternalInsert(index, column);
				column.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				if (notify)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SortedColumns);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveHelper(UltraTreeNodeColumn column, bool notify)
		{
			column.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalRemove(column);
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SortedColumns);
			}
		}

		internal void BumpVersion()
		{
			sortVersion++;
		}

		internal new void InternalClear()
		{
			for (int num = Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RemoveHelper(this[num], notify: false);
			}
		}

		internal void InitColumnSet(UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet)
		{
			this.columnSet = columnSet;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = this[i];
				ultraTreeNodeColumn.InitColumnSet(columnSet);
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		protected SortedColumnsCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Value is UltraTreeNodeColumn)
				{
					UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = (UltraTreeNodeColumn)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(UltraTreeNodeColumn), null);
					if (ultraTreeNodeColumn != null)
					{
						InternalAdd(ultraTreeNodeColumn);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(info, "Tag");
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public int Add(UltraTreeNodeColumn column)
		{
			return Add(column, ascending: true);
		}

		public int Add(UltraTreeNodeColumn column, bool ascending)
		{
			if (columnSet == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			SortType sortType = (ascending ? SortType.Ascending : SortType.Descending);
			if (!IsClone)
			{
				columnSet.Sort(column, sortType, columnSet.Control, clearExisting: false);
				return IndexOf(column);
			}
			UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = column.Clone();
			ultraTreeNodeColumn.SetSortType(sortType, notify: false);
			return AddHelper(ultraTreeNodeColumn, notify: false);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, UltraTreeNodeColumn column)
		{
			Insert(index, column, ascending: true);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, UltraTreeNodeColumn column, bool ascending)
		{
			SortType sortType = (ascending ? SortType.Ascending : SortType.Descending);
			if (!IsClone)
			{
				columnSet.Sort(column, sortType, index, columnSet.Control, clearExisting: false);
				return;
			}
			UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = column.Clone();
			ultraTreeNodeColumn.SetSortType(sortType, notify: false);
			InsertHelper(index, column, notify: false);
		}

		public void Remove(UltraTreeNodeColumn column)
		{
			if (!IsClone)
			{
				column.SetSortType(SortType.None, notify: true);
				return;
			}
			UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = column.Clone();
			ultraTreeNodeColumn.SetSortType(SortType.None, notify: false);
			RemoveHelper(column, notify: false);
		}

		public void Remove(int index)
		{
			Remove(this[index]);
		}

		public void Remove(string key)
		{
			Remove(this[key]);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			Remove(this[index]);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int num = Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				bool isClone = IsClone;
				this[num].SetSortType(SortType.None, !isClone);
				RemoveHelper(this[num], notify: false);
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SortedColumns);
		}

		public void RefreshSort()
		{
			BumpVersion();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SortedColumns);
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (Count <= 0)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTag();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(SortedColumnsCollection source)
		{
			if (source == null || columnSet == null || this != columnSet.SortedColumns)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (source.Count == 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					this[i].SetSortType(SortType.None, notify: true);
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
			for (int j = 0; j < source.Count; j++)
			{
				UltraTreeNodeColumn clonedFromColumn = source[j].ClonedFromColumn;
				if (clonedFromColumn != null)
				{
					InternalAdd(clonedFromColumn);
					clonedFromColumn.SetSortType(source[j].SortType, notify: true);
					continue;
				}
				UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = source[j];
				bool flag = false;
				for (int k = 0; k < columnSet.Columns.Count; k++)
				{
					UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn2 = columnSet.Columns[k];
					if (ultraTreeNodeColumn == ultraTreeNodeColumn2)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					InternalAdd(ultraTreeNodeColumn);
				}
			}
		}

		internal SortedColumnsCollection Clone()
		{
			SortedColumnsCollection sortedColumnsCollection = new SortedColumnsCollection(ColumnSet);
			sortedColumnsCollection.InitColumnSet(ColumnSet);
			sortedColumnsCollection.Tag = Tag;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = this[i].Clone();
				sortedColumnsCollection.InternalAdd(ultraTreeNodeColumn);
				ultraTreeNodeColumn.InitColumnSet(sortedColumnsCollection.ColumnSet);
			}
			return sortedColumnsCollection;
		}
	}
