	internal class CellMouseDownInfo
	{
		private MouseEventArgs mouseEventArgs;

		private UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement cellElement;

		private bool pointInEditArea;

		private bool pointInButtonArea;

		private bool eatMessage;

		private bool notifyParentElement;

		internal MouseEventArgs MouseEventArgs => mouseEventArgs;

		internal UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement CellElement => cellElement;

		internal bool PointInEditArea => pointInEditArea;

		internal bool PointInButtonArea => pointInButtonArea;

		internal bool EatMessage
		{
			get
			{
				return eatMessage;
			}
			set
			{
				eatMessage = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool NotifyParentElement
		{
			get
			{
				return notifyParentElement;
			}
			set
			{
				notifyParentElement = value;
			}
		}

		internal CellMouseDownInfo(EmbeddableMouseDownEventArgs e, bool pointInEditArea)
		{
			cellElement = ((UIElement)((EmbeddableClickEventArgs)e).EmbeddableElement).GetAncestor(typeof(UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement)) as UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement;
			mouseEventArgs = ((EmbeddableMouseEventArgs)e).MouseArgs;
			pointInButtonArea = ((EmbeddableClickEventArgs)e).IsButton;
			this.pointInEditArea = pointInEditArea;
			eatMessage = e.EatMessage;
		}

		internal CellMouseDownInfo(MouseEventArgs e, UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement cellElement, bool pointInEditArea)
		{
			this.cellElement = cellElement;
			mouseEventArgs = e;
			pointInButtonArea = false;
			this.pointInEditArea = pointInEditArea;
		}
	}
	[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.InheritanceDemand, Name = "FullTrust")]
	[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "FullTrust")]
	public class TreeNodeEditor : UITypeEditor
	{
		private IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc;

		public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return UITypeEditorEditStyle.Modal;
		}

		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
		{
			if (!(value is TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (treeNodesCollection.Control.BoundRootDescendantCount > 0)
			{
				IUIService iUIService = ((provider == null) ? null : (provider.GetService(typeof(IUIService)) as IUIService));
				IWin32Window win32Window;
				if (iUIService != null)
				{
					win32Window = iUIService.GetDialogOwnerWindow();
				}
				else
				{
					IWin32Window control = (IWin32Window)treeNodesCollection.Control;
					win32Window = control;
				}
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show(win32Window, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NodesCollectionEditor_CannotModifyNodes"), "Infragistics UltraWinTree", MessageBoxButtons.OK);
				return value;
			}
			edSvc = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
			NodePropertyEditor nodePropertyEditor = new NodePropertyEditor(((TreeNodesCollection)value).Control);
			edSvc.ShowDialog(nodePropertyEditor);
			nodePropertyEditor.Dispose();
			return value;
		}
	}
	public class NodeEnumerator : DisposableObjectEnumeratorBase
	{
		public UltraTreeNode Current => (UltraTreeNode)((IEnumerator)this).Current;

		internal NodeEnumerator(TreeNodesCollection nodes)
			: base(nodes)
		{
			nodes?.VerifyBoundNodes();
		}

		internal NodeEnumerator(SelectedNodesCollection nodes)
			: base(nodes)
		{
		}
	}
	internal class TreeUtils
	{
		internal static bool IsControlKeyDown => (Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) == Keys.Control;

		internal static bool HasChapteredColumns(PropertyDescriptorCollection props)
		{
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor prop in props)
			{
				if (IsChaptered(prop))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool HasNonChapteredColumns(PropertyDescriptorCollection props)
		{
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor prop in props)
			{
				if (!IsChaptered(prop))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsChaptered(PropertyDescriptor prop)
		{
			if (typeof(IList).IsAssignableFrom(prop.PropertyType))
			{
				return !typeof(Array).IsAssignableFrom(prop.PropertyType);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static UltraTreeColumnSet GenerateColumnSet(PropertyDescriptorCollection props)
		{
			UltraTreeColumnSet ultraTreeColumnSet = new UltraTreeColumnSet(isAutoGenerated: true);
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor prop in props)
			{
				UltraTreeNodeColumn column = GenerateColumn(prop);
				ultraTreeColumnSet.Columns.Add(column);
			}
			return ultraTreeColumnSet;
		}

		internal static UltraTreeNodeColumn GenerateColumn(PropertyDescriptor prop)
		{
			return GenerateColumn(prop, null);
		}

		internal static UltraTreeNodeColumn GenerateColumn(PropertyDescriptor prop, UltraTreeNodeColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				column = new UltraTreeNodeColumn(prop.Name);
			}
			else
			{
				column.Key = prop.Name;
			}
			column.DataType = prop.PropertyType;
			if (IsChaptered(prop))
			{
				column.IsChaptered = true;
			}
			return column;
		}

		internal static object GetObjectForRowComparision(object listObject)
		{
			if (listObject is DataRowView dataRowView)
			{
				return dataRowView.Row;
			}
			return listObject;
		}

		internal static bool FocusControl(Control control)
		{
			try
			{
				return control.Focus();
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				try
				{
					if (control.CanFocus)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.SetFocusApi(control.Handle);
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
			return control.Focused;
		}

		internal static void SetCursorPosition(Point screenPosition)
		{
			try
			{
				Cursor.Position = screenPosition;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				try
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.SetCursorPosApi(screenPosition);
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}

		internal static Control GetParent(Control control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				return control.Parent;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static ToggleState GetToggleState(CheckState checkState)
		{
			return checkState switch
			{
				CheckState.Checked => ToggleState.On, 
				CheckState.Indeterminate => ToggleState.Indeterminate, 
				CheckState.Unchecked => ToggleState.Off, 
				_ => ToggleState.Off, 
			};
		}

		internal static bool ShouldResolve(AppearancePropFlags property, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags flags, bool stripBit = true)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Expected I8, but got Unknown
			if ((AppearancePropFlags)(property & flags) == property && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet(property))
			{
				if (stripBit)
				{
					flags = (AppearancePropFlags)(long)(flags & ~property);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsEnumFlags(Type enumType)
		{
			object[] customAttributes = enumType.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(FlagsAttribute), inherit: true);
			if (customAttributes != null)
			{
				return customAttributes.Length != 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static void ValidateEnum(Type enumType, object enumVal)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(enumType, enumVal) && !IsEnumFlags(enumType))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(enumType.Name, (int)enumVal, enumType);
			}
		}

		internal static void ValidateEnum(string argumentName, Type enumType, object enumVal)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(enumType, enumVal) && !IsEnumFlags(enumType))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(argumentName, (int)enumVal, enumType);
			}
		}

		internal static Graphics GetCachedGraphics(UltraTree tree)
		{
			if (tree == null)
			{
				return DrawUtility.GetCachedGraphics((Control)(object)tree);
			}
			return tree.GetCachedGraphics();
		}

		internal static void ReleaseCachedGraphics(UltraTree tree, Graphics gr)
		{
			if (tree != null)
			{
				tree.ReleaseCachedGraphics(gr);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawUtility.ReleaseCachedGraphics(gr);
			}
		}

		protected class TreeAccessibleObject : UltraControlAccessibleObject
		{
			private UltraTree tree;

			public override Rectangle Bounds => ((AccessibleObject)this).Bounds;

			public override AccessibleRole Role
			{
				get
				{
					if (((Control)(object)tree).AccessibleRole != AccessibleRole.Default)
					{
						return ((Control.ControlAccessibleObject)this).Role;
					}
					return AccessibleRole.Outline;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					if (!((Control)(object)tree).Enabled)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Unavailable;
					}
					else if (((Control)(object)tree).Visible)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focusable;
						if (((Control)(object)tree).ContainsFocus)
						{
							accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focused;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					if (((AccessibleObject)(object)this).Bounds.IsEmpty)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Offscreen;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public UltraTree Tree => tree;

			public TreeAccessibleObject(UltraTree tree)
				: base((Control)(object)tree)
			{
				this.tree = tree;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (index < 0 || index >= ((AccessibleObject)(object)this).GetChildCount())
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (index < tree.VisibleNodesArray.Count)
				{
					if (!(tree.VisibleNodesArray[index] is UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return ultraTreeNode.AccessibilityObject;
				}
				index -= tree.VisibleNodesArray.Count;
				if (tree.ActiveCell != null)
				{
					if (index == 0)
					{
						return tree.ActiveCell.AccessibilityObject;
					}
					index--;
				}
				if (index < ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetChildCount())
				{
					return ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetChild(index);
				}
				index -= ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetChildCount();
				if (((IScrollableControl)tree).IsScrollShown(ScrollBarType.horizontal))
				{
					switch (index)
					{
					case 0:
					{
						HorizontalScrollbarUIElement horizontalScrollbarUIElement = (HorizontalScrollbarUIElement)(object)((UIElement)tree.UIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(HorizontalScrollbarUIElement));
						if (horizontalScrollbarUIElement == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						return ((UIElement)horizontalScrollbarUIElement).AccessibilityInstance;
					}
					case 1:
						if (((IScrollableControl)tree).IsScrollShown(ScrollBarType.vertical))
						{
							VerticalScrollbarUIElement verticalScrollbarUIElement = (VerticalScrollbarUIElement)(object)((UIElement)tree.UIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(VerticalScrollbarUIElement));
							if (verticalScrollbarUIElement == null)
							{
								return null;
							}
							return ((UIElement)verticalScrollbarUIElement).AccessibilityInstance;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (((IScrollableControl)tree).IsScrollShown(ScrollBarType.vertical) && index == 0)
				{
					VerticalScrollbarUIElement verticalScrollbarUIElement2 = (VerticalScrollbarUIElement)(object)((UIElement)tree.UIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(VerticalScrollbarUIElement));
					if (verticalScrollbarUIElement2 == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return ((UIElement)verticalScrollbarUIElement2).AccessibilityInstance;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				return tree.VisibleNodesArray.Count + ((tree.ActiveCell != null) ? 1 : 0) + ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetChildCount() + (((IScrollableControl)tree).IsScrollShown(ScrollBarType.horizontal) ? 1 : 0) + (((IScrollableControl)tree).IsScrollShown(ScrollBarType.vertical) ? 1 : 0);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				if (((Control)(object)Tree).Focused)
				{
					if (tree.ActiveNode != null)
					{
						return tree.ActiveNode.AccessibilityObject.GetFocused();
					}
					return (AccessibleObject)(object)this;
				}
				return ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetFocusedChildControl();
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				if (tree.ActiveNode != null)
				{
					return tree.ActiveNode.AccessibilityObject;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject HitTest(int x, int y)
			{
				AccessibleObject childControlAccessibleObject = ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetChildControlAccessibleObject(x, y);
				if (childControlAccessibleObject != null)
				{
					return childControlAccessibleObject;
				}
				UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)tree.UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return uIElement.HitTest(x, y);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObject)this).Navigate(navdir);
			}
		}

		internal class UltraTreeGridBagLayoutDragManager
		{
			private UltraTree ultraTree;

			private GridBagLayoutDragStrategy dragStrategy;

			internal bool IsInSpanResizeMode
			{
				get
				{
					if (((ITreeDesignInfo)ultraTree).ForceSpanResizeMode)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return TreeUtils.IsControlKeyDown;
				}
			}

			internal UltraTreeGridBagLayoutDragManager(UltraTree ultraTree)
			{
				this.ultraTree = ultraTree;
			}

			private bool CreateDragStrategy(UltraTreeNodeColumn column, UltraTreeNodeColumnDragManager.DragType dragType)
			{
				//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_003c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_004c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0074: Expected O, but got Unknown
				UltraTreeColumnSet columnSet = column.ColumnSet;
				if (columnSet == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (dragType)
				{
				case UltraTreeNodeColumnDragManager.DragType.HeaderReposition:
					if ((int)columnSet.SettingsResolved.AllowColMoving == 1)
					{
						return false;
					}
					break;
				case UltraTreeNodeColumnDragManager.DragType.HeaderSpanResize:
					if ((int)columnSet.SettingsResolved.AllowLabelSpanSizing == 1)
					{
						return false;
					}
					break;
				case UltraTreeNodeColumnDragManager.DragType.CellSpanResize:
					if ((int)columnSet.SettingsResolved.AllowCellSpanSizing == 1)
					{
						return false;
					}
					break;
				}
				UltraTreeNodeColumnDragManager ultraTreeNodeColumnDragManager = new UltraTreeNodeColumnDragManager(column, dragType);
				UltraTree control = ultraTreeNodeColumnDragManager.Control;
				if (control == null || control != ultraTree)
				{
					return false;
				}
				GridBagLayoutDragStrategy val = new GridBagLayoutDragStrategy((IGridBagLayoutDragManager)(object)ultraTreeNodeColumnDragManager);
				dragStrategy = val;
				return true;
			}

			internal void ResetDragStrategy()
			{
				if (dragStrategy != null)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)dragStrategy).Dispose();
					dragStrategy = null;
				}
			}

			internal GridBagLayoutDragStrategy GetDragStrategy(UltraTreeNodeColumnDragManager dragManager)
			{
				//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0014: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (dragStrategy == null)
				{
					dragStrategy = new GridBagLayoutDragStrategy((IGridBagLayoutDragManager)(object)dragManager);
				}
				_ = dragStrategy.GridBagLayoutDragManager;
				return dragStrategy;
			}

			internal bool ColumnRepositionDragStart(UltraTreeNodeColumn column, Point cursorPos)
			{
				ResetDragStrategy();
				if (!CreateDragStrategy(column, UltraTreeNodeColumnDragManager.DragType.HeaderReposition))
				{
					return false;
				}
				UltraTreeNodeColumnDragManager ultraTreeNodeColumnDragManager = dragStrategy.GridBagLayoutDragManager as UltraTreeNodeColumnDragManager;
				IGridBagLayoutDragManager val = (IGridBagLayoutDragManager)(object)ultraTreeNodeColumnDragManager;
				UIElement[] layoutItemElementsFromPoint = val.GetLayoutItemElementsFromPoint(cursorPos);
				if (layoutItemElementsFromPoint != null)
				{
					Point mouseOffSet = ultraTreeNodeColumnDragManager.GetMouseOffSet(layoutItemElementsFromPoint, cursorPos);
					return dragStrategy.DragStart(layoutItemElementsFromPoint, mouseOffSet);
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal void ColumnRepositionDragMove(Point clientPos)
			{
				if (dragStrategy != null)
				{
					dragStrategy.DragMove(clientPos);
				}
			}

			internal bool ColumnRepositionDragEnd(Point clientPoint)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (dragStrategy != null)
				{
					flag = dragStrategy.DragEnd(clientPoint);
				}

		internal bool IsVerticalScrollShown
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsPrint)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (ScrollableResolved)
				{
				case Scrollbar.Show:
				case Scrollbar.ShowVertical:
					return true;
				case Scrollbar.Hide:
					return false;
				case Scrollbar.ShowIfNeeded:
				case Scrollbar.ShowVerticalIfNeeded:
					if (!AllVisibleNodesAreInView)
					{
						return true;
					}
					break;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsHorizontalScrollShown
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsPrint)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!IsViewStyleStandard && ColumnSettings.SettingsResolved.AutoFitColumns)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (ScrollableResolved)
				{
				case Scrollbar.Show:
					return true;
				case Scrollbar.Hide:
				case Scrollbar.ShowVertical:
				case Scrollbar.ShowVerticalIfNeeded:
					return false;
				case Scrollbar.ShowIfNeeded:
				{
					int num = 0;
					if (IsVerticalScrollShown)
					{
						num = ScrollbarControl.VScrollRect.Width;
					}
					if (RightMostNodePosition + num >= ((IScrollableControl)this).RectInsideBorders.Width)
					{
						return true;
					}
					break;
				}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		Rectangle IScrollableControl.RectInsideBorders
		{
			get
			{
				Rectangle rectangle = ((UIElement)UIElement).RectInsideBorders;
				if (!UIElement.ControlElementRectIsScaledDown)
				{
					rectangle = Utilities.GetRectangleForZoomFactor(rectangle, ((UltraControlBase)this).ZoomFactor, true);
				}
				if (rectangle.Height > 0 && rectangle.Width > 0)
				{
					return rectangle;
				}
				return ((Control)this).Bounds;
			}
		}

		private bool CanScrollDown
		{
			get
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = TopNode;
				if (ultraTreeNode == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ultraTreeNode.VisibleIndex < VisibleNodesManager.MaxTopNodeVisibleIndex;
			}
		}

		internal int AverageNodeHeight
		{
			get
			{
				if (VisibleNodesArray.Count == 0)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return VisibleNodesManager.ScrollSize.Height / VisibleNodesArray.Count;
			}
		}

		Control IScrollableControl.Control => (Control)(object)this;

		internal int VScrollOriginOffSet
		{
			get
			{
				ArrayList visibleNodesArray = VisibleNodesArray;
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ((visibleNodesArray.Count > 0) ? (visibleNodesArray[0] as UltraTreeNode) : null);
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode2 = TopNode;
				if (ultraTreeNode == null || ultraTreeNode2 == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return ultraTreeNode2.Bounds.Top - ultraTreeNode.Bounds.Top;
			}
		}

		internal UltraTreeNode InternalTopNode
		{
			get
			{
				if (topNode == null && VisibleNodesArray.Count > 0)
				{
					topNode = VisibleNodesArray[0] as UltraTreeNode;
				}
				return topNode;
			}
			set
			{
				topNode = value;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public UltraTreeNode TopNode
		{
			get
			{
				return InternalTopNode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null && !value.VisibleResolved)
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraTree_Exception_CannotSetTopNodeToHiddenNode"));
				}
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = value;
				while (ultraTreeNode != null && ultraTreeNode.Parent != null)
				{
					if (ultraTreeNode.Parent.Expanded)
					{
						ultraTreeNode = ultraTreeNode.Parent;
						continue;
					}
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_32"));
				}
				if (value != InternalTopNode)
				{
					if (value != null && !IsScrollingVertically)
					{
						ScrollbarControl.VScrollPosition = value.VisibleIndex;
					}
					topNode = value;
					VisibleNodesManager.VerifyScrollBoundsForTopNode(ScrollBoundsResolved, scrollToTopNodeInScrollToFill: true);
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.TopNode);
				}
			}
		}

		internal UltraTreeNode BottomVisibleNode
		{
			get
			{
				int itemHeightResolvedWithSpacing = TopNode.ItemHeightResolvedWithSpacing;
				if (itemHeightResolvedWithSpacing >= ViewableArea.Height)
				{
					return TopNode;
				}
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = TopNode;
				int num = ViewableArea.Top + itemHeightResolvedWithSpacing;
				for (int i = TopNode.VisibleIndex + 1; i < VisibleNodesArray.Count; i++)
				{
					ultraTreeNode = VisibleNodesArray[i] as UltraTreeNode;
					num += ultraTreeNode.ItemHeightResolvedWithSpacing;
					if (num > ViewableArea.Bottom)
					{
						return VisibleNodesArray[i - 1] as UltraTreeNode;
					}
				}
				return ultraTreeNode;
			}
		}

		internal UltraTreeNode LastVisibleNode
		{
			get
			{
				UltraTreeNode result = null;
				if (VisibleNodesArray != null && VisibleNodesArray.Count > 0)
				{
					result = (UltraTreeNode)VisibleNodesArray[VisibleNodesArray.Count - 1];
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal UltraTreeNode FirstVisibleNode
		{
			get
			{
				if (VisibleNodesArray != null && VisibleNodesArray.Count > 0)
				{
					return (UltraTreeNode)VisibleNodesArray[0];
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public UltraTreeState CurrentState
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0042: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				int num = 0;
				if (ActiveNode == null)
				{
					if (nodes != null)
					{
						if (nodes.HasOverride && nodes.Override.ShouldSerializeAllowPaste())
						{
							if ((int)nodes.Override.AllowPaste == 1)
							{
								num |= 0x1000;
							}
						}
						else if (AllowPasteResolved)
						{
							num |= 0x1000;
						}
					}
					return (UltraTreeState)num;
				}
				if (ActiveNode.IsEditing)
				{
					num |= 1;
				}
				bool hasNodes = ActiveNode.HasNodes;
				if (ActiveNode.Expanded && hasNodes)
				{
					num |= 0x40;
				}
				if (ActiveNode.Expanded && ActiveNode.ShowExpansionIndicatorResolved != ShowExpansionIndicator.Never)
				{
					num |= 0x40;
				}
				if (ActiveNode.Parent != null)
				{
					num |= 0x10;
				}
				if (ActiveNode.VisibleIndex == 0)
				{
					num |= 4;
				}
				if (hasNodes && !ActiveNode.Expanded)
				{
					num |= 0x20;
				}
				if (!ActiveNode.Expanded && ActiveNode.ShowExpansionIndicatorResolved != ShowExpansionIndicator.Never)
				{
					num |= 0x20;
				}
				if (!hasNodes || ActiveNode.Expanded)
				{
					num |= 0x80;
				}
				if (hasNodes)
				{
					num |= 0x100;
				}
				if (ActiveNode.IsStyleCheckBox)
				{
					num |= 2;
				}
				if (ActiveNode.IsStyleOptionButton)
				{
					num |= 0x200;
				}
				if (ActiveNode.AllowPasteResolved)
				{
					num |= 0x1000;
				}
				if (selectedNodes != null)
				{
					int count = selectedNodes.Count;
					for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
					{
						if (selectedNodes[i].AllowCopyResolved)
						{
							num |= 0x800;
							break;
						}
					}
					for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
					{
						if (selectedNodes[j].AllowCutResolved)
						{
							num |= 0x400;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (HasActiveCell)
				{
					num |= 0x2000;
					if (IsCellInEditMode)
					{
						num |= 0x4000;
					}
					CellNavigator cellNavigator = new CellNavigator(ActiveNode);
					if (cellNavigator.IsFirstCellInNodeActive)
					{
						num |= 0x8000;
					}
					if (cellNavigator.IsLastCellInNodeActive)
					{
						num |= 0x10000;
					}
					CellPosition activeCellPosition = cellNavigator.ActiveCellPosition;
					if ((activeCellPosition & CellPosition.InFirstLogicalColumn) == CellPosition.InFirstLogicalColumn)
					{
						num |= 0x400000;
					}
					if ((activeCellPosition & CellPosition.InLastLogicalColumn) == CellPosition.InLastLogicalColumn)
					{
						num |= 0x800000;
					}
					if ((activeCellPosition & CellPosition.OnFirstLogicalRow) == CellPosition.OnFirstLogicalRow)
					{
						num |= 0x200000;
					}
					if ((activeCellPosition & CellPosition.OnLastLogicalRow) == CellPosition.OnLastLogicalRow)
					{
						num |= 0x100000;
					}
					switch (ColumnSettings.SettingsResolved.TabNavigation)
					{
					case TabNavigation.NextControl:
						num |= 0x8000000;
						break;
					case TabNavigation.NextCell:
						num |= 0x4000000;
						break;
					}
				}
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ActiveNode;
				if (ultraTreeNode != null)
				{
					UltraTreeNode firstActivateableNodeInTree = GetFirstActivateableNodeInTree(mustDisplayCells: false);
					UltraTreeNode lastActivateableNodeInTree = GetLastActivateableNodeInTree(mustDisplayCells: false);
					if (firstActivateableNodeInTree != null && firstActivateableNodeInTree.IsActive)
					{
						num |= 0x1000000;
					}
					if (lastActivateableNodeInTree != null && lastActivateableNodeInTree.IsActive)
					{
						num |= 0x2000000;
					}
					if (ultraTreeNode.DisplaysCells)
					{
						num |= 0x10000000;
					}
					UltraTreeNode prevVisibleNode = ultraTreeNode.GetPrevVisibleNode(disregardEnabledStatus: false);
					if (prevVisibleNode == null || prevVisibleNode.DisplaysCells)
					{
						num |= 0x40000;
					}
					UltraTreeNode nextVisibleNode = ultraTreeNode.GetNextVisibleNode(disregardEnabledStatus: false);
					if (nextVisibleNode == null || nextVisibleNode.DisplaysCells)
					{
						num |= 0x80000;
					}
					if (ultraTreeNode.HasCellChanges)
					{
						num |= 0x20000;
					}
				}
				if (!DrawsFocusRectResolved)
				{
					num |= 0x20000000;
				}
				return (UltraTreeState)num;
			}
		}

		internal bool InEndEdit => inEndEdit;

		internal int NextHandle
		{
			get
			{
				Monitor.Enter(typeof(UltraTree));
				try
				{
					nextHandle++;
					return nextHandle;
				}
				finally
				{
					Monitor.Exit(typeof(UltraTree));
				}
			}
		}

		internal Rectangle ViewableArea
		{
			get
			{
				Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((IScrollableControl)this).RectInsideBorders;
				if (!ColumnSettings.SettingsResolved.AutoFitColumns)
				{
					rectInsideBorders.Height -= ScrollbarControl.HScrollRect.Height;
				}
				rectInsideBorders.Width -= ScrollbarControl.VScrollRect.Width;
				if (ColumnSettings.SettingsResolved.HasSeparateHeaderAreaInOutlookExpressViewStyle && ColumnSettings.OutlookExpressDisplayColumnSet != null)
				{
					int height = ColumnSettings.OutlookExpressDisplayColumnSet.LayoutManager.HeaderAreaSize.Height;
					rectInsideBorders.Height -= height;
					rectInsideBorders.Y += height;
				}
				return rectInsideBorders;
			}
		}

			{
				//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0029: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (scrollbarLook == null || ((DisposableObject)(object)scrollbarLook).Disposed)
				{
					scrollbarLook = new ScrollBarLook(Appearances);
					if (scrollbarControl != null)

						if (ScrollbarControl.HorizontalScroll != null)

						scrollbarLook.InitializeAppearances(Appearances);

			{

					return;
				}
				if (scrollbarLook != null)
				{
					((SubObjectBase)(object)scrollbarLook).SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				scrollbarLook = value;
				if (scrollbarControl != null)
				{
					if (ScrollbarControl.VerticalScroll != null)
					{
						ScrollbarControl.VerticalScroll.ScrollBarLook = scrollbarLook;
					}
					if (ScrollbarControl.HorizontalScroll != null)
					{
						ScrollbarControl.HorizontalScroll.ScrollBarLook = scrollbarLook;
					}
				}
				if (scrollbarLook != null)
				{
					((SubObjectBase)(object)scrollbarLook).SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					scrollbarLook.InitializeAppearances(Appearances);
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.ScrollBarLook, (PropChangeInfo)null);
			}
		}

		internal ToolTip ToolTip
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0014: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (toolTip == null)
				{
					toolTip = new ToolTip((Control)(object)this);
					toolTip.AutoPopDelay = 5000;
					toolTip.InitialDelay = 0;
					toolTip.TopMost = false;
					toolTip.RightMargin = 2;

				switch (DisplayStyleResolved)
				{
				case UltraTreeDisplayStyle.Standard:
					toolTip.DisplayStyle = (ToolTipDisplayStyle)1;
					toolTip.DisplayShadow = false;

				case UltraTreeDisplayStyle.WindowsVista:

					toolTip.DisplayShadow = true;
					break;
				default:
					toolTip.DisplayStyle = (ToolTipDisplayStyle)1;
					toolTip.DisplayShadow = false;
					break;
				}
				return toolTip;
			}
		}

		internal bool AllVisibleNodesAreInView
		{
			get
			{
				if (VisibleNodesArray.Count < 2)
				{
					return true;
				}
				Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((IScrollableControl)this).RectInsideBorders;
				if (ColumnSettings.SettingsResolved.HasSeparateHeaderAreaInOutlookExpressViewStyle)
				{
					UltraTreeColumnSet outlookExpressDisplayColumnSet = ColumnSettings.OutlookExpressDisplayColumnSet;
					if (outlookExpressDisplayColumnSet != null)
					{
						int height = outlookExpressDisplayColumnSet.LayoutManager.HeaderAreaSize.Height;
						rectInsideBorders.Height -= height;
						rectInsideBorders.Y += height;
					}
				}
				Size scrollSize = VisibleNodesManager.ScrollSize;
				if (rectInsideBorders.Height < scrollSize.Height)
				{
					return false;
				}
				GetScrollBarExtents(out var vertical, out var horizontal);
				if (rectInsideBorders.Height - horizontal > scrollSize.Height)
				{
					return true;
				}
				switch (ScrollableResolved)
				{
				case Scrollbar.Show:
					return false;
				case Scrollbar.Hide:
				case Scrollbar.ShowVertical:
				case Scrollbar.ShowVerticalIfNeeded:
					return true;
				case Scrollbar.ShowIfNeeded:
					if (rectInsideBorders.Width - vertical > scrollSize.Width)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool HasUnmanagedCodeRights
		{
			get
			{
				try
				{
					SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						securityPermission.Assert();
					}
					securityPermission.Demand();
					return true;
				}
				catch
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal UltraTreeNode TopRootNode
		{
			get
			{
				if (TopNode != null && TopNode.Level == 0)
				{
					return TopNode;
				}
				for (UltraTreeNode parent = TopNode.Parent; parent != null; parent = parent.Parent)
				{
					if (parent.Level == 0)
					{
						return parent;
					}
				}
				return TopNode;
			}
		}

		public ViewStyle ViewStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return viewStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == viewStyle)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ViewStyle), value))
				{
					throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("ViewStyle", (int)value, typeof(ViewStyle));
				}
				viewStyle = value;
				BumpMetricsVersion();
				DirtyBorderStyleNodeVersion();
				if (ScrollBoundsResolved == ScrollBounds.ScrollToFill)
				{
					VisibleNodesManager.IsDirty = true;
					ScrollbarControl.SetVScrollbarDirty(dirty: true);
					VisibleNodesManager.VerifyScrollBoundsForTopNode();
					if (UIElement != null)
					{
						((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements(false);
						((UIElement)UIElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
					}
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.ViewStyle);
			}
		}

		internal HideExpansionIndicators HideExpansionIndicatorsResolved
		{
			get
			{
				HideExpansionIndicators hideExpansionIndicators;
				switch (HideExpansionIndicators)
				{
				case HideExpansionIndicators.Never:
				case HideExpansionIndicators.OnLostFocus:
				case HideExpansionIndicators.OnMouseLeave:
				case HideExpansionIndicators.OnLostFocusAndNotMouseOver:
					hideExpansionIndicators = HideExpansionIndicators;
					break;
				default:
					hideExpansionIndicators = DisplayStyleResolved switch
					{
						UltraTreeDisplayStyle.Standard => HideExpansionIndicators.Never, 
						UltraTreeDisplayStyle.WindowsVista => AreTouchMetricsEnabled ? HideExpansionIndicators.Never : HideExpansionIndicators.OnLostFocusAndNotMouseOver, 
						_ => HideExpansionIndicators.Never, 
					};
					break;
				}
				UltraTreeRole ultraTreeRole = ((UltraControlBase)this).ComponentRole as UltraTreeRole;
				if (ultraTreeRole.GetPropertyValue(UltraTreeApplicationStylingCustomProperty.HideExpansionIndicators, hideExpansionIndicators) is HideExpansionIndicators hideExpansionIndicators2)
				{
					switch (hideExpansionIndicators2)
					{
					case HideExpansionIndicators.Never:
					case HideExpansionIndicators.OnLostFocus:
					case HideExpansionIndicators.OnMouseLeave:
					case HideExpansionIndicators.OnLostFocusAndNotMouseOver:
						return hideExpansionIndicators2;
					}
				}
				return HideExpansionIndicators.Never;
			}
		}

		private Scrollbar ScrollableResolved
		{
			get
			{
				switch (Scrollable)
				{
				case Scrollbar.Show:
				case Scrollbar.Hide:
				case Scrollbar.ShowIfNeeded:
				case Scrollbar.ShowVertical:
				case Scrollbar.ShowVerticalIfNeeded:
					return Scrollable;
				case Scrollbar.Default:
					switch (DisplayStyleResolved)
					{
					case UltraTreeDisplayStyle.WindowsVista:
						switch (ViewStyleResolved)
						{
						case ViewStyle.OutlookExpress:
						case ViewStyle.Grid:
						case ViewStyle.FreeForm:
							return Scrollbar.ShowIfNeeded;
						case ViewStyle.Standard:
							return Scrollbar.ShowVerticalIfNeeded;
						}
						break;
					case UltraTreeDisplayStyle.Standard:
						return Scrollbar.ShowIfNeeded;
					}
					break;
				}
				return Scrollbar.ShowIfNeeded;
			}
		}

		public void LoadFromXml(Stream stream)
		{
			LoadFromXmlHelper(stream);
		}

		public void LoadFromXml(string filename)
		{
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(filename, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			try
			{
				LoadFromXmlHelper(fileStream);
			}
			finally
			{
				fileStream.Close();
			}
		}

		private void LoadFromXmlHelper(Stream stream)
		{
			SoapFormatter soapFormatter = new SoapFormatter();
			soapFormatter.AssemblyFormat = FormatterAssemblyStyle.Simple;
			IFormatter formatter = soapFormatter;
			LoadHelper(stream, formatter);
		}

		public void SaveAsXml(Stream stream)
		{
			SaveAsXmlHelper(stream);
		}

		public void SaveAsXml(string filename)
		{
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(filename, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write);
			try
			{
				SaveAsXmlHelper(fileStream);
			}
			finally
			{
				fileStream.Close();
			}
		}

		private void SaveAsXmlHelper(Stream stream)
		{
			UltraTreeStreamer ultraTreeStreamer = new UltraTreeStreamer(this);
			StreamingContext context = new StreamingContext(StreamingContextStates.Persistence, ultraTreeStreamer);
			SoapFormatter soapFormatter = new SoapFormatter(null, context);
			soapFormatter.AssemblyFormat = FormatterAssemblyStyle.Simple;
			IFormatter formatter = soapFormatter;
			SaveHelper(stream, ultraTreeStreamer, formatter);
		}

		private bool LoadComponentSettingsFromXml()
		{
			bool result = false;
			string xmlData = Settings.XmlData;
			if (xmlData != null && xmlData.Length != 0)
			{
				using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(memoryStream);
				streamWriter.Write(xmlData);
				streamWriter.Flush();
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				try
				{
					LoadFromXml(memoryStream);
					result = true;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void FireEvent(TreeEventIds id, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (Initializing || !EventManager.CanFireEvent(id) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(TreeEventIds), id))
			{
				return;
			}
			EventManager.IncrementInProgress(id);
			try
			{
				switch (id)
				{
				case TreeEventIds.AfterActivate:
					OnAfterActivate((NodeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterCheck:
					OnAfterCheck((NodeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterCollapse:
					OnAfterCollapse((NodeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterCopy:
					OnAfterCopy((AfterCopyEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterCut:
					OnAfterCut((AfterCutEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterDelete:
					OnAfterDelete(e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterExpand:
					OnAfterExpand((NodeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterLabelEdit:
					OnAfterLabelEdit((NodeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterPaste:
					OnAfterPaste((AfterPasteEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterSelect:
					OnAfterSelect((SelectEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeActivate:
					OnBeforeActivate((CancelableNodeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeCheck:
					OnBeforeCheck((BeforeCheckEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeCollapse:
					OnBeforeCollapse((CancelableNodeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeCopy:
					OnBeforeCopy((BeforeCopyEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeCut:
					OnBeforeCut((BeforeCutEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeDelete:
					OnBeforeDelete((BeforeNodesDeletedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeExpand:
					OnBeforeExpand((CancelableNodeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeLabelEdit:
					OnBeforeLabelEdit((CancelableNodeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforePaste:
					OnBeforePaste((BeforePasteEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeSelect:
					OnBeforeSelect((BeforeSelectEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.PasteError:
					OnPasteError((PasteErrorEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.SelectionDragStart:
					OnSelectionDragStart();
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.ValidateLabelEdit:
					OnValidateLabelEdit((ValidateLabelEditEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.Scroll:
					OnScroll((TreeScrollEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterNodeLayoutItemResize:
					OnAfterNodeLayoutItemResize((AfterNodeLayoutItemResizeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterSortChange:
					OnAfterSortChange((AfterSortChangeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeNodeLayoutItemResize:
					OnBeforeNodeLayoutItemResize((BeforeNodeLayoutItemResizeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeSortChange:
					OnBeforeSortChange((BeforeSortChangeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.InitializeDataNode:
					OnInitializeDataNode((InitializeDataNodeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeDataNodesCollectionPopulated:
					OnBeforeDataNodesCollectionPopulated((BeforeDataNodesCollectionPopulatedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterDataNodesCollectionPopulated:
					OnAfterDataNodesCollectionPopulated((AfterDataNodesCollectionPopulatedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.ColumnSetGenerated:
					OnColumnSetGenerated((ColumnSetGeneratedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeColumnMoved:
					OnBeforeColumnMoved((BeforeColumnMovedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterColumnMoved:
					OnAfterColumnMoved((AfterColumnMovedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeNodeLayoutItemSpanResize:
					OnBeforeNodeLayoutItemSpanResize((BeforeNodeLayoutItemSpanResizeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterNodeLayoutItemSpanResize:
					OnAfterNodeLayoutItemSpanResize((AfterNodeLayoutItemSpanResizeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeCellActivate:
					OnBeforeCellActivate((BeforeCellActivateEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterCellActivate:
					OnAfterCellActivate(e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeCellDeactivate:
					OnBeforeCellDeactivate((BeforeCellDeactivateEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeCellEnterEditMode:
					OnBeforeCellEnterEditMode((BeforeCellEnterEditModeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterCellEnterEditMode:
					OnAfterCellEnterEditMode((AfterCellEnterEditModeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeCellExitEditMode:
					OnBeforeCellExitEditMode((BeforeCellExitEditModeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterCellExitEditMode:
					OnAfterCellExitEditMode((AfterCellExitEditModeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.CellValueChanged:
					OnCellValueChanged((CellValueChangedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.DataError:
					OnDataError((DataErrorEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.CellValidationError:
					OnCellValidationError((CellValidationErrorEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeNodeUpdate:
					OnBeforeNodeUpdate((CancelableNodeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterNodeUpdate:
					OnAfterNodeUpdate((NodeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.BeforeNodeCancelUpdate:
					OnBeforeNodeCancelUpdate((CancelableNodeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TreeEventIds.AfterNodeCancelUpdate:
					OnAfterNodeCancelUpdate((NodeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EventManager.DecrementInProgress(id);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnAfterSelect(SelectEventArgs e)
		{
			((AfterNodeSelectEventHandler)((UltraControlBase)this).EventsOptimized[EVENT_AFTERSELECT])?.Invoke(this, e);
			if (e.NewSelections.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (UltraTreeNode newSelection in e.NewSelections)
			{
				if (newSelection.HasSelectedNodeAppearance)
				{
					flag = true;
					newSelection.RecalcSize = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag && UIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

		public UltraTree()
		{
			try
			{
				license = LicenseManager.Validate(typeof(UltraTree), this) as UltraLicense;
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException)
			{
			}
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.AllPaintingInWmPaint, value: true);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.ResizeRedraw, value: true);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: true);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer, value: false);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.StandardClick, value: true);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.StandardDoubleClick, value: true);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.SupportsTransparentBackColor, value: true);
			if (nodes != null && nodes.Count > 0)
			{
				InternalTopNode = nodes[0];
			}
		}

		protected void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			//IL_01b2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01b8: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (initializing)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (propChangeInfo.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				for (PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo2 = propChangeInfo; propChangeInfo2 != null; propChangeInfo2 = propChangeInfo2.Trigger)
				{
					if (propChangeInfo2.PropId is PropertyIds)
					{
						PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo2.PropId;
						if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.Columns || propertyIds == PropertyIds.ColumnSet || propertyIds == PropertyIds.ColumnSets || propertyIds == PropertyIds.ShowColumns)
						{
							OnColumnSettingsChanged(propChangeInfo);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case PropertyIds.ItemHeight:
				case PropertyIds.ActiveNodeAppearance:
				case PropertyIds.ExpandedNodeAppearance:
				case PropertyIds.HotTrackingNodeAppearance:
				case PropertyIds.NodeAppearance:
				case PropertyIds.SelectedNodeAppearance:
				case PropertyIds.BorderStyleNode:
				case PropertyIds.LeftImages:
				case PropertyIds.NodeStyle:
				case PropertyIds.ReserveCheckBoxSpace:
				case PropertyIds.ReserveImageSpace:
				case PropertyIds.ImageSize:
				case PropertyIds.ShowExpansionIndicator:
				case PropertyIds.RightImages:
				case PropertyIds.Editor:
				case PropertyIds.MaxLabelWidth:
				case PropertyIds.MaxLabelHeight:
				case PropertyIds.Multiline:
				case PropertyIds.UseEditor:
				case PropertyIds.ShowEditorButtons:
				case PropertyIds.GlyphPadding:
					BumpMetricsVersion();
					break;
				case PropertyIds.SortComparer:
				case PropertyIds.Sort:
					OnSortCriteriaChanged();
					break;
				case PropertyIds.ShowBandNodes:
					Nodes.RefreshShowBandNode();
					break;
				case PropertyIds.DataSource:
				case PropertyIds.DataMember:
					BumpColumnSetVersion();
					break;
				}
			}
			if (propChangeInfo.Source == overrideObj)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.Override, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (HasAppearance && propChangeInfo.Source == appearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				if ((int)(AppearancePropIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId == 1)
				{
					SynchBackColor();
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.Appearance, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == appearances)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.Appearances, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == nodes)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo3 = propChangeInfo.FindTrigger(null);
				if (propChangeInfo3 != null && propChangeInfo3.PropId is SubObjectBase.NotifyId && (SubObjectBase.NotifyId)(object)propChangeInfo3.PropId == SubObjectBase.NotifyId.Key)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (propChangeInfo3 != null && propChangeInfo3.PropId is PropertyIds)
				{
					PropertyIds propertyIds2 = (PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo3.PropId;
					if (propertyIds2 == PropertyIds.Text || propertyIds2 == PropertyIds.Nodes || propertyIds2 == PropertyIds.Sort || propertyIds2 == PropertyIds.SortComparer)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					sortVersion++;
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.Nodes, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == nodeLevelOverrides)
			{
				PropChangeInfo trigger = propChangeInfo.Trigger;
				if (trigger != null && trigger.Source is Override)
				{
					switch ((PropertyIds)(object)trigger.PropId)
					{
					case PropertyIds.SortComparer:
					case PropertyIds.Sort:
						if (nodes != null && nodes.Count > 0)
						{
							OnSortCriteriaChanged();
						}
						break;
					case PropertyIds.ItemHeight:
					case PropertyIds.ActiveNodeAppearance:
					case PropertyIds.ExpandedNodeAppearance:
					case PropertyIds.HotTrackingNodeAppearance:
					case PropertyIds.NodeAppearance:
					case PropertyIds.SelectedNodeAppearance:
					case PropertyIds.BorderStyleNode:
					case PropertyIds.NodeStyle:
					case PropertyIds.ReserveCheckBoxSpace:
					case PropertyIds.ReserveImageSpace:
					case PropertyIds.ImageSize:
					case PropertyIds.ShowExpansionIndicator:
					case PropertyIds.Editor:
					case PropertyIds.MaxLabelWidth:
					case PropertyIds.MaxLabelHeight:
					case PropertyIds.Multiline:
					case PropertyIds.UseEditor:
					case PropertyIds.ShowEditorButtons:
						BumpMetricsVersion();
						((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
						break;
					case PropertyIds.ColumnSet:
						BumpColumnSetVersion();
						break;
					}
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.NodeLevelOverrides, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == scrollbarLook)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.ScrollBarLook, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == columnSettings)
			{
				OnColumnSettingsChanged(propChangeInfo);
			}
		}

		private void OnColumnSettingsChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			BumpColumnSetVersion();
			VisibleNodesManager.IsScrollSizeDirty = true;
			bool dirtyVisibleNodesManager = propChangeInfo.FindPropId(PropertyIds.SortType) != null;
			if (propChangeInfo.FindPropId(PropertyIds.AllowCellEdit) != null)
			{
				VerifyActiveCell();
			}

		private void RefreshNodesSort(TreeNodesCollection nodes, bool recursive)
		{
			if (nodes.SortResolved != SortType.None)
			{
				nodes.DirtySortVersion();
				nodes.ApplySort();
			}
			if (!recursive)
			{
				((UIElement)nodes.Control.UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i].HasNodes)
				{
					RefreshNodesSort(nodes[i].Nodes, recursive);
				}
			}
			if (nodes.Control != null && nodes.Control.UIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)nodes.Control.UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		private void RefreshNodesSort(TreeNodesCollection nodes, int level)
		{
			if (nodes.Count > 0 && nodes[0].Level == level && nodes.SortResolved != SortType.None)
			{
				nodes.ApplySort();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i].HasNodes)
				{
					RefreshNodesSort(nodes[i].Nodes, level);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool SetActiveNode(UltraTreeNode node, bool bringIntoView, bool adjustHorizontalPosition, NodeActivationReason reason)
		{
			if (node != null && node.Control != this)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_InvalidActiveNode"));
			}
			if (node != null && !node.EnabledResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (activeNode == node)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (reason != NodeActivationReason.ActiveCell)
			{
				UltraTreeNodeCell activeCell = ActiveCell;
				if (activeCell != null && activeCell.Node.HasCellChanges)
				{
					OnCommitCellValue(CellValueCommittedEventType.CellDeactivated);
				}
			}
			if (IsCellInEditMode && !SetActiveCellHelper(null, null))
			{
				return true;
			}
			CancelableNodeEventArgs e = new CancelableNodeEventArgs(node);
			FireEvent(TreeEventIds.BeforeActivate, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (activeNode != null && activeNode.IsEditing)
			{
				activeNode.EndEdit(cancel: false);
			}
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ActiveNode;
			if (!OnCommitCellValue(CellValueCommittedEventType.NodeDeactivated))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (node != null && node.Disposed)
			{
				return true;
			}
			activeNode = node;
			if (activeNode != null)
			{
				activeNode.ResetPendingCellValues();
				activeNode.ResetChangedBoundCellsHash();
				if (activeNode != null)
				{
					bool flag = !activeNode.ShowColumnsResolved;
					flag = flag && adjustHorizontalPosition;
					if (bringIntoView)
					{
						activeNode.BringIntoViewHelper(includeChildNodes: false, flag);
					}
				}
			}
			if (activeCellColumn != null && activeNode != ultraTreeNode)
			{
				SetActiveCellHelper(activeNode, null);
			}
			bool flag2 = ultraTreeNode?.HasActiveNodeAppearance ?? false;
			bool flag3 = activeNode != null && activeNode.HasActiveNodeAppearance;
			if (flag3 || flag2)
			{
				if (flag3)
				{
					activeNode.RecalcSize = true;
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					ultraTreeNode.RecalcSize = true;
				}
				((UIElement)element).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
			if (((Control)this).ContainsFocus && activeNode != null)
			{
				int visibleIndex = activeNode.VisibleIndex;

		internal void DoDragScroll(Point MouseLoc, int nTimerInterval)
		{
			ScrollEventType scrollEventType = ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement;
			Rectangle rectangleForZoomFactor = Utilities.GetRectangleForZoomFactor(ViewableArea, ((UltraControlBase)this).ZoomFactor, false);
			if (MouseLoc.Y < rectangleForZoomFactor.Top)
			{
				scrollEventType = ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement;
			}
			else
			{
				if (MouseLoc.Y <= rectangleForZoomFactor.Bottom)
				{
					return;
				}
				scrollEventType = ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement;
			}
			int num = 0;
			switch (scrollEventType)
			{
			case ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement:
				num = TopNode.VisibleIndex + 1;
				if (num > VisibleNodesArray.Count - 1)
				{
					num = VisibleNodesArray.Count - 1;
				}
				break;
			case ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement:
				num = TopNode.VisibleIndex - 1;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				break;
			}
			ScrollEventArgs arg = new ScrollEventArgs(scrollEventType, num);
			ScrollbarControl.OnVerticalScroll(null, arg);
		}

		bool ISelectionManager.DoesDragNeedScrollVertical(Point MouseLoc, ref int nTimerInterval)
		{
			if (Nodes.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Rectangle rectangleForZoomFactor = Utilities.GetRectangleForZoomFactor(ViewableArea, ((UltraControlBase)this).ZoomFactor, false);
			int top = rectangleForZoomFactor.Top;
			int bottom = rectangleForZoomFactor.Bottom;
			if (MouseLoc.Y >= top && MouseLoc.Y <= bottom)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MouseLoc.Y > bottom && TopNode.VisibleIndex == VisibleNodesArray.Count - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MouseLoc.Y < top && TopNode.VisibleIndex == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int distanceFromOrigin = 0;
			if (MouseLoc.Y < top)
			{
				distanceFromOrigin = top - MouseLoc.Y;
			}
			else if (bottom < MouseLoc.Y)
			{
				distanceFromOrigin = MouseLoc.Y - bottom;
			}
			nTimerInterval = GetVerticalDragScrollTimerInterval(distanceFromOrigin);
			return true;
		}

		private int GetVerticalDragScrollTimerInterval(int distanceFromOrigin)
		{
			int num = 500;
			int num2 = 5;
			int height = Utilities.GetRectangleForZoomFactor(ViewableArea, ((UltraControlBase)this).ZoomFactor, false).Height;
			height = (int)((float)height * 0.4f);
			double num3 = Math.Log(num / num2);
			double num4 = (double)distanceFromOrigin / (double)height;
			num4 = Math.Abs(num4 * num3);
			int num5 = (int)((double)num / Math.Pow(Math.E, num4));
			if (num5 < 1)
			{
				num5 = 1;
			}
			return num5;
		}

		private void CalcSelectionRange(UltraTreeNode item, ref SelectedNodesCollection newSelection, bool clearExistingSelection, bool select)
		{
			if (CanSelectAcrossCollections)
			{
				CalcSelectionRangeAcrossCollections(item, ref newSelection, clearExistingSelection, select);
				return;
			}
			int index = item.Index;
			int index2 = pivotItem.Index;
			if (index != index2)
			{
				int num;
				int num2;
				if (index > index2)
				{
					num = index2 + 1;
					num2 = index;
				}
				else
				{
					num = index;
					num2 = index2 - 1;

		private SelectedNodesCollection GetSelectionWithAllDescendants(SelectedNodesCollection selectedNodes)
		{
			int count = selectedNodes.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SelectedNodesCollection selectedNodesCollection = new SelectedNodesCollection(cloned: true);
			UltraTreeNode lastNodeInSelection = selectedNodes[count - 1];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = selectedNodes[i];
				if (ultraTreeNode.CanBeSelected(clearExistingSelection: false))
				{
					selectedNodesCollection.InternalAdd(ultraTreeNode);
				}
				SelectAllDescendants(ultraTreeNode, ref selectedNodesCollection, lastNodeInSelection);
			}
			return selectedNodesCollection;
		}

		private bool SelectAllDescendants(UltraTreeNode parentNode, ref SelectedNodesCollection selectedNodes, UltraTreeNode lastNodeInSelection)
		{
			if (parentNode == null || !parentNode.HasVisibleNodes)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (parentNode == lastNodeInSelection)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection = parentNode.Nodes;
			int count = treeNodesCollection.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = treeNodesCollection[i];
				if (ultraTreeNode.CanBeSelected(clearExistingSelection: false))
				{
					selectedNodes.InternalAdd(ultraTreeNode);
				}
				if (ultraTreeNode == lastNodeInSelection)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!SelectAllDescendants(ultraTreeNode, ref selectedNodes, lastNodeInSelection))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		bool ISelectionManager.SelectRange(ISelectableItem item, bool clearExistingSelection)
		{
			if (item is UltraTreeNodeColumn)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!((ISelectionManager)this).IsItemSelectableWithCurrentSelection(item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				if (pivotItem == null)
				{
					pivotItem = ActiveNode;
				}
				if (pivotItem != null)
				{
					return InternalSelectRange(item, clearExistingSelection, select: true);
				}
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.SelectionWithin, 0);
			}
		}

		bool ISelectionManager.UnselectRange(ISelectableItem item, bool clearExistingSelection)
		{
			if (item is UltraTreeNodeColumn)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return InternalSelectRange(item, clearExistingSelection, select: false);
		}

		internal bool InternalSelectRange(ISelectableItem item, bool clearExistingSelection, bool select)
		{
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = item as UltraTreeNode;
			if (!ultraTreeNode.EnabledResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SelectedNodesCollection selected = CalcNewSelectionRange(ultraTreeNode, clearExistingSelection, select);
			if (SelectNewSelection(selected, isRangeSelect: true))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			dragInProgress = false;
			if (AutoScrollHorizontalResolved)
			{
				UIElement val = ((UIElement)UIElement).ElementFromPoint(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
				if (val != null && !(val is TreeNodeUIElement) && val.GetAncestor(typeof(TreeNodeUIElement)) == null)
				{
					NodeClientAreaUIElement nodeClientAreaUIElement = ((val is NodeClientAreaUIElement) ? ((NodeClientAreaUIElement)(object)val) : (val.GetAncestor(typeof(NodeClientAreaUIElement)) as NodeClientAreaUIElement));
					if (nodeClientAreaUIElement != null)
					{
						UIElementEnumerator enumerator = ((UIElement)nodeClientAreaUIElement).ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
						try
						{
							while (enumerator.MoveNext())
							{
								UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
								if (current is TreeNodeUIElement treeNodeUIElement && e.X < ((UIElement)treeNodeUIElement).Rect.X && e.Y >= ((UIElement)treeNodeUIElement).Rect.Y && e.Y <= ((UIElement)treeNodeUIElement).Rect.Bottom)
								{
									treeNodeUIElement.Node.BringIntoViewHelper(includeChildNodes: false, includeHorizontal: true, includeVertical: false, leftOnly: false);
								}
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
							{
								disposable.Dispose();
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnMouseMove(e);
		}
