		private void ExpandCollapseAllHelper(bool expand, ExpandAllType expandAllType)
		{
			TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection = Nodes;
			if (treeNodesCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraTreeNode item in treeNodesCollection)
			{
				item.ExpandCollapseAllHelper(expand, expandAllType);
			}
			((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			((UltraControlBase)this).Update();
			if (TopNode != null)
			{
				ScrollbarControl.VScrollPosition = TopNode.VisibleIndex;
			}
			VisibleNodesManager.IsDirty = true;
			ScrollbarControl.RecalcVScroll();
			((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.IsExpanded);
			AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.StateChange, 0);
		}

		protected override void OnGotFocus(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (hideSelection && selectedNodes != null && SelectedNodes.Count > 0)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).Invalidate();
			}
			if (HideExpansionIndicatorsResolved == HideExpansionIndicators.OnLostFocus || HideExpansionIndicatorsResolved == HideExpansionIndicators.OnLostFocusAndNotMouseOver)
			{
				RefreshExpansionIndicators();
			}
			if (((Control)this).ContainsFocus && activeNode != null)
			{
				int visibleIndex = activeNode.VisibleIndex;
				if (visibleIndex >= 0)
				{
					AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.Focus, visibleIndex);
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnGotFocus(e);
		}

		protected override void OnLostFocus(EventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnLostFocus(e);
			if (!inBeginEdit)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				try
				{
					flag = Utilities.IsActiveFormRelated((Control)(object)this, true);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					InternalLostFocus();
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).Invalidate();
				if (HideExpansionIndicatorsResolved == HideExpansionIndicators.OnLostFocus || HideExpansionIndicatorsResolved == HideExpansionIndicators.OnLostFocusAndNotMouseOver)
				{
					RefreshExpansionIndicators();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InternalLostFocus()
		{
			if (!InEndEdit)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ActiveNode;
				if (ultraTreeNode != null && ultraTreeNode.IsEditing)
				{
					EndEdit(ultraTreeNode, cancel: false);
				}
			}
			if (hideSelection && selectedNodes != null && SelectedNodes.Count > 0)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).Invalidate();
			}
		}

		internal void ShowScrollBar(ScrollBarType scrollBarType, bool show)
		{
			switch (scrollBarType)
			{
			case ScrollBarType.vertical:
				if (recalcVScrollbars)
				{
					ScrollbarControl.ShowVerticalScroll(show);
				}
				break;
			case ScrollBarType.horizontal:
				if (recalcHScrollbars)
				{
					ScrollbarControl.ShowHorizontalScroll(show);
				}
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_27"));
			}
		}

		bool IScrollableControl.IsScrollShown(ScrollBarType scrollBarType)
		{
			return scrollBarType switch
			{
				ScrollBarType.vertical => IsVerticalScrollShown, 
				ScrollBarType.horizontal => IsHorizontalScrollShown, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_27")), 
			};
		}

		void IScrollableControl.DirtyControl()
		{
			((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements(!IsScrollingVertically);
		}

		int IScrollableControl.MaxSize(ScrollBarType scrollBarType)
		{
			switch (scrollBarType)
			{
			case ScrollBarType.vertical:
				if (VisibleNodesArray != null && VisibleNodesArray.Count > 0)
				{
					if (AllVisibleNodesAreInView)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					int val = VisibleNodesManager.MaxTopNodeVisibleIndex + ((IScrollableControl)this).LargeChange(ScrollBarType.vertical) - 1;
					return Math.Max(val, 1);
				}
				return 0;
			case ScrollBarType.horizontal:
				return VisibleNodesManager.ScrollSize.Width;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_27"));
			}
		}

		int IScrollableControl.MinSize(ScrollBarType scrollBarType)
		{
			if (scrollBarType == ScrollBarType.vertical)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 16;
		}

		int IScrollableControl.LargeChange(ScrollBarType scrollBarType)
		{
			if (scrollBarType == ScrollBarType.vertical)
			{
				int height = ViewableArea.Height;
				if (height == 0)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				int num = ((AverageNodeHeight != 0) ? (height / AverageNodeHeight) : 0);
				if (num <= 1)
				{
					return num;
				}
				return num - 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		void IScrollableControl.OnScroll(ScrollBarType scrollBarType, ScrollEventArgs arg, ref int newPosition)
		{
			FireEvent(TreeEventIds.Scroll, new TreeScrollEventArgs(scrollBarType, arg));
			if (ActiveNode != null && ActiveNode.IsEditing)
			{
				ActiveNode.EndEdit(cancel: false);
			}
			if (scrollBarType != ScrollBarType.vertical)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraTreeNode prevTopNode = topNode;
			UltraTreeNode bottomVisibleNode = BottomVisibleNode;
			if (arg.Type != ScrollEventType.EndScroll)
			{
				switch (arg.Type)
				{
				case ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement:
				case ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement:
				case ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement:
				case ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement:
				case ScrollEventType.ThumbTrack:
				case ScrollEventType.First:
				case ScrollEventType.Last:
					if (arg.NewValue >= 0 && arg.NewValue < VisibleNodesArray.Count)
					{
						int vScrollPosition = ScrollbarControl.VScrollPosition;
						((UltraControlBase)this).Update();
						TopNode = (UltraTreeNode)VisibleNodesArray[arg.NewValue];
						if (arg.NewValue != vScrollPosition)
						{
							DoVerticalScroll(arg, prevTopNode, vScrollPosition);
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			newPosition = TopNode.VisibleIndex;
		}

		internal void ScrollLargeChange(ScrollEventType eventType)
		{
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = null;
			switch (eventType)
			{
			case ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement:
			{
				int visibleIndex = TopNode.VisibleIndex;
				int num = TopNode.Bounds.Height;
				for (int num2 = visibleIndex - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					ultraTreeNode = (UltraTreeNode)VisibleNodesArray[num2];
					num += ultraTreeNode.ItemHeightResolvedWithSpacing;
					if (num > ViewableArea.Height)
					{
						if (num2 != visibleIndex - 1)
						{
							ultraTreeNode = (UltraTreeNode)VisibleNodesArray[num2 + 1];
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement:
				ultraTreeNode = BottomVisibleNode;
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_26"));
			}
			TopNode = ultraTreeNode;
		}

		internal int GetScrollPosition(ScrollBarType scrollBarType)
		{
			return scrollBarType switch
			{
				ScrollBarType.vertical => ScrollbarControl.VScrollPosition, 
				ScrollBarType.horizontal => ScrollbarControl.HScrollPosition, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_27")), 
			};
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool HasNodeLevelOverride(int index)
		{
			if (nodeLevelOverrides != null && nodeLevelOverrides.Count > index && nodeLevelOverrides[index] != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal KeyActionMappingsBase GetKeyActionMappings()
		{
			return (KeyActionMappingsBase)(object)KeyActionMappings;
		}

		internal long GetCurrentState()
		{
			return (long)CurrentState;
		}

		internal bool PerformKeyAction(Enum actionCode, bool shiftKeyDown, bool ctlKeyDown)
		{
			return PerformAction((UltraTreeAction)(object)actionCode, shiftKeyDown, ctlKeyDown);
		}

		public virtual bool PerformAction(UltraTreeAction actionCode, bool shift, bool control)
		{
			if (!((KeyActionMappingsBase)KeyActionMappings).IsActionAllowed((Enum)actionCode, (long)CurrentState))
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (actionCode)
			{
			case UltraTreeAction.Cut:
				return CutSelectedNodesHelper(allowExceptions: false, honorAllowCut: true);
			case UltraTreeAction.Copy:
				return CopySelectedNodesHelper(allowExceptions: false, honorAllowCopy: true);
			case UltraTreeAction.Paste:
				return PasteNodes();
			default:
				if (ActiveNode == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (actionCode)
				{
				case UltraTreeAction.ExpandNode:
					ActiveNode.Expanded = true;
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.ExpandAllNode:
					if (ActiveNode.ShowExpansionIndicatorResolved == ShowExpansionIndicator.CheckOnExpand)
					{
						ActiveNode.ExpandAll(ExpandAllType.Always);
					}
					else
					{
						ActiveNode.ExpandAll();
					}
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.CollapseNode:
					ActiveNode.Expanded = false;
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.EnterEditMode:
					ActiveNode.BeginEdit(ignoreLabelEdit: false);
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.ExitEditMode:
				case UltraTreeAction.ExitEditModeAndSave:
				{
					bool flag = actionCode == UltraTreeAction.ExitEditMode;
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode3 = ActiveNode;
					if (ultraTreeNode3 != null)
					{
						if (ultraTreeNode3.IsBound() && ultraTreeNode3.EditorResolved != null)
						{
							ultraTreeNode3.EditorResolved.ExitEditMode(false, !flag);
						}
						else
						{
							ultraTreeNode3.EndEdit(flag);
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.PrevNodeNoSelect:
				{
					UltraTreeNode prevVisibleNode2 = ActiveNode.PrevVisibleNode;
					ActiveNode = ((prevVisibleNode2 != null) ? prevVisibleNode2 : ActiveNode);
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.NextNodeNoSelect:
				{
					UltraTreeNode nextVisibleNode = ActiveNode.NextVisibleNode;
					ActiveNode = ((nextVisibleNode != null) ? nextVisibleNode : ActiveNode);
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.FirstNodeNoSelect:
					if (nodes != null && nodes.Count > 0)
					{
						ScrollNodeIntoView(nodes[0], includeHorizontal: false);
						ActiveNode = nodes[0];
					}
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.LastNodeNoSelect:
				{
					UltraTreeNode lastVisibleNode2 = LastVisibleNode;
					ScrollNodeIntoView(lastVisibleNode2, includeHorizontal: false);
					ActiveNode = ((lastVisibleNode2 != null) ? lastVisibleNode2 : ActiveNode);
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.PageUpNoSelect:
				{
					UltraTreeNode internalTopNode = InternalTopNode;
					if (ActiveNode != internalTopNode)
					{
						ActiveNode = ((internalTopNode != null) ? internalTopNode : ActiveNode);
					}
					else
					{
						int num = VScrollOriginOffSet - ScrollbarControl.LargeVerticalChange;
						num = ((num >= 0) ? num : 0);
						ScrollEventArgs arg2 = new ScrollEventArgs(ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement, num);
						ScrollbarControl.OnVerticalScroll(null, arg2);
						ActiveNode = InternalTopNode;
					}
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.PageDownNoSelect:
					if (ActiveNode == BottomVisibleNode && !AllVisibleNodesAreInView)
					{
						int newValue = ScrollbarControl.LargeVerticalChange + VScrollOriginOffSet;
						ScrollEventArgs arg = new ScrollEventArgs(ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement, newValue);
						ScrollbarControl.OnVerticalScroll(null, arg);
					}
					ActiveNode = BottomVisibleNode;
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.ScrollUp:
				{
					UltraTreeNode prevVisibleNode = TopNode.PrevVisibleNode;
					if (prevVisibleNode != null)
					{
						TopNode = prevVisibleNode;
					}
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.ScrollDown:
				{
					UltraTreeNode nextVisibleNode2 = TopNode.NextVisibleNode;
					if (nextVisibleNode2 != null)
					{
						TopNode = nextVisibleNode2;
					}
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.ScrollTop:
				{
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ((VisibleNodesArray != null && VisibleNodesArray.Count > 0) ? ((UltraTreeNode)VisibleNodesArray[0]) : null);
					if (ultraTreeNode != null)
					{
						ScrollNodeIntoView(ultraTreeNode, includeHorizontal: false);
					}
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.ScrollBottom:
				{
					UltraTreeNode lastVisibleNode = LastVisibleNode;
					if (lastVisibleNode != null)
					{
						ScrollNodeIntoView(lastVisibleNode, includeHorizontal: false);
					}
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.ScrollPageUp:
					ScrollLargeChange(ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement);
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.ScrollPageDown:
					ScrollLargeChange(ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement);
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.DeleteNodes:
					InternalDeleteNodesHelper(selectedNodes);
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.ToggleCheckbox:
					if (((UIElement)UIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(NodeCheckBoxUIElement), (object)ActiveNode) is NodeCheckBoxUIElement nodeCheckBoxUIElement)
					{
						nodeCheckBoxUIElement.InternalOnClick();
					}
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.CheckOptionButton:
					if (ActiveNode.CheckedState != CheckState.Checked)
					{
						ActiveNode.CheckedState = CheckState.Checked;
					}
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.ClearAllSelectedNodes:
					SelectedNodes.Clear();
					((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.SelectActiveNode:
					if (ActiveNode != null && ActiveNode.SelectionTypeResolved == SelectType.None)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (ActiveNode != null && !ActiveNode.Selected)
					{
						((UltraControlBase)this).GetSelectionManager().SelectItem((ISelectableItem)ActiveNode, false);
					}
					((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.NextCell:
					PerformActionNextCell();
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.PreviousCell:
					PerformActionPreviousCell();
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.FirstCellInNode:
				{
					UltraTreeNode node2 = ActiveNode;
					CellNavigator cellNavigator2 = new CellNavigator(node2);
					LightweightCell firstCellInNode = cellNavigator2.FirstCellInNode;
					if (firstCellInNode != null)
					{
						SetActiveCellHelper(firstCellInNode.Node, firstCellInNode.DataColumn);
					}
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.LastCellInNode:
				{
					UltraTreeNode node = ActiveNode;
					CellNavigator cellNavigator = new CellNavigator(node);
					LightweightCell lastCellInNode = cellNavigator.LastCellInNode;
					if (lastCellInNode != null)
					{
						SetActiveCellHelper(lastCellInNode.Node, lastCellInNode.DataColumn);
					}
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.FirstCellInNodesCollection:
				{
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode5 = ActiveNode;
					UltraTreeNode firstActivateableNodeInCollection = ultraTreeNode5.GetFirstActivateableNodeInCollection(mustDisplayCells: true);
					if (firstActivateableNodeInCollection != null)
					{
						CellNavigator cellNavigator8 = new CellNavigator(firstActivateableNodeInCollection);
						LightweightCell firstCellInNode3 = cellNavigator8.FirstCellInNode;
						if (firstCellInNode3 != null)
						{
							SetActiveCellHelper(firstCellInNode3.Node, firstCellInNode3.DataColumn);
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.LastCellInNodesCollection:
				{
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode4 = ActiveNode;
					UltraTreeNode lastActivateableNodeInCollection = ultraTreeNode4.GetLastActivateableNodeInCollection(mustDisplayCells: true);
					if (lastActivateableNodeInCollection != null)
					{
						CellNavigator cellNavigator7 = new CellNavigator(lastActivateableNodeInCollection);
						LightweightCell lastCellInNode3 = cellNavigator7.LastCellInNode;
						if (lastCellInNode3 != null)
						{
							SetActiveCellHelper(lastCellInNode3.Node, lastCellInNode3.DataColumn);
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.FirstCellInTree:
				{
					UltraTreeNode firstActivateableNodeInTree = GetFirstActivateableNodeInTree(mustDisplayCells: true);
					if (firstActivateableNodeInTree != null)
					{
						CellNavigator cellNavigator6 = new CellNavigator(firstActivateableNodeInTree);
						LightweightCell firstCellInNode2 = cellNavigator6.FirstCellInNode;
						if (firstCellInNode2 != null)
						{
							SetActiveCellHelper(firstCellInNode2.Node, firstCellInNode2.DataColumn);
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.LastCellInTree:
				{
					UltraTreeNode lastActivateableNodeInTree = GetLastActivateableNodeInTree(mustDisplayCells: true);
					if (lastActivateableNodeInTree != null)
					{
						CellNavigator cellNavigator5 = new CellNavigator(lastActivateableNodeInTree);
						LightweightCell lastCellInNode2 = cellNavigator5.LastCellInNode;
						if (lastCellInNode2 != null)
						{
							SetActiveCellHelper(lastCellInNode2.Node, lastCellInNode2.DataColumn);
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.AboveCell:
				{
					UltraTreeNode node4 = ActiveNode;
					CellNavigator cellNavigator4 = new CellNavigator(node4);
					LightweightCell aboveCell = cellNavigator4.AboveCell;
					if (aboveCell != null)
					{
						SetActiveCellHelper(aboveCell.Node, aboveCell.DataColumn);
					}
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.BelowCell:
				{
					UltraTreeNode node3 = ActiveNode;
					CellNavigator cellNavigator3 = new CellNavigator(node3);
					LightweightCell belowCell = cellNavigator3.BelowCell;
					if (belowCell != null)
					{
						SetActiveCellHelper(belowCell.Node, belowCell.DataColumn);
					}
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.EnterEditModeOnCell:
				{
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode2 = ActiveNode;
					UltraTreeNodeColumn column = ActiveCellColumn;
					ultraTreeNode2.BeginCellEdit(column);
					return true;
				}
				case UltraTreeAction.ExitEditModeOnCellSaveChanges:
					ActiveNode.EndCellEdit(cancel: false);
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.UndoCellEdit:
					ActiveNode.EndCellEdit(cancel: true);
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.NextCellEnterEditMode:
					if (PerformActionNextCell())
					{
						ActiveNode.BeginCellEdit(ActiveCellColumn);
					}
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.PreviousCellEnterEditMode:
					if (PerformActionPreviousCell())
					{
						ActiveNode.BeginCellEdit(ActiveCellColumn);
					}
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.SelectNextControl:
					ActiveNode.EndCellEdit(cancel: false);
					((Control)(object)this).ProcessDialogKey(Keys.Tab);
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.SelectPreviousControl:
					ActiveNode.EndCellEdit(cancel: false);
					((Control)(object)this).ProcessDialogKey(Keys.Tab | Keys.Shift);
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.UndoNodeEdit:
					ActiveNode.UndoEdit(dirtyElements: true, fireEvents: true);
					return true;
				case UltraTreeAction.DeactivateCell:
					SetActiveCellHelper(ActiveNode, null);
					((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
					return true;
				default:
				{
					UltraTreeNode selectableItem = GetSelectableItem(actionCode, ref shift, control);
					if (actionCode != UltraTreeAction.ToggleSelection && selectableItem == null && (ActiveNode == VisibleNodesArray[0] || ActiveNode == VisibleNodesArray[VisibleNodesArray.Count - 1]))
					{
						selectableItem = ActiveNode;
					}
					if (selectableItem != null && !NodeLevelIsCurrentlySelectable(selectableItem.Level) && (control || shift))
					{
						return false;
					}
					((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
					return SelectNode(selectableItem, shift, control);
				}
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool NodeLevelIsCurrentlySelectable(int level)
		{
			if (SelectedNodes.Count == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (CanSelectAcrossCollections)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (SelectedNodes[0].Level == level)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal UltraTreeNode GetSelectableItem(UltraTreeAction actionCode, ref bool shiftKeyDown, bool ctlKeyDown)
		{
			switch (actionCode)
			{
			case UltraTreeAction.NextNode:
			{
				UltraTreeNode nextVisibleNode = ActiveNode.GetNextVisibleNode(disregardEnabledStatus: false);
				if (nextVisibleNode == null)
				{
					return ActiveNode;
				}
				if (ActiveNode == BottomVisibleNode && !ActiveNode.IsLastViewableNode)
				{
					TopNode = VisibleNodesArray[TopNode.VisibleIndex + 1] as UltraTreeNode;
				}
				return nextVisibleNode;
			}
			case UltraTreeAction.PrevNode:
			{
				UltraTreeNode prevVisibleNode = ActiveNode.GetPrevVisibleNode(disregardEnabledStatus: false);
				if (prevVisibleNode == null)
				{
					return ActiveNode;
				}
				if (!ActiveNode.IsFirstViewableNode && prevVisibleNode.VisibleIndex < TopNode.VisibleIndex)
				{
					TopNode = prevVisibleNode;
				}
				return prevVisibleNode;
			}
			case UltraTreeAction.FirstNode:
				if (VisibleNodesArray != null && VisibleNodesArray.Count > 0)
				{
					TopNode = (UltraTreeNode)VisibleNodesArray[0];
					if (!TopNode.EnabledResolved)
					{
						return TopNode.GetNextVisibleNode(disregardEnabledStatus: false);
					}
					return TopNode;
				}
				return null;
			case UltraTreeAction.LastNode:
			{
				UltraTreeNode lastVisibleNode = LastVisibleNode;
				lastVisibleNode = (lastVisibleNode.EnabledResolved ? lastVisibleNode : lastVisibleNode.GetPrevVisibleNode(disregardEnabledStatus: false));
				ScrollNodeIntoView(lastVisibleNode, includeHorizontal: false);
				return lastVisibleNode;
			}
			case UltraTreeAction.PageDown:
			{
				UltraTreeNode bottomVisibleNode = BottomVisibleNode;
				bottomVisibleNode = (bottomVisibleNode.EnabledResolved ? bottomVisibleNode : bottomVisibleNode.GetPrevVisibleNode(disregardEnabledStatus: false));
				if (ActiveNode == bottomVisibleNode && !AllVisibleNodesAreInView)
				{
					ScrollLargeChange(ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement);
				}
				bottomVisibleNode = BottomVisibleNode;
				if (!bottomVisibleNode.EnabledResolved)
				{
					return bottomVisibleNode.GetPrevVisibleNode(disregardEnabledStatus: false);
				}
				return bottomVisibleNode;
			}
			case UltraTreeAction.PageUp:
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = (TopNode.EnabledResolved ? TopNode : TopNode.GetNextVisibleNode(disregardEnabledStatus: false));
				if (ActiveNode == ultraTreeNode)
				{
					ScrollLargeChange(ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement);
				}
				if (!TopNode.EnabledResolved)
				{
					return TopNode.GetNextVisibleNode(disregardEnabledStatus: false);
				}
				return TopNode;
			}
			case UltraTreeAction.ParentNode:
			{
				UltraTreeNode parent = ActiveNode.Parent;
				if (!IsNodeInFullView(parent))
				{
					ScrollNodeIntoView(parent, includeHorizontal: false);
				}
				return parent;
			}
			case UltraTreeAction.ToggleSelection:
			{
				if (!ActiveNode.Selected)
				{
					return ActiveNode;
				}
				ISelectionStrategy selectionStrategy = ((UltraControlBase)this).GetSelectionManager().GetSelectionStrategy((ISelectableItem)ActiveNode);
				if (selectionStrategy != null && ((object)selectionStrategy).GetType() != typeof(SelectionStrategySingle) && ((object)selectionStrategy).GetType() != typeof(SelectionStrategySingleAutoDrag))
				{
					if ((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) != Keys.Control)
					{
						InternalSelectItem(ActiveNode, clearExistingSelection: true, select: false);
					}
					else
					{
						InternalSelectItem(ActiveNode, clearExistingSelection: false, select: false);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal UltraTreeNode FindNodeFromActiveNode(string findString)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ActiveNode.NextVisibleNode;
			while (true)
			{
				if (ultraTreeNode != null)
				{
					string text = "";
					if (ultraTreeNode.Text.Length >= findString.Length)
					{
						text = ultraTreeNode.Text.Substring(0, findString.Length);
					}
					if (text.Length > 0 && CompareStrings(text, findString, caseSensitive: false))
					{
						return ultraTreeNode;
					}
					if (flag && ultraTreeNode == ActiveNode)
					{
						return null;
					}
					ultraTreeNode = ultraTreeNode.NextVisibleNode;
				}
				else
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						return null;
					}
					flag = true;
					ultraTreeNode = FirstVisibleNode;
					if (!flag)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static bool CompareStrings(string string1, string string2, bool caseSensitive)
		{
			if (caseSensitive)
			{
				return string.Compare(string1, string2, ignoreCase: false, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0;
			}
			CaseInsensitiveComparer caseInsensitiveComparer = new CaseInsensitiveComparer();
			return caseInsensitiveComparer.Compare(string1, string2) == 0;
		}

		internal bool IsNodeInFullView(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (node != null)
			{
				if (UIElement == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!(((UIElement)UIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(TreeNodeUIElement), (object)node) is TreeNodeUIElement treeNodeUIElement))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (((UIElement)treeNodeUIElement).Rect.Top < ViewableArea.Top || ((UIElement)treeNodeUIElement).Rect.Bottom > ViewableArea.Bottom)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool IsInputKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			if (!((Control)this).ContainsFocus)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ViewStyleResolved != ViewStyle.Standard && (keyData & Keys.Tab) == Keys.Tab && ColumnSettings.TabNavigationResolved == TabNavigation.NextControl)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsCellInEditMode)
			{
				EmbeddableUIElementBase cellEmbeddableElement = ActiveNode.GetCellEmbeddableElement(ActiveCellColumn);
				EmbeddableEditorBase val = ((cellEmbeddableElement != null) ? cellEmbeddableElement.Editor : null);
				if (val != null && !val.CanFocus && !val.Focused && val.IsInputKey(keyData))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ActiveNode;
			if (ultraTreeNode != null && ultraTreeNode.IsEditing)
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = ultraTreeNode.EditorResolved;
				if (editorResolved != null && editorResolved.IsInEditMode && !editorResolved.CanFocus && !editorResolved.Focused && editorResolved.IsInputKey(keyData))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (((KeyActionMappingsBase)KeyActionMappings).IsKeyMapped(keyData, (long)CurrentState))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((Control)this).IsInputKey(keyData);
		}

			return GetNodeFromPoint(new Point(X, Y));
		}

		public UltraTreeNode GetNodeFromPoint(Point pt)
		{
			UIElement val = ((UIElement)UIElement).ElementFromPoint(pt);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return (UltraTreeNode)val.GetContext(typeof(UltraTreeNode), true);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public int GetNodeCount(bool includeSubTrees)
		{
			int num = Nodes.Count;
			if (!includeSubTrees)
			{
				return num;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				num += nodes[i].GetNodeCount(includeSubTrees: true);
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal bool BeginEdit(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			return BeginEdit(node, ignoreLabelEdit: false);
		}

		internal bool BeginEdit(UltraTreeNode node, bool ignoreLabelEdit)
		{
			return BeginEdit(node, ignoreLabelEdit, callEnterEditMode: true);
		}

		internal bool BeginEdit(UltraTreeNode node, bool ignoreLabelEdit, bool callEnterEditMode)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (node.ShowColumnsResolved || node.IsBandNode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ignoreLabelEdit && !node.LabelEditResolved)
			{
				LabelEditNode.Active = false;
				return false;
			}
			if (node.IsBound() && !node.UseEditorResolved)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Exception_CannotEditDataBoundNode"));
			}
			if (EventManager.InProgress(TreeEventIds.BeforeLabelEdit))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (EventManager.InProgress(TreeEventIds.AfterLabelEdit))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (node != ActiveNode)
			{
				ActiveNode = node;
				if (node != ActiveNode)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = node.EditorResolved;
			if (editorResolved != null && !editorResolved.CanEditType(typeof(string)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			oldLabelEditText = node.Text;
			inBeginEdit = true;
			try
			{
				CancelableNodeEventArgs e = new CancelableNodeEventArgs(ActiveNode);
				FireEvent(TreeEventIds.BeforeLabelEdit, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					oldLabelEditText = null;
					return false;
				}
				if (!Utilities.IsControlOnActiveForm((Control)(object)this, true))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (SelectedNodes.Count > 1 || (SelectedNodes.Count == 1 && SelectedNodes[0] != node))
				{
					SelectedNodesCollection selectedNodesCollection = new SelectedNodesCollection(cloned: true);
					if (SelectedNodes.Contains(node))
					{
						selectedNodesCollection.InternalAdd(node);
					}
					SelectNewSelection(selectedNodesCollection);
				}
				ActiveNode.BringIntoView();
				((UIElement)UIElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
				ActiveNode.InternalSetEditing(editing: true);
				UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)ActiveNode.UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ActiveNode.RecalcSize = true;
				ActiveNode.TextRectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
				uIElement.Parent.DirtyChildElements(true);
				uIElement.Parent.VerifyChildElements(true);
				if (editorResolved != null)
				{
					UIElement descendant = uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(EmbeddableUIElementBase));
					EmbeddableUIElementBase val = (EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)((descendant is EmbeddableUIElementBase) ? descendant : null);
					if (val == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					HookIntoEditorEvents(editorResolved);
					if (callEnterEditMode)
					{
						editorResolved.EnterEditMode(val);
						if (!editorResolved.IsInEditMode)
						{
							return false;
						}
						ActiveNode.RecalcSize = true;
						uIElement.Parent.DirtyChildElements(true);
						uIElement.Parent.VerifyChildElements(true);
						AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.Reorder, -1);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					LabelEditNode.SetupEdit(node);
					LabelEditNode.Show(show: true);
					AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.Reorder, -1);
				}
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				inBeginEdit = false;
			}
		}

		internal void EndEdit(UltraTreeNode node, bool cancel)
		{
			EndEdit(node, cancel, callExitEditMode: true);
		}

		internal bool EndEdit(UltraTreeNode node, bool cancel, bool callExitEditMode)
		{
			if (EventManager.InProgress(TreeEventIds.ValidateLabelEdit) || EventManager.InProgress(TreeEventIds.AfterLabelEdit))
			{
				return false;
			}
			inEndEdit = true;
			ValidateLabelEditEventArgs e = null;
			bool flag = false;
			bool result = false;
			try
			{
				if (LabelEditNode.Active)
				{
					if (!cancel && LabelEditNode.Text != oldLabelEditText)
					{
						e = new ValidateLabelEditEventArgs(LabelEditNode.Text, oldLabelEditText, node);
						FireEvent(TreeEventIds.ValidateLabelEdit, e);
						if (!e.Cancel && !e.StayInEditMode)
						{
							node.Text = e.LabelEditText;
						}
					}
					flag = e?.StayInEditMode ?? false;
					if (!flag)
					{
						LabelEditNode.Show(show: false);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = node.EditorResolved;
					if (editorResolved != null && editorResolved.IsInEditMode && editorResolved.ElementBeingEdited.OwnerContext == node)
					{
						if (!cancel && editorResolved.IsValid && editorResolved.IsInEditMode)
						{
							bool flag2 = true;
							string text;
							if (editorResolved.IsValid)
							{
								text = editorResolved.DataValueToText(editorResolved.Value, (EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)EditorOwner, (object)node);
							}
							else
							{
								text = editorResolved.CurrentEditText;
								flag2 = false;
							}
							if (text != oldLabelEditText)
							{
								e = new ValidateLabelEditEventArgs(text, oldLabelEditText, node);
								FireEvent(TreeEventIds.ValidateLabelEdit, e);
								cancel = e.Cancel;
								flag = e?.StayInEditMode ?? false;
								if (!cancel)
								{
									if (text != e.LabelEditText)
									{
										flag2 = true;
										try
										{
											editorResolved.Value = e.LabelEditText;
										}
										catch
										{
											flag2 = false;
										}
									}
									if (flag2)
									{
										if (node.IsBound())
										{
											UltraTreeNodeColumn ultraTreeNodeColumn = node.DataColumnSetResolved?.SettingsResolved.NodeTextColumn;
											if (ultraTreeNodeColumn != null)
											{
												bool flag3 = ultraTreeNodeColumn.BeforeCellExitEditModeHelper(node, ultraTreeNodeColumn, editorResolved);
												flag = flag || flag3;
												result = flag;
											}
										}
										if (editorResolved.IsValid)
										{
											node.Text = editorResolved.DataValueToText(editorResolved.Value, (EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)EditorOwner, (object)node);
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
						if (callExitEditMode && !flag)
						{
							editorResolved.ExitEditMode(cancel, false);
						}
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					oldLabelEditText = null;
				}
				if (LabelEditNode.Active && !flag)
				{
					NodeEventArgs e2 = new NodeEventArgs(ActiveNode);
					FireEvent(TreeEventIds.AfterLabelEdit, e2);
					AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.Reorder, -1);
				}
				if (ActiveNode != null)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						ActiveNode.InternalSetEditing(editing: true);
					}
					else
					{
						ActiveNode.ClearIsEditingFlag();
					}
				}
				if (ActiveNode != null)
				{
					ActiveNode.RecalcSize = true;
				}
				if (LabelEditNode.Active)
				{
					if (ActiveNode.MultilineCached)
					{
						ActiveNode.RecalcSize = true;
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						LabelEditNode.Active = false;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (UIElement != null)
				{
					((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements(false);
					((UIElement)UIElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
					((Control)(object)this).Refresh();
				}
				inEndEdit = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void LabelEdit_KeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)this).OnKeyDown(e);
			if ((e.KeyData & Keys.Escape) == Keys.Escape)
			{
				ActiveNode.EndEdit(cancel: true);
			}
			else if (e.KeyData == Keys.Return || (e.KeyData & Keys.F2) == Keys.F2)
			{
				ActiveNode.EndEdit(cancel: false);
			}
		}

			((Control)(object)this).OnKeyUp(e);
		}

		{
			((Control)(object)this).OnKeyPress(e);
		}

		internal void LabelEdit_LostFocus(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (ActiveNode.IsEditing)
			{
				ActiveNode.EndEdit(cancel: false);
			}
		}

		internal void AddNodeKey(UltraTreeNode node, bool addChildKeys)
		{
			if (node.Key != null && node.Key.Length > 0)
			{
				if (TreeNodeKeys.Contains(node.Key))
				{
					TreeNodeKeys.Remove(node.Key);
				}
				TreeNodeKeys.Add(node.Key, node);
			}
			if (!addChildKeys || !node.HasNodes)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraTreeNode node2 in node.Nodes)
			{
				AddNodeKey(node2, addChildKeys: true);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveNodeKey(UltraTreeNode node, bool removeChildKeys)
		{
			if (node.Key != null && node.Key.Length > 0)
			{
				TreeNodeKeys.Remove(node.Key);
			}
			if (removeChildKeys && node.HasNodesWithoutVerification)
			{
				TreeNodesCollection nodesWithoutVerification = node.GetNodesWithoutVerification();
				int listCount = nodesWithoutVerification.ListCount;
				for (int i = 0; i < listCount; i++)
				{
					RemoveNodeKey(nodesWithoutVerification.GetNodeWithoutVerification(i), removeChildKeys: true);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ValidateKeyDoesNotExist(string key)
		{
			if (treeNodeKeys != null && key != null && key.Length >= 1 && treeNodeKeys.Contains(key))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_28", key));
			}
		}

			return null;
		}

		internal void InternalDeleteNodesHelper(SelectedNodesCollection nodes)
		{
			UltraTreeNode newActiveNodeAfterDeletion = GetNewActiveNodeAfterDeletion(ActiveNode);
			if (hideSelection)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).Invalidate();
			}
			if (nodes == null || nodes.Count < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool displayPromptMsg = true;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(5);
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i].AllowDeleteResolved)
				{
					arrayList.Add(nodes[i]);
				}
			}
			if (arrayList.Count < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeforeNodesDeletedEventArgs e = new BeforeNodesDeletedEventArgs((UltraTreeNode[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(UltraTreeNode)), displayPromptMsg);
			FireEvent(TreeEventIds.BeforeDelete, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.DisplayPromptMsg)
			{
				string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("BeforeNodesDeletedMessage", arrayList.Count);
				DialogResult dialogResult = UltraMessageBoxManager.Show(text, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("BeforeNodesDeletedTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Question);
				if (dialogResult != DialogResult.Yes)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			for (int num = arrayList.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				((UltraTreeNode)arrayList[num]).Remove();
			}
			if (newActiveNodeAfterDeletion != null)
			{
				ActiveNode = newActiveNodeAfterDeletion;
			}
			FireEvent(TreeEventIds.AfterDelete, EventArgs.Empty);
			((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
		}

		internal UltraTreeNode GetNewActiveNodeAfterDeletion(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			return GetNewActiveNodeAfterDeletion(node, checkSelected: true);
		}

		internal UltraTreeNode GetNewActiveNodeAfterDeletion(UltraTreeNode node, bool checkSelected)
		{
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = node;
			if (node == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (checkSelected && !IsMarkedForDeletion(node))
			{
				return node;
			}
			node = node.GetActivateableSibling(NodePosition.Next);
			if (node != null && (!checkSelected || !IsMarkedForDeletion(node)))
			{
				return node;
			}
			node = ultraTreeNode;
			node = node.GetActivateableSibling(NodePosition.Previous);
			if (node != null && (!checkSelected || !IsMarkedForDeletion(node)))
			{
				return node;
			}
			node = ultraTreeNode;
			node = node.Parent;
			return GetNewActiveNodeAfterDeletion(node, checkSelected);
		}

		internal bool IsMarkedForDeletion(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			foreach (UltraTreeNode selectedNode in SelectedNodes)
			{
				if (node == selectedNode)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			while (node != null)
			{
				node = node.Parent;
				if (node != null && node.Selected)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnterElement(UIElementEventArgs e)
		{
			if (showingTipForNode == null && (ActiveNode == null || !ActiveNode.IsEditing))
			{
				UIElement val = e.Element;
				if (IsTooTipElement(val) && val.GetAncestor(typeof(NodeSelectableAreaUIElement)) is NodeSelectableAreaUIElement { Node: not null, Node: var node } nodeSelectableAreaUIElement && node.TipStyleNodeResolved != TipStyleNode.Hide)
				{
					if (UIElement != null && node.HasHotTrackingNodeAppearance)
					{
						((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements(false);
						((UIElement)UIElement).VerifyChildElements();
					}
					if (node.ShowTooltipIfNeeded())
					{
						showingTipForNode = node;
						lastTooltipNodeElementEntered = nodeSelectableAreaUIElement;
					}
				}
			}
			if (e.Element is UltraTreeUIElement)
			{
				IsMouseOverControl = true;
			}
			if (AutoScrollHorizontalResolved && e.Element is TreeNodeUIElement treeNodeUIElement && (horizontalScrollPositionTarget == int.MinValue || ScrollbarControl.HScrollPosition >= horizontalScrollPositionTarget))
			{
				treeNodeUIElement.Node.BringIntoViewHelper(includeChildNodes: false, includeHorizontal: true, includeVertical: false, leftOnly: true);
			}
			if (EventManager.CanFireEvent(TreeEventIds.MouseEnterElement))
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).OnMouseEnterElement(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeaveElement(UIElementEventArgs e)
		{
			lastTooltipNodeElementEntered = null;
			if (showingTipForNode != null && (ActiveNode == null || !ActiveNode.IsEditing))
			{
				UIElement val = e.Element;
				if (IsTooTipElement(val))
				{
					showingTipForNode = null;
					ToolTip.Hide();
				}
			}
			if (e.Element is UltraTreeUIElement)
			{
				IsMouseOverControl = false;
			}
			if (EventManager.CanFireEvent(TreeEventIds.MouseLeaveElement))
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).OnMouseLeaveElement(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (lastTooltipNodeElementEntered != null)
			{
				Point pt = ((Control)this).PointToClient(Control.MousePosition);
				if (((UIElement)lastTooltipNodeElementEntered).Rect.Contains(pt))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnMouseLeave(e);
		}

		protected override bool IsInputChar(char charCode)
		{
			if ((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Alt) == Keys.Alt)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase CellOwnerForEditModeKeyEvents(Keys keyData)
		{
			if (IsCellInEditMode)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ActiveNode;
				UltraTreeNodeColumn dataColumn = ActiveCellColumn;
				EmbeddableUIElementBase cellEmbeddableElement = ultraTreeNode.GetCellEmbeddableElement(dataColumn);
				EmbeddableEditorBase val = ((cellEmbeddableElement != null) ? cellEmbeddableElement.Editor : null);
				if (val != null && !val.CanFocus && !val.Focused)
				{
					if (keyData == Keys.None || val.IsInputKey(keyData))
					{
						return cellEmbeddableElement.Owner;
					}
					return null;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void RaiseKeyPress(KeyPressEventArgs args)
		{
			((Control)(object)this).OnKeyPress(args);
		}

		protected override void OnKeyPress(KeyPressEventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnKeyPress(e);
			if (e.Handled || (keyMessageType & KeyMessageType.Cell) == KeyMessageType.Cell || (keyMessageType & KeyMessageType.Node) == KeyMessageType.Node)
			{
				return;
			}
			EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase val = CellOwnerForEditModeKeyEvents(Keys.None);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.RaiseKeyPress(e);
				e.Handled = true;
				return;
			}
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ActiveNode;
			if (ultraTreeNode != null && ultraTreeNode.IsEditing)
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = ultraTreeNode.EditorResolved;
				if (editorResolved != null && editorResolved.IsInEditMode && !editorResolved.CanFocus && !editorResolved.Focused)
				{
					((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)EditorOwner).RaiseKeyPress(e);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			if (ActiveNode == null || ActiveNode.IsEditing || !allowKeyboardSearch)
			{
				return;
			}
			keyboardSearchString += e.KeyChar;
			ultraTreeNode = FindNodeFromActiveNode(keyboardSearchString);
			if (ultraTreeNode == null)
			{
				keyboardSearchString = e.KeyChar.ToString();
				ultraTreeNode = FindNodeFromActiveNode(keyboardSearchString);
			}
			int length = keyboardSearchString.Length;
			bool flag = true;
			if (ultraTreeNode != null && length > 1 && length <= ultraTreeNode.Text.Length && length <= ActiveNode.Text.Length)
			{
				string text = ultraTreeNode.Text.Substring(0, length).ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
				string text2 = ActiveNode.Text.Substring(0, length).ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
				if (text == text2)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			if (ultraTreeNode != null && flag)
			{
				SelectNode(ultraTreeNode, shift: false, control: false);
				ScrollNodeIntoView(ultraTreeNode, includeHorizontal: true);
			}
			if (keyboardTimer == null)
			{
				keyboardTimer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
				keyboardTimer.Enabled = false;
				keyboardTimer.Interval = keyboardSearchInterval;
				keyboardTimerTickHandler = OnKeyboardTimerTick;
				keyboardTimer.Tick += keyboardTimerTickHandler;
				keyboardTimer.Enabled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0055: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			isEditorInputKey = false;
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnKeyDown(e);
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Space)
				{
					SpecialKeys val = (SpecialKeys)0;
					if (e.Control)
					{
						val = (SpecialKeys)(val | 2);
					}
					if (e.Shift)
					{
						val = (SpecialKeys)(val | 1);
					}
					if (e.Alt)
					{
						val = (SpecialKeys)(val | 4);
					}
					KeyActionMappingBase[] actionMappings = ((KeyActionMappingsBase)KeyActionMappings).GetActionMappings(Keys.Space, (long)CurrentState, val);
					if (actionMappings != null && actionMappings.Length != 0)
					{
						e.SuppressKeyPress = true;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if ((keyMessageType & KeyMessageType.Cell) == KeyMessageType.Cell || (keyMessageType & KeyMessageType.Node) == KeyMessageType.Node)
				{
					return;
				}
				EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase val2 = CellOwnerForEditModeKeyEvents(e.KeyData);
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					isEditorInputKey = true;
					val2.RaiseKeyDown(e);
				}
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ActiveNode;
				if (ultraTreeNode != null && ultraTreeNode.IsEditing)
				{
					EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = ultraTreeNode.EditorResolved;
					if (editorResolved != null && editorResolved.IsInEditMode && !editorResolved.CanFocus && !editorResolved.Focused && editorResolved.IsInputKey(e.KeyData))
					{
						((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)EditorOwner).RaiseKeyDown(e);
						e.Handled = true;
					}
				}
				if (TreeUtils.IsControlKeyDown)
				{
					OnToggleControlKey();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyUp(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)this).OnKeyUp(e);
			if (e.Handled || (keyMessageType & KeyMessageType.Cell) == KeyMessageType.Cell || (keyMessageType & KeyMessageType.Node) == KeyMessageType.Node)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (isEditorInputKey)
			{
				EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase val = CellOwnerForEditModeKeyEvents(Keys.None);
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.RaiseKeyUp(e);
				}
			}
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ActiveNode;
			if (ultraTreeNode != null && ultraTreeNode.IsEditing)
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = ultraTreeNode.EditorResolved;
				if (editorResolved != null && editorResolved.IsInEditMode && !editorResolved.CanFocus && !editorResolved.Focused && editorResolved.IsInputKey(e.KeyData))
				{
					((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)EditorOwner).RaiseKeyUp(e);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			if (e.KeyData == Keys.ControlKey)
			{
				OnToggleControlKey();
			}
		}

		internal bool SelectNode(UltraTreeNode node, bool shift, bool control)
		{
			if (node != null)
			{
				ISelectionStrategy selectionStrategy = ((UltraControlBase)this).GetSelectionManager().GetSelectionStrategy((ISelectableItem)node);
				if (selectionStrategy != null)
				{
					if (((object)selectionStrategy).GetType() == typeof(SelectionStrategySingle) || ((object)selectionStrategy).GetType() == typeof(SelectionStrategySingleAutoDrag))
					{
						return selectionStrategy.ProcessKeyBoardItem((ISelectableItem)node, shift, control);
					}
					return selectionStrategy.ProcessKeyBoardItem((ISelectableItem)node, shift, control, control);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnDragOver(DragEventArgs drgevent)
		{
			if (HotTrackingNode != null)
			{
				HotTrackingNode = null;
			}
			if (allowAutoDragScrolling)
			{
				Rectangle displayRectangle = ((Control)(object)this).DisplayRectangle;
				Point pointToCheck = ((Control)this).PointToClient(new Point(drgevent.X, drgevent.Y));
				ScrollDragArea scrollDragArea = IsInDragScrollArea(pointToCheck);
				if (IsVerticalScrollShown)
				{
					if ((scrollDragArea & ScrollDragArea.VerticalBottom) == ScrollDragArea.VerticalBottom)
					{
						ScrollbarControl.ScrollVertical(ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement);
					}
					if ((scrollDragArea & ScrollDragArea.VerticalTop) == ScrollDragArea.VerticalTop)
					{
						ScrollbarControl.ScrollVertical(ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement);
					}
				}
				if (IsHorizontalScrollShown)
				{
					if ((scrollDragArea & ScrollDragArea.HorizontalLeft) == ScrollDragArea.HorizontalLeft)
					{
						ScrollbarControl.ScrollHorizontal(ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement);
					}
					if ((scrollDragArea & ScrollDragArea.HorizontalRight) == ScrollDragArea.HorizontalRight)
					{
						ScrollbarControl.ScrollHorizontal(ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement);
					}
				}
			}
			Point p = new Point(drgevent.X, drgevent.Y);
			p = ((Control)this).PointToClient(p);
			UltraTreeNode nodeFromPoint = GetNodeFromPoint(p);
			if (nodeFromPoint != lastHoverNode)
			{
				if (dragHoverTimer == null)
				{
					dragHoverTimer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
					dragHoverTimerTickHandler = OnDragHoverTimerTick;
					dragHoverTimer.Tick += dragHoverTimerTickHandler;
					dragHoverTimer.Interval = autoDragExpandDelay;
				}
				lastHoverNode = nodeFromPoint;
				dragHoverTimer.Enabled = true;
			}
			((Control)this).OnDragOver(drgevent);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseWheel(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)this).OnMouseWheel(e);
			HandledMouseEventArgs e2 = e as HandledMouseEventArgs;
			if (e2 != null)
			{
				if (e2.Handled)
				{
					return;
				}
				e2.Handled = true;
			}
			if (!AllVisibleNodesAreInView && (CanScrollDown || e.Delta >= 0))
			{
				int mouseWheelScrollUnits = GetMouseWheelScrollUnits(e2);
				int newValue = TopNode.VisibleIndex - mouseWheelScrollUnits;
				ScrollEventType type = ((mouseWheelScrollUnits < 0) ? ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement : ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement);
				ScrollEventArgs arg = new ScrollEventArgs(type, newValue);
				ScrollbarControl.OnVerticalScroll(null, arg);
			}
		}

		private int GetMouseWheelScrollUnits(HandledMouseEventArgs args)
		{
			if (args == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int mouseWheelScrollDelta = SystemInformation.MouseWheelScrollDelta;
			int delta = args.Delta;
			int num = Math.Sign(delta);
			if (Math.Sign(mouseWheelBuffer) != num)
			{
				mouseWheelBuffer = 0;
			}
			int result = 0;
			int num2 = Math.DivRem(delta, mouseWheelScrollDelta, out result);
			result += mouseWheelBuffer;
			if (Math.Abs(result) >= mouseWheelScrollDelta)
			{
				num2 += num;
				result -= mouseWheelScrollDelta * num;
			}
			mouseWheelBuffer = result;
			if (mouseWheelBuffer != 0 && num2 == 0)
			{
				args.Handled = true;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		protected override void OnResize(EventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnResize(e);
			OnResizeHelper();
		}

		private void OnResizeHelper()
		{
			if (IsViewStyleOutlookExpress && ColumnSettings.SettingsResolved.AutoFitColumns)
			{
				BumpMetricsVersion();
			}
			ScrollbarControl.SetVScrollbarDirty(dirty: true);
			ScrollbarControl.SetHScrollbarDirty(dirty: true);
			if (initializing)
			{
				return;
			}
			VisibleNodesManager.DirtyMaxTopNodeVisibleIndex();
			ScrollbarControl.RecalcHScroll();
			ScrollbarControl.RecalcVScroll();
			bool allVisibleNodesAreInView = AllVisibleNodesAreInView;
			if (VisibleNodesArray.Count > 0)
			{
				if (allVisibleNodesAreInView)
				{
					TopNode = VisibleNodesArray[0] as UltraTreeNode;
				}
				else
				{
					VisibleNodesManager.VerifyScrollBoundsForTopNode();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsPointDesignTimeActive(Point pt)
		{
			for (UIElement val = ((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).ElementFromPoint(pt); val != null; val = val.Parent)
			{
				if (val is ExpansionIndicatorUIElement || val is OptionButtonUIElement || val is CheckBoxUIElement || val is UltraTreeNodeColumnHeaderUIElement)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (val is UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement && ((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).AdjustableElementFromPoint(pt, (UIElementInputType)4) is UltraTreeNodeCellUIElement)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return ((UltraControlBase)this).IsPointDesignTimeActive(pt);
		}

		public void ResetExpansionIndicator()
		{
			ResetExpansionIndicator(Nodes, resetAllDescendants: true);
		}

		public void ResetExpansionIndicator(int level)
		{
			if (level < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_29"));
			}
			int count = Nodes.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = nodes[i];
				if (level > 0)
				{
					ultraTreeNode.ResetForceSuppresionOfExpansionIndicator(level);
				}
				else
				{
					ultraTreeNode.ForceSuppresionOfExpansionIndicator = false;
				}
			}
			((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
		}

		public void ResetExpansionIndicator(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_30"));
			}
			node.ForceSuppresionOfExpansionIndicator = false;
			((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
		}

		public void ResetExpansionIndicator(TreeNodesCollection nodesCollection, bool resetAllDescendants)
		{
			if (nodesCollection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_31"));
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < nodesCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = nodesCollection[i];
				if (resetAllDescendants)
				{
					ultraTreeNode.ResetForceSuppresionOfExpansionIndicator();
				}
				else
				{
					ultraTreeNode.ForceSuppresionOfExpansionIndicator = false;
				}
			}
			((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
		}

		private void OnKeyboardTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			keyboardTimer.Enabled = false;
			keyboardTimer.Tick -= keyboardTimerTickHandler;
			keyboardTimer = null;
			keyboardSearchString = "";
		}

		private void OnDragHoverTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			dragHoverTimer.Enabled = false;
			dragHoverTimer.Tick -= dragHoverTimerTickHandler;
			dragHoverTimerTickHandler = null;
			dragHoverTimer = null;
			if (dragInProgress || isInExternalDragDropOperation)
			{
				Point position = Cursor.Position;
				position = ((Control)this).PointToClient(position);
				UltraTreeNode nodeFromPoint = GetNodeFromPoint(position);
				if ((!IsVerticalScrollShown || IsInDragScrollArea(position) == ScrollDragArea.None) && nodeFromPoint != null && nodeFromPoint == lastHoverNode && nodeFromPoint.ShouldExpandOnHover())
				{
					nodeFromPoint.Expanded = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private ScrollDragArea IsInDragScrollArea(Point pointToCheck)
		{
			ScrollDragArea scrollDragArea = ScrollDragArea.None;
			Rectangle displayRectangle = ((Control)(object)this).DisplayRectangle;
			if (!displayRectangle.Contains(pointToCheck))
			{
				return ScrollDragArea.None;
			}
			if (pointToCheck.Y > displayRectangle.Bottom - 15)
			{
				scrollDragArea |= ScrollDragArea.VerticalBottom;
			}
			if (pointToCheck.Y < displayRectangle.Top + 15)
			{
				scrollDragArea |= ScrollDragArea.VerticalTop;
			}
			if (pointToCheck.X < displayRectangle.Left + 15)
			{
				scrollDragArea |= ScrollDragArea.HorizontalLeft;
			}
			if (pointToCheck.X > displayRectangle.Right - 15)
			{
				scrollDragArea |= ScrollDragArea.HorizontalRight;
			}
			return scrollDragArea;
		}

			horizontal = ScrollBarLook.GetHorizontalScrollBarHeightResolved((Control)(object)this, scrollBarLookIfAllocated, ((UltraControlBase)this).ComponentRole);
		}

		internal static void ApplyTransparentColor(ImageUIElement imageElement, Color transparentColor)
		{
			if (transparentColor != Color.Transparent)
			{
				ColorMap[] array = new ColorMap[1]
				{
					new ColorMap()
				};
				array[0].NewColor = Color.Transparent;
				array[0].OldColor = transparentColor;
				((ImageUIElementBase)imageElement).ColorMaps = array;
			}
		}

		internal int GetOverallTop(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (node.cachedOverallTop != -1)
			{
				return node.cachedOverallTop;
			}
			ArrayList visibleNodes = VisibleNodesManager.VisibleNodes;
			int num = 0;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = visibleNodes.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = visibleNodes[i] as UltraTreeNode;
				ultraTreeNode.cachedOverallTop = num;
				int num2 = ultraTreeNode.NodeSpacingBeforeResolved + ultraTreeNode.ItemHeightResolved + ultraTreeNode.NodeSpacingAfterResolved;
				num += num2;
			}
			return node.cachedOverallTop;
		}

		private void DoVerticalScroll(ScrollEventArgs arg, UltraTreeNode prevTopNode, int prevScrollPos)
		{
			if (arg.NewValue == prevScrollPos)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!CanOptimizeVerticalScroll)
			{
				((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				return;
			}
			switch (arg.Type)
			{
			case ScrollEventType.ThumbPosition:
			case ScrollEventType.EndScroll:
				return;
			case ScrollEventType.First:
			case ScrollEventType.Last:
				((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				return;
			}
			bool flag = arg.NewValue > prevScrollPos && arg.NewValue >= VisibleNodesArray.Count - ScrollbarControl.LargeVerticalChange - 2;
			bool flag2 = arg.NewValue < prevScrollPos && arg.NewValue <= ScrollbarControl.LargeVerticalChange + 2;
			if ((flag && arg.NewValue > prevScrollPos) || (flag2 && arg.NewValue < prevScrollPos))
			{
				((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				return;
			}
			if (prevTopNode == null)
			{
				prevTopNode = VisibleNodesArray[0] as UltraTreeNode;
			}
			((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements(false);
			((UltraControlBase)this).Update();
			Rectangle rectangleForZoomFactor = Utilities.GetRectangleForZoomFactor(ViewableArea, ((UltraControlBase)this).ZoomFactor, false);
			Rectangle a = rectangleForZoomFactor;
			Rectangle rectangle = default(Rectangle);
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = null;
			if (arg.NewValue > prevScrollPos)
			{
				for (int i = prevScrollPos; i < arg.NewValue; i++)
				{
					ultraTreeNode = VisibleNodesArray[i] as UltraTreeNode;
					num2 += ultraTreeNode.ItemHeightResolvedWithSpacing;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int j = arg.NewValue; j < prevScrollPos; j++)
				{
					ultraTreeNode = VisibleNodesArray[j] as UltraTreeNode;
					num2 += ultraTreeNode.ItemHeightResolvedWithSpacing;
				}
			}
			num = Utilities.GetZoomedValue(num2, ((UltraControlBase)this).ZoomFactor, false);
			num = ((arg.NewValue <= prevScrollPos) ? num : (num *= -1));
			a.Offset(0, num);
			a = Rectangle.Intersect(a, rectangleForZoomFactor);
			((UltraControlBase)this).ScrollControl(0, num, rectangleForZoomFactor, a, ref rectangle, true, true, true, (short)0);
			((UltraControlBase)this).Invalidate(rectangleForZoomFactor);
			((UltraControlBase)this).Update();
		}

		public bool CopySelectedNodes()
		{
			return CopySelectedNodesHelper(allowExceptions: true, honorAllowCopy: false);
		}

		private bool CopySelectedNodesHelper(bool allowExceptions, bool honorAllowCopy)
		{
			if (selectedNodes == null || selectedNodes.Count < 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(5);
			for (int i = 0; i < selectedNodes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!honorAllowCopy)
				{
					selectedNodes[i].VerifyCanCutCopyOrPaste();
				}
				if (!honorAllowCopy || selectedNodes[i].AllowCopyResolved)
				{
					arrayList.Add(selectedNodes[i]);
				}
			}
			if (arrayList.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SelectedNodesCollection selectedNodesCollection = new SelectedNodesCollection(cloned: true);
			selectedNodesCollection.AddNodes(arrayList);
			selectedNodesCollection.SortByPosition();
			BeforeCopyEventArgs e = new BeforeCopyEventArgs(selectedNodesCollection);
			FireEvent(TreeEventIds.BeforeCopy, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = false;
			try
			{
				result = selectedNodesCollection.CopyToClipboard();
			}
			catch
			{
				if (allowExceptions)
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
			FireEvent(TreeEventIds.AfterCopy, new AfterCopyEventArgs(selectedNodesCollection));
			return result;
		}

		private int GetNodeCollectionNextIndex(UltraTreeNode parentNode)
		{
			if (parentNode == null)
			{
				return Nodes.Count;
			}
			if (!parentNode.HasNodes)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return parentNode.Nodes.Count;
		}

		public bool PasteNodes(UltraTreeNode parentNode, int index)
		{
			if (parentNode != null && parentNode.Control != this)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V3_Exception_46"));
			}
			VerifyCanCutCopyOrPaste(parentNode);
			SelectedNodesCollection selectedNodesCollection = new SelectedNodesCollection(cloned: true);
			Exception ex = null;
			try
			{
				TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection = null;
				try
				{
					IDataObject dataObject = Clipboard.GetDataObject();
					if (dataObject != null && dataObject.GetDataPresent(typeof(TreeNodesCollection)))
					{
						treeNodesCollection = dataObject.GetData(typeof(TreeNodesCollection)) as TreeNodesCollection;
						if (treeNodesCollection != null)
						{
							selectedNodesCollection.InternalAddRange(treeNodesCollection.All);
							selectedNodesCollection.Tag = treeNodesCollection.Tag;
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					ex = ex2;
					return false;
				}
				BeforePasteEventArgs e = new BeforePasteEventArgs(selectedNodesCollection, parentNode, index);
				FireEvent(TreeEventIds.BeforePaste, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return false;
				}
				parentNode = e.ParentNode;
				index = e.Index;
				try
				{
					TreeNodesCollection.ValidateChildKeysDontExist(treeNodesCollection, this);
					TreeNodesCollection treeNodesCollection2 = ((parentNode == null) ? Nodes : parentNode.Nodes);
					if (treeNodesCollection != null)
					{
						treeNodesCollection2.PasteNodes(index, treeNodesCollection.All);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex3)
				{
					ex = ex3;
					return false;
				}
				AfterPasteEventArgs e2 = new AfterPasteEventArgs(selectedNodesCollection);
				FireEvent(TreeEventIds.AfterPaste, e2);
				if (e2.SelectPastedNodes)
				{
					SelectNewSelection(selectedNodesCollection);
				}
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (ex != null)
				{
					PasteErrorEventArgs e3 = new PasteErrorEventArgs(selectedNodesCollection, ex);
					FireEvent(TreeEventIds.PasteError, e3);
					if (e3.DisplayErrorMessage)
					{
						string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PasteErrorMessage", ex.Message);
						string text2 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PasteErrorMessageCaption");
						UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text, text2, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public bool PasteNodes(UltraTreeNode relativeNode, NodePosition relativePosition)
		{

				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V3_Exception_47"));

			if (relativeNode.Control != this)

				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V3_Exception_48"));
			}
			int index = -1;
			switch (relativePosition)
			{
			case NodePosition.First:
				index = 0;
				break;
			case NodePosition.Last:
				index = GetNodeCollectionNextIndex(relativeNode.Parent);
				break;
			case NodePosition.Next:
				index = relativeNode.Index + 1;
				break;
			case NodePosition.Previous:
				index = relativeNode.Index;
				break;
			}
			return PasteNodes(relativeNode.Parent, index);
		}

		internal bool OnCommitCellValue(CellValueCommittedEventType eventType)
		{
			try
			{
				UpdateMode updateMode = UpdateMode;
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				switch (eventType)
				{
				case CellValueCommittedEventType.CellDeactivated:
					if (updateMode == UpdateMode.OnActiveCellChange || updateMode == UpdateMode.OnActiveCellChangeOrLostFocus)
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
					break;
				case CellValueCommittedEventType.NodeDeactivated:
					if (updateMode == UpdateMode.OnActiveNodeChange || updateMode == UpdateMode.OnActiveNodeChangeOrLostFocus)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					break;
				case CellValueCommittedEventType.LostFocus:
					switch (updateMode)
					{
					case UpdateMode.OnActiveNodeChangeOrLostFocus:
						flag = true;
						break;
					case UpdateMode.OnActiveCellChangeOrLostFocus:
						flag2 = true;
						break;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (!flag && !flag2)
				{
					return true;
				}
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ActiveNode;
				if (ultraTreeNode != null)
				{
					bool result = false;

		private void ClearBitmapCache()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				if (cachedBitmaps[i] != null)
				{
					cachedBitmaps[i].Dispose();
					cachedBitmaps[i] = null;
				}
				if (cachedBitmapStreams[i] != null)
				{
					cachedBitmapStreams[i].Close();
					cachedBitmapStreams[i] = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private Image GetCachedBitmap(CachedBitmapIndex index)
		{
			if (cachedBitmaps[(int)index] == null)
			{
				string name;
				switch (index)
				{
				case CachedBitmapIndex.WindowsVistaExpansionIndicatorCollapsed:
					name = "Images.WindowsVistaExpansionIndicatorCollapsed.png";
					break;
				case CachedBitmapIndex.WindowsVistaExpansionIndicatorCollapsedHotTracked:
					name = "Images.WindowsVistaExpansionIndicatorCollapsedHotTracked.png";
					break;
				case CachedBitmapIndex.WindowsVistaExpansionIndicatorExpanded:
					name = "Images.WindowsVistaExpansionIndicatorExpanded.png";
					break;
				case CachedBitmapIndex.WindowsVistaExpansionIndicatorExpandedHotTracked:
					name = "Images.WindowsVistaExpansionIndicatorExpandedHotTracked.png";
					break;
				default:
					return null;
				}
				Type typeFromHandle = typeof(UltraTree);
				cachedBitmapStreams[(int)index] = typeFromHandle.Module.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(typeFromHandle, name);
				Stream stream = cachedBitmapStreams[(int)index];
				if (stream != null)
				{
					cachedBitmaps[(int)index] = Image.FromStream(stream);
				}
			}
			return cachedBitmaps[(int)index];
		}

		private void RefreshExpansionIndicators()
		{
			switch (HideExpansionIndicatorsResolved)
			{
			case HideExpansionIndicators.Never:
				expansionIndicatorAlphaTarget = 255;
				break;
			case HideExpansionIndicators.OnLostFocus:
				expansionIndicatorAlphaTarget = (short)(((Control)(object)this).Focused ? 255 : 0);
				break;
			case HideExpansionIndicators.OnMouseLeave:
				expansionIndicatorAlphaTarget = (short)(IsMouseOverControl ? 255 : 0);
				break;
			case HideExpansionIndicators.OnLostFocusAndNotMouseOver:
				expansionIndicatorAlphaTarget = (short)((IsMouseOverControl || ((Control)(object)this).Focused) ? 255 : 0);
				break;
			default:
				expansionIndicatorAlphaTarget = 255;
				break;
			}
			StartExpansionIndicatorAlphaAnimationTimer();
			((UltraControlBase)this).Invalidate();
		}

		private void StartExpansionIndicatorAlphaAnimationTimer()
		{
			StopExpansionIndicatorAlphaAnimationTimer();
			if (expansionIndicatorAlpha != expansionIndicatorAlphaTarget)
			{
				BuildExpansionIndicatorUIElementList();
				ExpansionIndicatorAnimationTimer.Start();
			}
		}

		private void StopExpansionIndicatorAlphaAnimationTimer()
		{
			if (expansionIndicatorAnimationTimer != null)
			{
				expansionIndicatorAnimationTimer.Stop();
			}
			if (expansionIndicatorUIElementList != null)
			{
				expansionIndicatorUIElementList = null;
			}
		}

		internal void StartHorizontalScrollAnimationTimer(int horizontalScrollPositionTarget)
		{
			if (horizontalScrollPositionTarget < ScrollbarControl.HorizontalScroll.Minimum)
			{
				horizontalScrollPositionTarget = ScrollbarControl.HorizontalScroll.Minimum;
			}
			if (horizontalScrollPositionTarget > ScrollbarControl.HorizontalScroll.Maximum)
			{
				horizontalScrollPositionTarget = ScrollbarControl.HorizontalScroll.Maximum;
			}
			if (this.horizontalScrollPositionTarget != horizontalScrollPositionTarget)
			{
				this.horizontalScrollPositionTarget = horizontalScrollPositionTarget;
				if (ScrollbarControl.HScrollPosition == this.horizontalScrollPositionTarget)
				{
					this.horizontalScrollPositionTarget = int.MinValue;
				}
				if (this.horizontalScrollPositionTarget != int.MinValue)
				{
					HorizontalScrollAnimationTimer.Start();
				}
			}
		}

		private void StopHorizontalScrollAnimationTimer()
		{
			if (horizontalScrollAnimationTimer != null)
			{
				horizontalScrollAnimationTimer.Stop();
				horizontalScrollPositionTarget = int.MinValue;
			}
		}

		internal void StartMouseTimer(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (timerNode != null && timerNode.Target is UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode)
			{
				ultraTreeNode.StopMouseTimer();
			}
			timerNode = new WeakReference(node);
			System.Windows.Forms.Timer timer = MouseDownTimer;
			timer.Tick += node.Mouseup_Timer;
			timer.Interval = 400;
			timer.Start();
		}

		internal void StopMouseTimer(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (timerNode != null && node != null && node == timerNode.Target)
			{
				timerNode = null;
				System.Windows.Forms.Timer timer = MouseDownTimer;
				timer.Stop();
				timer.Tick -= node.Mouseup_Timer;
			}
		}

		private bool IsTooTipElement(UIElement element)
		{
			switch (DisplayStyleResolved)
			{
			case UltraTreeDisplayStyle.Standard:
				if (!(element is NodeTextUIElement))
				{
					return element is EmbeddableUIElementBase;
				}
				return true;
			case UltraTreeDisplayStyle.WindowsVista:
				if (!(element is NodeSelectableAreaUIElement))
				{
					return element is EmbeddableUIElementBase;
				}
				return true;
			default:
				if (!(element is NodeTextUIElement))
				{
					return element is EmbeddableUIElementBase;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private void expansionIndicatorAnimationTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (expansionIndicatorAlpha > expansionIndicatorAlphaTarget)
			{
				expansionIndicatorAlpha -= 15;
			}
			else
			{
				expansionIndicatorAlpha += 60;
			}
			expansionIndicatorAlpha = Math.Min(Math.Max(expansionIndicatorAlpha, (short)0), (short)255);
			InvalidateExpansionIndicators();
			if (expansionIndicatorAlpha == expansionIndicatorAlphaTarget)
			{
				StopExpansionIndicatorAlphaAnimationTimer();
			}
		}

		private void horizontalScrollAnimationTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (horizontalScrollPositionTarget == int.MinValue)
			{
				StopHorizontalScrollAnimationTimer();
				return;
			}
			int num = horizontalScrollPositionTarget - scrollbarControl.HScrollPosition;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				StopHorizontalScrollAnimationTimer();
				return;
			}
			int num2 = ((num >= 0) ? 1 : (-1));
			int num3 = Math.Min(6, Math.Abs(num)) * num2;
			int num4 = ScrollbarControl.HScrollPosition + num3;
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				if (num4 < horizontalScrollPositionTarget)
				{
					horizontalScrollPositionTarget = num4;
				}
				num4 = Math.Max(ScrollbarControl.HorizontalScroll.Minimum, num4);
			}
			else
			{
				if (num4 > horizontalScrollPositionTarget)
				{
					horizontalScrollPositionTarget = num4;
				}
				num4 = Math.Min(ScrollbarControl.HorizontalScroll.Maximum, num4);
			}
			scrollbarControl.HScrollPosition = num4;
			if (horizontalScrollPositionTarget == scrollbarControl.HScrollPosition || scrollbarControl.HScrollPosition != num4)
			{
				StopHorizontalScrollAnimationTimer();
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessKeyMessage(KeyMessageType keyMessageType, EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			bool flag = (keyMessageType & KeyMessageType.KeyDown) == KeyMessageType.KeyDown;
			bool flag2 = (keyMessageType & KeyMessageType.KeyPress) == KeyMessageType.KeyPress;
			bool flag3 = (keyMessageType & KeyMessageType.KeyUp) == KeyMessageType.KeyUp;
			try
			{
				this.keyMessageType = keyMessageType;
				if (flag)
				{
					((Control)(object)this).OnKeyDown(eventArgs as KeyEventArgs);
				}
				else if (flag2)
				{
					((Control)(object)this).OnKeyPress(eventArgs as KeyPressEventArgs);
				}
				else if (flag3)
				{
					((Control)(object)this).OnKeyUp(eventArgs as KeyEventArgs);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				this.keyMessageType = KeyMessageType.None;
			}
		}

		private void VerifyPendingBringIntoViewInfo()
		{

		}

		internal static void GetAllNodesCollections(ref ArrayList list, TreeNodesCollection startingCollection, bool includeCollapsed)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				list = new ArrayList();
			}
			if (startingCollection == null || startingCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			list.Add(startingCollection);
			foreach (UltraTreeNode item in startingCollection)
			{
				if (item.HasVisibleNodes && (item.Expanded || includeCollapsed))
				{
					GetAllNodesCollections(ref list, item.Nodes, includeCollapsed);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DirtyChildElementRecursive(UIElement element)
		{
			element.DirtyChildElements();
			UIElementEnumerator enumerator = element.ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
					DirtyChildElementRecursive(current);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		int IGestureConsumer.ConvertItemsToScrollUnits(UIElement containerElement, Orientation orientation, int items)
		{
			if (containerElement == null)
			{
				return items;
			}
			int num = ((orientation != Orientation.Horizontal) ? 1 : 4);
			return items / num;
		}

		int IGestureConsumer.ConvertPixelsToScrollUnits(UIElement containerElement, Orientation orientation, int pixels)
		{
			if (containerElement == null)
			{
				return pixels;
			}
			if (orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return pixels / 2;
			}
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = TopNode;
			if (ultraTreeNode == null)
			{
				return pixels;
			}
			int height = ultraTreeNode.Size.Height;
			height = Math.Max(height, 1);
			return pixels / height;
		}

			{
				if (((IScrollableControl)((UIElement)this).Control).IsScrollShown(ScrollBarType.vertical))
				{
					rectInsideBorders.Width -= ((UltraTree)(object)((UIElement)this).Control).ScrollbarControl.VScrollRect.Width;
				}
				if (((IScrollableControl)((UIElement)this).Control).IsScrollShown(ScrollBarType.horizontal))
				{
					rectInsideBorders.Height -= ((UltraTree)(object)((UIElement)this).Control).ScrollbarControl.HScrollRect.Height;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			UltraTree ultraTree = ((UIElement)this).Control as UltraTree;
			if (ultraTree.ColumnSettings.SettingsResolved.HasSeparateHeaderAreaInOutlookExpressViewStyle)
			{
				UltraTreeColumnSet outlookExpressDisplayColumnSet = ultraTree.ColumnSettings.OutlookExpressDisplayColumnSet;
				if (outlookExpressDisplayColumnSet != null)
				{
					ColumnHeaderAreaUIElement columnHeaderAreaUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(ColumnHeaderAreaUIElement), true) as ColumnHeaderAreaUIElement;

					}
					ColumnSetLayoutManager layoutManager = outlookExpressDisplayColumnSet.LayoutManager;
					Size headerAreaSize = layoutManager.HeaderAreaSize;
					int num = rectInsideBorders.Left - ultraTree.GetScrollPosition(ScrollBarType.horizontal);
					Rectangle rectInsideBorders2 = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
					headerAreaSize.Width = Math.Min(headerAreaSize.Width, rectInsideBorders2.Width - num);
					((UIElement)columnHeaderAreaUIElement).Rect = new Rectangle(new Point(num, rectInsideBorders.Top), headerAreaSize);
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)columnHeaderAreaUIElement);
					rectInsideBorders.Y += headerAreaSize.Height;
					rectInsideBorders.Height -= headerAreaSize.Height;
				}
			}
			((UIElement)nodeClientAreaUIElement).Rect = rectInsideBorders;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)nodeClientAreaUIElement);
			((UIElement)nodeClientAreaUIElement).VerifyChildElements();
			ScrollBarViewStyle viewStyle = (ScrollBarViewStyle)(TreeControl.DisplayStyleResolved switch
			{
				UltraTreeDisplayStyle.WindowsVista => 4, 
				UltraTreeDisplayStyle.Standard => 0, 
				_ => 0, 
			});
			TreeControl.ScrollbarControl.VerticalScroll.ViewStyle = viewStyle;
			TreeControl.ScrollbarControl.HorizontalScroll.ViewStyle = viewStyle;
			if (((IScrollableControl)((UIElement)this).Control).IsScrollShown(ScrollBarType.vertical))
			{

				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)verticalScrollbarUIElement);
				treeControl.ShowScrollBar(ScrollBarType.vertical, show: true);
			}
			else
			{
				treeControl.ShowScrollBar(ScrollBarType.vertical, show: false);
				((VerticalScrollbarUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(VerticalScrollbarUIElement), true))?.ResetScrollInfo();
			}
			if (((IScrollableControl)((UIElement)this).Control).IsScrollShown(ScrollBarType.horizontal))
			{
				HorizontalScrollbarUIElement horizontalScrollbarUIElement = (HorizontalScrollbarUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(HorizontalScrollbarUIElement), true);
				if (horizontalScrollbarUIElement == null)

			else
			{
