				((HorizontalScrollbarUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(HorizontalScrollbarUIElement), true))?.ResetScrollInfo();
			}
			if (treeControl.ScrollbarControl.ShowIntersectionElement)

		{
			int num = treeControl.ScrollbarControl.HScrollPosition + delta;
			ScrollBarInfo horizontalScroll = treeControl.ScrollbarControl.HorizontalScroll;
			if (num > horizontalScroll.MaximumDragValue)
			{
				num = horizontalScroll.MaximumDragValue;
			}
			else if (num < 0)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			if (num != treeControl.ScrollbarControl.HScrollPosition)
			{
				treeControl.ScrollbarControl.HScrollPosition = num;
				ScrollEventType type = ((delta > 0) ? ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement : ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement);
				ScrollEventArgs arg = new ScrollEventArgs(type, num);
				treeControl.ScrollbarControl.OnHorizontalScroll(null, arg);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMousePanVertical(int delta)
		{
			int num = delta / 12;
			int num2 = treeControl.TopNode.VisibleIndex + num;
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				num2 = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				int maxTopNodeVisibleIndex = treeControl.VisibleNodesManager.MaxTopNodeVisibleIndex;
				if (num2 > maxTopNodeVisibleIndex)
				{
					num2 = maxTopNodeVisibleIndex;
				}
			}
			if (num2 != treeControl.TopNode.VisibleIndex)
			{
				ScrollEventType type = ((num > 0) ? ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement : ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement);
				ScrollEventArgs arg = new ScrollEventArgs(type, num2);
				treeControl.ScrollbarControl.OnVerticalScroll(null, arg);
			}
		}

	internal class VisibleNodesManager
	{
		private UltraTree treeControl;

		private ArrayList visibleNodes;

		private bool isDirty;

		private Size scrollSize = new Size(0, 0);

		private bool isScrollSizeDirty;

		private bool isInReinitialize;

		private int maxTopNodeVisibleIndex = -1;

		private bool isInRecalculateScrollSize;

		private Dictionary<UltraTreeNode, int> flatList;

		internal ArrayList VisibleNodes
		{
			get
			{
				if (visibleNodes == null)
				{
					visibleNodes = new ArrayList(TotalNodeCount + 500);
				}
				if (isDirty)
				{
					isDirty = false;
					Reinitialize();
					treeControl.VerticalPositionVersion++;
				}
				return visibleNodes;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsDirty
		{
			get
			{
				return isDirty;
			}
			set
			{
				MarkDirty(value, collectionChanged: false);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsScrollSizeDirty
		{
			get
			{
				return isScrollSizeDirty;
			}
			set
			{
				isScrollSizeDirty = value;
			}
		}

		internal int TotalNodeCount
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				TreeNodesCollection nodes = treeControl.Nodes;
				int count = nodes.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					num += GetNumberOfDescendants(nodes.GetNodeWithoutVerification(i));
				}
				return num + count;
			}
		}

		internal Size ScrollSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (isScrollSizeDirty)
				{
					RecalulateScrollSize();
				}
				return scrollSize;
			}
		}

		internal int MaxTopNodeVisibleIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (VisibleNodes.Count == 0)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (treeControl.ScrollBoundsResolved == ScrollBounds.ScrollToLastItem)
				{
					return VisibleNodes.Count - 1;
				}
				if (maxTopNodeVisibleIndex == -1)
				{
					maxTopNodeVisibleIndex = CalculateMaxTopNodeVisibleIndex();
				}
				return maxTopNodeVisibleIndex;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsInitializing => isInReinitialize;

		private bool IsUpdating => ((UltraControlBase)treeControl).IsUpdating;

		private Dictionary<UltraTreeNode, int> FlatList
		{
			get
			{
				if (flatList == null)
				{
					int capacity = ((visibleNodes != null) ? visibleNodes.Count : 0);
					flatList = new Dictionary<UltraTreeNode, int>(capacity);
					PopulateFlatList(treeControl.Nodes, ref flatList);
				}
				return flatList;
			}
		}

		internal VisibleNodesManager(UltraTree treeControl)
		{
			this.treeControl = treeControl;
		}

		internal void Reinitialize()
		{
			if (IsUpdating || isInReinitialize)
			{
				return;
			}
			isInReinitialize = true;
			ArrayList arrayList = VisibleNodes;
			try
			{
				arrayList.Clear();
				DrawUtility.BeginGraphicsCaching();
				try
				{
					UltraTreeNode topNode = treeControl.TopNode;
					int topNodeVisibleIndex = -1;
					TreeNodesCollection nodes = treeControl.Nodes;
					int count = nodes.Count;
					bool isViewStyleStandard = treeControl.IsViewStyleStandard;
					bool isViewStyleOutlookExpress = treeControl.IsViewStyleOutlookExpress;
					for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
					{
						UltraTreeNode nodeWithoutVerification = nodes.GetNodeWithoutVerification(i);
						if (!nodeWithoutVerification.VisibleResolved)
						{
							nodeWithoutVerification.VisibleIndex = -1;
						}
						else
						{
							int num = (nodeWithoutVerification.VisibleIndex = arrayList.Add(nodeWithoutVerification));
							if (nodeWithoutVerification == topNode)
							{
								topNodeVisibleIndex = num;
							}
						}
						if (nodeWithoutVerification.HasNodes)
						{
							ProcessDescendantNodes(nodeWithoutVerification, topNode, ref topNodeVisibleIndex);
						}
					}
					IsScrollSizeDirty = true;
					scrollSize = Size.Empty;
					RecalulateScrollSize(isInReinitialize: false, isInRecalculateScrollSize: false);
					DirtyScrollbars();
					VerifyTopNode(topNodeVisibleIndex);
					treeControl.AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.Reorder, -1);
				}
				finally
				{
					DrawUtility.EndGraphicsCaching();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isInReinitialize = false;
				maxTopNodeVisibleIndex = -1;
				isScrollSizeDirty = true;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessDescendantNodes(UltraTreeNode node, UltraTreeNode topNode, ref int topNodeVisibleIndex)
		{
			if (!node.HasNodes)
			{
				return;
			}
			TreeNodesCollection nodes = node.Nodes;
			int count = nodes.Count;
			bool isViewStyleStandard = treeControl.IsViewStyleStandard;
			bool isViewStyleOutlookExpress = treeControl.IsViewStyleOutlookExpress;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode nodeWithoutVerification = nodes.GetNodeWithoutVerification(i);
				if (IsNodeViewable(nodeWithoutVerification))
				{
					int num = (nodeWithoutVerification.VisibleIndex = VisibleNodes.Add(nodeWithoutVerification));
					if (nodeWithoutVerification == topNode)
					{
						topNodeVisibleIndex = num;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					nodeWithoutVerification.VisibleIndex = -1;
				}
				if (nodeWithoutVerification.HasNodes)
				{
					ProcessDescendantNodes(nodeWithoutVerification, topNode, ref topNodeVisibleIndex);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyTopNode(int oldVisibleIndex)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = VisibleNodes;
			if (treeControl.AllVisibleNodesAreInView)
			{
				oldVisibleIndex = ((arrayList.Count <= 0) ? (-1) : 0);
			}
			oldVisibleIndex = Math.Min(oldVisibleIndex, arrayList.Count - 1);
			treeControl.InternalTopNode = ((oldVisibleIndex < 0) ? null : (arrayList[oldVisibleIndex] as UltraTreeNode));
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = treeControl.InternalTopNode;
			while (ultraTreeNode != null && !ultraTreeNode.VisibleResolved)
			{
				ultraTreeNode = ultraTreeNode.Parent;
			}
			treeControl.InternalTopNode = ultraTreeNode;
			VerifyScrollBoundsForTopNode();
		}

		internal void MarkDirty(bool value, bool collectionChanged)
		{
			isDirty = value;
			if (collectionChanged)
			{
				flatList = null;
			}
		}

		private void RecalulateScrollSize()
		{
			RecalulateScrollSize(isInReinitialize, isInRecalculateScrollSize);
		}

		private void RecalulateScrollSize(bool isInReinitialize, bool isInRecalculateScrollSize)
		{
			if (isInRecalculateScrollSize)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = this.isInRecalculateScrollSize;
			if (isInReinitialize || !isScrollSizeDirty)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				this.isInRecalculateScrollSize = true;
				isScrollSizeDirty = false;
				ArrayList arrayList = VisibleNodes;
				isScrollSizeDirty = false;
				scrollSize = Size.Empty;
				bool isViewStyleStandard = treeControl.IsViewStyleStandard;
				bool isViewStyleOutlookExpress = treeControl.IsViewStyleOutlookExpress;
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = null;
				for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
				{
					ultraTreeNode = arrayList[i] as UltraTreeNode;
					scrollSize.Height += ultraTreeNode.ItemHeightResolvedWithSpacing;
					scrollSize.Width = Math.Max(ScrollSize.Width, ultraTreeNode.Size.Width + ultraTreeNode.OverallLeft);
					if (!isViewStyleStandard && !isViewStyleOutlookExpress && ultraTreeNode.DisplaysHeaderAreaHelper(0))
					{
						scrollSize.Height += ultraTreeNode.DisplayColumnSetResolved.LayoutManager.HeaderAreaSize.Height;
					}
				}
				Size size = scrollSize;
				treeControl.ScrollbarControl.SetHScrollbarDirty(dirty: true);
				treeControl.ScrollbarControl.SetVScrollbarDirty(dirty: true);
				treeControl.ScrollbarControl.RecalcHScroll();
				treeControl.ScrollbarControl.RecalcVScroll();
				scrollSize = size;
			}
			finally
			{
				this.isInRecalculateScrollSize = flag;
				isScrollSizeDirty = false;
			}
		}

		private int GetNumberOfDescendants(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (!node.HasNodes)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int count = node.Nodes.Count;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				num += GetNumberOfDescendants(node.Nodes.GetNodeWithoutVerification(i));
			}
			return num + count;
		}

		internal bool IsNodeViewable(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (node == null || !node.VisibleResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (node.Parent == null)
			{
				return node.VisibleResolved;
			}
			for (UltraTreeNode parent = node.Parent; parent != null; parent = parent.Parent)
			{
				if (!parent.Expanded || !parent.VisibleResolved)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void GetViewableDescendantNodes(UltraTreeNode node, ref ArrayList list)
		{
			if (!node.HasNodes)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = node.Nodes.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode nodeWithoutVerification = node.Nodes.GetNodeWithoutVerification(i);
				if (IsNodeViewable(nodeWithoutVerification))
				{
					list.Add(nodeWithoutVerification);
					scrollSize.Height += nodeWithoutVerification.ItemHeightResolvedWithSpacing;
					scrollSize.Width = Math.Max(scrollSize.Width, nodeWithoutVerification.Size.Width + nodeWithoutVerification.OverallLeft);
				}
				else
				{
					nodeWithoutVerification.VisibleIndex = -1;
				}
				if (nodeWithoutVerification.HasNodes)
				{
					GetViewableDescendantNodes(nodeWithoutVerification, ref list);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessExpandedStateChanged(UltraTreeNode node, bool expand)
		{
			if (!IsUpdating && !IsDirty && node.Visible && !IsHiddenByAncestor(node))
			{
				ProcessDescendantVisibilityChange(node, expand, node.VisibleIndex);
			}
		}

		internal bool ProcessVisibleStateChanged(UltraTreeNode node, bool visible)
		{
			if (IsUpdating)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (visible)
			{
				return Add(node);
			}
			return Remove(node);
		}

		internal bool Add(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (IsUpdating)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (node == null || IsDirty)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (IsHiddenByAncestor(node))
			{
				return true;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = VisibleNodes;
			int num = -1;
			UltraTreeNode parent = node.Parent;
			if (parent != null && parent.VisibleIndex < 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Dictionary<UltraTreeNode, int> dictionary = FlatList;
			int value = -1;
			if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(node, out value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num2 = ((parent != null) ? arrayList.IndexOf(parent) : (-1));
			num2++;
			int num3 = -1;
			int i = num2;
			for (int num4 = arrayList.Count - 1; i <= num4; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ((i > 0) ? (arrayList[i - 1] as UltraTreeNode) : null);
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode2 = arrayList[i] as UltraTreeNode;
				int value2 = -1;
				int value3 = -1;
				if (ultraTreeNode != null)
				{
					dictionary.TryGetValue(ultraTreeNode, out value2);
				}
				if (ultraTreeNode2 != null)
				{

		internal bool Remove(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (IsUpdating)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (node == null || IsDirty)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (IsHiddenByAncestor(node))
			{
				return true;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = VisibleNodes;
			int visibleIndex = node.VisibleIndex;

			if (visibleIndex == -1 || ultraTreeNode != node)
			{

				return false;
			}
			if (visibleIndex > -1 && node.HasNodes && node.Expanded)
			{
				ProcessDescendantVisibilityChange(node, visible: false, visibleIndex);
			}

			if (visibleIndex == -1 || ultraTreeNode != node)

		}

		private bool IsHiddenByAncestor(UltraTreeNode node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (node.Parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraTreeNode parent = node.Parent;
			if (!parent.Visible || !parent.Expanded)
			{
				return true;
			}
			parent = parent.Parent;
			return false;
		}

		private void ProcessDescendantVisibilityChange(UltraTreeNode parent, bool visible, int parentVisibleIndex)
		{
			try
			{
				if (IsDirty)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = 0;
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = null;
				if (!visible)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					int num2 = parentVisibleIndex + 1;
					int i = num2;
					for (int count = VisibleNodes.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						ultraTreeNode = VisibleNodes[i] as UltraTreeNode;
						if (ultraTreeNode.Level > parent.Level)
						{
							ultraTreeNode.VisibleIndex = -1;
							num++;
						}
						if (ultraTreeNode.Level <= parent.Level)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					VisibleNodes.RemoveRange(parentVisibleIndex + 1, num);
					if (flag)
					{
						for (int j = 0; j < VisibleNodes.Count; j++)
						{
							ultraTreeNode = VisibleNodes[j] as UltraTreeNode;
							ultraTreeNode.VisibleIndex = j;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						int k = parentVisibleIndex + 1;
						for (int count2 = VisibleNodes.Count; k < count2; k++)
						{
							ultraTreeNode = VisibleNodes[k] as UltraTreeNode;
							ultraTreeNode.VisibleIndex = k;
						}
					}
					DirtyScrollbars();
				}
				else
				{
					num += GetNumberOfDescendants(parent);
					ArrayList list = new ArrayList(num);
					GetViewableDescendantNodes(parent, ref list);
					int descendantCount = GetDescendantCount(parentVisibleIndex);
					if (descendantCount >= 0)
					{
						VisibleNodes.RemoveRange(parentVisibleIndex + 1, descendantCount);
					}
					VisibleNodes.InsertRange(parentVisibleIndex + 1, list);
					for (int l = parentVisibleIndex + 1; l < VisibleNodes.Count; l++)
					{
						ultraTreeNode = VisibleNodes[l] as UltraTreeNode;
						ultraTreeNode.VisibleIndex = l;
					}
					DirtyScrollbars();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isScrollSizeDirty = true;
				DirtyMaxTopNodeVisibleIndex();
				if (!visible)
				{

				}
			}
		}

		private int GetDescendantCount(int parentVisibleIndex)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = VisibleNodes;
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = arrayList[parentVisibleIndex] as UltraTreeNode;
			int num = parentVisibleIndex + 1;
			int count = arrayList.Count;

				if (ultraTreeNode2.Level <= ultraTreeNode.Level)
				{
					return i - num;
				}
			}
			return count - num;
		}

		private void DirtyScrollbars()
		{
			maxTopNodeVisibleIndex = -1;
			treeControl.ScrollbarControl.SetHScrollbarDirty(dirty: true);

		private int CalculateMaxTopNodeVisibleIndex()
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = VisibleNodes;
			int count = arrayList.Count;
			int height = treeControl.ViewableArea.Height;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = count - 1;
			int num3 = count;
			for (int num4 = count - 1; num4 >= 0; num4--)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = arrayList[num4] as UltraTreeNode;
				int itemHeightResolvedWithSpacing = ultraTreeNode.ItemHeightResolvedWithSpacing;
				num += itemHeightResolvedWithSpacing;
				if (num <= height)
				{
					num3--;
				}
				else if (num > height)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			num3 = Math.Min(num3, count - 1);
			num3 = Math.Max(num3, 0);
			ViewStyle viewStyleResolved = treeControl.ViewStyleResolved;
			if (viewStyleResolved != ViewStyle.Grid && viewStyleResolved != ViewStyle.FreeForm)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			for (; num3 < count; num3++)
			{
				num = 0;
				for (int i = num3; i < count; i++)
				{
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode2 = arrayList[i] as UltraTreeNode;
					int itemHeightResolvedWithSpacing2 = ultraTreeNode2.ItemHeightResolvedWithSpacing;
					int num5 = (ultraTreeNode2.DisplaysHeaderAreaHelper(num3) ? ultraTreeNode2.DisplayColumnSetResolved.LayoutManager.HeaderAreaSize.Height : 0);
					num += itemHeightResolvedWithSpacing2 + num5;
					if (num > height)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if (num <= height)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			num2 = Math.Min(num3, count - 1);
			return Math.Max(num3, 0);
		}

		internal void DirtyMaxTopNodeVisibleIndex()
		{
			maxTopNodeVisibleIndex = -1;
		}

		internal void VerifyScrollBoundsForTopNode()
		{
			VerifyScrollBoundsForTopNode(treeControl.ScrollBoundsResolved);
		}

		internal void VerifyScrollBoundsForTopNode(ScrollBounds scrollBounds, bool scrollToTopNodeInScrollToFill = false)
		{
			if (VisibleNodes.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (scrollBounds)
			{
			case ScrollBounds.ScrollToFill:
			{
				int num = MaxTopNodeVisibleIndex;
				int num2 = ((treeControl.TopNode != null) ? treeControl.TopNode.VisibleIndex : (-1));
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					num2 = num;
					treeControl.TopNode = VisibleNodes[num] as UltraTreeNode;
				}
				if (scrollToTopNodeInScrollToFill)
				{
					treeControl.ScrollbarControl.VScrollPosition = treeControl.TopNode.VisibleIndex;
				}
				else if (-1 != num2)
				{
					treeControl.ScrollbarControl.VScrollPosition = num2;
				}
				break;
			}
			case ScrollBounds.ScrollToLastItem:
			{
				UltraTreeNode topNode = treeControl.TopNode;
				int vScrollPosition = topNode.VisibleIndex;
				Size size = treeControl.ViewableArea.Size;
				if (ScrollSize.Height <= size.Height)
				{
					vScrollPosition = 0;
				}
				treeControl.ScrollbarControl.VScrollPosition = vScrollPosition;
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private static void PopulateFlatList(TreeNodesCollection nodesCollection, ref Dictionary<UltraTreeNode, int> list)
		{
			int num = nodesCollection?.Count ?? 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = nodesCollection[i];
				list.Add(ultraTreeNode, list.Count);
				if (ultraTreeNode.HasNodes)
				{
					PopulateFlatList(ultraTreeNode.Nodes, ref list);
				}
			}
		}
	}

			}
		}

		internal UltraTreePrintControl PrintControl
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyNotDisposed();
				if (PrintCacheInstance != null)
				{
					return printCache.PrintControl;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal UltraTree Tree
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyNotDisposed();
				if (PrintCacheInstance != null)
				{
					return printCache.Tree;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasTree
		{
			get
			{
				if (printDocument != null)
				{
					return printDocument.Tree != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal PrintCache PrintCacheInstance
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyNotDisposed();
				if (printCache == null)
				{
					printCache = new PrintCache(this);
				}
				return printCache;
			}
		}

		internal UltraTreePrintDocument PrintDocument => printDocument;

		internal int? TotalNumberOfPages
		{
			get
			{
				if (printInfo == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return printInfo.TotalNumberOfPages;
			}
		}

		internal PrintManager(UltraTreePrintDocument printDocument)
		{
			this.printDocument = printDocument;
		}

		internal bool BeginPrint(out string errorText)
		{
			UltraTree tree = Tree;
			UltraTreePrintDocument ultraTreePrintDocument = PrintDocument;
			printInfo = new PrintInfo(ultraTreePrintDocument, tree);
			if (!((Control)(object)PrintControl).Created)
			{
				((Control)(object)PrintControl).CreateControl();
			}
			((Control)(object)PrintControl).Font = printCache.BaseFont;
			DirtyPrintControlElements();
			CalculateAvailablePageBodySize();
			((Control)(object)PrintControl).Size = availablePageBodySize;
			VerifyControlSize();
			DirtyPrintControlElements();
			CalculateHorizontalPageInfos(out errorText);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(errorText))
			{
				return false;
			}
			CalculateVerticalPageInfo(out errorText);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(errorText))
			{
				return false;
			}
			printInfo.LogicalPageInfoCalculated = true;
			if (!printInfo.HasMorePagesToPrint)
			{
				errorText = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraTreePrintDocument_Error_NothingToPrint");
			}
			return printInfo.HasMorePagesToPrint;
		}

		private void CalculateAvailablePageBodySize()
		{
			PaperSize paperSize = ((PrintDocument)(object)printDocument).DefaultPageSettings.PaperSize;
			availablePageBodySize = new Size(paperSize.Width, paperSize.Height);
			if (printDocument != null && ((PrintDocument)(object)printDocument).DefaultPageSettings != null && ((PrintDocument)(object)printDocument).DefaultPageSettings.Landscape)
			{
				availablePageBodySize = new Size(paperSize.Height, paperSize.Width);
			}
			availablePageBodySize = ((UltraPrintDocument)printDocument).CalculateAvailablePageSize(availablePageBodySize);
			availablePageBodySize.Width -= ((PrintDocument)(object)printDocument).DefaultPageSettings.Margins.Right + ((PrintDocument)(object)printDocument).DefaultPageSettings.Margins.Left;
			availablePageBodySize.Height -= ((PrintDocument)(object)printDocument).DefaultPageSettings.Margins.Bottom + ((PrintDocument)(object)printDocument).DefaultPageSettings.Margins.Top;
		}

		internal void PrintPageStart(PagePrintingEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		internal void PrintPage(PrintPageEventArgs e)
		{
			InitializeForPrintPage(e.MarginBounds);
			Print(e);
		}

		internal void PrintPageEnd(PagePrintedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!e.ReprintPage)
			{
				printInfo.AdvanceToNextLogicalPage();
			}
			if (printInfo.HasMorePagesToPrint)
			{
				e.HasMorePages = true;
			}
		}

		internal void EndPrint()
		{
			FreeState();
		}

		internal Graphics GetMeasurementGraphics()
		{
			VerifyNotDisposed();
			return PrintCacheInstance.MeasurementGraphics;
		}

		private void FreeState()
		{
			if (printCache != null)
			{
				printCache.Dispose();
				printCache = null;
			}
			if (printInfo != null)
			{
				printInfo = null;
			}
		}

		private void VerifyControlSize()
		{
			Size placeHolderSize = GetPlaceHolderSize();
			Control tree = (Control)(object)Tree;
			if (tree != null)
			{
				tree.Size = placeHolderSize;
			}
		}

		private void DirtyPrintControlElements()
		{
			if (PrintCacheInstance.WasPrintControlCreated)
			{
				UIElement mainUIElement = (UIElement)(object)((IUltraControlElement)PrintControl).MainUIElement;
				if (mainUIElement != null)
				{
					mainUIElement.DirtyChildElements(false);
				}
			}
		}

		private Size GetPlaceHolderSize()
		{
			UIElement mainUIElement = (UIElement)(object)((IUltraControlElement)PrintControl).MainUIElement;
			if (mainUIElement != null)
			{
				mainUIElement.VerifyChildElements(true);
				UIElement placeHolderElement = GetPlaceHolderElement(mainUIElement);
				if (placeHolderElement != null)
				{
					return placeHolderElement.Rect.Size;
				}
			}
			return Size.Empty;
		}

		private static UIElement GetPlaceHolderElement(UIElement element)
		{
			if (element.HasChildElements)
			{
				UIElementEnumerator enumerator = element.ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
						if (current is TreeControlPlaceHolderUIElement)
						{
							return current;
						}
						if (current.HasChildElements)
						{
							UIElement placeHolderElement = GetPlaceHolderElement(current);
							if (placeHolderElement != null)
							{
								return placeHolderElement;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void OnControlCreated(UltraControlBase control)
		{
			if (control is UltraTreePrintControl)
			{
				((Control)(object)control).Font = printCache.BaseFont;
				((Control)(object)control).BackColor = Color.White;
				control.DrawFilter = printDocument.DrawFilter;
				control.CreationFilter = printDocument.CreationFilter;
			}
			else if (control is UltraTree)
			{
				printDocument.OnTreeControlCreated((UltraTree)(object)control);
			}
		}

		private void CalculateHorizontalPageInfos(out string errorText)
		{
			errorText = null;
			UltraTree tree = Tree;
			int width = ((UIElement)tree.UIElement).RectInsideBorders.Width;
			List<HorizontalPrintPageInfo> list = new List<HorizontalPrintPageInfo>();
			int num = ((IScrollableControl)tree).MaxSize(ScrollBarType.horizontal);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i += width)
			{
				HorizontalPrintPageInfo item = new HorizontalPrintPageInfo(i);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(errorText))
			{
				printInfo.HorizontalPrintPageInfos = list;
			}
		}

		private void CalculateVerticalPageInfo(out string errorText)
		{
			UltraTree tree = Tree;
			ArrayList visibleNodesArray = tree.VisibleNodesArray;
			int num = 0;
			int count = visibleNodesArray.Count;
			UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode = ((visibleNodesArray.Count > 0) ? (visibleNodesArray[0] as UltraTreeNode) : null);
			if (ultraTreeNode == null)
			{
				errorText = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraTreePrintDocument_Error_NothingToPrint");
				return;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			while (flag)
			{
				VerticalPrintPageInfo item = new VerticalPrintPageInfo(ultraTreeNode);
				printInfo.VerticalPrintPageInfos.Add(item);
				tree.TopNode = ultraTreeNode;
				((UIElement)tree.UIElement).VerifyChildElements();
				if (!(((UIElement)tree.UIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(NodeClientAreaUIElement)) is NodeClientAreaUIElement nodeClientAreaUIElement))
				{
					errorText = null;
					return;
				}
				flag = false;
				for (int i = num; i < count; i++)
				{
					UltraTreeNode ultraTreeNode2 = visibleNodesArray[i] as UltraTreeNode;
					UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)ultraTreeNode2.UIElement;
					if (uIElement.Rect.Bottom >= ((UIElement)nodeClientAreaUIElement).Rect.Bottom)
					{
						if (i != num)
						{
							ultraTreeNode = ultraTreeNode2;
							num = i;
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
						errorText = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraTreePrintDocument_Error_NodeIsTooTall", ultraTreeNode.Text);
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			errorText = null;
		}

		private void InitializeForPrintPage(Rectangle pageBodyRect)
		{
			if (printInfo.HasMorePagesToPrint)
			{
				UltraTree tree = Tree;
				LogicalPrintPageInfo currentLogicalPrintPageInfo = printInfo.GetCurrentLogicalPrintPageInfo();
				HorizontalPrintPageInfo horizontalPrintPageInfo = currentLogicalPrintPageInfo.HorizontalPrintPageInfo;
				UltraTreeNode topNode = currentLogicalPrintPageInfo.VerticalPrintPageInfo.TopNode;
				tree.TopNode = topNode;
				tree.ScrollbarControl.SetHScrollPosition(horizontalPrintPageInfo.HScrollPosition);
				DirtyPrintControlElements();
			}
		}

		private void Print(PrintPageEventArgs e)
		{
			PrintControlHelper((UltraControlBase)(object)PrintControl, e.MarginBounds, e);
			PrintPlaceHolders((UIElement)(object)((IUltraControlElement)PrintControl).MainUIElement, e);
		}

		private void PrintControlHelper(UltraControlBase control, Rectangle rect, PrintPageEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!((Control)(object)control).Created)
			{
				((Control)(object)control).CreateControl();
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = rect;
			float pageScale = e.Graphics.PageScale;
			((Control)(object)control).Size = rectangle.Size;
			((Control)(object)control).Location = Point.Empty;
			UIElement mainUIElement = (UIElement)(object)((IUltraControlElement)control).MainUIElement;
			mainUIElement.VerifyChildElements(true);
			e.Graphics.TranslateTransform(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y);
			mainUIElement.Print(e.Graphics, printDocument.ClipText);
			e.Graphics.TranslateTransform(-rectangle.X, -rectangle.Y);
			if (pageScale != e.Graphics.PageScale)
			{
				e.Graphics.PageScale = pageScale;
			}
		}

		private void PrintPlaceHolders(UIElement element, PrintPageEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!element.HasChildElements)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElementEnumerator enumerator = element.ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current is TreeControlPlaceHolderUIElement)
					{
						Rectangle rect = current.Rect;
						rect.Offset(e.MarginBounds.Left, e.MarginBounds.Top);
						PrintControlHelper((UltraControlBase)(object)printDocument.GetPlaceHolderControl(), rect, e);
					}
					else
					{
						PrintPlaceHolders(current, e);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			FreeState();
		}
	}

	internal class LogicalPrintPageInfo
	{
		private HorizontalPrintPageInfo horizontalPrintPageInfo;

		private VerticalPrintPageInfo verticalPrintPageInfo;

		public HorizontalPrintPageInfo HorizontalPrintPageInfo => horizontalPrintPageInfo;

		public VerticalPrintPageInfo VerticalPrintPageInfo => verticalPrintPageInfo;

		internal LogicalPrintPageInfo(HorizontalPrintPageInfo horizontalPrintPageInfo, VerticalPrintPageInfo verticalPrintPageInfo)
		{
			this.horizontalPrintPageInfo = horizontalPrintPageInfo;
			this.verticalPrintPageInfo = verticalPrintPageInfo;
		}
	}
	internal class PrintInfo
	{
		private List<HorizontalPrintPageInfo> horizontalPrintPageInfos;

		private List<VerticalPrintPageInfo> verticalPrintPageInfos;

		private bool logicalPageInfoCalculated;

		private bool hasMorePagesToPrint;

		private int currentHorizontalPageNumber;

		private int currentVerticalPageNumber;

		internal int CurrentHorizontalPageNumber => currentHorizontalPageNumber + 1;

		internal int CurrentVerticalPageNumber => currentVerticalPageNumber + 1;

		public bool HasMorePagesToPrint => hasMorePagesToPrint;

		private int HorizontalPageCount => HorizontalPrintPageInfos.Count;

		public List<HorizontalPrintPageInfo> HorizontalPrintPageInfos
		{
			get
			{
				if (horizontalPrintPageInfos == null)
				{
					horizontalPrintPageInfos = new List<HorizontalPrintPageInfo>();
				}
				return horizontalPrintPageInfos;
			}
			set
			{
				horizontalPrintPageInfos = value;
			}
		}

		public bool LogicalPageInfoCalculated
		{
			get
			{
				return logicalPageInfoCalculated;
			}
			set
			{
				logicalPageInfoCalculated = value;
				if (logicalPageInfoCalculated)
				{
					LogicalPrintPageInfo currentLogicalPrintPageInfo = GetCurrentLogicalPrintPageInfo();
					hasMorePagesToPrint = currentLogicalPrintPageInfo != null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal int TotalNumberOfPages
		{
			get
			{
				int horizontalPageCount = HorizontalPageCount;
				int verticalPageCount = VerticalPageCount;
				return verticalPageCount * horizontalPageCount;
			}
		}

		private int VerticalPageCount => VerticalPrintPageInfos.Count;

		public List<VerticalPrintPageInfo> VerticalPrintPageInfos
		{
			get
			{
				if (verticalPrintPageInfos == null)
				{
					verticalPrintPageInfos = new List<VerticalPrintPageInfo>();
				}
				return verticalPrintPageInfos;
			}
		}

		internal PrintInfo(UltraTreePrintDocument ultraTreePrintDocument, UltraTree tree)
		{
		}

		internal void AdvanceToNextLogicalPage()
		{
			AdvanceToNextHorizontalPage();
		}

		private void AdvanceToNextHorizontalPage()
		{
			currentHorizontalPageNumber++;
			if (currentHorizontalPageNumber < horizontalPrintPageInfos.Count)
			{
				hasMorePagesToPrint = true;
			}
			else
			{
				AdvanceToNextVerticalPage();
			}
		}

		private void AdvanceToNextVerticalPage()
		{
			currentVerticalPageNumber++;
			if (currentVerticalPageNumber < verticalPrintPageInfos.Count)
			{
				currentHorizontalPageNumber = 0;
				hasMorePagesToPrint = true;
			}
			else
			{
				hasMorePagesToPrint = false;
			}
		}

		private HorizontalPrintPageInfo GetCurrentHorizontalPageInfo()
		{
			if (currentHorizontalPageNumber < 0 || currentHorizontalPageNumber >= HorizontalPrintPageInfos.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return HorizontalPrintPageInfos[currentHorizontalPageNumber];
		}

		private VerticalPrintPageInfo GetCurrentVerticalPageInfo()
		{
			if (currentVerticalPageNumber < 0 || currentVerticalPageNumber >= VerticalPrintPageInfos.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return VerticalPrintPageInfos[currentVerticalPageNumber];
		}

		public LogicalPrintPageInfo GetCurrentLogicalPrintPageInfo()
		{
			HorizontalPrintPageInfo currentHorizontalPageInfo = GetCurrentHorizontalPageInfo();
			if (currentHorizontalPageInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			VerticalPrintPageInfo currentVerticalPageInfo = GetCurrentVerticalPageInfo();
			if (currentVerticalPageInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new LogicalPrintPageInfo(currentHorizontalPageInfo, currentVerticalPageInfo);
		}
	}

					((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
				}
			}
		}

		internal PrintManager PrintManager
		{
			get
			{

				}
				return document.PrintManager;
			}
		}

		protected override ControlUIElementBase ControlUIElement => (ControlUIElementBase)(object)controlElement;

			controlElement = new TreePrintControlUIElement(this);
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Win.UltraWinTree.Serialization
{
	public class Binder : Binder
	{
		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, SerializationFormatter = true)]
		public override Type BindToType(string assemblyName, string typeName)
		{
			if (assemblyName == null || !assemblyName.StartsWith("Infragistics.Win.UltraWinTree"))
			{
				return ((Binder)this).BindToType(assemblyName, typeName);
			}
			Type type = null;
			try
			{
				assemblyName = typeof(UltraTree).Assembly.FullName;
			}
			catch
			{
				assemblyName = "Infragistics4.Win.UltraWinTree.v21.1";
			}
			type = Type.GetType($"{typeName}, {assemblyName}");
			if (type == null)
			{
				return ((Binder)this).BindToType(assemblyName, typeName);
			}
			return type;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Shared
{
	internal sealed class SR
	{
		private static Infragistics.Shared.SR loader;

		private ResourceManager[] resources;

		private SR()
		{
			string text = "Infragistics.Win.UltraWinTree.strings";
			string[] array = text.Split(';');
			int num = 0;
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text2 in array2)
			{
				if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			resources = new ResourceManager[num];
			Assembly assembly = GetType().Assembly;
			int num2 = 0;
			string[] array3 = array;
			foreach (string text3 in array3)
			{
				if (text3 != null && text3.Length > 0)
				{
					resources[num2++] = new ResourceManager(text3, assembly);
				}
			}
		}

		private static Infragistics.Shared.SR GetLoader()
		{
			if (loader == null)
			{
				lock (typeof(Infragistics.Shared.SR))
				{
					if (loader == null)
					{
						loader = new Infragistics.Shared.SR();
					}
				}
			}
			return loader;
		}

		public static string GetString(string name)
		{
			return GetString(null, name);
		}

		public static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetString(null, name, args);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetString(culture, name, null);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: true, culture, name, args);
		}

		private static string GetStringHelper(bool allowCustomizedStrings, CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (allowCustomizedStrings)
			{
				text = global::ResourceCustomizerLocator.Customizer.GetCustomizedString(name);
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				Infragistics.Shared.SR sR = GetLoader();
				if (sR == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				text = sR.GetString(name, culture);
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = string.Empty;
				}
			}
			if (args != null && args.Length != 0 && text.Length > 2)
			{
				try
				{
					text = string.Format(null, text, args);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string GetString(string name, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ResourceManager[] array = resources;
			foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
			{
				string text = resourceManager.GetString(name, culture);
				if (text != null)
				{
					return text;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(null, name);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(null, name, args);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(culture, name, null);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: false, culture, name, args);
		}

		public static object GetObject(string name)
		{
			return GetObject(null, name);
		}

		public static object GetObject(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetLoader()?.GetObject(name, culture);
		}

		private object GetObject(string name, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ResourceManager[] array = resources;
			foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
			{
				object obj = resourceManager.GetObject(name, culture);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					return obj;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
